## 🐞 Bugs & Logic Issues

 * **A participant can set `best_streak` with future dates and a zero value (2026-10-27).** `POST /api/community-challenges/:id/entries` requires a JWT and then replaces body `user_id` with `CurrentUser()` (`community-group-challenges.controller.ts` 33–34, 651–658). `CreateChallengeEntryDto.entry_date` is optional `@IsDateString()` and has no maximum date (`community-challenge.dto.ts` 194–196). `value` only has `@Min(0)` (198–200), so `0` is valid. The handler writes that date and value with no comparison to today or to the challenge goal (689–691, 725–734). The streak query loads every `entry_date` for that user, groups consecutive dates, and takes one group with `LIMIT 1` and no `ORDER BY` (737–754). It does not require the newest date to be today, and it does not look at `value`. `best_streak` becomes `GREATEST(best_streak, current_streak)` and `last_entry_date` is set to the client date (761–768). `GET /api/community-challenges/:id` returns `p.*` for the top 10 participants ordered by `best_streak` (525–537). A public challenge id is available from `GET /api/community-challenges`, which keeps `is_public` when `creator_id` is omitted (232–238). Concrete trigger: obtain any JWT, join a public challenge, then post one entry per calendar day from today through today plus 30 with `value: 0`. The same `GET :id` lists that user first. The 2026-09-11 row is the private-challenge join, which does not consult `is_public`. The 2026-10-09 row is `GET daily-tracker` returning another user's `notes`. This row is the caller's own streak. Recommendation: Accept `entry_date` only when it is the server's current local date, or a short lookback the product defines. Count a day only when `value` meets the goal. Compute `current_streak` from today backward and stop at the first gap.

 * **Item search calls `unnest` on a text column (2026-10-16, re-verified 2026-10-27).** `listItems` adds `unnest(i.tags)` when `search` is present (`items-delivery.service.ts` 163–174). `items.tags` is `TEXT` (`schema.sql` 1007). The list catch returns `error.message` (`items-delivery.controller.ts` 172–176). Recommendation: Search the text column with `ILIKE`. Return a generic error.

 * **Hierarchy remove commits inside the helper (2026-10-16, re-verified 2026-10-27).** `manageHierarchy` begins a transaction (`user-hierarchy.service.ts` 883). `manageHierarchyExecuteRemove` commits at line 828 before the notification insert. Recommendation: One transaction owned by the caller.

 * **Standing logic defects re-verified at the same lines.** Reserve does not lock the item (`items-delivery.service.ts` 351–410). Items-delivery insert names columns the table does not have (654–676). `GET /api/users` and `GET :id` disagree on money counters (`user-profile.service.ts` 148–149 vs 510–511). Task create and patch log the raw body. Notification `listAll` has no cap. Daily-tracker dates are caller-sized. Admin-file search drops the folder filter. Time-log `ON CONFLICT` replaces `actual_hours`. Hours-report failures return `success: true`. CRM and community-members still run DDL on the request path. Ride booking approval has no seat lock (`rides.controller.ts` 505–555). `GET /place-details` interpolates `place_id` (`places.controller.ts` 75) and `GET /search-stats` lists search strings (88–91, 139–166). Comment handlers return `error.message`. The rate limiter fails open (`rate-limit.service.ts` 87–89, 106–111). `POST /api/stats/track-visit` has no guard (373–401). `loginUser` does not read `is_active`. `anonymity_level` is still absent. Recommendation: Keep the fix named on each 2026-10-16 bug row.

## 🚨 Critical Vulnerabilities

 * **Any JWT reassigns another user's open tasks through hierarchy remove (2026-10-16).** `POST /api/users/:id/hierarchy/manage` has `JwtAuthGuard` and never reads `req.user` (`users.controller.ts` 55–62). SRS §2.2.3 lists that route among endpoints that require `JwtAuthGuard` and describes `parent_manager_id` as the reporting line. The body is `{ action, managerId }` only. `manageHierarchy` blocks the call when the target email is the root admin mailbox, then does not compare `managerId` to the session (`user-hierarchy.service.ts` 871–901). `action: "add"` checks for a cycle and runs `UPDATE user_profiles SET parent_manager_id = $1 WHERE id = $2` (705–770). The caller then `COMMIT`s (903–914). `action: "remove"` loads the target and returns an error unless `parent_manager_id` equals body `managerId` (783–789). It then sets `parent_manager_id` to null (806–813) and, when the target still has tasks whose status is not `done` or `archived`, runs `UPDATE tasks SET assignees = array_replace(assignees::UUID[], $1::UUID, $2::UUID)` with the target id and `managerId` (794–825). That helper `COMMIT`s (828). `schema.sql` defines `tasks.assignees` as `UUID[]` (445). A later insert into `notifications` copies task ids and the target name (830–855) and is not required for the assignee write. Unguarded `GET /api/users` returns ids (`users.controller.ts` 135–149). `POST /api/users/register` and `POST /api/users/resolve-id` still mint a Bearer. Concrete trigger: obtain any JWT, `POST /api/users/<target>/hierarchy/manage` with `{ "action": "add", "managerId": "<caller or any other profile id>" }`, then the same path with `{ "action": "remove", "managerId": "<that same id>" }`. Open tasks that listed the target now list that id. NFR §3.5 requires omitting fields the caller may not see. §2.11.4 treats assignees as task-management data under the admin task API. The 2026-09-25 row is the parent-pointer update at 871–914 and the `set-manager` skip when `requestingUserId` is omitted. The 2026-10-10 row is `GET /api/collections/notifications`, which can read the JSON this remove writes. The 2026-10-11 and 2026-10-12 rows are `POST /api/tasks` and `PATCH /api/tasks/:id`. This row is the assignee rewrite on the hierarchy route. - File: `apps/api/src/controllers/users.controller.ts` (55–62); `apps/api/src/services/user-hierarchy.service.ts` (705–772, 775–855, 871–932); `apps/api/src/database/schema.sql` (41–66, 445) -> Action: Bind `managerId` checks to `req.user.userId`. Require that subject to already manage the target, or require `AdminAuthGuard`. Do not `array_replace` assignees from a client id. Move task transfer into an admin task use case that records the acting user.

 * **Unauthenticated reserve writes a delivery request as any user id (2026-10-15, re-verified 2026-10-16).** `ItemsDeliveryController` has no `UseGuards` (`items-delivery.controller.ts` 25–26). `POST :id/reserve` and `POST requests` call `createItemRequest` (200–214), which inserts body `requester_id`, `message`, and `meeting_location` (348–410). The `requester_id` foreign key stays commented out (`schema.sql` 1027–1043). The insert does not change `items.status`. A driver error is returned as `error.message` (412–417). - File: `apps/api/src/controllers/items-delivery.controller.ts` (25–26, 200–214); `apps/api/src/controllers/items-delivery.service.ts` (348–420) -> Action: Require `JwtAuthGuard`. Bind `requester_id` to `req.user.userId`. Do not return the driver error.

 * **Unauthenticated hard delete removes any item and cascades to its feed post (2026-10-14, re-verified 2026-10-16).** `DELETE /api/items-delivery/:id` runs `DELETE FROM items WHERE id = $1` (`items-delivery.service.ts` 319–326). `schema.sql` adds `posts_item_id_fkey` with `ON DELETE CASCADE` (652–658). `PUT :id` still rewrites `title`, `price`, `status`, and `location` (216–239). - File: `apps/api/src/controllers/items-delivery.controller.ts` (25–26, 140–196); `apps/api/src/controllers/items-delivery.service.ts` (99–326) -> Action: Require `JwtAuthGuard`. Delete only when the subject owns the item. Prefer the dedicated-items soft delete.

 * **Unauthenticated user directory returns lifetime donation totals, volunteer hours, and manager email (2026-10-13, re-verified 2026-10-16).** `GET /api/users` has no `UseGuards` (`users.controller.ts` 135–149). `getUsers` selects the real counters, email, roles, last activity, and manager email (`user-profile.service.ts` 502–537, 549–578). `GET /api/users/:id` forces both counters to `0` (148–149). - File: `apps/api/src/controllers/users.controller.ts` (121–149); `apps/api/src/services/user-profile.service.ts` (124–159, 439–598) -> Action: Drop those fields from the public list. Cap `limit`. Return the real counters only to that user or an admin.

 * **Admin JWT reassigns any task as the stored creator, or as anyone when `created_by` is null (2026-10-12, re-verified 2026-10-16).** `PATCH /api/tasks/:id` never reads `req.user` (`tasks.controller.ts` 466–468). The hierarchy check runs only inside `if (taskCreatorId)` (`tasks-patch-mutation.service.ts` 307–322). - File: `apps/api/src/tasks/tasks.controller.ts` (466–529); `apps/api/src/tasks/tasks-patch-mutation.service.ts` (198–265, 279–385) -> Action: Bind the assignee check to `req.user.userId` and reject the update when `created_by` is null.

Cap the date span and the row count.

 * **Any JWT overwrites another user's task hours (2026-10-07, re-verified 2026-10-16).** `POST /api/tasks/:id/log-hours` writes body `user_id` and replaces `actual_hours` (`tasks.controller.ts` 384–446). - File: `apps/api/src/tasks/tasks.controller.ts` (384–464) -> Action: Bind `user_id` to `req.user.userId`. Do not return `error.message`.

SRS §2.11.4 names `AdminAuthGuard`. - File: `apps/api/src/tasks/tasks.controller.ts` (568–586) -> Action: Require `AdminAuthGuard`, or allow the call only when the JWT subject is that manager.

 * **Unauthenticated CRM contact book (2026-10-05, re-verified 2026-10-16).** `CrmController` has no guard. `GET` is `SELECT *` with no `LIMIT`. `POST` / `PATCH` / `DELETE` write any id. The first request runs `CREATE TABLE` (`crm.controller.ts` 38, 48–268). - File: `apps/api/src/controllers/crm.controller.ts` -> Action: Require `AdminAuthGuard`. Move DDL off the request path.

Omit `contact_info` unless the caller is an admin.

Bind `owner_id` and `posts.author_id` to `req.user.userId`.

Check the subject before either write. Use one transaction.

The pull check fails open at line 149. - File: `apps/api/src/controllers/users.controller.ts` (64–88) -> Action: Bind the actor to `req.user.userId` and require `AdminAuthGuard`. Fail closed on the pull check.

Delete uses query `user_id` (2053–2106). - File: `apps/api/src/controllers/posts.controller.ts` -> Action: Bind the actor to `req.user.userId`.

Stop minting tokens from `resolve-id`.

No `trust proxy` exists under `apps/api`. - File: `apps/api/src/controllers/rate-limit.controller.ts` -> Action: Do not mount `RateLimitController` on deployed builds.

 * **Unauthenticated plant of the shared JOSE JWT lockout (2026-09-23, re-verified 2026-10-16).** `POST /rate-limit/custom` can write `blocked:api_access:<JOSE prefix>` (`rate-limit.service.ts` 269–275; `jwt-auth.guard.ts` 96–114). - File: `apps/api/src/controllers/rate-limit.controller.ts` (233–248) -> Action: Remove the route from deployed builds. Key the bucket on the verified user id after `verifyToken`.

The limiter fails open when Redis throws (`rate-limit.service.ts` 87–89, 106–111). - File: `apps/api/src/auth/guards/jwt-auth.guard.ts` (96–134) -> Action: Key the bucket on the verified user id. Fail closed on auth routes when the limiter cannot be read.

Guest send accepts `sender_id` (456–570). - File: `apps/api/src/controllers/chat.controller.ts` (45–46, 246–669) -> Action: Require JWT. Bind the sender and the reader to `req.user.userId`.

 * **Unauthenticated Redis session-key harvest (2026-09-14, re-verified 2026-10-16).** `GET /session/stats` lists `session:*` keys. `GET /session/validate/:sessionId` returns the session blob. `DELETE /session/logout-all/:userId` drops those sessions (`session.controller.ts` 136–299). - File: `apps/api/src/auth/controllers/session.controller.ts` -> Action: Remove `/session` from deployed builds or require admin JWT.

Follow uses body `follower_id` (`user-follow.service.ts` 19–34, 96–98). - File: `apps/api/src/controllers/posts.controller.ts` -> Action: Bind actors to `req.user.userId`.

 * **Unauthenticated `POST /api/users/resolve-id` mints a JWT (re-verified 2026-10-16).** A known email, `google_id`, or `firebase_uid` returns an access and refresh pair (`users.controller.ts` 183–188; `user-auth.service.ts` 270–342, 645–660). - File: `apps/api/src/controllers/users.controller.ts` (183–188) -> Action: Remove token minting from resolve-id. Require a verified ID token.

 * **Password-optional `/api/users/login` and root-admin bootstrap (re-verified 2026-10-16).** `loginUser` verifies argon2 only when both `password` and `password_hash` are truthy (`user-auth.service.ts` 223–231). Register with the committed fallback mailbox sets `admin` (101–102). - File: `apps/api/src/services/user-auth.service.ts` (97–139, 212–263) -> Action: Fail closed unless a password verifies. Never mutate roles before `argon2.verify`.

 * **Profile mass-assignment and unauthenticated profile reads (re-verified 2026-10-16).** `PUT /api/users/:id` accepts `password`, `roles`, and `firebase_uid` and is not bound to `req.user` (`users.controller.ts` 126–133). `GET :id` returns `phone`, `settings`, and `roles`, and it zeros the money and hours counters (`user-profile.service.ts` 126–158). - File: `apps/api/src/controllers/users.controller.ts` (121–163) -> Action: Bind `:id` to `req.user.userId` unless admin. Strip privileged fields from the public DTO.

 * **Other unguarded write surfaces and stats export (re-verified 2026-10-16).** Knowledge-link `POST` is public, matching SRS §2.3.3. `GET /api/stats/details/:statType` is JWT-only and `totalUsers` returns name, email, and city (`stats.controller.ts` 834–876). - File: `apps/api/src/controllers/stats.controller.ts` (834–876) -> Action: Add `JwtAuthGuard` (admin where appropriate).  * **Request-path `DROP TABLE ... CASCADE` (re-verified 2026-10-16).** `ensurePostsTable` drops `posts` when legacy columns are detected (`posts.controller.ts` 78, 309, 373–374). `DatabaseInit` drops donations and rides on startup when it treats the schema as legacy (`database.init.ts` 568, 670). - File: `apps/api/src/controllers/posts.controller.ts` (78, 309, 373–374) -> Action: Never DROP on a request path. Gate destructive DDL behind an offline migration.

Tracked JSON under `apps/api/data-backups/20251224-162421/` includes email, phone, and `password_hash`. `refreshAccessToken` copies `payload.roles` (`jwt.service.ts` 146–177). Firebase JWKS derives `aud` from the token (`firebase-admin.service.ts` 150–184). `/auth/google` can fall back to a client-supplied access token (`auth.controller.ts` 588–698). - File: `apps/api/railway.toml.dev` (34); `apps/api/src/main.ts` (149–218); `apps/api/data-backups/` -> Action: Rotate every fingerprinted credential. Purge backups from git history. Reload roles on refresh. Accept only verified ID tokens.

## 🐞 Bugs & Logic Issues

 * **Item search calls `unnest` on a text column and returns the driver error (2026-10-16).** `listItems` adds `unnest(i.tags)` when `search` is present (`items-delivery.service.ts` 163–174). `items.tags` is `TEXT` in `schema.sql` (1007) and in `database.init.ts` (395). `donations.tags` and `community_events.tags` are `TEXT[]` (586, 850) and are a different table. `GET /api/items-delivery` has no guard and the catch returns `error.message` (`items-delivery.controller.ts` 140–176). Concrete trigger: `GET /api/items-delivery?search=chair` with no `Authorization`. PostgreSQL rejects `unnest(text)`, the list does not return, and the client receives the driver message. Recommendation: Search `tags` with `ILIKE` on the text column, or store tags as `TEXT[]` in one migration and use that type in both writers. Return a generic error.

 * **Hierarchy remove commits inside the helper after the caller already began a transaction (2026-10-16).** `manageHierarchy` issues `BEGIN` (883). `manageHierarchyExecuteRemove` issues `COMMIT` (828) before the caller returns. The notification insert then uses the pool, outside that transaction (830–832). A notification failure is swallowed (856–859) after the assignee change has committed. Recommendation: One transaction owned by the caller. Commit only after the task update and the notification attempt policy are decided together.

 * **`POST :id/reserve` does not reserve the item, and two callers can both insert (2026-10-15, re-verified 2026-10-16).** `createItemRequest` checks `status = 'available'` and then inserts a `pending` row. It does not update `items.status` and it does not lock the item row (`items-delivery.service.ts` 351–410). Recommendation: Take `SELECT … FOR UPDATE` on the item, set `status` to `reserved` in the same transaction when the product means a hold, cap `message`, and return a generic error.

 * **`POST /api/items-delivery` writes columns the `items` table does not have (2026-10-14, re-verified 2026-10-16).** `insertItemRow` lists `images`, `tags`, `metadata`, and `expires_at` (`items-delivery.service.ts` 654–676). `schema.sql` (990–1017) and `DatabaseInit` (381–403) do not define `images`, `metadata`, or `expires_at`. `GET /api/items-delivery/requests` remains shadowed by `GET :id` (180 vs 216). Recommendation: Insert the columns the table has. Return a generic error. Declare `GET requests` before `GET :id`.

 * **The public directory and the profile read disagree on money fields, and the list has no cap (2026-10-13, re-verified 2026-10-16).** `getUsers` returns the stored counters (510–511). `getUserById` substitutes `0` for both (148–149). `parseInt(limit)` has no upper bound (485–488). `GET /api/users/:id/stats` still sums `donations.amount` with no guard (`user-stats.service.ts` 50–90, 140–147; `users.controller.ts` 160–162). Recommendation: Use one public projection. Cap `limit`. Keep the per-user money sum on an authenticated self or admin read.

 * **Task patch logs the raw body and the SQL parameters, and attributes the feed post to the new assignee (2026-10-12, re-verified 2026-10-16).** `JSON.stringify(body)` is written at info level (`tasks.controller.ts` 511–514). The mutation log includes the bound parameter list (`tasks-patch-mutation.service.ts` 339). Recommendation: Log only the task id after update. Bind `author_id` to `req.user.userId`.

 * **Task create logs the raw body and attributes the feed post to the spoofed creator (2026-10-11, re-verified 2026-10-16).** `JSON.stringify(body)` is written at info level (`tasks.controller.ts` 287). Recommendation: Log only the task id after insert. Bind `author_id` to `req.user.userId`.

 * **Notification listAll has no cap and logs the first JSON body (2026-10-10, re-verified 2026-10-16).** `listAll` returns every `data` blob and `console.log` writes `JSON.stringify(rows[0].data)` (`items.service.ts` 249–276). Recommendation: Paginate `listAll`. Do not log row bodies.

 * **Daily tracker date window is caller-sized and has no row cap (2026-10-09, re-verified 2026-10-16).** Supplied dates are bound as-is (`community-group-challenges.controller.ts` 300–316, 364–370). Recommendation: Require `CurrentUser()`, allow at most a fixed number of days, and paginate entries.

 * **Admin file search drops the folder filter and the list has no cap (2026-10-08, re-verified 2026-10-16).** `folder_path = $1` is added only when `search` is absent (`admin-files.controller.ts` 104–113). Recommendation: Keep the folder predicate. Cap and paginate the list.

 * **A planted time log replaces the total and unlocks mark-done (2026-10-07, re-verified 2026-10-16).** `ON CONFLICT` sets `actual_hours` to the new value (`tasks.controller.ts` 437–442). Recommendation: Add to `actual_hours` when the product means an increment. Return a generic error.

 * **Hours report hides failures and has no cycle cap (2026-10-06, re-verified 2026-10-16).** Both catch paths return `success: true` with zero hours (`tasks.controller.ts` 576–584; `tasks-read.service.ts` 313–323). Recommendation: Return `success: false` on query failure. Stop the walk at a fixed depth.

 * **CRM list has no cap, and a missing table is created on the public GET (2026-10-05, re-verified 2026-10-16).** `GET /api/crm` has no `LIMIT` (`crm.controller.ts` 137). Recommendation: Cap the list. Create `crm_contacts` in an offline migration.

 * **Community-members list replaces a shared trigger function (2026-10-04, re-verified 2026-10-16).** `ensureTable` executes `CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION update_updated_at_column()` (`community-members.controller.ts` 157–165). Recommendation: Leave the shared function untouched on the request path.

 * **Ride booking approval has no driver and no seat lock (2026-10-03, re-verified 2026-10-16).** `PUT /api/rides/bookings/:bookingId/status` sets the body status before it counts remaining seats (`rides.controller.ts` 505–555). Recommendation: `SELECT … FOR UPDATE` on the ride. Allowlist status. Approve only when the JWT subject is the driver.

 * **Places details interpolates `place_id` and publishes search terms (2026-10-02, re-verified 2026-10-16).** `GET /place-details` concatenates `place_id` into the Google URL (`places.controller.ts` 75). Recommendation: `encodeURIComponent` on `place_id`. Do not return the upstream error string.

 * **Companion item post is best-effort, and the caller chooses the item id (2026-10-01, re-verified 2026-10-16).** A failed `INSERT INTO posts` is caught and the dedicated item still commits (`dedicated-items.service.ts` 170–177). Recommendation: One transaction. Generate the id on the server.

 * **Item deliver commits `delivered` before the request permission check (2026-09-30, re-verified 2026-10-16).** `markAsDelivered` updates the item, then optionally calls `updateItemRequest` (`items-delivery.controller.ts` 247–258). Recommendation: One transaction. Check the JWT subject before either write.

 * **Money donation counters ignore sign, zero, and later edits (2026-09-29, re-verified 2026-10-16).** A truthy negative `amount` subtracts from `total_donations_amount`. `PUT` and `DELETE` leave both counters unchanged (`donations.controller.ts` 525–541, 698–780). Recommendation: Reject non-positive money amounts. Adjust both counters by the delta inside the same transaction.

 * **Anonymous hierarchy read can `ALTER TABLE` (2026-09-28, re-verified 2026-10-16).** `ensureSalarySeniorityColumns` adds `salary`, `seniority_start_date`, and `parent_manager_id` (`user-hierarchy.service.ts` 436–483). Recommendation: Apply those columns in an offline migration.

 * **Hierarchy pull check fails open (2026-09-27, re-verified 2026-10-16).** `assertRequesterMayPullTargetUnderSelf` returns `{ ok: true }` at line 149 when neither ancestor check matches. Recommendation: Default to deny.

 * **Comment handlers return `error.message` (re-verified 2026-10-16).** Update, delete, and list catch blocks interpolate the driver message (`posts.controller.ts` 1803–1805, 2042–2045, 2134–2137). `GET /api/posts` does the same (1013–1018). Recommendation: Return a generic error and log the driver message server-side.

 * **`GET /rate-limit/stats` lists every limiter key with no auth (re-verified 2026-10-16).** `getRateLimitStats` runs `KEYS rate_limit:*` and `KEYS blocked:*` (`rate-limit.service.ts` 238–256). Recommendation: Remove the route from deployed builds.

 * **Rate limiter fails open when Redis errors (re-verified 2026-10-16).** `checkRateLimit` returns `allowed: true` if the block read or the counter read throws (`rate-limit.service.ts` 87–89, 106–111). Recommendation: Fail closed on auth routes.

 * **Unauthenticated `POST /api/stats/track-visit` inflates production metrics (re-verified 2026-10-16).** No guard. Increments `community_stats.site_visits` (373–401). Recommendation: Require a bot-resistant token, or drop the public increment.

 * **Items-delivery static route is shadowed (re-verified 2026-10-16).** `GET /api/items-delivery/:id` is declared before `GET requests` (180–223), so the request list is captured as an item id. Dedicated-items `GET :id` still shadows `GET search` (69 vs 166). Recommendation: Declare static routes before parameterized routes.

 * **`loginUser` and `JwtAuthGuard` never consult `user_profiles.is_active` (re-verified 2026-10-16).** Deactivated rows can still obtain a session via email-only login or an existing refresh token. Recommendation: Fail closed on `is_active = false`.

 * **Anonymity filtering is specified and not implemented (re-verified 2026-10-16).** SRS §2.5.7 / NFR §3.2 require server-side redaction for `anonymity_level < 4`. The column is still absent (0 matches under `apps/`). Recommendation: Add the column and the feed projection.

## 🏗️ Architecture & Clean Code

 * **No Domain / Application / Infrastructure folders** under `apps/` or `packages/` (count 0). The target in `docs/SSOT/CODE_QUALITY/layers-and-boundaries.md` is Infrastructure → Application → Domain. The monorepo remains NestJS feature folders plus React Native screens. `packages/` still only contains `config-eslint`. The closest pure islands remain `apps/api/src/tasks/task-completion-participants.ts`, `tasks-validation.ts`, `tasks-query-params.ts`, and `tasks.types.ts`. `tasks-permissions.service.ts` imports `pg`. `UserHierarchyService` imports `pg` and both rewrites `parent_manager_id` and `tasks.assignees` from a controller that never passes the session.

 * **Fat HTTP layer owns SQL and policy.** Largest API files: `posts.controller.ts` (2741), `stats.controller.ts` (1709), `user-hierarchy.service.ts` (1675), `database.init.ts` (1374), `community-group-challenges.controller.ts` (1097), `donations.controller.ts` (892), `chat.controller.ts` (813), `rides.controller.ts` (779). `items-delivery.service.ts` is 748 lines and owns the hard delete, the mismatched insert, the request insert, and the `unnest` search. `user-profile.service.ts` is 600 lines and owns both the public directory SQL and the profile read that zeros the counters.

 * **Task assignee type disagrees with the SRS.** §2.11.4 documents `assignees` as `TEXT[]`. `schema.sql` creates `UUID[]` (445). The hierarchy remove casts to `UUID[]` (819–822). One column type should be chosen in the schema and the SRS together.

 * **Privilege checks disagree inside the same product.** `DedicatedItemsService` soft-deletes and hides `is_deleted` rows. `ItemsDeliveryService` hard-deletes the same table, lists those rows, and accepts a delivery request with no session. Notifications `validateOwnership` compares `:userId` to `req.user.userId`. The collections controller never reads a session. Hierarchy `set-manager` checks an admin id only when the client sends one. Hierarchy `manage` never checks an actor, and its remove path writes the tasks table.

 * **Two notification stores, one of them generic.** SRS §2.9.1 names both `user_notifications` and the JSONB `notifications` table. The guarded controller uses `user_notifications`. The unguarded collection name `notifications` uses the JSONB table created by `tasks-schema.service.ts`. Hierarchy remove writes that JSONB table after it commits the assignee change.

 * **Two item writers, one table, plus a request table with no owner session.** SRS §2.6.2 and §2.6.3 both persist items. Dedicated items insert `image_base64` and text `tags`. Items delivery inserts `images`, `metadata`, and `expires_at`, searches `tags` with `unnest`, and `createItemRequest` inserts into `item_requests`. `schema.sql` matches the dedicated-items item insert and a `TEXT` tags column. The request foreign key is commented out.

 * **Database design and the community-members table disagree.** SRS database design lists `email` and `phone` columns on `community_members` (`docs/SSOT/SRS/06-database-design.md`). `schema.sql` stores one `contact_info` JSONB object (1072–1077).

 * **CRM table and admin file table are absent from the committed schema.** `schema.sql` and `docs/SSOT/SRS/06-database-design.md` do not define `crm_contacts` or `general_files`. `CrmController.ensureTable` and `AdminFilesController.ensureTable` create them on the first request.

 * **Positive in-folder contrasts (do not regress):** `/api/notifications` already uses `JwtAuthGuard` and `validateOwnership`; admin-files POST and DELETE already use `AdminAuthGuard`; community-group challenges bind the creator on create, join, entry, PUT, and DELETE; personal challenges scope timer reads and updates to `CurrentUser()` and keep `PUT` columns on a class-validator DTO; knowledge contribution-request binds `req.user.userId`; sync user/all/status use `AdminAuthGuard`; authenticated chat send/read checks `ANY(participants)` when a JWT is present; `/session/login` requires argon2 once the shared limiter allows the call; item list `ORDER BY` uses an allowlisted column; ride list `ORDER BY` uses an allowlisted column; community-challenge `sort_order` is only `ASC` or `DESC`; collection names are checked against `ALLOWED_COLLECTIONS` before SQL; `canAssignToUser` fails closed when the hierarchy query throws. `DedicatedItemsService` already soft-deletes and filters `is_deleted`. Places autocomplete encodes its query string. Admin-files search binds `ILIKE`.

 * **Operator matching workspace is specified and not implemented.** `OperatorAuthGuard` exists and there is no `/api/operator/*` module. Anonymity and matching-case tables remain SRS §10 gaps.

## 🚨 Critical Vulnerabilities

 * **Unauthenticated reserve writes a delivery request as any user id (2026-10-15).** `ItemsDeliveryController` has no `UseGuards` (`items-delivery.controller.ts` 25–26). SRS §2.6.3 lists `POST /api/items-delivery/:id/reserve` and `POST /api/items-delivery/requests` and does not name a guard. Both handlers call `createItemRequest` (200–214). The reserve parameter type is `Omit<CreateItemRequestDto, "item_id">`, which is erased at runtime, so the global `ValidationPipe` does not whitelist that body. `createItemRequest` reads `items.id`, `status`, and `owner_id` (352–356). It rejects the call only when the item is missing, the status is not `available`, the body `requester_id` equals `owner_id`, or that pair already has a `pending` row (359–386). It then inserts `item_id`, `requester_id`, `message`, `proposed_time`, `delivery_method`, and `meeting_location` and returns the new row (388–410). `schema.sql` stores `meeting_location` as JSONB and leaves the `requester_id` foreign key commented out (1027–1043). `database.init.ts` creates the same columns (934–950). A failed insert returns `error.message` (412–417). `GET /api/items-delivery` is unguarded and selects `i.*`, including `owner_id` (109–123), so the caller can pick a requester id that is not the owner. Concrete trigger: `GET /api/items-delivery` with no `Authorization`, then `POST /api/items-delivery/<id>/reserve` with a UUID in `requester_id`, a `message`, and a `meeting_location` object. The row is stored under that requester id. The item status stays `available` because this insert does not update `items`. NFR §3.5 requires omitting fields the caller may not see. The 2026-09-30 bullet is `POST :id/deliver` and `PUT requests/:requestId?userId=`, which trusts the query id and lets `completed` set `items.status` to `delivered`. The 2026-10-14 bullet is `DELETE :id`. This bullet is the insert. - File: `apps/api/src/controllers/items-delivery.controller.ts` (25–26, 200–214); `apps/api/src/controllers/items-delivery.service.ts` (348–420); `apps/api/src/database/schema.sql` (1027–1043); `apps/api/src/database/database.init.ts` (934–950) -> Action: Require `JwtAuthGuard` on reserve and request create. Bind `requester_id` to `req.user.userId` and reject a mismatched client id. Require `requester_id` to reference `user_profiles`. Cap `message`. Do not return the driver error.

 * **Unauthenticated hard delete removes any item and cascades to its feed post (2026-10-14, re-verified 2026-10-15).** `DELETE /api/items-delivery/:id` runs `DELETE FROM items WHERE id = $1` (`items-delivery.controller.ts` 193–196; `items-delivery.service.ts` 319–326). `schema.sql` adds `posts_item_id_fkey` with `ON DELETE CASCADE` (652–658). `PUT :id` still rewrites `title`, `price`, `status`, and `location` (216–239). `POST /api/items-delivery` still inserts `images`, `metadata`, and `expires_at` (654–676), which the `items` DDL does not create. - File: `apps/api/src/controllers/items-delivery.controller.ts` (25–26, 140–196); `apps/api/src/controllers/items-delivery.service.ts` (99–326); `apps/api/src/database/schema.sql` (652–658, 990–1017) -> Action: Require `JwtAuthGuard` on create, update, delete, reserve, request, and deliver.  * **Unauthenticated `POST /api/users/resolve-id` mints a JWT (re-verified 2026-10-15).** A known email, `google_id`, or `firebase_uid` returns an access and refresh pair (`users.controller.ts` 183–188; `user-auth.service.ts` 270–342, 645–660). - File: `apps/api/src/controllers/users.controller.ts` (183–188) -> Action: Remove token minting from resolve-id. Require a verified ID token.

 * **Password-optional `/api/users/login` and root-admin bootstrap (re-verified 2026-10-15).** `loginUser` verifies argon2 only when both `password` and `password_hash` are truthy (`user-auth.service.ts` 223–231). Register with the committed fallback mailbox sets `admin` (101–102). - File: `apps/api/src/services/user-auth.service.ts` (97–139, 212–263) -> Action: Fail closed unless a password verifies. Never mutate roles before `argon2.verify`.

 * **Profile mass-assignment and unauthenticated profile reads (re-verified 2026-10-15).** `PUT /api/users/:id` accepts `password`, `roles`, and `firebase_uid` and is not bound to `req.user` (`users.controller.ts` 126–133). `GET :id` returns `phone`, `settings`, and `roles`, and it zeros the money and hours counters (`user-profile.service.ts` 126–158). - File: `apps/api/src/controllers/users.controller.ts` (121–163) -> Action: Bind `:id` to `req.user.userId` unless admin. Strip privileged fields from the public DTO.

 * **Other unguarded write surfaces and stats export (re-verified 2026-10-15).** Knowledge-link `POST` is public, matching SRS §2.3.3. `GET /api/stats/details/:statType` is JWT-only and `totalUsers` returns name, email, and city (`stats.controller.ts` 834–876). - File: `apps/api/src/controllers/stats.controller.ts` (834–876) -> Action: Add `JwtAuthGuard` (admin where appropriate). Bind owners and actors to the JWT.

 * **Request-path `DROP TABLE ... CASCADE` (re-verified 2026-10-15).** `ensurePostsTable` drops `posts` when legacy columns are detected (`posts.controller.ts` 78, 309, 373–374). `DatabaseInit` drops donations and rides on startup when it treats the schema as legacy (`database.init.ts` 568, 670). - File: `apps/api/src/controllers/posts.controller.ts` (78, 309, 373–374) -> Action: Never DROP on a request path. Gate destructive DDL behind an offline migration.

Tracked JSON under `apps/api/data-backups/20251224-162421/` includes email, phone, and `password_hash`. `refreshAccessToken` copies `payload.roles` (`jwt.service.ts` 146–177). Firebase JWKS derives `aud` from the token (`firebase-admin.service.ts` 150–184). `/auth/google` can fall back to a client-supplied access token (`auth.controller.ts` 588–698). - File: `apps/api/railway.toml.dev` (34); `apps/api/src/main.ts` (149–218); `apps/api/data-backups/` -> Action: Rotate every fingerprinted credential. Purge backups from git history. Reload roles on refresh. Accept only verified ID tokens.

## 🐞 Bugs & Logic Issues

 * **`POST :id/reserve` does not reserve the item, and two callers can both insert (2026-10-15).** `createItemRequest` checks `status = 'available'` and then inserts a `pending` row. It does not update `items.status` and it does not lock the item row (`items-delivery.service.ts` 351–410). A second request with a different `requester_id` also passes. `message` has no length cap (`items.dto.ts` 252–254). A driver error, including an invalid UUID cast, is returned to the caller (412–417). Recommendation: Take `SELECT … FOR UPDATE` on the item, set `status` to `reserved` in the same transaction when the product means a hold, cap `message`, and return a generic error.

 * **`POST /api/items-delivery` writes columns the `items` table does not have (2026-10-14, re-verified 2026-10-15).** `insertItemRow` lists `images`, `tags`, `metadata`, and `expires_at` (`items-delivery.service.ts` 654–676). `schema.sql` (990–1017) and `DatabaseInit` (381–403) do not define `images`, `metadata`, or `expires_at`. The controller returns `error.message` (72–77). `GET /api/items-delivery/requests` remains shadowed by `GET :id` (180 vs 216). Recommendation: Insert the columns the table has. Return a generic error. Declare `GET requests` before `GET :id`.

 * **The public directory and the profile read disagree on money fields, and the list has no cap (2026-10-13, re-verified 2026-10-15).** `getUsers` returns the stored counters (510–511). `getUserById` substitutes `0` for both (148–149). `parseInt(limit)` has no upper bound (485–488). `GET /api/users/:id/stats` still sums `donations.amount` with no guard (`user-stats.service.ts` 50–90, 140–147; `users.controller.ts` 160–162). Recommendation: Use one public projection. Cap `limit`. Keep the per-user money sum on an authenticated self or admin read.

 * **Task patch logs the raw body and the SQL parameters, and attributes the feed post to the new assignee (2026-10-12, re-verified 2026-10-15).** `JSON.stringify(body)` is written at info level (`tasks.controller.ts` 511–514). The mutation log includes the bound parameter list (`tasks-patch-mutation.service.ts` 339). Recommendation: Log only the task id after update. Bind `author_id` to `req.user.userId`.

 * **Task create logs the raw body and attributes the feed post to the spoofed creator (2026-10-11, re-verified 2026-10-15).** `JSON.stringify(body)` is written at info level (`tasks.controller.ts` 287). Recommendation: Log only the task id after insert. Bind `author_id` to `req.user.userId`.

 * **Notification listAll has no cap and logs the first JSON body (2026-10-10, re-verified 2026-10-15).** `listAll` returns every `data` blob and `console.log` writes `JSON.stringify(rows[0].data)` (`items.service.ts` 249–276). Recommendation: Paginate `listAll`. Do not log row bodies.

 * **Daily tracker date window is caller-sized and has no row cap (2026-10-09, re-verified 2026-10-15).** Supplied dates are bound as-is (`community-group-challenges.controller.ts` 300–316, 364–370). Recommendation: Require `CurrentUser()`, allow at most a fixed number of days, and paginate entries.

 * **Admin file search drops the folder filter and the list has no cap (2026-10-08, re-verified 2026-10-15).** `folder_path = $1` is added only when `search` is absent (`admin-files.controller.ts` 104–113). Recommendation: Keep the folder predicate. Cap and paginate the list.

 * **A planted time log replaces the total and unlocks mark-done (2026-10-07, re-verified 2026-10-15).** `ON CONFLICT` sets `actual_hours` to the new value (`tasks.controller.ts` 437–442). Recommendation: Add to `actual_hours` when the product means an increment. Return a generic error.

 * **Hours report hides failures and has no cycle cap (2026-10-06, re-verified 2026-10-15).** Both catch paths return `success: true` with zero hours (`tasks.controller.ts` 576–584; `tasks-read.service.ts` 313–323). Recommendation: Return `success: false` on query failure. Stop the walk at a fixed depth.

 * **CRM list has no cap, and a missing table is created on the public GET (2026-10-05, re-verified 2026-10-15).** `GET /api/crm` has no `LIMIT` (`crm.controller.ts` 137). Recommendation: Cap the list. Create `crm_contacts` in an offline migration.

 * **Community-members list replaces a shared trigger function (2026-10-04, re-verified 2026-10-15).** `ensureTable` executes `CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION update_updated_at_column()` (`community-members.controller.ts` 157–165). Recommendation: Leave the shared function untouched on the request path.

 * **Ride booking approval has no driver and no seat lock (2026-10-03, re-verified 2026-10-15).** `PUT /api/rides/bookings/:bookingId/status` sets the body status before it counts remaining seats (`rides.controller.ts` 505–555). Recommendation: `SELECT … FOR UPDATE` on the ride. Allowlist status. Approve only when the JWT subject is the driver.

 * **Places details interpolates `place_id` and publishes search terms (2026-10-02, re-verified 2026-10-15).** `GET /place-details` concatenates `place_id` into the Google URL (`places.controller.ts` 75). Recommendation: `encodeURIComponent` on `place_id`. Do not return the upstream error string.

 * **Companion item post is best-effort, and the caller chooses the item id (2026-10-01, re-verified 2026-10-15).** A failed `INSERT INTO posts` is caught and the dedicated item still commits (`dedicated-items.service.ts` 170–177). Recommendation: One transaction. Generate the id on the server.

 * **Item deliver commits `delivered` before the request permission check (2026-09-30, re-verified 2026-10-15).** `markAsDelivered` updates the item, then optionally calls `updateItemRequest` (`items-delivery.controller.ts` 247–258). Recommendation: One transaction. Check the JWT subject before either write.

 * **Money donation counters ignore sign, zero, and later edits (2026-09-29, re-verified 2026-10-15).** A truthy negative `amount` subtracts from `total_donations_amount`. `PUT` and `DELETE` leave both counters unchanged (`donations.controller.ts` 525–541, 698–780). Recommendation: Reject non-positive money amounts. Adjust both counters by the delta inside the same transaction.

 * **Anonymous hierarchy read can `ALTER TABLE` (2026-09-28, re-verified 2026-10-15).** `ensureSalarySeniorityColumns` adds `salary`, `seniority_start_date`, and `parent_manager_id` (`user-hierarchy.service.ts` 436–483). Recommendation: Apply those columns in an offline migration.

 * **Hierarchy pull check fails open (2026-09-27, re-verified 2026-10-15).** `assertRequesterMayPullTargetUnderSelf` returns `{ ok: true }` at line 149 when neither ancestor check matches. Recommendation: Default to deny.

 * **Comment handlers return `error.message` (re-verified 2026-10-15).** Update, delete, and list catch blocks interpolate the driver message (`posts.controller.ts` 1803–1805, 2042–2045, 2134–2137). `GET /api/posts` does the same (1013–1018). Recommendation: Return a generic error and log the driver message server-side.

 * **`GET /rate-limit/stats` lists every limiter key with no auth (re-verified 2026-10-15).** `getRateLimitStats` runs `KEYS rate_limit:*` and `KEYS blocked:*` (`rate-limit.service.ts` 238–256). Recommendation: Remove the route from deployed builds.

 * **Rate limiter fails open when Redis errors (re-verified 2026-10-15).** `checkRateLimit` returns `allowed: true` if the block read or the counter read throws (`rate-limit.service.ts` 87–89, 106–111). Recommendation: Fail closed on auth routes.

 * **Unauthenticated `POST /api/stats/track-visit` inflates production metrics (re-verified 2026-10-15).** No guard. Increments `community_stats.site_visits` (373–401). Recommendation: Require a bot-resistant token, or drop the public increment.

 * **Items-delivery static route is shadowed (re-verified 2026-10-15).** `GET /api/items-delivery/:id` is declared before `GET requests` (180–223), so the request list is captured as an item id. Dedicated-items `GET :id` still shadows `GET search` (69 vs 166). Recommendation: Declare static routes before parameterized routes.

 * **`loginUser` and `JwtAuthGuard` never consult `user_profiles.is_active` (re-verified 2026-10-15).** Deactivated rows can still obtain a session via email-only login or an existing refresh token. Recommendation: Fail closed on `is_active = false`.

 * **Anonymity filtering is specified and not implemented (re-verified 2026-10-15).** SRS §2.5.7 / NFR §3.2 require server-side redaction for `anonymity_level < 4`. The column is still absent (0 matches under `apps/`). Recommendation: Add the column and the feed projection.

## 🏗️ Architecture & Clean Code

 * **No Domain / Application / Infrastructure folders** under `apps/` or `packages/` (count 0). The target in `docs/SSOT/CODE_QUALITY/layers-and-boundaries.md` is Infrastructure → Application → Domain. The monorepo remains NestJS feature folders plus React Native screens. `packages/` still only contains `config-eslint`. The closest pure islands remain `apps/api/src/tasks/task-completion-participants.ts`, `tasks-validation.ts`, `tasks-query-params.ts`, and `tasks.types.ts`. `tasks-permissions.service.ts` imports `pg`. `ItemsDeliveryService` lives under `controllers/`, imports `pg`, and both hard-deletes `items` and inserts `item_requests` with a client `requester_id`.

 * **Fat HTTP layer owns SQL and policy.** Largest API files: `posts.controller.ts` (2741), `stats.controller.ts` (1709), `user-hierarchy.service.ts` (1675), `database.init.ts` (1374), `community-group-challenges.controller.ts` (1097), `donations.controller.ts` (892), `chat.controller.ts` (813), `rides.controller.ts` (779). `items-delivery.service.ts` is 748 lines and owns the hard delete, the mismatched insert, and the request insert. `user-profile.service.ts` is 600 lines and owns both the public directory SQL and the profile read that zeros the counters.

 * **Privilege checks disagree inside the same product.** `DedicatedItemsService` soft-deletes and hides `is_deleted` rows. `ItemsDeliveryService` hard-deletes the same table, lists those rows, and accepts a delivery request with no session. Notifications `validateOwnership` compares `:userId` to `req.user.userId`. The collections controller never reads a session.

 * **Two notification stores, one of them generic.** SRS §2.9.1 names both `user_notifications` and the JSONB `notifications` table. The guarded controller uses `user_notifications`. The unguarded collection name `notifications` uses the JSONB table created by `tasks-schema.service.ts`.

 * **Two item writers, one table, plus a request table with no owner session.** SRS §2.6.2 and §2.6.3 both persist items. Dedicated items insert `image_base64` and text `tags`. Items delivery inserts `images`, `metadata`, and `expires_at`, and `createItemRequest` inserts into `item_requests`. `schema.sql` matches the dedicated-items item insert. The request foreign key is commented out.

 * **Database design and the community-members table disagree.** SRS database design lists `email` and `phone` columns on `community_members` (`docs/SSOT/SRS/06-database-design.md`). `schema.sql` stores one `contact_info` JSONB object (1072–1077).

 * **CRM table and admin file table are absent from the committed schema.** `schema.sql` and `docs/SSOT/SRS/06-database-design.md` do not define `crm_contacts` or `general_files`. `CrmController.ensureTable` and `AdminFilesController.ensureTable` create them on the first request.

 * **Positive in-folder contrasts (do not regress):** `/api/notifications` already uses `JwtAuthGuard` and `validateOwnership`; admin-files POST and DELETE already use `AdminAuthGuard`; community-group challenges bind the creator on create, join, entry, PUT, and DELETE; personal challenges scope timer reads and updates to `CurrentUser()` and keep `PUT` columns on a class-validator DTO; knowledge contribution-request binds `req.user.userId`; sync user/all/status use `AdminAuthGuard`; authenticated chat send/read checks `ANY(participants)` when a JWT is present; `/session/login` requires argon2 once the shared limiter allows the call; item list `ORDER BY` uses an allowlisted column; ride list `ORDER BY` uses an allowlisted column; community-challenge `sort_order` is only `ASC` or `DESC`; collection names are checked against `ALLOWED_COLLECTIONS` before SQL; `canAssignToUser` fails closed when the hierarchy query throws. `DedicatedItemsService` already soft-deletes and filters `is_deleted`. Places autocomplete encodes its query string. Admin-files search binds `ILIKE`.

 * **Operator matching workspace is specified and not implemented.** `OperatorAuthGuard` exists and there is no `/api/operator/*` module. Anonymity and matching-case tables remain SRS §10 gaps.

## 🚨 Critical Vulnerabilities

 * **Unauthenticated hard delete removes any item and cascades to its feed post (2026-10-14).** `ItemsDeliveryController` has no `UseGuards` (`items-delivery.controller.ts` 25–26). SRS §2.6.3 lists `DELETE /api/items-delivery/:id` and does not name a guard. The handler calls `deleteItem` (193–196), which runs `DELETE FROM items WHERE id = $1` and checks only `rowCount` (319–326). There is no comparison to an owner. `schema.sql` adds `posts_item_id_fkey` as `FOREIGN KEY (item_id) REFERENCES items(id) ON DELETE CASCADE` (652–658). `GET /api/items-delivery` has no guard (140–170). `listItems` selects `i.*`, defaults to `status = 'available'`, and does not test `is_deleted` (109–123). `limit` is `filters.limit || 50` with no maximum (194–198). `DedicatedItemsService.deleteItem` only sets `is_deleted = TRUE` (307–308) and its reads keep `is_deleted = FALSE` (205, 231, 338, 366). Those soft-deleted rows still match the delivery list. `PUT /api/items-delivery/:id` (185–190) updates `title`, `description`, `category`, `condition`, `location`, `price`, `quantity`, `status`, and `delivery_method` with no owner check (216–269). A body that also sets `images`, `metadata`, or `expires_at` fails because those columns are not on the table (246–281, 990–1017). `POST /api/items-delivery/:id/deliver` still sets `status` to `delivered` before any actor check; that path is the 2026-09-30 bullet and does not delete the row. Concrete trigger: `GET /api/items-delivery` with no `Authorization`, then `DELETE /api/items-delivery/<id>` using a returned id. The item row is removed. When the posts foreign key from `schema.sql` is present, the feed post whose `item_id` is that id is removed with it. A second trigger sends `PUT /api/items-delivery/<id>` with a new `title` or `status` and no `Authorization`. NFR §3.5 requires omitting fields the caller may not see. §2.5.4 requires a JWT to change a post; this path deletes one with no JWT. The 2026-10-01 bullet is `POST /api/dedicated-items`, which inserts into the same table and writes `posts.author_id` from the client. This bullet is the unauthenticated delete and rewrite. - File: `apps/api/src/controllers/items-delivery.controller.ts` (25–26, 140–196); `apps/api/src/controllers/items-delivery.service.ts` (99–326); `apps/api/src/database/schema.sql` (652–658, 990–1017) -> Action: Require `JwtAuthGuard` on create, update, delete, reserve, request, and deliver. Bind the actor to `req.user.userId`. Delete only when that subject owns the item. Prefer the soft delete already used by dedicated items. Do not cascade a public post from an unauthenticated delete.

Cap `limit`. Return the real counters only to that user or an admin.

Purge backups from git history. Reload roles on refresh. Accept only verified ID tokens.

## 🐞 Bugs & Logic Issues

 * **`POST /api/items-delivery` writes columns the `items` table does not have (2026-10-14).** `insertItemRow` lists `images`, `tags`, `metadata`, and `expires_at` (`items-delivery.service.ts` 654–676). `schema.sql` (990–1017) and `DatabaseInit` (381–403) define `image_base64`, `tags TEXT`, `city`, `address`, and `coordinates`. They do not define `images`, `metadata`, or `expires_at`. The only later alter adds `location` (460–462). PostgreSQL rejects the insert at `images`. `createItem` rolls the transaction back (62–64). The controller returns `error.message` to the caller (72–77). `DedicatedItemsService` inserts the real columns and can still create the row (102–106). `tryCreateLinkedPost` would set `posts.author_id` from client `owner_id` (693–699), but that statement is not reached while the item insert fails. `listItems` does not apply `is_deleted` (109–123), so a dedicated-items soft delete stays visible on `GET /api/items-delivery`. `GET /api/items-delivery/requests` remains shadowed by `GET :id` (180 vs 216). Recommendation: Insert `image_base64`, `city`, `address`, `coordinates`, and text `tags`. Return a generic error. Filter `is_deleted = FALSE`. Declare `GET requests` before `GET :id`.

 * **The public directory and the profile read disagree on money fields, and the list has no cap (2026-10-13, re-verified 2026-10-14).** `getUsers` returns the stored counters (510–511). `getUserById` substitutes `0` for both (148–149). `parseInt(limit)` has no upper bound (485–488). `GET /api/users/:id/stats` still sums `donations.amount` with no guard (`user-stats.service.ts` 50–90, 140–147; `users.controller.ts` 160–162). Recommendation: Use one public projection. Cap `limit`. Do not match email on an unauthenticated search. Keep the per-user money sum on an authenticated self or admin read.

 * **Task patch logs the raw body and the SQL parameters, and attributes the feed post to the new assignee (2026-10-12, re-verified 2026-10-14).** `JSON.stringify(body)` is written at info level (`tasks.controller.ts` 511–514). The mutation log includes the bound parameter list (`tasks-patch-mutation.service.ts` 339). Recommendation: Log only the task id after update. Bind `author_id` to `req.user.userId`.

 * **Task create logs the raw body and attributes the feed post to the spoofed creator (2026-10-11, re-verified 2026-10-14).** `JSON.stringify(body)` is written at info level (`tasks.controller.ts` 287). Recommendation: Log only the task id after insert. Bind `author_id` to `req.user.userId`.

 * **Notification listAll has no cap and logs the first JSON body (2026-10-10, re-verified 2026-10-14).** `listAll` returns every `data` blob and `console.log` writes `JSON.stringify(rows[0].data)` (`items.service.ts` 249–276). Recommendation: Paginate `listAll`. Do not log row bodies.

 * **Daily tracker date window is caller-sized and has no row cap (2026-10-09, re-verified 2026-10-14).** Supplied dates are bound as-is (`community-group-challenges.controller.ts` 300–316, 364–370). Recommendation: Require `CurrentUser()`, allow at most a fixed number of days, and paginate entries.

 * **Admin file search drops the folder filter and the list has no cap (2026-10-08, re-verified 2026-10-14).** `folder_path = $1` is added only when `search` is absent (`admin-files.controller.ts` 104–113). Recommendation: Keep the folder predicate. Cap and paginate the list.

 * **A planted time log replaces the total and unlocks mark-done (2026-10-07, re-verified 2026-10-14).** `ON CONFLICT` sets `actual_hours` to the new value (`tasks.controller.ts` 437–442). Recommendation: Add to `actual_hours` when the product means an increment. Return a generic error.

 * **Hours report hides failures and has no cycle cap (2026-10-06, re-verified 2026-10-14).** Both catch paths return `success: true` with zero hours (`tasks.controller.ts` 576–584; `tasks-read.service.ts` 313–323). Recommendation: Return `success: false` on query failure. Stop the walk at a fixed depth.

 * **CRM list has no cap, and a missing table is created on the public GET (2026-10-05, re-verified 2026-10-14).** `GET /api/crm` has no `LIMIT` (`crm.controller.ts` 137). Recommendation: Cap the list. Create `crm_contacts` in an offline migration.

 * **Community-members list replaces a shared trigger function (2026-10-04, re-verified 2026-10-14).** `ensureTable` executes `CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION update_updated_at_column()` (`community-members.controller.ts` 157–165). Recommendation: Leave the shared function untouched on the request path.

 * **Ride booking approval has no driver and no seat lock (2026-10-03, re-verified 2026-10-14).** `PUT /api/rides/bookings/:bookingId/status` sets the body status before it counts remaining seats (`rides.controller.ts` 505–555). Recommendation: `SELECT … FOR UPDATE` on the ride. Allowlist status. Approve only when the JWT subject is the driver.

 * **Places details interpolates `place_id` and publishes search terms (2026-10-02, re-verified 2026-10-14).** `GET /place-details` concatenates `place_id` into the Google URL (`places.controller.ts` 75). Recommendation: `encodeURIComponent` on `place_id`. Do not return the upstream error string.

 * **Companion item post is best-effort, and the caller chooses the item id (2026-10-01, re-verified 2026-10-14).** A failed `INSERT INTO posts` is caught and the dedicated item still commits (`dedicated-items.service.ts` 170–177). Recommendation: One transaction. Generate the id on the server.

 * **Item deliver commits `delivered` before the request permission check (2026-09-30, re-verified 2026-10-14).** `markAsDelivered` updates the item, then optionally calls `updateItemRequest` (`items-delivery.controller.ts` 247–258). Recommendation: One transaction. Check the JWT subject before either write.

 * **Money donation counters ignore sign, zero, and later edits (2026-09-29, re-verified 2026-10-14).** A truthy negative `amount` subtracts from `total_donations_amount`. `PUT` and `DELETE` leave both counters unchanged (`donations.controller.ts` 525–541, 698–780). Recommendation: Reject non-positive money amounts. Adjust both counters by the delta inside the same transaction.

 * **Anonymous hierarchy read can `ALTER TABLE` (2026-09-28, re-verified 2026-10-14).** `ensureSalarySeniorityColumns` adds `salary`, `seniority_start_date`, and `parent_manager_id` (`user-hierarchy.service.ts` 436–483). Recommendation: Apply those columns in an offline migration.

 * **Hierarchy pull check fails open (2026-09-27, re-verified 2026-10-14).** `assertRequesterMayPullTargetUnderSelf` returns `{ ok: true }` at line 149 when neither ancestor check matches. Recommendation: Default to deny.

 * **Comment handlers return `error.message` (re-verified 2026-10-14).** Update, delete, and list catch blocks interpolate the driver message (`posts.controller.ts` 1803–1805, 2042–2045, 2134–2137). `GET /api/posts` does the same (1013–1018). Recommendation: Return a generic error and log the driver message server-side.

 * **`GET /rate-limit/stats` lists every limiter key with no auth (re-verified 2026-10-14).** `getRateLimitStats` runs `KEYS rate_limit:*` and `KEYS blocked:*` (`rate-limit.service.ts` 238–256). Recommendation: Remove the route from deployed builds.

 * **Rate limiter fails open when Redis errors (re-verified 2026-10-14).** `checkRateLimit` returns `allowed: true` if the block read or the counter read throws (`rate-limit.service.ts` 87–89, 106–111). Recommendation: Fail closed on auth routes.

 * **Unauthenticated `POST /api/stats/track-visit` inflates production metrics (re-verified 2026-10-14).** No guard. Increments `community_stats.site_visits` (373–401). Recommendation: Require a bot-resistant token, or drop the public increment.

 * **Items-delivery static route is shadowed (re-verified 2026-10-14).** `GET /api/items-delivery/:id` is declared before `GET requests` (180–223), so the request list is captured as an item id. Dedicated-items `GET :id` still shadows `GET search` (69 vs 166). Recommendation: Declare static routes before parameterized routes.

 * **`loginUser` and `JwtAuthGuard` never consult `user_profiles.is_active` (re-verified 2026-10-14).** Deactivated rows can still obtain a session via email-only login or an existing refresh token. Recommendation: Fail closed on `is_active = false`.

 * **Anonymity filtering is specified and not implemented (re-verified 2026-10-14).** SRS §2.5.7 / NFR §3.2 require server-side redaction for `anonymity_level < 4`. The column is still absent (0 matches under `apps/`). Recommendation: Add the column and the feed projection.

## 🏗️ Architecture & Clean Code

 * **No Domain / Application / Infrastructure folders** under `apps/` or `packages/` (count 0). The target in `docs/SSOT/CODE_QUALITY/layers-and-boundaries.md` is Infrastructure → Application → Domain. The monorepo remains NestJS feature folders plus React Native screens. `packages/` still only contains `config-eslint`. The closest pure islands remain `apps/api/src/tasks/task-completion-participants.ts`, `tasks-validation.ts`, `tasks-query-params.ts`, and `tasks.types.ts`. `tasks-permissions.service.ts` imports `pg` and is invoked with a stored or client-supplied creator id. `ItemsDeliveryService` lives under `controllers/`, imports `pg`, and writes a different column set than `DedicatedItemsService` for the same `items` table.

 * **Fat HTTP layer owns SQL and policy.** Largest API files: `posts.controller.ts` (2741), `stats.controller.ts` (1709), `user-hierarchy.service.ts` (1675), `database.init.ts` (1374), `community-group-challenges.controller.ts` (1097), `donations.controller.ts` (892), `chat.controller.ts` (813), `rides.controller.ts` (779). `items-delivery.service.ts` is 748 lines and owns both the hard delete and the insert that does not match `schema.sql`. `user-profile.service.ts` is 600 lines and owns both the public directory SQL and the profile read that zeros the counters.

 * **Privilege checks disagree inside the same product.** `PATCH` and `DELETE` on `/api/tasks` use `AdminAuthGuard`. `PATCH` then authorizes new assignees as the stored creator. `GET /api/users` returns real donation totals with no session. `GET /api/users/:id` returns zeros for those same columns. `DedicatedItemsService` soft-deletes and hides `is_deleted` rows. `ItemsDeliveryService` hard-deletes the same table and lists those rows. Notifications `validateOwnership` compares `:userId` to `req.user.userId`. The collections controller never reads a session.

 * **Two notification stores, one of them generic.** SRS §2.9.1 names both `user_notifications` and the JSONB `notifications` table. The guarded controller uses `user_notifications`. The unguarded collection name `notifications` uses the JSONB table created by `tasks-schema.service.ts`.

 * **Two item writers, one table.** SRS §2.6.2 and §2.6.3 both persist items. Dedicated items insert `image_base64` and text `tags`. Items delivery inserts `images`, `metadata`, and `expires_at`. `schema.sql` matches the dedicated-items insert. The delivery delete is a physical `DELETE`, and the posts foreign key cascades.

 * **Database design and the community-members table disagree.** SRS database design lists `email` and `phone` columns on `community_members` (`docs/SSOT/SRS/06-database-design.md`). `schema.sql` stores one `contact_info` JSONB object (1072–1077).

 * **CRM table and admin file table are absent from the committed schema.** `schema.sql` and `docs/SSOT/SRS/06-database-design.md` do not define `crm_contacts` or `general_files`. `CrmController.ensureTable` and `AdminFilesController.ensureTable` create them on the first request.

 * **Positive in-folder contrasts (do not regress):** `/api/notifications` already uses `JwtAuthGuard` and `validateOwnership`; admin-files POST and DELETE already use `AdminAuthGuard`; community-group challenges bind the creator on create, join, entry, PUT, and DELETE; personal challenges scope timer reads and updates to `CurrentUser()` and keep `PUT` columns on a class-validator DTO; knowledge contribution-request binds `req.user.userId`; sync user/all/status use `AdminAuthGuard`; authenticated chat send/read checks `ANY(participants)` when a JWT is present; `/session/login` requires argon2 once the shared limiter allows the call; item list `ORDER BY` uses an allowlisted column; ride list `ORDER BY` uses an allowlisted column; collection names are checked against `ALLOWED_COLLECTIONS` before SQL; `canAssignToUser` fails closed when the hierarchy query throws. `DedicatedItemsService` already soft-deletes and filters `is_deleted`. Places autocomplete encodes its query string. Admin-files search binds `ILIKE`.

 * **Operator matching workspace is specified and not implemented.** `OperatorAuthGuard` exists and there is no `/api/operator/*` module. Anonymity and matching-case tables remain SRS §10 gaps.

## 🚨 Critical Vulnerabilities

 * **Unauthenticated user directory returns lifetime donation totals, volunteer hours, and manager email (2026-10-13).** `GET /api/users` has no `UseGuards` (`users.controller.ts` 135–149). SRS §2.2.1 lists the route and does not name a guard. `getUsers` selects `total_donations_amount`, `total_volunteer_hours`, `email`, `roles`, `last_active`, `bio`, `parent_manager_id`, and `manager_details` (`user-profile.service.ts` 502–537). `manager_details` includes the manager's `email` (525–531). The same columns are in the fallback query (549–578). `search` binds `ILIKE` against `name`, `bio`, and `email` (476–479). When `limit` is omitted the query uses `LIMIT 50` (489–491). When it is present, `parseInt(limit)` is sent with no maximum (485–488), and `offset` pages the rest (493–497). `forceRefresh=true` skips the 20-minute cache (449–463, 597). `GET /api/users/:id` is also unguarded (121–124) and selects `phone` and `settings` (130, 151), but it hardcodes `0 as total_donations_amount` and `0 as total_volunteer_hours` (148–149). A hardcoded root mailbox nulls only `parent_manager_id` and `manager_details` on the list (518–531). That row still includes email, roles, and the real totals. Concrete trigger: `GET /api/users?limit=100000` with no `Authorization`. Each row includes that person's email, roles, lifetime donation amount, volunteer hours, last activity, and manager email. `GET /api/users/<id>` for the same person returns `0` for both counters. NFR §3.5 requires omitting fields the caller may not see. The 2026-09-28 bullet is `salary` and `seniority_start_date` on `GET /api/users/hierarchy/tree`. The 2026-10-02 bullet is phone, email, and street address on a donation row. ## 🐞 Bugs & Logic Issues

 * **The public directory and the profile read disagree on money fields, and the list has no cap (2026-10-13).** `getUsers` returns the stored counters (510–511). `getUserById` substitutes `0` for both (148–149). `parseInt(limit)` has no upper bound (485–488). `search` matches email (476–479). Recommendation: Use one public projection. Cap `limit` and `offset`. Do not match email on an unauthenticated search.

 * **Task patch logs the raw body and the SQL parameters, and attributes the feed post to the new assignee (2026-10-12, re-verified 2026-10-13).** `JSON.stringify(body)` is written at info level (`tasks.controller.ts` 511–514). The mutation log includes the bound parameter list (`tasks-patch-mutation.service.ts` 339). A newly added assignee becomes `posts.author_id` (`tasks-side-effects.service.ts` 374–387). Recommendation: Log only the task id after update. Bind `author_id` to `req.user.userId`.

 * **Task create logs the raw body and attributes the feed post to the spoofed creator (2026-10-11, re-verified 2026-10-13).** `JSON.stringify(body)` is written at info level (`tasks.controller.ts` 287). A self-assignment under a spoofed `created_by` inserts a public post whose `author_id` is that user (`tasks-side-effects.service.ts` 136–147). Recommendation: Log only the task id after insert. Bind `author_id` to `req.user.userId`.

 * **Notification listAll has no cap and logs the first JSON body (2026-10-10, re-verified 2026-10-13).** `listAll` returns every `data` blob and `console.log` writes `JSON.stringify(rows[0].data)` (`items.service.ts` 249–276). `popular-collections` and `cache-stats` stay shadowed by `:collection` (43 vs 136–154). Recommendation: Paginate `listAll`. Do not log row bodies. Declare static routes before `:collection`.

 * **Daily tracker date window is caller-sized and has no row cap (2026-10-09, re-verified 2026-10-13).** Supplied dates are bound as-is (`community-group-challenges.controller.ts` 300–316, 364–370). Recommendation: Require `CurrentUser()`, allow at most a fixed number of days, and paginate entries.

 * **Admin file search drops the folder filter and the list has no cap (2026-10-08, re-verified 2026-10-13).** `folder_path = $1` is added only when `search` is absent (`admin-files.controller.ts` 104–113). Recommendation: Keep the folder predicate. Cap and paginate the list.

 * **A planted time log replaces the total and unlocks mark-done (2026-10-07, re-verified 2026-10-13).** `ON CONFLICT` sets `actual_hours` to the new value (`tasks.controller.ts` 437–442). Recommendation: Add to `actual_hours` when the product means an increment. Return a generic error.

 * **Hours report hides failures and has no cycle cap (2026-10-06, re-verified 2026-10-13).** Both catch paths return `success: true` with zero hours (`tasks.controller.ts` 576–584; `tasks-read.service.ts` 313–323). Recommendation: Return `success: false` on query failure. Stop the walk at a fixed depth.

 * **CRM list has no cap, and a missing table is created on the public GET (2026-10-05, re-verified 2026-10-13).** `GET /api/crm` has no `LIMIT` (`crm.controller.ts` 137). Recommendation: Cap the list. Create `crm_contacts` in an offline migration.

 * **Community-members list replaces a shared trigger function (2026-10-04, re-verified 2026-10-13).** `ensureTable` executes `CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION update_updated_at_column()` (`community-members.controller.ts` 157–165). Recommendation: Leave the shared function untouched on the request path.

 * **Ride booking approval has no driver and no seat lock (2026-10-03, re-verified 2026-10-13).** `PUT /api/rides/bookings/:bookingId/status` sets the body status before it counts remaining seats (`rides.controller.ts` 505–555). Recommendation: `SELECT … FOR UPDATE` on the ride. Allowlist status. Approve only when the JWT subject is the driver.

 * **Places details interpolates `place_id` and publishes search terms (2026-10-02, re-verified 2026-10-13).** `GET /place-details` concatenates `place_id` into the Google URL (`places.controller.ts` 75). `GET /search-stats` lists stored search strings with no auth (88–91, 139–166). Recommendation: `encodeURIComponent` on `place_id`. Do not return the upstream error string.

 * **Companion item post is best-effort, and the caller chooses the item id (2026-10-01, re-verified 2026-10-13).** A failed `INSERT INTO posts` is caught and the item still commits (`dedicated-items.service.ts` 170–177). Recommendation: One transaction. Generate the id on the server.

 * **Item deliver commits `delivered` before the request permission check (2026-09-30, re-verified 2026-10-13).** `markAsDelivered` updates the item, then optionally calls `updateItemRequest` (`items-delivery.controller.ts` 247–258). Recommendation: One transaction. Check the JWT subject before either write.

 * **Money donation counters ignore sign, zero, and later edits (2026-09-29, re-verified 2026-10-13).** A truthy negative `amount` subtracts from `total_donations_amount`. `PUT` and `DELETE` leave both counters unchanged (`donations.controller.ts` 525–541, 698–780). Recommendation: Reject non-positive money amounts. Adjust both counters by the delta inside the same transaction.

 * **Anonymous hierarchy read can `ALTER TABLE` (2026-09-28, re-verified 2026-10-13).** `ensureSalarySeniorityColumns` adds `salary`, `seniority_start_date`, and `parent_manager_id` (`user-hierarchy.service.ts` 436–483). Recommendation: Apply those columns in an offline migration.

 * **Hierarchy pull check fails open (2026-09-27, re-verified 2026-10-13).** `assertRequesterMayPullTargetUnderSelf` returns `{ ok: true }` at line 149 when neither ancestor check matches. Recommendation: Default to deny.

 * **Comment handlers return `error.message` (re-verified 2026-10-13).** Update, delete, and list catch blocks interpolate the driver message (`posts.controller.ts` 1803–1805, 2042–2045, 2134–2137). Recommendation: Return a generic error and log the driver message server-side.

 * **`GET /rate-limit/stats` lists every limiter key with no auth (re-verified 2026-10-13).** `getRateLimitStats` runs `KEYS rate_limit:*` and `KEYS blocked:*` (`rate-limit.service.ts` 238–256). Recommendation: Remove the route from deployed builds.

 * **Rate limiter fails open when Redis errors (re-verified 2026-10-13).** `checkRateLimit` returns `allowed: true` if the block read or the counter read throws (`rate-limit.service.ts` 87–89, 106–111). Recommendation: Fail closed on auth routes.

 * **Unauthenticated `POST /api/stats/track-visit` inflates production metrics (re-verified 2026-10-13).** No guard. Increments `community_stats.site_visits` (373–401). Recommendation: Require a bot-resistant token, or drop the public increment.

 * **Items-delivery static route is shadowed (re-verified 2026-10-13).** `GET /api/items-delivery/:id` is declared before `GET requests` (180–223), so the request list is captured as an item id. Dedicated-items `GET :id` still shadows `GET search` (69 vs 166). Recommendation: Declare static routes before parameterized routes.

 * **`loginUser` and `JwtAuthGuard` never consult `user_profiles.is_active` (re-verified 2026-10-13).** Deactivated rows can still obtain a session via email-only login or an existing refresh token. Recommendation: Fail closed on `is_active = false`.

 * **Anonymity filtering is specified and not implemented (re-verified 2026-10-13).** SRS §2.5.7 / NFR §3.2 require server-side redaction for `anonymity_level < 4`. The column is still absent (0 matches under `apps/`). Recommendation: Add the column and the feed projection.

## 🏗️ Architecture & Clean Code

 * **No Domain / Application / Infrastructure folders** under `apps/` or `packages/` (count 0). The target in `docs/SSOT/CODE_QUALITY/layers-and-boundaries.md` is Infrastructure → Application → Domain. The monorepo remains NestJS feature folders plus React Native screens. `packages/` still only contains `config-eslint`. The closest pure islands remain `apps/api/src/tasks/task-completion-participants.ts`, `tasks-validation.ts`, `tasks-query-params.ts`, and `tasks.types.ts`. `tasks-permissions.service.ts` imports `pg` and is invoked with a stored or client-supplied creator id. `UserProfileService.getUsers` and `getUserById` both live in the infrastructure service and project different columns for the same entity.

 * **Fat HTTP layer owns SQL and policy.** Largest API files: `posts.controller.ts` (2741), `stats.controller.ts` (1709), `user-hierarchy.service.ts` (1675), `database.init.ts` (1374), `community-group-challenges.controller.ts` (1097), `donations.controller.ts` (892), `chat.controller.ts` (813), `rides.controller.ts` (779). `user-profile.service.ts` is 600 lines and owns both the public directory SQL and the profile read that zeros the counters.

 * **Privilege checks disagree inside the same product.** `PATCH` and `DELETE` on `/api/tasks` use `AdminAuthGuard`. `PATCH` then authorizes new assignees as the stored creator. `GET /api/users` returns real donation totals with no session. `GET /api/users/:id` returns zeros for those same columns and still returns `phone` and `settings`. Notifications `validateOwnership` compares `:userId` to `req.user.userId`. The collections controller never reads a session.

 * **Two notification stores, one of them generic.** SRS §2.9.1 names both `user_notifications` and the JSONB `notifications` table. The guarded controller uses `user_notifications`. The unguarded collection name `notifications` uses the JSONB table created by `tasks-schema.service.ts`.

 * **Database design and the community-members table disagree.** SRS database design lists `email` and `phone` columns on `community_members` (`docs/SSOT/SRS/06-database-design.md`). `schema.sql` stores one `contact_info` JSONB object (1072–1077).

 * **CRM table and admin file table are absent from the committed schema.** `schema.sql` and `docs/SSOT/SRS/06-database-design.md` do not define `crm_contacts` or `general_files`. `CrmController.ensureTable` and `AdminFilesController.ensureTable` create them on the first request.

 * **Positive in-folder contrasts (do not regress):** `/api/notifications` already uses `JwtAuthGuard` and `validateOwnership`; admin-files POST and DELETE already use `AdminAuthGuard`; community-group challenges bind the creator on create, join, entry, PUT, and DELETE; personal challenges scope timer reads and updates to `CurrentUser()` and keep `PUT` columns on a class-validator DTO; knowledge contribution-request binds `req.user.userId`; sync user/all/status use `AdminAuthGuard`; authenticated chat send/read checks `ANY(participants)` when a JWT is present; `/session/login` requires argon2 once the shared limiter allows the call; CRM PATCH uses hardcoded column names; community-challenge `ORDER BY` uses an allowlist plus `pg-format` `%I`; item list `ORDER BY` uses an allowlisted column; ride list `ORDER BY` uses an allowlisted column; collection names are checked against `ALLOWED_COLLECTIONS` before SQL; `canAssignToUser` fails closed when the hierarchy query throws. `GET :id` already zeros the two counters this list returns. Places autocomplete encodes its query string; place-details does not. Admin-files search binds `ILIKE`.

 * **Operator matching workspace is specified and not implemented.** `OperatorAuthGuard` exists and there is no `/api/operator/*` module. Anonymity and matching-case tables remain SRS §10 gaps.
