## 🚨 Critical Vulnerabilities

 * **Admin JWT reassigns any task as the stored creator, or as anyone when `created_by` is null (2026-10-12).** SRS §2.11.4 lists `PATCH /api/tasks/:id` with `AdminAuthGuard`. The method also uses `JwtAuthGuard`, and the handler takes only `@Param` and `@Body` (`tasks.controller.ts` 466–468). `UpdateTaskDto` is a TypeScript interface (`tasks.types.ts` 41–53), so the global `ValidationPipe` does not whitelist the body (`main.ts` 427–430). The scalar allowlist does not include `created_by` (`tasks-patch-mutation.service.ts` 72–84). `collectAssigneesFromPatchBody` accepts `assignees` or `assigneesEmails` and resolves emails to profile ids (198–229). `applyTaskPatchMutation` then loads `created_by` for that task (307–311). The hierarchy check runs only inside `if (taskCreatorId)` (313–322). `created_by UUID` is nullable and has no default (`tasks-schema.service.ts` 114). A null value skips `canAssignToUser` and still writes `assignees`. When the column is set, `verifyHierarchyForPatchAssignees` calls `canAssignToUser(taskCreatorId, assigneeId)` (232–249), not `req.user.userId`. That helper returns true for a self-assignment or when the named creator has role `super_admin` (43–57). It returns false only when the subordinate query throws (80–83). Unguarded `GET /api/users` returns `id`, `email`, and `roles` (`users.controller.ts` 135–145; `user-profile.service.ts` 502–516). `GET /api/tasks` is `JwtAuthGuard` only and returns `creator_details` and `assignees_details`, including email (`tasks.controller.ts` 74–75; `tasks-list-query.service.ts` 172–182). `POST /api/users/resolve-id` mints an access and refresh pair that copies those roles (`users.controller.ts` 183–188; `user-auth.service.ts` 645–660). `AdminAuthGuard` accepts `admin`, `org_admin`, or `super_admin` (`jwt-auth.guard.ts` 250–253). After the update, `runUpdateTaskNewAssigneeSideEffects` writes a JSONB notification and inserts `posts` with `author_id` set to each new assignee and `post_type` `task_assignment` (`tasks-side-effects.service.ts` 320–387). `GET /api/posts` has no guard and keeps rows whose status is not `hidden` (`posts.controller.ts` 754, 830–831). The handler also logs `JSON.stringify(body)` (`tasks.controller.ts` 511–514) and the SQL parameters (`tasks-patch-mutation.service.ts` 339). Concrete trigger: `GET /api/users` with no `Authorization`, then `POST /api/users/resolve-id` with an email whose `roles` include `admin` or `org_admin` and not `super_admin`, then `GET /api/tasks` with that Bearer. If a row has `creator_details` null, `PATCH /api/tasks/:id` with `assignees` set to any other directory id succeeds because the null check is skipped. If no such row exists, pick a row whose `creator_details.id` matches a directory user whose `roles` include `super_admin`, and send the same PATCH. The task's `assignees` become that id, and the public feed shows a task post authored by that user. NFR §3.5 requires omitting fields the caller may not see. §2.5.4 requires a JWT to change a post; this path creates one as someone other than the caller. The 2026-10-11 bullet is `POST /api/tasks`, which writes `created_by` from the body. This bullet cannot change `created_by`. It reuses whoever is already stored, or nobody. - File: `apps/api/src/tasks/tasks.controller.ts` (466–529); `apps/api/src/tasks/tasks-patch-mutation.service.ts` (198–265, 279–385); `apps/api/src/tasks/tasks-permissions.service.ts` (43–84); `apps/api/src/tasks/tasks.types.ts` (41–53); `apps/api/src/tasks/tasks-schema.service.ts` (100–117); `apps/api/src/tasks/tasks-side-effects.service.ts` (320–399) -> Action: Bind the assignee check to `req.user.userId` and reject the update when `created_by` is null. Keep `posts.author_id` on the acting subject. Do not log the raw body or the SQL parameters.

 * **Admin JWT creates tasks as another user and bypasses the caller's assignment scope (2026-10-11, re-verified 2026-10-12).** `POST /api/tasks` never reads `req.user` (`tasks.controller.ts` 260–262). Body `created_by` is the subject of `canAssignToUser` (`tasks-create-prep.service.ts` 43–68, 130–154; `tasks-permissions.service.ts` 43–79). A self-assignment under that id writes `posts.author_id` to that user (`tasks-side-effects.service.ts` 127–147, 236–244). - File: `apps/api/src/tasks/tasks.controller.ts` (260–382) -> Action: Bind `created_by` to `req.user.userId`. Run `canAssignToUser` against that subject.

 * **Unauthenticated collections API reads and rewrites JSONB notification bodies (2026-10-10, re-verified 2026-10-12).** `ItemsController` has no `UseGuards` (`items.controller.ts` 22–23). `userId=all` calls `listAll` (57–62). `notifications` is allowlisted (`items.service.ts` 22) and `listAll` selects `data` with no `LIMIT` (249–255). - File: `apps/api/src/items/items.controller.ts` (22–23, 33–108); `apps/api/src/items/items.service.ts` (15–22, 65–90, 123–190, 201–276) -> Action: Require `JwtAuthGuard`. Bind `userId` to `req.user.userId` and reject `userId=all` for `notifications`.

 * **Any JWT reads another user's daily challenge notes (2026-10-09, re-verified 2026-10-12).** `GET /api/community-challenges/daily-tracker` reads query `user_id` and returns `notes` with no `LIMIT` (`community-group-challenges.controller.ts` 33–34, 288–293, 319–336, 355–370, 434–439). - File: `apps/api/src/controllers/community-group-challenges.controller.ts` (288–481) -> Action: Bind `user_id` to `CurrentUser()`. Cap the date span and the row count.

Cap the list. Move `CREATE TABLE` off the request path.

Do not return `error.message`.

SRS §2.11.4 names `AdminAuthGuard`. - File: `apps/api/src/tasks/tasks.controller.ts` (568–586); `apps/api/src/tasks/tasks-read.service.ts` (171–325) -> Action: Require `AdminAuthGuard`, or allow the call only when the JWT subject is that manager.

 * **Unauthenticated CRM contact book (2026-10-05, re-verified 2026-10-12).** `CrmController` has no guard. `GET` is `SELECT *` with no `LIMIT`. `POST` / `PATCH` / `DELETE` write any id. The first request runs `CREATE TABLE` (`crm.controller.ts` 38, 48–268). - File: `apps/api/src/controllers/crm.controller.ts` -> Action: Require `AdminAuthGuard`. Bind `created_by` to `req.user.userId`. Move DDL off the request path.

 * **Public admin UUID grants the `admin` role (2026-09-27, re-verified 2026-10-12).** `POST /api/users/:id/promote-admin` authorizes body `requestingAdminId` (`users.controller.ts` 64–70; `user-hierarchy.service.ts` 945–1049). The pull check fails open at line 149. `demote-admin` and `promote-volunteer` use the same body actor. - File: `apps/api/src/controllers/users.controller.ts` (64–88) -> Action: Bind the actor to `req.user.userId` and require `AdminAuthGuard`. Fail closed on the pull check.

 * **Comment edit/delete IDOR (2026-09-26, re-verified 2026-10-12).** Update compares `post_comments.user_id` to `body.user_id` (`posts.controller.ts` 1975–2024). Delete uses query `user_id` (2053–2106). - File: `apps/api/src/controllers/posts.controller.ts` -> Action: Bind the actor to `req.user.userId`.

Stop minting tokens from `resolve-id`.

No `trust proxy` exists under `apps/api`. - File: `apps/api/src/controllers/rate-limit.controller.ts` -> Action: Do not mount `RateLimitController` on deployed builds. Count login failures per account after a password check.

 * **Unauthenticated plant of the shared JOSE JWT lockout (2026-09-23, re-verified 2026-10-12).** `POST /rate-limit/custom` can write `blocked:api_access:<JOSE prefix>` (`rate-limit.service.ts` 269–275; `jwt-auth.guard.ts` 96–114). NFR §3.1 currently requires “per token prefix”; that sentence is the defect. - File: `apps/api/src/controllers/rate-limit.controller.ts` (233–248) -> Action: Remove the route from deployed builds. Key the bucket on the verified user id after `verifyToken`.

 * **Shared JOSE-header rate-limit lockout (2026-09-22, re-verified 2026-10-12).** One hundred forged Bearers that share the HS256 header write one block key for 300 seconds (`jwt-auth.guard.ts` 96–115). The limiter fails open when Redis throws (`rate-limit.service.ts` 87–89, 106–111). - File: `apps/api/src/auth/guards/jwt-auth.guard.ts` (96–134) -> Action: Key the bucket on the verified user id. Fail closed on auth routes when the limiter cannot be read.

 * **Guest chat roster and read-receipt forge (2026-09-15 / 2026-09-16, re-verified 2026-10-12).** `OptionalAuthGuard` always returns true (`jwt-auth.guard.ts` 338). Guest message history skips the participant check (`chat.controller.ts` 378–420). Guest send accepts `sender_id` (456–570). - File: `apps/api/src/controllers/chat.controller.ts` (45–46, 246–669) -> Action: Require JWT. Bind the sender and the reader to `req.user.userId`.

 * **Unauthenticated Redis session-key harvest (2026-09-14, re-verified 2026-10-12).** `GET /session/stats` lists `session:*` keys. `GET /session/validate/:sessionId` returns the session blob. `DELETE /session/logout-all/:userId` drops those sessions (`session.controller.ts` 136–299). - File: `apps/api/src/auth/controllers/session.controller.ts` -> Action: Remove `/session` from deployed builds or require admin JWT.

 * **JWT-gated like, comment, and follow actor spoof (re-verified 2026-10-12).** Like and comment writes persist `body.user_id` (`posts.controller.ts` 1343–1396, 1573–1643, 2152–2209). Follow uses body `follower_id` (`user-follow.service.ts` 19–34, 96–98). - File: `apps/api/src/controllers/posts.controller.ts` -> Action: Bind actors to `req.user.userId`.

 * **Unauthenticated `POST /api/users/resolve-id` mints a JWT (re-verified 2026-10-12).** A known email, `google_id`, or `firebase_uid` returns an access and refresh pair (`users.controller.ts` 183–188; `user-auth.service.ts` 270–342, 645–660). This token is the entry point for the hierarchy rewrite, the comment IDOR, promote-admin, the donation-total write, the task time-log write, the admin file list, the daily tracker, the `GET /api/tasks` call that creates the `notifications` table, the task-create path in the 2026-10-11 bullet, and the task-patch path in the 2026-10-12 bullet. - File: `apps/api/src/controllers/users.controller.ts` (183–188) -> Action: Remove token minting from resolve-id. Require a verified ID token.

 * **Password-optional `/api/users/login` and root-admin bootstrap (re-verified 2026-10-12).** `loginUser` verifies argon2 only when both `password` and `password_hash` are truthy (`user-auth.service.ts` 223–231). Register with the committed fallback mailbox sets `admin` (101–102). - File: `apps/api/src/services/user-auth.service.ts` (97–139, 212–263) -> Action: Fail closed unless a password verifies. Never mutate roles before `argon2.verify`.

 * **Profile mass-assignment and unauthenticated directory dumps (re-verified 2026-10-12).** `PUT /api/users/:id` accepts `password`, `roles`, and `firebase_uid` and is not bound to `req.user` (`users.controller.ts` 126–133). `GET /api/users`, `GET :id`, search, activities, and stats have no guards. `GET :id` returns `phone`, `settings`, and `roles` (`user-profile.service.ts` 126–158). - File: `apps/api/src/controllers/users.controller.ts` (40–163) -> Action: Bind `:id` to `req.user.userId` unless admin. Strip privileged fields from the public DTO.

 * **Other unguarded write surfaces and stats export (re-verified 2026-10-12).** Knowledge-link `POST` is public, matching SRS §2.3.3. `GET /api/stats/details/:statType` is JWT-only and `totalUsers` returns name, email, and city (`stats.controller.ts` 834–876). The collections notification dump is the 2026-10-10 bullet. Task create is the 2026-10-11 bullet. Task patch assignment is the 2026-10-12 bullet. - File: `apps/api/src/controllers/stats.controller.ts` (834–876) -> Action: Add `JwtAuthGuard` (admin where appropriate). Bind owners and actors to the JWT.

 * **Request-path `DROP TABLE ... CASCADE` (re-verified 2026-10-12).** `ensurePostsTable` drops `posts` when legacy columns are detected (`posts.controller.ts` 78, 309, 373–374). `DatabaseInit` drops donations and rides on startup when it treats the schema as legacy (`database.init.ts` 568, 670). - File: `apps/api/src/controllers/posts.controller.ts` (78, 309, 373–374) -> Action: Never DROP on a request path. Gate destructive DDL behind an offline migration.

 * **Committed credentials, backups, stale refresh roles, and Firebase audience (re-verified 2026-10-12).** `apps/api/railway.toml.dev` line 34 commits a `JWT_SECRET` (value not repeated here). `main.ts` 149–218 fingerprints environments with committed DB and Redis password substrings (values not repeated here). Tracked JSON under `apps/api/data-backups/20251224-162421/` includes email, phone, and `password_hash`. `refreshAccessToken` copies `payload.roles` (`jwt.service.ts` 146–177). Firebase JWKS derives `aud` from the token (`firebase-admin.service.ts` 150–184). `/auth/google` can fall back to a client-supplied access token (`auth.controller.ts` 588–698). - File: `apps/api/railway.toml.dev` (34); `apps/api/src/main.ts` (149–218); `apps/api/data-backups/` -> Action: Rotate every fingerprinted credential. Purge backups from git history. Reload roles on refresh. Accept only verified ID tokens.

## 🐞 Bugs & Logic Issues

 * **Task patch logs the raw body and the SQL parameters, and attributes the feed post to the new assignee (2026-10-12).** `JSON.stringify(body)` is written at info level (`tasks.controller.ts` 511–514). The mutation log includes the bound parameter list (`tasks-patch-mutation.service.ts` 339). A newly added assignee becomes `posts.author_id` (`tasks-side-effects.service.ts` 374–387). Recommendation: Log only the task id after update. Bind `author_id` to `req.user.userId`.

 * **Task create logs the raw body and attributes the feed post to the spoofed creator (2026-10-11, re-verified 2026-10-12).** `JSON.stringify(body)` is written at info level (`tasks.controller.ts` 287). A self-assignment under a spoofed `created_by` inserts a public post whose `author_id` is that user (`tasks-side-effects.service.ts` 136–147). Recommendation: Log only the task id after insert. Bind `author_id` to `req.user.userId`.

 * **Notification listAll has no cap and logs the first JSON body (2026-10-10, re-verified 2026-10-12).** `listAll` returns every `data` blob and `console.log` writes `JSON.stringify(rows[0].data)` (`items.service.ts` 249–276). `popular-collections` and `cache-stats` stay shadowed by `:collection` (43 vs 136–154). Recommendation: Paginate `listAll`. Do not log row bodies. Declare static routes before `:collection`.

 * **Daily tracker date window is caller-sized and has no row cap (2026-10-09, re-verified 2026-10-12).** Supplied dates are bound as-is (`community-group-challenges.controller.ts` 300–316, 364–370). Recommendation: Require `CurrentUser()`, allow at most a fixed number of days, and paginate entries.

 * **Admin file search drops the folder filter and the list has no cap (2026-10-08, re-verified 2026-10-12).** `folder_path = $1` is added only when `search` is absent (`admin-files.controller.ts` 104–113). Recommendation: Keep the folder predicate. Cap and paginate the list.

 * **A planted time log replaces the total and unlocks mark-done (2026-10-07, re-verified 2026-10-12).** `ON CONFLICT` sets `actual_hours` to the new value (`tasks.controller.ts` 437–442). Recommendation: Add to `actual_hours` when the product means an increment. Return a generic error.

 * **Hours report hides failures and has no cycle cap (2026-10-06, re-verified 2026-10-12).** Both catch paths return `success: true` with zero hours (`tasks.controller.ts` 576–584; `tasks-read.service.ts` 313–323). Recommendation: Return `success: false` on query failure. Stop the walk at a fixed depth.

 * **CRM list has no cap, and a missing table is created on the public GET (2026-10-05, re-verified 2026-10-12).** `GET /api/crm` has no `LIMIT` (`crm.controller.ts` 137). Recommendation: Cap the list. Create `crm_contacts` in an offline migration.

 * **Community-members list replaces a shared trigger function (2026-10-04, re-verified 2026-10-12).** `ensureTable` executes `CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION update_updated_at_column()` (`community-members.controller.ts` 157–165). Recommendation: Leave the shared function untouched on the request path.

 * **Ride booking approval has no driver and no seat lock (2026-10-03, re-verified 2026-10-12).** `PUT /api/rides/bookings/:bookingId/status` sets the body status before it counts remaining seats (`rides.controller.ts` 505–555). Recommendation: `SELECT … FOR UPDATE` on the ride. Allowlist status. Approve only when the JWT subject is the driver.

 * **Places details interpolates `place_id` and publishes search terms (2026-10-02, re-verified 2026-10-12).** `GET /place-details` concatenates `place_id` into the Google URL (`places.controller.ts` 75). `GET /search-stats` lists stored search strings with no auth (88–91, 139–166). Recommendation: `encodeURIComponent` on `place_id`. Do not return the upstream error string.

 * **Companion item post is best-effort, and the caller chooses the item id (2026-10-01, re-verified 2026-10-12).** A failed `INSERT INTO posts` is caught and the item still commits (`dedicated-items.service.ts` 170–177). Recommendation: One transaction. Generate the id on the server.

 * **Item deliver commits `delivered` before the request permission check (2026-09-30, re-verified 2026-10-12).** `markAsDelivered` updates the item, then optionally calls `updateItemRequest` (`items-delivery.controller.ts` 247–258). Recommendation: One transaction. Check the JWT subject before either write.

 * **Money donation counters ignore sign, zero, and later edits (2026-09-29, re-verified 2026-10-12).** A truthy negative `amount` subtracts from `total_donations_amount`. `PUT` and `DELETE` leave both counters unchanged (`donations.controller.ts` 525–541, 698–780). Recommendation: Reject non-positive money amounts. Adjust both counters by the delta inside the same transaction.

 * **Anonymous hierarchy read can `ALTER TABLE` (2026-09-28, re-verified 2026-10-12).** `ensureSalarySeniorityColumns` adds `salary`, `seniority_start_date`, and `parent_manager_id` (`user-hierarchy.service.ts` 436–483). Recommendation: Apply those columns in an offline migration.

 * **Hierarchy pull check fails open (2026-09-27, re-verified 2026-10-12).** `assertRequesterMayPullTargetUnderSelf` returns `{ ok: true }` at line 149 when neither ancestor check matches. Recommendation: Default to deny.

 * **Comment handlers return `error.message` (re-verified 2026-10-12).** Update, delete, and list catch blocks interpolate the driver message (`posts.controller.ts` 1803–1805, 2042–2045, 2134–2137). Recommendation: Return a generic error and log the driver message server-side.

 * **`GET /rate-limit/stats` lists every limiter key with no auth (re-verified 2026-10-12).** `getRateLimitStats` runs `KEYS rate_limit:*` and `KEYS blocked:*` (`rate-limit.service.ts` 238–256). Recommendation: Remove the route from deployed builds.

 * **Rate limiter fails open when Redis errors (re-verified 2026-10-12).** `checkRateLimit` returns `allowed: true` if the block read or the counter read throws (`rate-limit.service.ts` 87–89, 106–111). Recommendation: Fail closed on auth routes.

 * **Unauthenticated `POST /api/stats/track-visit` inflates production metrics (re-verified 2026-10-12).** No guard. Increments `community_stats.site_visits` (373–401). Recommendation: Require a bot-resistant token, or drop the public increment.

 * **Items-delivery static route is shadowed (re-verified 2026-10-12).** `GET /api/items-delivery/:id` is declared before `GET requests` (180–223), so the request list is captured as an item id. Dedicated-items `GET :id` still shadows `GET search` (69 vs 166). Recommendation: Declare static routes before parameterized routes.

 * **`loginUser` and `JwtAuthGuard` never consult `user_profiles.is_active` (re-verified 2026-10-12).** Deactivated rows can still obtain a session via email-only login or an existing refresh token. Recommendation: Fail closed on `is_active = false`.

 * **Anonymity filtering is specified and not implemented (re-verified 2026-10-12).** SRS §2.5.7 / NFR §3.2 require server-side redaction for `anonymity_level < 4`. The column is still absent (0 matches under `apps/`). Recommendation: Add the column and the feed projection.

## 🏗️ Architecture & Clean Code

 * **No Domain / Application / Infrastructure folders** under `apps/` or `packages/` (count 0). The target in `docs/SSOT/CODE_QUALITY/layers-and-boundaries.md` is Infrastructure → Application → Domain. The monorepo remains NestJS feature folders plus React Native screens. `packages/` still only contains `config-eslint`. The closest pure islands remain `apps/api/src/tasks/task-completion-participants.ts`, `tasks-validation.ts`, `tasks-query-params.ts`, and `tasks.types.ts`. `tasks-permissions.service.ts` is the hierarchy policy, but it imports `pg` and is invoked with a stored or client-supplied creator id.

 * **Fat HTTP layer owns SQL and policy.** Largest API files: `posts.controller.ts` (2741), `stats.controller.ts` (1709), `user-hierarchy.service.ts` (1675), `database.init.ts` (1374), `community-group-challenges.controller.ts` (1097), `donations.controller.ts` (892), `chat.controller.ts` (813), `rides.controller.ts` (779). `TasksController.updateTask` (466–529) still parses the body and delegates the assignee decision without a session subject. `TasksPatchMutationService` (386 lines) owns the SQL and calls `canAssignToUser` with `tasks.created_by`.

 * **Privilege checks disagree inside the same product.** `PATCH` and `DELETE` on `/api/tasks` use `AdminAuthGuard` (466–467, 531–532). `PATCH` then authorizes new assignees as the stored creator, and skips that check when `created_by` is null. `POST` uses `AdminAuthGuard` and then authorizes assignments as whoever the body names. `log-hours` and `hours-report` use only `JwtAuthGuard`. Notifications `validateOwnership` compares `:userId` to `req.user.userId`. The collections controller never reads a session.

Task assignment notifications on patch are written through `ItemsService.create("notifications", …)` (`tasks-side-effects.service.ts` 341–354), which is the same table the 2026-10-10 dump reads.

 * **Database design and the community-members table disagree.** SRS database design lists `email` and `phone` columns on `community_members` (`docs/SSOT/SRS/06-database-design.md`). `schema.sql` stores one `contact_info` JSONB object (1072–1077).

 * **CRM table and admin file table are absent from the committed schema.** `schema.sql` and `docs/SSOT/SRS/06-database-design.md` do not define `crm_contacts` or `general_files`. `CrmController.ensureTable` and `AdminFilesController.ensureTable` create them on the first request.

 * **Positive in-folder contrasts (do not regress):** `/api/notifications` already uses `JwtAuthGuard` and `validateOwnership`; admin-files POST and DELETE already use `AdminAuthGuard`; community-group challenges bind the creator on create, join, entry, PUT, and DELETE; `GET :id/entries` and `GET user/:userId/stats` bind `CurrentUser()`; personal challenges scope timer reads and updates to `CurrentUser()` and keep `PUT` columns on a class-validator DTO; knowledge contribution-request binds `req.user.userId`; sync user/all/status use `AdminAuthGuard`; authenticated chat send/read checks `ANY(participants)` when a JWT is present; `/session/login` requires argon2 once the shared limiter allows the call; CRM PATCH uses hardcoded column names; community-challenge `ORDER BY` uses an allowlist plus `pg-format` `%I`; item list `ORDER BY` uses an allowlisted column; ride list `ORDER BY` uses an allowlisted column; collection names are checked against `ALLOWED_COLLECTIONS` before SQL; `canAssignToUser` fails closed when the hierarchy query throws. The missing check on task patch is which user id is passed in, and that the check is skipped when `created_by` is null. Places autocomplete encodes its query string; place-details does not. Admin-files search binds `ILIKE`.

 * **Operator matching workspace is specified and not implemented.** `OperatorAuthGuard` exists and there is no `/api/operator/*` module. Anonymity and matching-case tables remain SRS §10 gaps.

## 🚨 Critical Vulnerabilities

 * **Admin JWT creates tasks as another user and bypasses the caller's assignment scope (2026-10-11).** SRS §2.11.4 lists `POST /api/tasks` with `JwtAuthGuard`. The method also uses `AdminAuthGuard` and the handler takes only `@Body()` (`tasks.controller.ts` 260–262). `created_by` defaults to null and is required from the client (277, 289–294). `CreateTaskDto` is a TypeScript interface (`tasks.types.ts` 22–36), so the global `ValidationPipe` does not whitelist the body (`main.ts` 427–430). `resolveCreateTaskCreatorUuid` resolves that string by UUID, email, or `firebase_uid` and never sees the session (`tasks-create-prep.service.ts` 43–68; `user-resolution.service.ts` 81–89). `assertCreateTaskAssigneeHierarchy` calls `canAssignToUser(createdByUuid, assigneeId)` (130–154). That helper returns true when the named creator is the assignee or has role `super_admin`, and otherwise walks `parent_manager_id` from the named creator (43–79). It returns false only when that query throws. Unguarded `GET /api/users` returns `id`, `email`, and `roles` (`users.controller.ts` 135–145; `user-profile.service.ts` 502–516). `POST /api/users/resolve-id` mints an access and refresh pair that copies those roles (`users.controller.ts` 183–188; `user-auth.service.ts` 328–342, 645–660). `AdminAuthGuard` accepts `admin`, `org_admin`, or `super_admin` (`jwt-auth.guard.ts` 250–253). A token for an `admin` or `org_admin` is not a `super_admin` token, but `canAssignToUser` never looks at the token. When the only assignee equals the spoofed creator, the create path treats the assignment as self-work and `insertCreatorAssignmentPostForNewTask` inserts `posts` with `author_id` set to that creator (`tasks-side-effects.service.ts` 213–244, 127–147). When other users are assigned, they receive a JSONB notification and a public `task_assignment` post authored as themselves (247–248, 275–317, 165–189). `GET /api/posts` has no guard and keeps rows whose status is not `hidden` (`posts.controller.ts` 754, 830–831). The handler also logs `JSON.stringify(body)` (287). Concrete trigger: `GET /api/users` with no `Authorization`, then `POST /api/users/resolve-id` with an email whose `roles` include `admin` or `org_admin` and not `super_admin`, then `POST /api/tasks` with that Bearer, `created_by` set to a directory id whose roles include `super_admin`, `assignees` set to that same id, and a `title`. The new task row's `created_by` is the super admin, and the public feed shows a task post authored by that user. A second call with `assignees` set to any other directory id succeeds for the same reason and notifies that person. NFR §3.5 requires omitting fields the caller may not see. §2.5.4 requires a JWT to change a post; this path creates one as someone other than the caller. The 2026-10-07 bullet is `log-hours`, which writes `task_time_logs` for body `user_id`. The 2026-10-10 bullet is the collections notification dump. This bullet is task create. - File: `apps/api/src/tasks/tasks.controller.ts` (260–382); `apps/api/src/tasks/tasks-create-prep.service.ts` (43–155); `apps/api/src/tasks/tasks-permissions.service.ts` (43–84); `apps/api/src/tasks/tasks.types.ts` (22–36); `apps/api/src/tasks/tasks-side-effects.service.ts` (127–189, 213–317); `apps/api/src/auth/guards/jwt-auth.guard.ts` (238–261) -> Action: Bind `created_by` to `req.user.userId` and reject a mismatched client id. Run `canAssignToUser` against that subject. Keep the feed post's `author_id` on the same subject. Do not log the raw body.

 * **Unauthenticated collections API reads and rewrites JSONB notification bodies (2026-10-10, re-verified 2026-10-11).** `ItemsController` has no `UseGuards` (`items.controller.ts` 22–23). `userId=all` calls `listAll` (57–62). `notifications` is allowlisted (`items.service.ts` 22) and `listAll` selects `data` with no `LIMIT` (249–255). `GET /api/tasks` calls `ensureTasksTable()` (`tasks.controller.ts` 74–80), which creates that JSONB table (`tasks-schema.service.ts` 197–206). Hierarchy removal writes task ids and names into it (`user-hierarchy.service.ts` 830–855). `POST` / `PUT` / `DELETE` rewrite those rows. `/api/notifications` still binds the subject and reads `user_notifications` (`notifications.controller.ts` 23–24, 94–110; `schema.sql` 330–341). - File: `apps/api/src/items/items.controller.ts` (22–23, 33–108); `apps/api/src/items/items.service.ts` (15–22, 65–90, 123–190, 201–276) -> Action: Require `JwtAuthGuard` on collection reads and writes. Bind `userId` to `req.user.userId` and reject `userId=all` for `notifications`.

Follow uses body `follower_id` (`user-follow.service.ts` 19–34, 96–98). - File: `apps/api/src/controllers/posts.controller.ts` -> Action: Bind actors to `req.user.userId`.

This token is the entry point for the hierarchy rewrite, the comment IDOR, promote-admin, the donation-total write, the task time-log write, the admin file list, the daily tracker, the `GET /api/tasks` call that creates the `notifications` table, and the task-create path in the 2026-10-11 bullet. - File: `apps/api/src/controllers/users.controller.ts` (183–188) -> Action: Remove token minting from resolve-id. Require a verified ID token.

Never mutate roles before `argon2.verify`.

## 🐞 Bugs & Logic Issues

 * **Task create logs the raw body and attributes the feed post to the spoofed creator (2026-10-11).** `JSON.stringify(body)` is written at info level (`tasks.controller.ts` 287). A self-assignment under a spoofed `created_by` inserts a public post whose `author_id` is that user (`tasks-side-effects.service.ts` 136–147). Recommendation: Log only the task id after insert. Bind `author_id` to `req.user.userId`.

 * **Notification listAll has no cap and logs the first JSON body (2026-10-10, re-verified 2026-10-11).** `listAll` returns every `data` blob and `console.log` writes `JSON.stringify(rows[0].data)` (`items.service.ts` 249–276). `popular-collections` and `cache-stats` stay shadowed by `:collection` (43 vs 136–154). Recommendation: Paginate `listAll`. Do not log row bodies. Declare static routes before `:collection`.

 * **Daily tracker date window is caller-sized and has no row cap (2026-10-09, re-verified 2026-10-11).** Supplied dates are bound as-is (`community-group-challenges.controller.ts` 300–316, 364–370). Recommendation: Require `CurrentUser()`, allow at most a fixed number of days, and paginate entries.

 * **Admin file search drops the folder filter and the list has no cap (2026-10-08, re-verified 2026-10-11).** `folder_path = $1` is added only when `search` is absent (`admin-files.controller.ts` 104–113). Recommendation: Keep the folder predicate. Cap and paginate the list.

 * **A planted time log replaces the total and unlocks mark-done (2026-10-07, re-verified 2026-10-11).** `ON CONFLICT` sets `actual_hours` to the new value (`tasks.controller.ts` 437–442). Recommendation: Add to `actual_hours` when the product means an increment. Return a generic error.

 * **Hours report hides failures and has no cycle cap (2026-10-06, re-verified 2026-10-11).** Both catch paths return `success: true` with zero hours (`tasks.controller.ts` 576–584; `tasks-read.service.ts` 313–323). Recommendation: Return `success: false` on query failure. Stop the walk at a fixed depth.

 * **CRM list has no cap, and a missing table is created on the public GET (2026-10-05, re-verified 2026-10-11).** `GET /api/crm` has no `LIMIT` (`crm.controller.ts` 137). Recommendation: Cap the list. Create `crm_contacts` in an offline migration.

 * **Community-members list replaces a shared trigger function (2026-10-04, re-verified 2026-10-11).** `ensureTable` executes `CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION update_updated_at_column()` (`community-members.controller.ts` 157–165). Recommendation: Leave the shared function untouched on the request path.

 * **Ride booking approval has no driver and no seat lock (2026-10-03, re-verified 2026-10-11).** `PUT /api/rides/bookings/:bookingId/status` sets the body status before it counts remaining seats (`rides.controller.ts` 505–555). Recommendation: `SELECT … FOR UPDATE` on the ride. Allowlist status. Approve only when the JWT subject is the driver.

 * **Places details interpolates `place_id` and publishes search terms (2026-10-02, re-verified 2026-10-11).** `GET /place-details` concatenates `place_id` into the Google URL (`places.controller.ts` 75). `GET /search-stats` lists stored search strings with no auth (88–91, 139–166). Recommendation: `encodeURIComponent` on `place_id`. Do not return the upstream error string.

 * **Companion item post is best-effort, and the caller chooses the item id (2026-10-01, re-verified 2026-10-11).** A failed `INSERT INTO posts` is caught and the item still commits (`dedicated-items.service.ts` 170–177). Recommendation: One transaction. Generate the id on the server.

 * **Item deliver commits `delivered` before the request permission check (2026-09-30, re-verified 2026-10-11).** `markAsDelivered` updates the item, then optionally calls `updateItemRequest` (`items-delivery.controller.ts` 247–258). Recommendation: One transaction. Check the JWT subject before either write.

 * **Money donation counters ignore sign, zero, and later edits (2026-09-29, re-verified 2026-10-11).** A truthy negative `amount` subtracts from `total_donations_amount`. `PUT` and `DELETE` leave both counters unchanged (`donations.controller.ts` 525–541, 698–780). Recommendation: Reject non-positive money amounts. Adjust both counters by the delta inside the same transaction.

 * **Anonymous hierarchy read can `ALTER TABLE` (2026-09-28, re-verified 2026-10-11).** `ensureSalarySeniorityColumns` adds `salary`, `seniority_start_date`, and `parent_manager_id` (`user-hierarchy.service.ts` 436–483). Recommendation: Apply those columns in an offline migration.

 * **Hierarchy pull check fails open (2026-09-27, re-verified 2026-10-11).** `assertRequesterMayPullTargetUnderSelf` returns `{ ok: true }` at line 149 when neither ancestor check matches. Recommendation: Default to deny.

 * **Comment handlers return `error.message` (re-verified 2026-10-11).** Update, delete, and list catch blocks interpolate the driver message (`posts.controller.ts` 1803–1805, 2042–2045, 2134–2137). Recommendation: Return a generic error and log the driver message server-side.

 * **`GET /rate-limit/stats` lists every limiter key with no auth (re-verified 2026-10-11).** `getRateLimitStats` runs `KEYS rate_limit:*` and `KEYS blocked:*` (`rate-limit.service.ts` 238–256). Recommendation: Remove the route from deployed builds.

 * **Rate limiter fails open when Redis errors (re-verified 2026-10-11).** `checkRateLimit` returns `allowed: true` if the block read or the counter read throws (`rate-limit.service.ts` 87–89, 106–111). Recommendation: Fail closed on auth routes.

 * **Unauthenticated `POST /api/stats/track-visit` inflates production metrics (re-verified 2026-10-11).** No guard. Increments `community_stats.site_visits` (373–401). Recommendation: Require a bot-resistant token, or drop the public increment.

 * **Items-delivery static route is shadowed (re-verified 2026-10-11).** `GET /api/items-delivery/:id` is declared before `GET requests` (180–223), so the request list is captured as an item id. Dedicated-items `GET :id` still shadows `GET search` (69 vs 166). Recommendation: Declare static routes before parameterized routes.

 * **`loginUser` and `JwtAuthGuard` never consult `user_profiles.is_active` (re-verified 2026-10-11).** Deactivated rows can still obtain a session via email-only login or an existing refresh token. Recommendation: Fail closed on `is_active = false`.

 * **Anonymity filtering is specified and not implemented (re-verified 2026-10-11).** SRS §2.5.7 / NFR §3.2 require server-side redaction for `anonymity_level < 4`. The column is still absent (0 matches under `apps/`). Recommendation: Add the column and the feed projection.

## 🏗️ Architecture & Clean Code

 * **No Domain / Application / Infrastructure folders** under `apps/` or `packages/` (count 0). The target in `docs/SSOT/CODE_QUALITY/layers-and-boundaries.md` is Infrastructure → Application → Domain. The monorepo remains NestJS feature folders plus React Native screens. `packages/` still only contains `config-eslint`. The closest pure islands remain `apps/api/src/tasks/task-completion-participants.ts`, `tasks-validation.ts`, `tasks-query-params.ts`, and `tasks.types.ts`. `tasks-permissions.service.ts` is the hierarchy policy, but it imports `pg` and is invoked with a client-supplied creator id.

 * **Fat HTTP layer owns SQL and policy.** Largest API files: `posts.controller.ts` (2741), `stats.controller.ts` (1709), `user-hierarchy.service.ts` (1675), `database.init.ts` (1374), `community-group-challenges.controller.ts` (1097), `donations.controller.ts` (892), `chat.controller.ts` (813), `rides.controller.ts` (779). `TasksController.createTask` (260–382) still parses the body, resolves users, and inserts SQL in the HTTP handler. The assignment decision lives in `TasksPermissionsService`, and the caller passes body `created_by` into it.

 * **Privilege checks disagree inside the same product.** `PATCH` and `DELETE` on `/api/tasks` use `AdminAuthGuard` (466–467, 531–532). `POST` uses `AdminAuthGuard` and then authorizes assignments as whoever the body names. `log-hours` and `hours-report` use only `JwtAuthGuard`. Notifications `validateOwnership` compares `:userId` to `req.user.userId`. The collections controller never reads a session.

 * **Two notification stores, one of them generic.** SRS §2.9.1 names both `user_notifications` and the JSONB `notifications` table. The guarded controller uses `user_notifications`. The unguarded collection name `notifications` uses the JSONB table created by `tasks-schema.service.ts`. Task assignment notifications are written through `ItemsService.create("notifications", …)` (`tasks-side-effects.service.ts` 341–354), which is the same table the 2026-10-10 dump reads.

 * **Database design and the community-members table disagree.** SRS database design lists `email` and `phone` columns on `community_members` (`docs/SSOT/SRS/06-database-design.md`). `schema.sql` stores one `contact_info` JSONB object (1072–1077).

 * **CRM table and admin file table are absent from the committed schema.** `schema.sql` and `docs/SSOT/SRS/06-database-design.md` do not define `crm_contacts` or `general_files`. `CrmController.ensureTable` and `AdminFilesController.ensureTable` create them on the first request.

 * **Positive in-folder contrasts (do not regress):** `/api/notifications` already uses `JwtAuthGuard` and `validateOwnership`; admin-files POST and DELETE already use `AdminAuthGuard`; community-group challenges bind the creator on create, join, entry, PUT, and DELETE; `GET :id/entries` and `GET user/:userId/stats` bind `CurrentUser()`; personal challenges scope timer reads and updates to `CurrentUser()` and keep `PUT` columns on a class-validator DTO; knowledge contribution-request binds `req.user.userId`; sync user/all/status use `AdminAuthGuard`; authenticated chat send/read checks `ANY(participants)` when a JWT is present; `/session/login` requires argon2 once the shared limiter allows the call; CRM PATCH uses hardcoded column names; community-challenge `ORDER BY` uses an allowlist plus `pg-format` `%I`; item list `ORDER BY` uses an allowlisted column; ride list `ORDER BY` uses an allowlisted column; collection names are checked against `ALLOWED_COLLECTIONS` before SQL; `canAssignToUser` fails closed when the hierarchy query throws. The missing check on task create is which user id is passed in. Places autocomplete encodes its query string; place-details does not. Admin-files search binds `ILIKE`.

 * **Operator matching workspace is specified and not implemented.** `OperatorAuthGuard` exists and there is no `/api/operator/*` module. Anonymity and matching-case tables remain SRS §10 gaps.

## 🚨 Critical Vulnerabilities

 * **Unauthenticated collections API reads and rewrites JSONB notification bodies (2026-10-10).** `ItemsController` has no `UseGuards` (`items.controller.ts` 22–23). `ItemsModule` registers it (`items.module.ts` 18; `app.module.ts` 86). SRS §2.6.1 lists `GET /api/collections/:collection`, `POST`, `PUT`, and `DELETE` and does not name a guard (`02-06-items.md` 6–14). `GET :collection` treats query `userId=all` as a full-table read for every allowlisted name (43–68). `notifications` is in `ALLOWED_COLLECTIONS` (`items.service.ts` 15–22). `listAll` runs `SELECT data FROM notifications` with no `LIMIT` and returns every JSON blob (228–255). A `q` value is bound into `data::text ILIKE` and still scans every row (234–247). `list` with any other `userId` returns that user's blobs (201–224). `GET /api/tasks` is `JwtAuthGuard` only and the first line of the handler calls `ensureTasksTable()` (`tasks.controller.ts` 74–80). That method runs `CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS notifications (user_id TEXT, item_id TEXT, data JSONB, …)` (`tasks-schema.service.ts` 197–206). The same statement is in `migrations/create_notifications_table.sql` (1–9). After a subordinate is removed, `user-hierarchy.service.ts` inserts a row whose `data` contains `transferredTaskIds`, `fromUser`, and `fromUserName` (830–855). `POST /api/collections/notifications` passes client `userId`, `id`, and `data` into an `INSERT … ON CONFLICT (user_id, item_id) DO UPDATE SET data = EXCLUDED.data` (`items.controller.ts` 80–86; `items.service.ts` 65–90). `UpsertItemDto` is a class, so `userId` and `data` are accepted as any string and any object (`item.dto.ts` 7–16). `PUT` merges the body into the stored JSON (156–171). `DELETE` removes any pair (100–107, 174–190). `GET :collection/:userId/:itemId` returns one blob with no session (33–40, 123–154). SRS §2.9.1 requires `ThrottleGuard` and `JwtAuthGuard` on `/api/notifications`, and `validateOwnership` allows only the subject or an admin (`02-09-notifications.md` 8–9; `notifications.controller.ts` 23–24, 94–110). That controller reads `user_notifications` (`title`, `content`, `metadata`) (`schema.sql` 330–341). That table has no `data` column, so `SELECT data FROM user_notifications` does not land. Allowlisted `messages`, `chats`, and `settings` still do not match `chat_messages` or `user_notifications`. Concrete trigger: `GET /api/users` with no `Authorization`, then `POST /api/users/resolve-id` with a non-admin email from that list, then `GET /api/tasks` with the returned Bearer (this creates `notifications` if it is missing), then `GET /api/collections/notifications?userId=all` with no `Authorization`. The body is every stored notification JSON, including task ids and names written by a hierarchy transfer. `POST /api/collections/notifications` with a victim `userId`, any `id`, and a `data` object stores or replaces that row. NFR §3.5 requires omitting fields the caller may not see. The 2026-10-09 bullet is the daily tracker. Reports through 2026-10-09 said `userId=all` calls `listAll` and then stopped at `messages` / `chats` / `settings`. This bullet is the `notifications` name, which matches the JSONB table. - File: `apps/api/src/items/items.controller.ts` (22–23, 33–108); `apps/api/src/items/items.service.ts` (15–22, 65–90, 123–190, 201–276); `apps/api/src/tasks/tasks.controller.ts` (74–80); `apps/api/src/tasks/tasks-schema.service.ts` (197–206); `apps/api/src/services/user-hierarchy.service.ts` (830–855); `apps/api/src/controllers/notifications.controller.ts` (23–24, 94–110); `apps/api/src/database/schema.sql` (330–341) -> Action: Require `JwtAuthGuard` on collection reads and writes. Bind `userId` to `req.user.userId` and reject `userId=all` for `notifications`. Keep the generic CRUD off the `notifications` table. Cap and paginate any remaining list. Stop logging row JSON. Leave `/api/notifications` on `user_notifications` with the ownership check it already has.

 * **Any JWT reads another user's daily challenge notes (2026-10-09, re-verified 2026-10-10).** `GET /api/community-challenges/daily-tracker` is class-level `JwtAuthGuard` and reads query `user_id` (`community-group-challenges.controller.ts` 33–34, 288–293). The participant query skips `is_public` (319–336). The entry query returns `notes` with no `LIMIT` (355–370, 434–439). `GET :id/entries` and `GET user/:userId/stats` already bind `CurrentUser()` (806–812, 846–849). Unguarded `GET /api/users` plus `POST /api/users/resolve-id` supplies the Bearer (`users.controller.ts` 135–145, 183–188; `user-auth.service.ts` 645–660). - File: `apps/api/src/controllers/community-group-challenges.controller.ts` (33–34, 288–481, 806–849) -> Action: Bind `user_id` to `CurrentUser()`. Cap the date span and the row count. Keep private daily challenges out of another caller's tracker.

POST and DELETE already use `AdminAuthGuard` (142–143, 202–203). - File: `apps/api/src/controllers/admin-files.controller.ts` (38–140, 142–203) -> Action: Require `AdminAuthGuard` on list and folders. Cap the list. Move `CREATE TABLE` off the request path. Bind `uploaded_by` to `req.user.userId`.

Require a verified ID token.

Register with the committed fallback mailbox sets `admin` (101–102). - File: `apps/api/src/services/user-auth.service.ts` (97–139, 212–263) -> Action: Fail closed unless a password verifies.  * **Request-path `DROP TABLE ... CASCADE` (re-verified 2026-10-10).** `ensurePostsTable` drops `posts` when legacy columns are detected (`posts.controller.ts` 78, 309, 373–374). `DatabaseInit` drops donations and rides on startup when it treats the schema as legacy (`database.init.ts` 568, 670). - File: `apps/api/src/controllers/posts.controller.ts` (78, 309, 373–374); `apps/api/src/database/database.init.ts` (568, 670) -> Action: Never DROP on a request path. Gate destructive DDL behind an offline migration.

 * **Committed credentials, backups, stale refresh roles, and Firebase audience (re-verified 2026-10-10).** `apps/api/railway.toml.dev` line 34 commits a `JWT_SECRET` (value not repeated here). `main.ts` 149–218 fingerprints environments with committed DB and Redis password substrings (values not repeated here). Tracked JSON under `apps/api/data-backups/20251224-162421/` includes email, phone, and `password_hash`. `refreshAccessToken` copies `payload.roles` (`jwt.service.ts` 146–177). Firebase JWKS derives `aud` from the token (`firebase-admin.service.ts` 150–184). `/auth/google` can fall back to a client-supplied access token (`auth.controller.ts` 588–698). - File: `apps/api/railway.toml.dev` (34); `apps/api/src/main.ts` (149–218); `apps/api/data-backups/` -> Action: Rotate every fingerprinted credential. Purge backups from git history. Reload roles on refresh. Accept only verified ID tokens.

## 🐞 Bugs & Logic Issues

 * **Notification listAll has no cap and logs the first JSON body (2026-10-10).** `listAll` orders every row and returns `rows.map((r) => r.data)` with no `LIMIT` (`items.service.ts` 249–276). When the table is empty it still runs `SELECT COUNT(*)` (267–272). When it is not empty, `console.log` writes `JSON.stringify(rows[0].data)` (257–260). `GET :collection` is registered before `popular-collections` and `cache-stats` (43 vs 136–154), so those Redis `KEYS` helpers never run; a one-segment name that is not allowlisted throws `Invalid collection`. `GET user-activity/:userId` is two segments, so it still runs and returns the last ten Redis activities for any id (112–133, 326–340). Recommendation: Paginate `listAll`. Do not log row bodies. Declare static routes before `:collection`. Require the JWT subject on `user-activity`.

 * **Daily tracker date window is caller-sized and has no row cap (2026-10-09, re-verified 2026-10-10).** Omitted dates use a seven-day server-local window (`community-group-challenges.controller.ts` 300–316). Supplied dates are bound as-is (364–370). Recommendation: Require `CurrentUser()`, allow at most a fixed number of days, and paginate entries.

 * **Admin file search drops the folder filter and the list has no cap (2026-10-08, re-verified 2026-10-10).** `folder_path = $1` is added only when `search` is absent (`admin-files.controller.ts` 104–113). Recommendation: Keep the folder predicate. Cap and paginate the list.

 * **A planted time log replaces the total and unlocks mark-done (2026-10-07, re-verified 2026-10-10).** `ON CONFLICT` sets `actual_hours` to the new value (`tasks.controller.ts` 437–442). The catch path returns `error.message` (456–462). Recommendation: Add to `actual_hours` when the product means an increment. Return a generic error.

 * **Hours report hides failures and has no cycle cap (2026-10-06, re-verified 2026-10-10).** Both catch paths return `success: true` with zero hours (`tasks.controller.ts` 576–584; `tasks-read.service.ts` 313–323). The recursive CTE has no depth limit (199–215). Recommendation: Return `success: false` on query failure. Stop the walk at a fixed depth.

 * **CRM list has no cap, and a missing table is created on the public GET (2026-10-05, re-verified 2026-10-10).** `GET /api/crm` has no `LIMIT` (`crm.controller.ts` 137). `ensureTable` runs `CREATE TABLE` plus `CREATE TRIGGER` (62–97). Recommendation: Cap the list. Create `crm_contacts` in an offline migration.

 * **Community-members list replaces a shared trigger function (2026-10-04, re-verified 2026-10-10).** `ensureTable` executes `CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION update_updated_at_column()` (`community-members.controller.ts` 157–165). Recommendation: Leave the shared function untouched on the request path.

 * **Ride booking approval has no driver and no seat lock (2026-10-03, re-verified 2026-10-10).** `PUT /api/rides/bookings/:bookingId/status` sets the body status before it counts remaining seats (`rides.controller.ts` 505–555). Recommendation: `SELECT … FOR UPDATE` on the ride. Allowlist status. Approve only when the JWT subject is the driver.

 * **Places details interpolates `place_id` and publishes search terms (2026-10-02, re-verified 2026-10-10).** Autocomplete encodes `input` (`places.controller.ts` 38–40). `GET /place-details` concatenates `place_id` into the Google URL (75). `GET /search-stats` lists stored search strings with no auth (88–91, 139–166). Recommendation: `encodeURIComponent` on `place_id`. Do not return the upstream error string.

 * **Companion item post is best-effort, and the caller chooses the item id (2026-10-01, re-verified 2026-10-10).** A failed `INSERT INTO posts` is caught and the item still commits (`dedicated-items.service.ts` 170–177). Recommendation: One transaction. Generate the id on the server.

 * **Item deliver commits `delivered` before the request permission check (2026-09-30, re-verified 2026-10-10).** `markAsDelivered` updates the item, then optionally calls `updateItemRequest` (`items-delivery.controller.ts` 247–258). Recommendation: One transaction. Check the JWT subject before either write.

 * **Money donation counters ignore sign, zero, and later edits (2026-09-29, re-verified 2026-10-10).** A truthy negative `amount` subtracts from `total_donations_amount`. `PUT` and `DELETE` leave both counters unchanged (`donations.controller.ts` 525–541, 698–780). Recommendation: Reject non-positive money amounts. Adjust both counters by the delta inside the same transaction.

 * **Anonymous hierarchy read can `ALTER TABLE` (2026-09-28, re-verified 2026-10-10).** `ensureSalarySeniorityColumns` adds `salary`, `seniority_start_date`, and `parent_manager_id` (`user-hierarchy.service.ts` 436–483). Recommendation: Apply those columns in an offline migration.

 * **Hierarchy pull check fails open (2026-09-27, re-verified 2026-10-10).** `assertRequesterMayPullTargetUnderSelf` returns `{ ok: true }` at line 149 when neither ancestor check matches. Recommendation: Default to deny.

 * **Comment handlers return `error.message` (re-verified 2026-10-10).** Update, delete, and list catch blocks interpolate the driver message (`posts.controller.ts` 1803–1805, 2042–2045, 2134–2137). Recommendation: Return a generic error and log the driver message server-side.

 * **`GET /rate-limit/stats` lists every limiter key with no auth (re-verified 2026-10-10).** `getRateLimitStats` runs `KEYS rate_limit:*` and `KEYS blocked:*` (`rate-limit.service.ts` 238–256). Recommendation: Remove the route from deployed builds.

 * **Rate limiter fails open when Redis errors (re-verified 2026-10-10).** `checkRateLimit` returns `allowed: true` if the block read or the counter read throws (`rate-limit.service.ts` 87–89, 106–111). Recommendation: Fail closed on auth routes.

 * **Unauthenticated `POST /api/stats/track-visit` inflates production metrics (re-verified 2026-10-10).** No guard. Increments `community_stats.site_visits` (373–401). Recommendation: Require a bot-resistant token, or drop the public increment.

 * **Items-delivery static route is shadowed (re-verified 2026-10-10).** `GET /api/items-delivery/:id` is declared before `GET requests` (180–223), so the request list is captured as an item id. Dedicated-items `GET :id` still shadows `GET search` (69 vs 166). Recommendation: Declare static routes before parameterized routes.

 * **`loginUser` and `JwtAuthGuard` never consult `user_profiles.is_active` (re-verified 2026-10-10).** Deactivated rows can still obtain a session via email-only login or an existing refresh token. Recommendation: Fail closed on `is_active = false`.

 * **Anonymity filtering is specified and not implemented (re-verified 2026-10-10).** SRS §2.5.7 / NFR §3.2 require server-side redaction for `anonymity_level < 4`. The column is still absent (0 matches under `apps/`). Recommendation: Add the column and the feed projection.

## 🏗️ Architecture & Clean Code

 * **No Domain / Application / Infrastructure folders** under `apps/` or `packages/` (count 0). The target in `docs/SSOT/CODE_QUALITY/layers-and-boundaries.md` is Infrastructure → Application → Domain. The monorepo remains NestJS feature folders plus React Native screens. `packages/` still only contains `config-eslint`. The closest pure islands remain `apps/api/src/tasks/task-completion-participants.ts`, `tasks-validation.ts`, `tasks-query-params.ts`, and `tasks.types.ts`.

 * **Fat HTTP layer owns SQL and policy.** Largest API files: `posts.controller.ts` (2741), `stats.controller.ts` (1709), `user-hierarchy.service.ts` (1675), `database.init.ts` (1374), `community-group-challenges.controller.ts` (1097; imports `pg` and returns another user's `notes` from `GET daily-tracker`, 288–439), `donations.controller.ts` (892), `chat.controller.ts` (813), `rides.controller.ts` (779). `ItemsController` imports no pool of its own and still exposes table names as URL segments. `ItemsService` imports `pg` and selects `notifications.data` for an anonymous caller (`items.service.ts` 1–10, 228–255). `TasksSchemaService` creates that table from the task-list request (`tasks-schema.service.ts` 197–206). `NotificationsController` enforces ownership on a different table (`notifications.controller.ts` 94–110). `AdminFilesController` imports `pg` and runs `SELECT *` plus request-path `CREATE TABLE`. `CommunityMembersController` and `CrmController` own directory SQL and request-path DDL with no authenticated subject. `logTaskHours` writes `task_time_logs` for body `user_id` (`tasks.controller.ts` 384–446).

 * **Privilege checks disagree inside the same product.** Notifications `validateOwnership` compares `:userId` to `req.user.userId` (94–110). The collections controller never reads a session and uses the path segment `notifications` as a table name (22–23, 43–68). Admin-files POST and DELETE use `AdminAuthGuard`; the list and folder reads use only `JwtAuthGuard`. Community-challenge entry history and user stats bind `CurrentUser()` (`community-group-challenges.controller.ts` 806–812, 846–849). `GET daily-tracker` uses query `user_id` (288–293). Task `log-hours` uses body `user_id`. Donation create checks that some JWT is present and then trusts `donor_id`.

 * **Two notification stores, one of them generic.** SRS §2.9.1 names both `user_notifications` and the JSONB `notifications` table. The guarded controller uses `user_notifications` (`schema.sql` 330–341). The unguarded collection name `notifications` uses the JSONB table created by `tasks-schema.service.ts` (197–206) and written by hierarchy transfer (830–855). `schema.sql` does not create `notifications`.

 * **Database design and the community-members table disagree.** SRS database design lists `email` and `phone` columns on `community_members` (`docs/SSOT/SRS/06-database-design.md`). `schema.sql` stores one `contact_info` JSONB object (1072–1077).

 * **CRM table and admin file table are absent from the committed schema.** `schema.sql` and `docs/SSOT/SRS/06-database-design.md` do not define `crm_contacts` or `general_files`. `CrmController.ensureTable` and `AdminFilesController.ensureTable` create them on the first request.

 * **Positive in-folder contrasts (do not regress):** `/api/notifications` already uses `JwtAuthGuard` and `validateOwnership`; admin-files POST and DELETE already use `AdminAuthGuard`; community-group challenges bind the creator on create, join, entry, PUT, and DELETE; `GET :id/entries` and `GET user/:userId/stats` bind `CurrentUser()`; personal challenges scope timer reads to `CurrentUser()`; knowledge contribution-request binds `req.user.userId`; sync user/all/status use `AdminAuthGuard`; authenticated chat send/read checks `ANY(participants)` when a JWT is present; `/session/login` requires argon2 once the shared limiter allows the call; CRM PATCH uses hardcoded column names; community-challenge `ORDER BY` uses an allowlist plus `pg-format` `%I`; item list `ORDER BY` uses an allowlisted column; ride list `ORDER BY` uses an allowlisted column; collection names are checked against `ALLOWED_COLLECTIONS` before SQL (the missing check is the caller, and the landing table for `notifications`); dedicated-item and personal-challenge updates go through class-validator DTOs. Places autocomplete encodes its query string; place-details does not. Admin-files search binds `ILIKE`. `popular-collections` and `cache-stats` stay shadowed, so their `KEYS` scans are not reachable.

 * **Operator matching workspace is specified and not implemented.** `OperatorAuthGuard` exists and there is no `/api/operator/*` module. Anonymity and matching-case tables remain SRS §10 gaps.

## 🚨 Critical Vulnerabilities

 * **Any JWT reads another user's daily challenge notes (2026-10-09).** `CommunityGroupChallengesController` applies `JwtAuthGuard` on the class (`community-group-challenges.controller.ts` 33–34). `GET /api/community-challenges/daily-tracker` takes `user_id`, `start_date`, and `end_date` from the query and never reads the session (288–293). The participant query selects `c.*` plus streak fields for `p.user_id = $1` where `frequency = 'DAILY'` and `is_active = true` (319–336). It does not test `is_public`. The entry query selects `value` and `notes` for that user across the supplied dates and has no `LIMIT` (355–370). The JSON copies `notes` into `entries_by_date` (434–439) and copies each challenge `description` (448–452). `community_challenge_entries.notes` is `TEXT` (`community-group-challenges-schema.sql` 90–98). `is_public` defaults to true and can be false (23, 62–70). When the dates are omitted the window is the last seven server-local days (300–316). A caller can pass any earlier `start_date` and later `end_date`. `GET :id/entries` and `GET user/:userId/stats` already replace the subject with `CurrentUser()` (806–812, 846–849). Create, join, and entry writes do the same (49–50, 566–567, 657–658). SRS §2.8.2 lists the tracker and does not name a subject (`02-08-challenges.md` 35). NFR §3.5 requires omitting fields the caller may not see. Unguarded `GET /api/users` returns `id` and `email` (`users.controller.ts` 135–145; `user-profile.service.ts` 504–515). `POST /api/users/resolve-id` mints a Bearer from that email (`users.controller.ts` 183–188; `user-auth.service.ts` 328–342, 645–660). The mobile client sends `user_id` on this route (`databaseService.ts` 1191–1203). Concrete trigger: `GET /api/users` with no `Authorization`, then `POST /api/users/resolve-id` with a non-admin email from that list, then `GET /api/community-challenges/daily-tracker?user_id=<another id>&start_date=2000-01-01&end_date=2099-12-31` with the returned Bearer. The body includes that person's daily challenge titles, descriptions, streaks, values, and notes, including private daily challenges they joined. The 2026-09-11 bullet is the private join. The first request runs `ensureTable`, which executes `CREATE TABLE crm_contacts` (`name`, `capabilities`, `desire`, `time_availability`, `source`, `referrer`, `status`, `created_by`) and attaches trigger `update_crm_contacts_updated_at` to `update_updated_at_column()` (48–104). `GET /api/crm` runs `SELECT *` with no `LIMIT` (106–147). `status` and `search` are bound parameters. The full row set is cached for 10 minutes (113–140). `POST` inserts client `name`, `capabilities`, `desire`, `time_availability`, `source`, `referrer`, `status`, and `created_by` (149–183). `CreateContactDto` and `UpdateContactDto` are TypeScript interfaces (17–36), so the global `ValidationPipe` does not whitelist the body. `PATCH` updates any id; the column list is hardcoded (185–248). `DELETE` removes any id (250–268). Concrete trigger: `POST /api/crm` with `name`, `capabilities`, `desire`, and `referrer`, and no `Authorization`. `GET /api/crm` returns that row, including the free-text fields. NFR §3.5 requires omitting fields the caller may not see. The 2026-10-04 bullet is `community_members.contact_info`. This bullet is the CRM contact book. - File: `apps/api/src/controllers/crm.controller.ts` (17–36, 38, 48–268); `apps/api/src/app.module.ts` (117) -> Action: Require `AdminAuthGuard` on every method. Bind `created_by` to `req.user.userId`. Cap the list. Move `CREATE TABLE` and the trigger into an offline migration.

 * **Unauthenticated community-members directory returns phone and email and accepts writes (2026-10-04, re-verified 2026-10-09).** `CommunityMembersController` has no `UseGuards` (`community-members.controller.ts` 48) and is registered from `app.module.ts` (115).  * **Unauthenticated ride create forges a public feed post and can insert a passwordless profile (2026-10-03, re-verified 2026-10-09).** `RidesController` has no `UseGuards` (`rides.controller.ts` 37). Firebase JWKS derives `aud` from the token (`firebase-admin.service.ts` 150–184). `/auth/google` can fall back to a client-supplied access token (`auth.controller.ts` 588–698). - File: `apps/api/railway.toml.dev` (34); `apps/api/src/main.ts` (149–218); `apps/api/data-backups/` -> Action: Rotate every fingerprinted credential. Purge backups from git history. Reload roles on refresh. Accept only verified ID tokens.

## 🐞 Bugs & Logic Issues

 * **Daily tracker date window is caller-sized and has no row cap (2026-10-09).** Omitted dates use a seven-day server-local window (`community-group-challenges.controller.ts` 300–316). Supplied `start_date` and `end_date` are bound as-is (364–370) with no maximum span and no `LIMIT`. The query parameters are raw strings, so the global `ValidationPipe` does not check that they are dates. An invalid date hits the catch and returns `Failed to fetch daily tracker data` (482–487). Recommendation: Require `CurrentUser()`, allow at most a fixed number of days, and paginate entries.

 * **Admin file search drops the folder filter and the list has no cap (2026-10-08, re-verified 2026-10-09).** `GET /api/admin-files` adds `folder_path = $1` only when `search` is absent (`admin-files.controller.ts` 104–113). Any non-empty `search`, including `%`, matches names in every folder and returns `SELECT *` with no `LIMIT` (115–117). `ensureTable` logs and swallows a DDL failure (75–77), and the `SELECT` still runs. The cache key includes the raw search string and stores the full rows for 10 minutes (92–118). Recommendation: Keep the folder predicate. Cap and paginate the list. Create `general_files` in an offline migration. Scope the cache to an admin caller.

 * **A planted time log replaces the total and unlocks mark-done (2026-10-07, re-verified 2026-10-09).** `ON CONFLICT` sets `actual_hours` to the new value (`tasks.controller.ts` 437–442). `validateMarkDoneRequiresTimeLog` counts any `task_time_logs` row for the task (`tasks-patch-mutation.service.ts` 48–56). One positive `hours` value from any JWT makes that count greater than zero, so a later admin mark-done no longer asks for hours. The catch path returns `error.message` (456–462). Recommendation: Count a time log for the JWT subject before either write. Add to `actual_hours` when the product means an increment. Return a generic error and log the driver message server-side.

 * **Hours report hides failures and has no cycle cap (2026-10-06, re-verified 2026-10-09).** Both the controller catch (`tasks.controller.ts` 576–584) and `getHoursReport`'s catch (`tasks-read.service.ts` 313–323) return `success: true` with zero hours and empty arrays. A database error looks like an empty report. The recursive CTE uses `UNION ALL` and has no depth limit and no visited set (199–215). A cycle in `parent_manager_id`, which the 2026-09-25 `set-manager` path can write, keeps that query running until Postgres stops it. Recommendation: Return `success: false` on query failure. Stop the walk at a fixed depth and skip ids already seen.

 * **CRM list has no cap, and a missing table is created on the public GET (2026-10-05, re-verified 2026-10-09).** `GET /api/crm` appends `ORDER BY created_at DESC` with no `LIMIT` (`crm.controller.ts` 137). `ensureTable` runs on that same request and executes `CREATE TABLE` plus `CREATE TRIGGER` (62–97). The trigger calls `update_updated_at_column()`. A failure inside `ensureTable` is logged and swallowed (101–103), so the following `SELECT` still runs. Recommendation: Cap the list. Create `crm_contacts` in an offline migration. Leave the shared `updated_at` function untouched on the request path.

 * **Community-members list has no cap, and a missing table replaces a shared trigger function (2026-10-04, re-verified 2026-10-09).** `GET /api/community-members` appends `ORDER BY created_at DESC` with no `LIMIT` (`community-members.controller.ts` 230). `ensureTable` runs only when the table is absent and then executes `CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION update_updated_at_column()` (157–165) plus `DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS` (169). Other tables use that function for `updated_at`. Recommendation: Cap the list. Create the table in an offline migration. Leave the shared function untouched on the request path.

 * **Ride booking approval has no driver and no seat lock (2026-10-03, re-verified 2026-10-09).** `PUT /api/rides/bookings/:bookingId/status` sets the body status, including `approved`, before it counts remaining seats (`rides.controller.ts` 505–555). It does not reject when approved seats would exceed `available_seats`, and it accepts any status string. The book path checks remaining seats only against already-approved rows (384–410), so two pending bookings can both be approved. Recommendation: `SELECT … FOR UPDATE` on the ride. Allowlist status. Approve only when the JWT subject is the driver and remaining seats are sufficient.

 * **Places details interpolates `place_id` and publishes search terms (2026-10-02, re-verified 2026-10-09).** `PlacesController` has no guard (`places.controller.ts` 9–13). Autocomplete encodes `input` (38–40). `GET /place-details` concatenates `place_id` into the Google URL (75). A value that contains `&` adds extra query parameters on the request that uses `GOOGLE_API_KEY`. The handler returns Google's `error_message` (82). `GET /search-stats` lists the top stored search strings with no auth (88–91, 139–166). SRS §2.13.2 lists these routes and does not name a guard. Recommendation: `encodeURIComponent` on `place_id`. Allowlist Google fields. Do not return the upstream error string. Require an app credential or a tight limiter before spending the key. Drop public search-term stats.

 * **Companion item post is best-effort, and the caller chooses the item id (2026-10-01, re-verified 2026-10-09).** A failed `INSERT INTO posts` is caught and the item still commits (`dedicated-items.service.ts` 170–177). If the provided id is not a 10–13 digit timestamp, it becomes the primary key (78–88). `PUT` can set `is_deleted` to false and clear the soft-delete (dto 136–142; service 262–279). Recommendation: One transaction. Generate the id on the server. Allow delete and restore only for the JWT subject.

 * **Item deliver commits `delivered` before the request permission check (2026-09-30, re-verified 2026-10-09).** `markAsDelivered` updates the item, then optionally calls `updateItemRequest` (`items-delivery.controller.ts` 247–258). A mismatched `userId` returns Unauthorized from the request update while the item stays `delivered`. `completed` is not restricted to the owner (`items-delivery.service.ts` 507–551). Recommendation: One transaction. Check the JWT subject before either write. Limit `completed` to the owner.

 * **Money donation counters ignore sign, zero, and later edits (2026-09-29, re-verified 2026-10-09).** A truthy negative `amount` subtracts from `total_donations_amount`. A missing amount increments `community_stats` by 1 (`donations.controller.ts` 525–541). `PUT` and `DELETE` leave both counters unchanged (698–780). Recommendation: Reject non-positive money amounts. Adjust both counters by the delta inside the same transaction.

 * **Anonymous hierarchy read can `ALTER TABLE` (2026-09-28, re-verified 2026-10-09).** `ensureSalarySeniorityColumns` adds `salary`, `seniority_start_date`, and `parent_manager_id` (`user-hierarchy.service.ts` 436–483). Recommendation: Apply those columns in an offline migration.

 * **Hierarchy pull check fails open (2026-09-27, re-verified 2026-10-09).** `assertRequesterMayPullTargetUnderSelf` returns `{ ok: true }` at line 149 when neither ancestor check matches. Recommendation: Default to deny.

 * **Comment handlers return `error.message` (re-verified 2026-10-09).** Update, delete, and list catch blocks interpolate the driver message (`posts.controller.ts` 1803–1805, 2042–2045, 2134–2137). Recommendation: Return a generic error and log the driver message server-side.

 * **`GET /rate-limit/stats` lists every limiter key with no auth (re-verified 2026-10-09).** `getRateLimitStats` runs `KEYS rate_limit:*` and `KEYS blocked:*` (`rate-limit.service.ts` 238–256). Recommendation: Remove the route from deployed builds.

 * **Rate limiter fails open when Redis errors (re-verified 2026-10-09).** `checkRateLimit` returns `allowed: true` if the block read or the counter read throws (`rate-limit.service.ts` 87–89, 106–111). Recommendation: Fail closed on auth routes.

 * **Unauthenticated `POST /api/stats/track-visit` inflates production metrics (re-verified 2026-10-09).** No guard. Increments `community_stats.site_visits` (373–401). Recommendation: Require a bot-resistant token, or drop the public increment.

 * **Items-delivery static route is shadowed (re-verified 2026-10-09).** `GET /api/items-delivery/:id` is declared before `GET requests` (180–223), so the request list is captured as an item id. Dedicated-items `GET :id` still shadows `GET search` (69 vs 166). Recommendation: Declare static routes before parameterized routes.

 * **`loginUser` and `JwtAuthGuard` never consult `user_profiles.is_active` (re-verified 2026-10-09).** Deactivated rows can still obtain a session via email-only login or an existing refresh token. Recommendation: Fail closed on `is_active = false`.

 * **Anonymity filtering is specified and not implemented (re-verified 2026-10-09).** SRS §2.5.7 / NFR §3.2 require server-side redaction for `anonymity_level < 4`. The column is still absent (0 matches under `apps/`). Recommendation: Add the column and the feed projection.

The target in `docs/SSOT/CODE_QUALITY/layers-and-boundaries.md` is Infrastructure → Application → Domain. The closest pure islands remain `apps/api/src/tasks/task-completion-participants.ts`, `tasks-validation.ts`, `tasks-query-params.ts`, and `tasks.types.ts`.

 * **Fat HTTP layer owns SQL and policy.** Largest API files: `posts.controller.ts` (2741), `stats.controller.ts` (1709), `user-hierarchy.service.ts` (1675), `database.init.ts` (1374), `community-group-challenges.controller.ts` (1097; imports `pg` and returns another user's `notes` from `GET daily-tracker`, 288–439), `donations.controller.ts` (892), `chat.controller.ts` (813), `rides.controller.ts` (779). `items-delivery.service.ts` remains under `controllers/`. `AdminFilesController` imports `pg` and runs `SELECT *` plus request-path `CREATE TABLE`, and the list methods have no authenticated subject (`admin-files.controller.ts` 38–140). `CommunityMembersController` imports `pg` and runs `SELECT` / `INSERT` / `UPDATE` / `DELETE`, plus request-path DDL, with no authenticated subject. `CrmController` imports `pg` and runs `SELECT *` / `INSERT` / `UPDATE` / `DELETE`, plus request-path `CREATE TABLE`, with no authenticated subject (`crm.controller.ts` 38–268). `TasksReadService` returns another manager's team names and task hours to any JWT (`tasks-read.service.ts` 194–309) while the route guard is only `JwtAuthGuard` (`tasks.controller.ts` 568–570). `logTaskHours` writes `task_time_logs` for body `user_id` and replaces `actual_hours` on conflict (`tasks.controller.ts` 384–446) with no comparison to `req.user`. `RidesController` imports `pg` and writes `user_profiles`, `rides`, `posts`, `user_activities`, and `community_stats` in one method. `DedicatedItemsService` still writes both `items` and `posts`. Donation reads and money totals are still computed in the controller. Item completion policy still authorizes nobody. Hierarchy permission policy authorizes a body id.

 * **Privilege checks disagree inside the same product.** Notifications `validateOwnership` compares `:userId` to `req.user.userId` (94–110). Admin tables use a class-level `AdminAuthGuard`. Admin-files POST and DELETE use `AdminAuthGuard`; the list and folder reads use only `JwtAuthGuard`. Community-members, CRM, and ride create never read a session. Item request updates compare `owner_id` to a query string. Dedicated-item create writes `posts.author_id` from a client identifier. Post DELETE uses `getSessionUserId`; comment PUT/DELETE use the client id. Task `log-hours` uses body `user_id`. Donation create checks that some JWT is present and then trusts `donor_id`. Donation `GET :id` checks nobody. `GET hierarchy/tree` has no actor at all. Community-challenge entry history and user stats bind `CurrentUser()` (`community-group-challenges.controller.ts` 806–812, 846–849). `GET daily-tracker` uses query `user_id` (288–293) and returns `notes` (355–370, 434–439).

 * **Database design and the community-members table disagree.** SRS database design lists `email` and `phone` columns on `community_members` (`docs/SSOT/SRS/06-database-design.md`). `schema.sql` stores one `contact_info` JSONB object (1072–1077). The controller reads and writes that JSON.

 * **CRM table and admin file table are absent from the committed schema.** `schema.sql` and `docs/SSOT/SRS/06-database-design.md` do not define `crm_contacts` or `general_files`. `CrmController.ensureTable` creates `crm_contacts` on the first request (62–97). `AdminFilesController.ensureTable` creates `general_files` on the first request (48–74). SRS §2.11.2 and §2.11.3 still list those routes.

 * **Positive in-folder contrasts (do not regress):** admin-files POST and DELETE already use `AdminAuthGuard`; community-group challenges bind the creator on create, join, entry, PUT, and DELETE; `GET :id/entries` and `GET user/:userId/stats` bind `CurrentUser()`; `GET daily-tracker` still reads query `user_id`; personal challenges scope timer reads to `CurrentUser()`; knowledge contribution-request binds `req.user.userId`; sync user/all/status use `AdminAuthGuard`; authenticated chat send/read checks `ANY(participants)` when a JWT is present; `/session/login` requires argon2 once the shared limiter allows the call; CRM PATCH uses hardcoded column names; community-challenge `ORDER BY` uses an allowlist plus `pg-format` `%I`; item list `ORDER BY` uses an allowlisted column; ride list `ORDER BY` uses an allowlisted column; dedicated-item and personal-challenge updates go through class-validator DTOs (the dedicated-item column list is allowlisted; the missing check is the owner). Collection names are checked against `ALLOWED_COLLECTIONS` before SQL. Places autocomplete encodes its query string; place-details does not. Admin-files search binds `ILIKE`.

 * **Operator matching workspace is specified and not implemented.** `OperatorAuthGuard` exists and there is no `/api/operator/*` module. Anonymity and matching-case tables remain SRS §10 gaps.

## 🚨 Critical Vulnerabilities

 * **Any JWT lists admin file URLs (2026-10-08).** SRS §2.11.2 names `JwtAuthGuard` on `GET /api/admin-files` and `GET /api/admin-files/folders`, and names `JwtAuthGuard` plus `AdminAuthGuard` on `POST` and `DELETE` (`docs/SSOT/SRS/functional/02-11-admin.md` 25–32). The code matches that sentence (`admin-files.controller.ts` 80–81, 127–128, 142–143, 202–203). `AdminAuthGuard` requires `admin`, `org_admin`, or `super_admin` (`jwt-auth.guard.ts` 238–261). The list and folder handlers never read `req.user` (82–85, 129–130). `GET /api/admin-files` runs `SELECT * FROM general_files` with no `LIMIT` (100–117). When `search` is omitted, the query filters `folder_path`. When `search` is present, that predicate is skipped and `name ILIKE` is bound (104–113). `search=%` matches every name. The selected columns include `url`, `mime_type`, `size`, `folder_path`, and `uploaded_by` (52–63). The DTO comment names folders such as Finance and HR (24). The full row set is cached for 10 minutes (31, 92–118). `GET folders` returns every distinct `folder_path` (127–136). `schema.sql` does not define `general_files`. `ensureTable` runs `CREATE EXTENSION` and `CREATE TABLE` on the same request (38–74). `CreateFileDto` is a TypeScript interface (19–26), so the global `ValidationPipe` does not whitelist the POST body. POST remains `AdminAuthGuard`. If `req.user.userId` is missing or is not a UUID, POST stores body `uploaded_by` (164–177). Unguarded `GET /api/users` returns `email` and `roles` (`users.controller.ts` 135–145; `user-profile.service.ts` 502–516). `POST /api/users/resolve-id` mints an access and refresh pair from that email (`users.controller.ts` 183–188; `user-auth.service.ts` 328–342, 645–660). A default `user` role fails `AdminAuthGuard` and still passes `JwtAuthGuard`. Concrete trigger: `GET /api/users` with no `Authorization`, then `POST /api/users/resolve-id` with a non-admin email from that list, then `GET /api/admin-files?search=%` with the returned Bearer. The body is every stored file row, including `url` and `folder_path`. NFR §3.5 requires omitting fields the caller may not see. The 2026-10-07 bullet is the task time-log write.
