Guest `GET /api/chat/conversations/user/:userId` returns the inbox (267–269). Mark-read uses `req.user?.userId || body?.user_id` (679, 759). Guest `GET conversations/:conversationId/messages` skips the participant check and returns `cm.*` (378–420). Guest `POST /api/chat/messages` accepts `sender_id` and skips membership (456–570). - File: `apps/api/src/controllers/chat.controller.ts` (45–46, 107–230, 246–330, 341–420, 441–669, 671–812) -> Action: Require JWT. Bind the sender and the reader to `req.user.userId`. Require the caller to be a participant before read or send.

 * **Unauthenticated Redis session-key harvest (2026-09-14, re-verified 2026-10-08).** `GET /session/stats` lists `session:*` keys. `GET /session/validate/:sessionId` returns the session blob. `DELETE /session/logout-all/:userId` drops those sessions (`session.controller.ts` 136–299). - File: `apps/api/src/auth/controllers/session.controller.ts` (136–299) -> Action: Remove `/session` from deployed builds or require admin JWT.

 * **JWT-gated like, comment, and follow actor spoof (re-verified 2026-10-08).** Like and comment writes persist `body.user_id` (`posts.controller.ts` 1343–1396, 1573–1643, 2152–2209). Follow uses body `follower_id` (`user-follow.service.ts` 19–34, 96–98). - File: `apps/api/src/controllers/posts.controller.ts`; `apps/api/src/services/user-follow.service.ts` -> Action: Bind actors to `req.user.userId`.

 * **Unauthenticated `POST /api/users/resolve-id` mints a JWT (re-verified 2026-10-08).** A known email, `google_id`, or `firebase_uid` returns an access and refresh pair (`users.controller.ts` 183–188; `user-auth.service.ts` 270–342, 645–660). This token is the entry point for the hierarchy rewrite, the comment IDOR, promote-admin, the donation-total write, the task time-log write, and the admin file list. Require a verified ID token.

Register with the committed fallback mailbox sets `admin` (101–102). A profile created by ride insert has a null `password_hash`, so this login path accepts that email with no password. - File: `apps/api/src/services/user-auth.service.ts` (97–139, 212–263); `apps/api/src/config/kc-root-admin.defaults.ts` -> Action: Fail closed unless a password verifies. Never mutate roles before `argon2.verify`.

 * **Profile mass-assignment and unauthenticated directory dumps (re-verified 2026-10-08).** `PUT /api/users/:id` accepts `password`, `roles`, and `firebase_uid` and is not bound to `req.user` (`users.controller.ts` 126–133). `GET /api/users`, `GET :id`, search, activities, and stats have no guards. `GET :id` also returns `phone` and `settings` (`user-profile.service.ts` 126–158). - File: `apps/api/src/controllers/users.controller.ts` (40–43, 91–163); `apps/api/src/services/user-profile.service.ts` (126–158, 267–361) -> Action: Bind `:id` to `req.user.userId` unless admin. Strip privileged fields from the public DTO.

Task `log-hours` is the 2026-10-07 bullet. `GET /api/tasks` and `GET :id` embed assignee and creator email (`tasks-list-query.service.ts` 175–182; `tasks-read.service.ts` 50–57). The hours report is the 2026-10-06 bullet. CASCADE` (re-verified 2026-10-08).** `ensurePostsTable` drops `posts` when legacy columns are detected (`posts.controller.ts` 78, 309, 373–374). `DatabaseInit` drops donations and rides on startup when it treats the schema as legacy (`database.init.ts` 568, 670). - File: `apps/api/src/controllers/posts.controller.ts` (78, 309, 373–374); `apps/api/src/database/database.init.ts` (568, 670) -> Action: Never DROP on a request path. Gate destructive DDL behind an offline migration.

Tracked JSON under `apps/api/data-backups/20251224-162421/` includes email, phone, and `password_hash`. `refreshAccessToken` copies `payload.roles` (`jwt.service.ts` 146–177). Firebase JWKS derives `aud` from the token (`firebase-admin.service.ts` 150–184). `/auth/google` can fall back to a client-supplied access token (`auth.controller.ts` 588–698). - File: `apps/api/railway.toml.dev` (34); `apps/api/src/main.ts` (149–218); `apps/api/data-backups/` -> Action: Rotate every fingerprinted credential. Purge backups from git history. Reload roles on refresh. Accept only verified ID tokens.

## 🐞 Bugs & Logic Issues

 * **Admin file search drops the folder filter and the list has no cap (2026-10-08).** `GET /api/admin-files` adds `folder_path = $1` only when `search` is absent (`admin-files.controller.ts` 104–113). Any non-empty `search`, including `%`, matches names in every folder and returns `SELECT *` with no `LIMIT` (115–117). `ensureTable` logs and swallows a DDL failure (75–77), and the `SELECT` still runs. The cache key includes the raw search string and stores the full rows for 10 minutes (92–118). Recommendation: Keep the folder predicate. Cap and paginate the list. Create `general_files` in an offline migration. Scope the cache to an admin caller.

 * **A planted time log replaces the total and unlocks mark-done (2026-10-07, re-verified 2026-10-08).** `ON CONFLICT` sets `actual_hours` to the new value (`tasks.controller.ts` 437–442). `validateMarkDoneRequiresTimeLog` counts any `task_time_logs` row for the task (`tasks-patch-mutation.service.ts` 48–56). One positive `hours` value from any JWT makes that count greater than zero, so a later admin mark-done no longer asks for hours. The catch path returns `error.message` (456–462). Recommendation: Count a time log for the JWT subject before either write. Add to `actual_hours` when the product means an increment. Return a generic error and log the driver message server-side.

 * **Hours report hides failures and has no cycle cap (2026-10-06, re-verified 2026-10-08).** Both the controller catch (`tasks.controller.ts` 576–584) and `getHoursReport`'s catch (`tasks-read.service.ts` 313–323) return `success: true` with zero hours and empty arrays. A database error looks like an empty report. The recursive CTE uses `UNION ALL` and has no depth limit and no visited set (199–215). A cycle in `parent_manager_id`, which the 2026-09-25 `set-manager` path can write, keeps that query running until Postgres stops it. Recommendation: Return `success: false` on query failure. Stop the walk at a fixed depth and skip ids already seen.

 * **CRM list has no cap, and a missing table is created on the public GET (2026-10-05, re-verified 2026-10-08).** `GET /api/crm` appends `ORDER BY created_at DESC` with no `LIMIT` (`crm.controller.ts` 137). `ensureTable` runs on that same request and executes `CREATE TABLE` plus `CREATE TRIGGER` (62–97). The trigger calls `update_updated_at_column()`. A failure inside `ensureTable` is logged and swallowed (101–103), so the following `SELECT` still runs. Recommendation: Cap the list. Create `crm_contacts` in an offline migration. Leave the shared `updated_at` function untouched on the request path.

 * **Community-members list has no cap, and a missing table replaces a shared trigger function (2026-10-04, re-verified 2026-10-08).** `GET /api/community-members` appends `ORDER BY created_at DESC` with no `LIMIT` (`community-members.controller.ts` 230). `ensureTable` runs only when the table is absent and then executes `CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION update_updated_at_column()` (157–165) plus `DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS` (169). Other tables use that function for `updated_at`. Recommendation: Cap the list. Create the table in an offline migration. Leave the shared function untouched on the request path.

 * **Ride booking approval has no driver and no seat lock (2026-10-03, re-verified 2026-10-08).** `PUT /api/rides/bookings/:bookingId/status` sets the body status, including `approved`, before it counts remaining seats (`rides.controller.ts` 505–555). It does not reject when approved seats would exceed `available_seats`, and it accepts any status string. The book path checks remaining seats only against already-approved rows (384–410), so two pending bookings can both be approved. Recommendation: `SELECT … FOR UPDATE` on the ride. Allowlist status. Approve only when the JWT subject is the driver and remaining seats are sufficient.

 * **Places details interpolates `place_id` and publishes search terms (2026-10-02, re-verified 2026-10-08).** `PlacesController` has no guard (`places.controller.ts` 9–13). Autocomplete encodes `input` (38–40). `GET /place-details` concatenates `place_id` into the Google URL (75). A value that contains `&` adds extra query parameters on the request that uses `GOOGLE_API_KEY`. The handler returns Google's `error_message` (82). `GET /search-stats` lists the top stored search strings with no auth (88–91, 139–166). SRS §2.13.2 lists these routes and does not name a guard. Recommendation: `encodeURIComponent` on `place_id`. Allowlist Google fields. Do not return the upstream error string. Require an app credential or a tight limiter before spending the key. Drop public search-term stats.

 * **Companion item post is best-effort, and the caller chooses the item id (2026-10-01, re-verified 2026-10-08).** A failed `INSERT INTO posts` is caught and the item still commits (`dedicated-items.service.ts` 170–177). If the provided id is not a 10–13 digit timestamp, it becomes the primary key (78–88). `PUT` can set `is_deleted` to false and clear the soft-delete (dto 136–142; service 262–279). Recommendation: One transaction. Generate the id on the server. Allow delete and restore only for the JWT subject.

 * **Item deliver commits `delivered` before the request permission check (2026-09-30, re-verified 2026-10-08).** `markAsDelivered` updates the item, then optionally calls `updateItemRequest` (`items-delivery.controller.ts` 247–258). A mismatched `userId` returns Unauthorized from the request update while the item stays `delivered`. `completed` is not restricted to the owner (`items-delivery.service.ts` 507–551). Recommendation: One transaction. Check the JWT subject before either write. Limit `completed` to the owner.

 * **Money donation counters ignore sign, zero, and later edits (2026-09-29, re-verified 2026-10-08).** A truthy negative `amount` subtracts from `total_donations_amount`. A missing amount increments `community_stats` by 1 (`donations.controller.ts` 525–541). `PUT` and `DELETE` leave both counters unchanged (698–780). Recommendation: Reject non-positive money amounts. Adjust both counters by the delta inside the same transaction.

 * **Anonymous hierarchy read can `ALTER TABLE` (2026-09-28, re-verified 2026-10-08).** `ensureSalarySeniorityColumns` adds `salary`, `seniority_start_date`, and `parent_manager_id` (`user-hierarchy.service.ts` 436–483). Recommendation: Apply those columns in an offline migration.

 * **Hierarchy pull check fails open (2026-09-27, re-verified 2026-10-08).** `assertRequesterMayPullTargetUnderSelf` returns `{ ok: true }` at line 149 when neither ancestor check matches. Recommendation: Default to deny.

 * **Comment handlers return `error.message` (re-verified 2026-10-08).** Update, delete, and list catch blocks interpolate the driver message (`posts.controller.ts` 1803–1805, 2042–2045, 2134–2137). Recommendation: Return a generic error and log the driver message server-side.

 * **`GET /rate-limit/stats` lists every limiter key with no auth (re-verified 2026-10-08).** `getRateLimitStats` runs `KEYS rate_limit:*` and `KEYS blocked:*` (`rate-limit.service.ts` 238–256). Recommendation: Remove the route from deployed builds.

 * **Rate limiter fails open when Redis errors (re-verified 2026-10-08).** `checkRateLimit` returns `allowed: true` if the block read or the counter read throws (`rate-limit.service.ts` 87–89, 106–111). Recommendation: Fail closed on auth routes.

 * **Unauthenticated `POST /api/stats/track-visit` inflates production metrics (re-verified 2026-10-08).** No guard. Increments `community_stats.site_visits` (373–401). Recommendation: Require a bot-resistant token, or drop the public increment.

 * **Items-delivery static route is shadowed (re-verified 2026-10-08).** `GET /api/items-delivery/:id` is declared before `GET requests` (180–223), so the request list is captured as an item id. Dedicated-items `GET :id` still shadows `GET search` (69 vs 166). Recommendation: Declare static routes before parameterized routes.

 * **`loginUser` and `JwtAuthGuard` never consult `user_profiles.is_active` (re-verified 2026-10-08).** Deactivated rows can still obtain a session via email-only login or an existing refresh token. Recommendation: Fail closed on `is_active = false`.

 * **Anonymity filtering is specified and not implemented (re-verified 2026-10-08).** SRS §2.5.7 / NFR §3.2 require server-side redaction for `anonymity_level < 4`. The column is still absent (0 matches under `apps/`). Recommendation: Add the column and the feed projection.

## 🏗️ Architecture & Clean Code

 * **No Domain / Application / Infrastructure folders** under `apps/` or `packages/` (count 0). The target in `docs/SSOT/CODE_QUALITY/layers-and-boundaries.md` is Infrastructure → Application → Domain. The monorepo remains NestJS feature folders plus React Native screens. `packages/` still only contains `config-eslint`. The closest pure islands remain `apps/api/src/tasks/task-completion-participants.ts`, `tasks-validation.ts`, `tasks-query-params.ts`, and `tasks.types.ts`.

 * **Fat HTTP layer owns SQL and policy.** Largest API files: `posts.controller.ts` (2741), `stats.controller.ts` (1709), `user-hierarchy.service.ts` (1675), `database.init.ts` (1374), `community-group-challenges.controller.ts` (1097), `donations.controller.ts` (892), `chat.controller.ts` (813), `rides.controller.ts` (779). `items-delivery.service.ts` remains under `controllers/`. `AdminFilesController` imports `pg` and runs `SELECT *` plus request-path `CREATE TABLE`, and the list methods have no authenticated subject (`admin-files.controller.ts` 38–140). `CommunityMembersController` imports `pg` and runs `SELECT` / `INSERT` / `UPDATE` / `DELETE`, plus request-path DDL, with no authenticated subject. `CrmController` imports `pg` and runs `SELECT *` / `INSERT` / `UPDATE` / `DELETE`, plus request-path `CREATE TABLE`, with no authenticated subject (`crm.controller.ts` 38–268). `TasksReadService` returns another manager's team names and task hours to any JWT (`tasks-read.service.ts` 194–309) while the route guard is only `JwtAuthGuard` (`tasks.controller.ts` 568–570). `logTaskHours` writes `task_time_logs` for body `user_id` and replaces `actual_hours` on conflict (`tasks.controller.ts` 384–446) with no comparison to `req.user`. `RidesController` imports `pg` and writes `user_profiles`, `rides`, `posts`, `user_activities`, and `community_stats` in one method. `DedicatedItemsService` still writes both `items` and `posts`. Donation reads and money totals are still computed in the controller. Item completion policy still authorizes nobody. Hierarchy permission policy authorizes a body id.

 * **Privilege checks disagree inside the same product.** Notifications `validateOwnership` compares `:userId` to `req.user.userId` (94–110). Admin tables use a class-level `AdminAuthGuard`. Admin-files POST and DELETE use `AdminAuthGuard`; the list and folder reads use only `JwtAuthGuard`. Community-members, CRM, and ride create never read a session. Item request updates compare `owner_id` to a query string. Dedicated-item create writes `posts.author_id` from a client identifier. Post DELETE uses `getSessionUserId`; comment PUT/DELETE use the client id. Task `log-hours` uses body `user_id`. Donation create checks that some JWT is present and then trusts `donor_id`. Donation `GET :id` checks nobody. `GET hierarchy/tree` has no actor at all.

 * **Database design and the community-members table disagree.** SRS database design lists `email` and `phone` columns on `community_members` (`docs/SSOT/SRS/06-database-design.md`). `schema.sql` stores one `contact_info` JSONB object (1072–1077). The controller reads and writes that JSON.

 * **CRM table and admin file table are absent from the committed schema.** `schema.sql` and `docs/SSOT/SRS/06-database-design.md` do not define `crm_contacts` or `general_files`. `CrmController.ensureTable` creates `crm_contacts` on the first request (62–97). `AdminFilesController.ensureTable` creates `general_files` on the first request (48–74). SRS §2.11.2 and §2.11.3 still list those routes.

 * **Positive in-folder contrasts (do not regress):** admin-files POST and DELETE already use `AdminAuthGuard`; community-group challenges bind the creator on create, join, entry, PUT, and DELETE; personal challenges scope timer reads to `CurrentUser()`; knowledge contribution-request binds `req.user.userId`; sync user/all/status use `AdminAuthGuard`; authenticated chat send/read checks `ANY(participants)` when a JWT is present; `/session/login` requires argon2 once the shared limiter allows the call; CRM PATCH uses hardcoded column names; community-challenge `ORDER BY` uses an allowlist plus `pg-format` `%I`; item list `ORDER BY` uses an allowlisted column; ride list `ORDER BY` uses an allowlisted column; dedicated-item and personal-challenge updates go through class-validator DTOs (the dedicated-item column list is allowlisted; the missing check is the owner). Collection names are checked against `ALLOWED_COLLECTIONS` before SQL. Places autocomplete encodes its query string; place-details does not. Admin-files search binds `ILIKE`.

 * **Operator matching workspace is specified and not implemented.** `OperatorAuthGuard` exists and there is no `/api/operator/*` module. Anonymity and matching-case tables remain SRS §10 gaps.

## 🚨 Critical Vulnerabilities

 * **Any JWT overwrites another user's task hours (2026-10-07).** SRS §2.11.4 lists `POST /api/tasks/:id/log-hours` with `JwtAuthGuard` and does not name `AdminAuthGuard`. The guard is present (`tasks.controller.ts` 384–386). The handler takes only `taskId` and `body` and never reads `req.user` (386–389). `user_id` is required from the body (399–407). `resolveUserIdToUUID` matches a UUID, an email, or a `firebase_uid` (409–412; `user-resolution.service.ts` 81–89). `LogTaskHoursDto` is a TypeScript interface (`tasks.types.ts` 73–76), so the global `ValidationPipe` does not whitelist the body. The write is `INSERT INTO task_time_logs ... ON CONFLICT (task_id, user_id) DO UPDATE SET actual_hours = EXCLUDED.actual_hours` (437–446). `schema.sql` defines `UNIQUE(task_id, user_id)` and `CHECK (actual_hours > 0)` (505–513). A second call replaces the stored total. It does not add to it. Unguarded `GET /api/users` returns `email` (`users.controller.ts` 135–145; `user-profile.service.ts` 515). `POST /api/users/resolve-id` mints a Bearer from that email (`users.controller.ts` 183–188). `GET /api/tasks` is `JwtAuthGuard` only and returns task ids plus assignee and creator email (`tasks.controller.ts` 74–75; `tasks-list-query.service.ts` 175–182). The admin screen sends `selectedUser.id` (`useAdminTasksScreen.tsx` 610; `apiService.ts` 217–222). The API accepts any other resolved id. Concrete trigger: `GET /api/users` with no `Authorization`, then `POST /api/users/resolve-id` with a non-admin email from that list, then `GET /api/tasks` with the returned Bearer, then `POST /api/tasks/<task id>/log-hours` with a positive `hours` and another user's email as `user_id`. The row for that pair becomes the new `actual_hours`, including when a larger total was already stored. The 2026-10-06 hours report sums that column (`tasks-read.service.ts` 224–280). NFR §3.5 requires omitting fields the caller may not see. The 2026-10-06 bullet is the report read. This bullet is the write. - File: `apps/api/src/tasks/tasks.controller.ts` (74–75, 384–464); `apps/api/src/tasks/tasks.types.ts` (73–76); `apps/api/src/services/user-resolution.service.ts` (81–89); `apps/api/src/database/schema.sql` (505–513); `apps/api/src/tasks/tasks-list-query.service.ts` (172–182) -> Action: Bind `user_id` to `req.user.userId` and reject a mismatched client id. Allow a manager to log for a subordinate only under an explicit admin or manager check. Add hours, or replace them only for that same subject. Do not return `error.message`.

 * **Non-admin JWT reads another manager's team time report (2026-10-06, re-verified 2026-10-07).** SRS §2.11.4 names `AdminAuthGuard` on `GET /api/tasks/hours-report/:managerId` (`docs/SSOT/SRS/functional/02-11-admin.md` 57). The route uses only `JwtAuthGuard` and the handler never reads `req.user` (`tasks.controller.ts` 568–573). `AdminAuthGuard` requires `admin`, `org_admin`, or `super_admin` (`jwt-auth.guard.ts` 238–261). `getHoursReport` resolves `:managerId` through `UserResolutionService`, which matches a UUID, an email, or a `firebase_uid` (`tasks-read.service.ts` 194–197; `user-resolution.service.ts` 81–89). It then walks `parent_manager_id` with `WITH RECURSIVE ... UNION ALL` and selects each subordinate's `id`, `name`, and `email` (199–215). The JSON body returns `manager_hours`, `team_total_hours`, task titles, and each person's `user_id`, `user_name`, and `hours` (290–309). Those selected emails are not copied into the JSON. Unguarded `GET /api/users` returns `email`, `roles`, and `parent_manager_id` (`users.controller.ts` 135–145; `user-profile.service.ts` 502–521). `POST /api/users/resolve-id` mints a JWT from an email (`users.controller.ts` 183–188). Concrete trigger: `GET /api/users` with no `Authorization`, then `POST /api/users/resolve-id` with a non-admin email from that list, then `GET /api/tasks/hours-report/<manager email>` with the returned Bearer. The body lists that manager's subtree names, user ids, task titles, and hour totals. NFR §3.5 requires omitting fields the caller may not see. The 2026-10-05 bullet is the CRM contact book. This bullet is the task time report. - File: `apps/api/src/tasks/tasks.controller.ts` (568–586); `apps/api/src/tasks/tasks-read.service.ts` (171–325); `apps/api/src/auth/guards/jwt-auth.guard.ts` (238–261); `apps/api/src/services/user-resolution.service.ts` (81–89) -> Action: Require `AdminAuthGuard`, or allow the call only when `req.user.userId` is that manager. Stop selecting `email`. Cap the recursive walk. Return `success: false` when the query fails.

 * **Unauthenticated CRM contact book returns volunteer notes and accepts writes (2026-10-05, re-verified 2026-10-07).** `CrmController` has no `UseGuards` (`crm.controller.ts` 38; zero `UseGuards` and zero `req.user` in the file) and is registered from `app.module.ts` (117). SRS §2.11.3 lists `GET /api/crm`, `POST /api/crm`, `PATCH /api/crm/:id`, and `DELETE /api/crm/:id` and does not name a guard. The routes sit in the admin module (§2.11), beside `/api/admin/tables`, which requires `AdminAuthGuard` (§2.11.1). `schema.sql` and `docs/SSOT/SRS/06-database-design.md` do not define `crm_contacts`. The first request runs `ensureTable`, which executes `CREATE TABLE crm_contacts` (`name`, `capabilities`, `desire`, `time_availability`, `source`, `referrer`, `status`, `created_by`) and attaches trigger `update_crm_contacts_updated_at` to `update_updated_at_column()` (48–104). `GET /api/crm` runs `SELECT *` with no `LIMIT` (106–147). `status` and `search` are bound parameters. NFR §3.5 requires omitting fields the caller may not see. The 2026-10-04 bullet is `community_members.contact_info`. This bullet is the CRM contact book. - File: `apps/api/src/controllers/crm.controller.ts` (17–36, 38, 48–268); `apps/api/src/app.module.ts` (117) -> Action: Require `AdminAuthGuard` on every method.  * **Unauthenticated community-members directory returns phone and email and accepts writes (2026-10-04, re-verified 2026-10-07).** `CommunityMembersController` has no `UseGuards` (`community-members.controller.ts` 48) and is registered from `app.module.ts` (115). ## 🐞 Bugs & Logic Issues

 * **A planted time log replaces the total and unlocks mark-done (2026-10-07).** `ON CONFLICT` sets `actual_hours` to the new value (`tasks.controller.ts` 437–442). `validateMarkDoneRequiresTimeLog` counts any `task_time_logs` row for the task (`tasks-patch-mutation.service.ts` 48–56). One positive `hours` value from any JWT makes that count greater than zero, so a later admin mark-done no longer asks for hours. The catch path returns `error.message` (456–462). Recommendation: Count a time log for the JWT subject before either write. Add to `actual_hours` when the product means an increment. Return a generic error and log the driver message server-side.

 * **Hours report hides failures and has no cycle cap (2026-10-06, re-verified 2026-10-07).** Both the controller catch (`tasks.controller.ts` 576–584) and `getHoursReport`'s catch (`tasks-read.service.ts` 313–323) return `success: true` with zero hours and empty arrays. A database error looks like an empty report. The recursive CTE uses `UNION ALL` and has no depth limit and no visited set (199–215). A cycle in `parent_manager_id`, which the 2026-09-25 `set-manager` path can write, keeps that query running until Postgres stops it. Recommendation: Return `success: false` on query failure. Stop the walk at a fixed depth and skip ids already seen.

 * **CRM list has no cap, and a missing table is created on the public GET (2026-10-05, re-verified 2026-10-07).** `GET /api/crm` appends `ORDER BY created_at DESC` with no `LIMIT` (`crm.controller.ts` 137). `ensureTable` runs on that same request and executes `CREATE TABLE` plus `CREATE TRIGGER` (62–97). The trigger calls `update_updated_at_column()`. A failure inside `ensureTable` is logged and swallowed (101–103), so the following `SELECT` still runs. Recommendation: Cap the list. Create `crm_contacts` in an offline migration. Leave the shared `updated_at` function untouched on the request path.

 * **Community-members list has no cap, and a missing table replaces a shared trigger function (2026-10-04, re-verified 2026-10-07).** `GET /api/community-members` appends `ORDER BY created_at DESC` with no `LIMIT` (`community-members.controller.ts` 230). `ensureTable` runs only when the table is absent and then executes `CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION update_updated_at_column()` (157–165) plus `DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS` (169). Other tables use that function for `updated_at`. Recommendation: Cap the list. Create the table in an offline migration. Leave the shared function untouched on the request path.

 * **Ride booking approval has no driver and no seat lock (2026-10-03, re-verified 2026-10-07).** `PUT /api/rides/bookings/:bookingId/status` sets the body status, including `approved`, before it counts remaining seats (`rides.controller.ts` 505–555). It does not reject when approved seats would exceed `available_seats`, and it accepts any status string. The book path checks remaining seats only against already-approved rows (384–410), so two pending bookings can both be approved. Recommendation: `SELECT … FOR UPDATE` on the ride. Allowlist status. Approve only when the JWT subject is the driver and remaining seats are sufficient.

 * **Places details interpolates `place_id` and publishes search terms (2026-10-02, re-verified 2026-10-07).** `PlacesController` has no guard (`places.controller.ts` 9–13). Autocomplete encodes `input` (38–40). `GET /place-details` concatenates `place_id` into the Google URL (75). A value that contains `&` adds extra query parameters on the request that uses `GOOGLE_API_KEY`. The handler returns Google's `error_message` (82). `GET /search-stats` lists the top stored search strings with no auth (88–91, 139–166). SRS §2.13.2 lists these routes and does not name a guard. Recommendation: `encodeURIComponent` on `place_id`. Allowlist Google fields. Do not return the upstream error string. Require an app credential or a tight limiter before spending the key. Drop public search-term stats.

 * **Companion item post is best-effort, and the caller chooses the item id (2026-10-01, re-verified 2026-10-07).** A failed `INSERT INTO posts` is caught and the item still commits (`dedicated-items.service.ts` 170–177). If the provided id is not a 10–13 digit timestamp, it becomes the primary key (78–88). `PUT` can set `is_deleted` to false and clear the soft-delete (dto 136–142; service 262–279). Recommendation: One transaction. Generate the id on the server. Allow delete and restore only for the JWT subject.

 * **Item deliver commits `delivered` before the request permission check (2026-09-30, re-verified 2026-10-07).** `markAsDelivered` updates the item, then optionally calls `updateItemRequest` (`items-delivery.controller.ts` 247–258). A mismatched `userId` returns Unauthorized from the request update while the item stays `delivered`. `completed` is not restricted to the owner (`items-delivery.service.ts` 507–551). Recommendation: One transaction. Check the JWT subject before either write. Limit `completed` to the owner.

 * **Money donation counters ignore sign, zero, and later edits (2026-09-29, re-verified 2026-10-07).** A truthy negative `amount` subtracts from `total_donations_amount`. A missing amount increments `community_stats` by 1 (`donations.controller.ts` 525–541). `PUT` and `DELETE` leave both counters unchanged (698–780). Recommendation: Reject non-positive money amounts. Adjust both counters by the delta inside the same transaction.

 * **Anonymous hierarchy read can `ALTER TABLE` (2026-09-28, re-verified 2026-10-07).** `ensureSalarySeniorityColumns` adds `salary`, `seniority_start_date`, and `parent_manager_id` (`user-hierarchy.service.ts` 436–483). Recommendation: Apply those columns in an offline migration.

 * **Hierarchy pull check fails open (2026-09-27, re-verified 2026-10-07).** `assertRequesterMayPullTargetUnderSelf` returns `{ ok: true }` at line 149 when neither ancestor check matches. Recommendation: Default to deny.

 * **Comment handlers return `error.message` (re-verified 2026-10-07).** Update, delete, and list catch blocks interpolate the driver message (`posts.controller.ts` 1803–1805, 2042–2045, 2134–2137). Recommendation: Return a generic error and log the driver message server-side.

 * **`GET /rate-limit/stats` lists every limiter key with no auth (re-verified 2026-10-07).** `getRateLimitStats` runs `KEYS rate_limit:*` and `KEYS blocked:*` (`rate-limit.service.ts` 238–256). Recommendation: Remove the route from deployed builds.

 * **Rate limiter fails open when Redis errors (re-verified 2026-10-07).** `checkRateLimit` returns `allowed: true` if the block read or the counter read throws (`rate-limit.service.ts` 87–89, 106–111). Recommendation: Fail closed on auth routes.

 * **Unauthenticated `POST /api/stats/track-visit` inflates production metrics (re-verified 2026-10-07).** No guard. Increments `community_stats.site_visits` (373–401). Recommendation: Require a bot-resistant token, or drop the public increment.

 * **Items-delivery static route is shadowed (re-verified 2026-10-07).** `GET /api/items-delivery/:id` is declared before `GET requests` (180–223), so the request list is captured as an item id. Dedicated-items `GET :id` still shadows `GET search` (69 vs 166). Recommendation: Declare static routes before parameterized routes.

 * **`loginUser` and `JwtAuthGuard` never consult `user_profiles.is_active` (re-verified 2026-10-07).** Deactivated rows can still obtain a session via email-only login or an existing refresh token. Recommendation: Fail closed on `is_active = false`.

 * **Anonymity filtering is specified and not implemented (re-verified 2026-10-07).** SRS §2.5.7 / NFR §3.2 require server-side redaction for `anonymity_level < 4`. The column is still absent (0 matches under `apps/`). Recommendation: Add the column and the feed projection.

## 🏗️ Architecture & Clean Code

 * **No Domain / Application / Infrastructure folders** under `apps/` or `packages/` (count 0). The target in `docs/SSOT/CODE_QUALITY/layers-and-boundaries.md` is Infrastructure → Application → Domain. The monorepo remains NestJS feature folders plus React Native screens. `packages/` still only contains `config-eslint`. The closest pure islands remain `apps/api/src/tasks/task-completion-participants.ts`, `tasks-validation.ts`, `tasks-query-params.ts`, and `tasks.types.ts`.

 * **Fat HTTP layer owns SQL and policy.** Largest API files: `posts.controller.ts` (2741), `stats.controller.ts` (1709), `user-hierarchy.service.ts` (1675), `database.init.ts` (1374), `community-group-challenges.controller.ts` (1097), `donations.controller.ts` (892), `chat.controller.ts` (813), `rides.controller.ts` (779). `items-delivery.service.ts` remains under `controllers/`. `CommunityMembersController` imports `pg` and runs `SELECT` / `INSERT` / `UPDATE` / `DELETE`, plus request-path DDL, with no authenticated subject. `CrmController` imports `pg` and runs `SELECT *` / `INSERT` / `UPDATE` / `DELETE`, plus request-path `CREATE TABLE`, with no authenticated subject (`crm.controller.ts` 38–268). `TasksReadService` returns another manager's team names and task hours to any JWT (`tasks-read.service.ts` 194–309) while the route guard is only `JwtAuthGuard` (`tasks.controller.ts` 568–570). `logTaskHours` writes `task_time_logs` for body `user_id` and replaces `actual_hours` on conflict (`tasks.controller.ts` 384–446) with no comparison to `req.user`. `RidesController` imports `pg` and writes `user_profiles`, `rides`, `posts`, `user_activities`, and `community_stats` in one method. `DedicatedItemsService` still writes both `items` and `posts`. Donation reads and money totals are still computed in the controller. Item completion policy still authorizes nobody. Hierarchy permission policy authorizes a body id.

 * **Privilege checks disagree inside the same product.** Notifications `validateOwnership` compares `:userId` to `req.user.userId` (94–110). Admin tables use a class-level `AdminAuthGuard`. Community-members, CRM, and ride create never read a session. Item request updates compare `owner_id` to a query string. Dedicated-item create writes `posts.author_id` from a client identifier. Post DELETE uses `getSessionUserId`; comment PUT/DELETE use the client id. Task `log-hours` uses body `user_id`. Donation create checks that some JWT is present and then trusts `donor_id`. Donation `GET :id` checks nobody. `GET hierarchy/tree` has no actor at all.

 * **Database design and the community-members table disagree.** SRS database design lists `email` and `phone` columns on `community_members` (`docs/SSOT/SRS/06-database-design.md`). `schema.sql` stores one `contact_info` JSONB object (1072–1077). The controller reads and writes that JSON.

 * **CRM table is absent from the committed schema.** `schema.sql` and `docs/SSOT/SRS/06-database-design.md` do not define `crm_contacts`. `CrmController.ensureTable` creates that table on the first request (62–97). SRS §2.11.3 still lists the four CRM routes.

 * **Positive in-folder contrasts (do not regress):** community-group challenges bind the creator on create, join, entry, PUT, and DELETE; personal challenges scope timer reads to `CurrentUser()`; knowledge contribution-request binds `req.user.userId`; sync user/all/status use `AdminAuthGuard`; authenticated chat send/read checks `ANY(participants)` when a JWT is present; `/session/login` requires argon2 once the shared limiter allows the call; CRM PATCH uses hardcoded column names; community-challenge `ORDER BY` uses an allowlist plus `pg-format` `%I`; item list `ORDER BY` uses an allowlisted column; ride list `ORDER BY` uses an allowlisted column; dedicated-item and personal-challenge updates go through class-validator DTOs (the dedicated-item column list is allowlisted; the missing check is the owner). Collection names are checked against `ALLOWED_COLLECTIONS` before SQL. Places autocomplete encodes its query string; place-details does not.

 * **Operator matching workspace is specified and not implemented.** `OperatorAuthGuard` exists and there is no `/api/operator/*` module. Anonymity and matching-case tables remain SRS §10 gaps.

## 🚨 Critical Vulnerabilities

 * **Non-admin JWT reads another manager's team time report (2026-10-06).** SRS §2.11.4 names `AdminAuthGuard` on `GET /api/tasks/hours-report/:managerId` (`docs/SSOT/SRS/functional/02-11-admin.md` 57). The route uses only `JwtAuthGuard` and the handler never reads `req.user` (`tasks.controller.ts` 568–573). `AdminAuthGuard` requires `admin`, `org_admin`, or `super_admin` (`jwt-auth.guard.ts` 238–261). `getHoursReport` resolves `:managerId` through `UserResolutionService`, which matches a UUID, an email, or a `firebase_uid` (`tasks-read.service.ts` 194–197; `user-resolution.service.ts` 81–89). It then walks `parent_manager_id` with `WITH RECURSIVE ... UNION ALL` and selects each subordinate's `id`, `name`, and `email` (199–215). The JSON body returns `manager_hours`, `team_total_hours`, task titles, and each person's `user_id`, `user_name`, and `hours` (290–309). Those selected emails are not copied into the JSON. Unguarded `GET /api/users` returns `email`, `roles`, and `parent_manager_id` (`users.controller.ts` 135–145; `user-profile.service.ts` 502–521). `POST /api/users/resolve-id` mints a JWT from an email (`users.controller.ts` 183–188). Concrete trigger: `GET /api/users` with no `Authorization`, then `POST /api/users/resolve-id` with a non-admin email from that list, then `GET /api/tasks/hours-report/<manager email>` with the returned Bearer. The body lists that manager's subtree names, user ids, task titles, and hour totals. NFR §3.5 requires omitting fields the caller may not see. The 2026-10-05 bullet is the CRM contact book. This bullet is the task time report. - File: `apps/api/src/tasks/tasks.controller.ts` (568–586); `apps/api/src/tasks/tasks-read.service.ts` (171–325); `apps/api/src/auth/guards/jwt-auth.guard.ts` (238–261); `apps/api/src/services/user-resolution.service.ts` (81–89) -> Action: Require `AdminAuthGuard`, or allow the call only when `req.user.userId` is that manager. Stop selecting `email`. Cap the recursive walk. Return `success: false` when the query fails.

 * **Unauthenticated CRM contact book returns volunteer notes and accepts writes (2026-10-05, re-verified 2026-10-06).** `CrmController` has no `UseGuards` (`crm.controller.ts` 38; zero `UseGuards` and zero `req.user` in the file) and is registered from `app.module.ts` (117). SRS §2.11.3 lists `GET /api/crm`, `POST /api/crm`, `PATCH /api/crm/:id`, and `DELETE /api/crm/:id` and does not name a guard. The routes sit in the admin module (§2.11), beside `/api/admin/tables`, which requires `AdminAuthGuard` (§2.11.1). `schema.sql` and `docs/SSOT/SRS/06-database-design.md` do not define `crm_contacts`. The first request runs `ensureTable`, which executes `CREATE TABLE crm_contacts` (`name`, `capabilities`, `desire`, `time_availability`, `source`, `referrer`, `status`, `created_by`) and attaches trigger `update_crm_contacts_updated_at` to `update_updated_at_column()` (48–104). `GET /api/crm` runs `SELECT *` with no `LIMIT` (106–147). `status` and `search` are bound parameters. The full row set is cached for 10 minutes (113–140). `POST` inserts client `name`, `capabilities`, `desire`, `time_availability`, `source`, `referrer`, `status`, and `created_by` (149–183). `CreateContactDto` and `UpdateContactDto` are TypeScript interfaces (17–36), so the global `ValidationPipe` does not whitelist the body. `PATCH` updates any id; the column list is hardcoded (185–248). `DELETE` removes any id (250–268). Concrete trigger: `POST /api/crm` with `name`, `capabilities`, `desire`, and `referrer`, and no `Authorization`. `GET /api/crm` returns that row, including the free-text fields. NFR §3.5 requires omitting fields the caller may not see. The 2026-10-04 bullet is `community_members.contact_info`. This bullet is the CRM contact book. - File: `apps/api/src/controllers/crm.controller.ts` (17–36, 38, 48–268); `apps/api/src/app.module.ts` (117) -> Action: Require `AdminAuthGuard` on every method. Bind `created_by` to `req.user.userId`. Cap the list. Move `CREATE TABLE` and the trigger into an offline migration.

 * **Unauthenticated community-members directory returns phone and email and accepts writes (2026-10-04, re-verified 2026-10-06).** `CommunityMembersController` has no `UseGuards` (`community-members.controller.ts` 48) and is registered from `app.module.ts` (115). SRS §2.11.5 lists list, get, create, update, and delete and does not name a guard. The routes sit in the admin module (§2.11), beside `/api/admin/tables`, which requires `AdminAuthGuard` (§2.11.1). `GET /api/community-members` selects `contact_info` for every row and has no `LIMIT` (186–236). `GET :id` repeats that column (247–284). `schema.sql` documents `contact_info` as `{email, phone, etc.}` (1072–1077; `database.init.ts` 882–894). `POST` inserts `name`, `role`, `description`, `contact_info`, `status`, and `created_by` (294–339). `PATCH` updates those fields for any id (354–429). `DELETE` removes any id (439–462). `CreateMemberDto` and `UpdateMemberDto` are TypeScript interfaces (23–46), so the global `ValidationPipe` does not whitelist `contact_info`. `resolveUserIdToUUID` maps a client email, `firebase_uid`, or UUID onto `created_by` (63–97, 307–316). When `community_members` is absent, the same request runs `CREATE TABLE` and `CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION update_updated_at_column()` (102–176). That function is shared by other `updated_at` triggers. The list is cached for 10 minutes, including `contact_info` (193–234). Concrete trigger: `GET /api/community-members` with no `Authorization`. Each row includes `contact_info`. `POST /api/community-members` with `name`, `role`, and `contact_info.email` / `contact_info.phone` stores that record. NFR §3.5 requires omitting fields the caller may not see. - File: `apps/api/src/controllers/community-members.controller.ts` (23–46, 48, 63–97, 102–176, 186–470); `apps/api/src/app.module.ts` (115); `apps/api/src/database/schema.sql` (1071–1092) -> Action: Require `AdminAuthGuard` on every method. Omit `contact_info` unless the caller is an admin. Bind `created_by` to `req.user.userId`. Cap the list. Move table and function DDL into an offline migration.

 * **Unauthenticated ride create forges a public feed post and can insert a passwordless profile (2026-10-03, re-verified 2026-10-06).** `RidesController` has no `UseGuards` (`rides.controller.ts` 37). SRS §2.4.1 lists create, book, booking-status, update, and delete and does not name a guard. `createRide` accepts client `driver_id`. When that value matches a UUID it is used as-is (74–75). When it does not, the handler looks up `settings->>'legacy_id'` or email `<id>@legacy.com`, and if neither exists it `INSERT`s `user_profiles` with that email, a display name, and `settings.legacy_id` (80–113). `user_profiles.roles` defaults to `user` and `password_hash` is nullable (`schema.sql` 15–33). The same transaction inserts `rides` and then `posts` with `author_id` set to that driver and `post_type` `ride` (121–175). `posts.ride_id` exists (`schema.sql` 524; `posts.controller.ts` 211). Client `metadata` is spread into the post JSON (169–171). `GET /api/posts` has no guard and keeps rows whose status is not `hidden` (754, 830–831). `GET /api/rides` returns `up.phone as driver_phone` (247–250). `GET /api/rides/:id` adds `driver_email` (347–351). `limit` is `parseInt` with no cap (314–316). `POST :id/book` resolves `passenger_id` by email, `firebase_uid`, or UUID and inserts `ride_bookings` plus `user_activities` (412–488). `PUT bookings/:bookingId/status` writes the body status, including `approved`, with no driver comparison (505–522). `PUT :id` and `DELETE :id` change or cancel any ride (695–743). `GET user/:userId` returns that user's rides, and the passenger branch includes `driver_phone` (579–646). Concrete trigger: `GET /api/users`, then `POST /api/rides` with that `id` as `driver_id`, `from_location`, `to_location`, and `departure_time`, and no `Authorization`. The public feed shows a ride post authored by that user. A second trigger uses a non-UUID `driver_id` and then `POST /api/users/resolve-id` with email `<id>@legacy.com`, which mints a token pair for the new row (`user-auth.service.ts` 328–342, 645–660). NFR §3.5 requires omitting fields the caller may not see. §2.5.4 requires `JwtAuthGuard` to change a post; this path creates one with no JWT. The 2026-10-01 bullet is `POST /api/dedicated-items`. This bullet is the ride path. - File: `apps/api/src/controllers/rides.controller.ts` (37–225, 247–251, 314–316, 338–522, 579–646, 695–743); `apps/api/src/database/schema.sql` (11–33, 185–210, 520–534); `apps/api/src/controllers/posts.controller.ts` (211, 754, 830–831) -> Action: Require `JwtAuthGuard` on create, book, status, update, and delete. Bind `driver_id`, `posts.author_id`, and booking approval to `req.user.userId`. Bind `passenger_id` to the JWT subject. Do not insert `user_profiles` from a ride body. Omit driver phone and email from public reads. Cap `limit`. Allowlist booking status.

 * **Unauthenticated dedicated-item create forges a public feed post as any directory user (2026-10-01, re-verified 2026-10-06).** `DedicatedItemsController` has no `UseGuards` (`dedicated-items.controller.ts` 19–28). `ItemsModule` registers it (`items.module.ts` 16–18; `app.module.ts` 86).  * **Unauthenticated item delivery completion (2026-09-30, re-verified 2026-10-06).** `ItemsDeliveryController` has no `UseGuards` (`items-delivery.controller.ts` 25–26). SRS §2.6.3 lists `POST /api/items-delivery/:id/deliver` and does not name an auth guard. `markAsDelivered` calls `updateItem(itemId, { status: "delivered" })` and only afterwards looks at `body.requestId` (241–260). `updateItem` writes `status` with no owner comparison (service 261–265, 292–299). If a `requestId` is also sent, that request update runs after the item write and is not in the same transaction; `updateItemRequest` may return Unauthorized while the item stays delivered (466–499). `PUT /api/items-delivery/:id` accepts class-validator `UpdateItemDto.status`, including `delivered` (dto 127–128; controller 185–191). `DELETE :id` removes the row with no actor (193–196, service 319–326). `PUT /api/items-delivery/requests/:requestId` requires only a query `userId` (225–238). The service treats that string as the owner or the requester (493–499). `approved` and `rejected` require the owner string; `cancelled` requires the requester string; `completed` has no extra role check and then sets the item to `delivered` (507–551). Bind the actor to `req.user.userId`. Allow deliver and status changes only for the item owner, or for an approved requester when the product rule says so. Run the item update and the request update in one transaction. Stop taking owner identity from the query string. Omit `owner_id` and owner contact fields from public reads.

 * **Donation create forges money totals with an unbound donor and an unchecked amount (2026-09-29, re-verified 2026-10-06).** SRS §2.3.2 requires `JwtAuthGuard` on `POST /api/donations`. Bind the sender and the reader to `req.user.userId`. Require the caller to be a participant before read or send.

Follow uses body `follower_id` (`user-follow.service.ts` 19–34, 96–98). - File: `apps/api/src/controllers/posts.controller.ts`; `apps/api/src/services/user-follow.service.ts` -> Action: Bind actors to `req.user.userId`.

## 🐞 Bugs & Logic Issues

 * **Hours report hides failures and has no cycle cap (2026-10-06).** Both the controller catch (`tasks.controller.ts` 576–584) and `getHoursReport`'s catch (`tasks-read.service.ts` 313–323) return `success: true` with zero hours and empty arrays. A database error looks like an empty report. The recursive CTE uses `UNION ALL` and has no depth limit and no visited set (199–215). A cycle in `parent_manager_id`, which the 2026-09-25 `set-manager` path can write, keeps that query running until Postgres stops it. Recommendation: Return `success: false` on query failure. Stop the walk at a fixed depth and skip ids already seen.

 * **CRM list has no cap, and a missing table is created on the public GET (2026-10-05, re-verified 2026-10-06).** `GET /api/crm` appends `ORDER BY created_at DESC` with no `LIMIT` (`crm.controller.ts` 137). `ensureTable` runs on that same request and executes `CREATE TABLE` plus `CREATE TRIGGER` (62–97). The trigger calls `update_updated_at_column()`. A failure inside `ensureTable` is logged and swallowed (101–103), so the following `SELECT` still runs. Recommendation: Cap the list. Create `crm_contacts` in an offline migration. Leave the shared `updated_at` function untouched on the request path.

 * **Community-members list has no cap, and a missing table replaces a shared trigger function (2026-10-04, re-verified 2026-10-06).** `GET /api/community-members` appends `ORDER BY created_at DESC` with no `LIMIT` (`community-members.controller.ts` 230). `ensureTable` runs only when the table is absent and then executes `CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION update_updated_at_column()` (157–165) plus `DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS` (169). Other tables use that function for `updated_at`. Recommendation: Cap the list. Create the table in an offline migration. Leave the shared function untouched on the request path.

 * **Ride booking approval has no driver and no seat lock (2026-10-03, re-verified 2026-10-06).** `PUT /api/rides/bookings/:bookingId/status` sets the body status, including `approved`, before it counts remaining seats (`rides.controller.ts` 505–555). It does not reject when approved seats would exceed `available_seats`, and it accepts any status string. The book path checks remaining seats only against already-approved rows (384–410), so two pending bookings can both be approved. Recommendation: `SELECT … FOR UPDATE` on the ride. Allowlist status. Approve only when the JWT subject is the driver and remaining seats are sufficient.

 * **Places details interpolates `place_id` and publishes search terms (2026-10-02, re-verified 2026-10-06).** `PlacesController` has no guard (`places.controller.ts` 9–13). Autocomplete encodes `input` (38–40). `GET /place-details` concatenates `place_id` into the Google URL (75). A value that contains `&` adds extra query parameters on the request that uses `GOOGLE_API_KEY`. The handler returns Google's `error_message` (82). `GET /search-stats` lists the top stored search strings with no auth (88–91, 139–166). SRS §2.13.2 lists these routes and does not name a guard. Recommendation: `encodeURIComponent` on `place_id`. Allowlist Google fields. Do not return the upstream error string. Require an app credential or a tight limiter before spending the key. Drop public search-term stats.

 * **Companion item post is best-effort, and the caller chooses the item id (2026-10-01, re-verified 2026-10-06).** A failed `INSERT INTO posts` is caught and the item still commits (`dedicated-items.service.ts` 170–177). If the provided id is not a 10–13 digit timestamp, it becomes the primary key (78–88). `PUT` can set `is_deleted` to false and clear the soft-delete (dto 136–142; service 262–279). Recommendation: One transaction. Generate the id on the server. Allow delete and restore only for the JWT subject.

 * **Item deliver commits `delivered` before the request permission check (2026-09-30, re-verified 2026-10-06).** `markAsDelivered` updates the item, then optionally calls `updateItemRequest` (`items-delivery.controller.ts` 247–258). A mismatched `userId` returns Unauthorized from the request update while the item stays `delivered`. `completed` is not restricted to the owner (`items-delivery.service.ts` 507–551). Recommendation: One transaction. Check the JWT subject before either write. Limit `completed` to the owner.

 * **Money donation counters ignore sign, zero, and later edits (2026-09-29, re-verified 2026-10-06).** A truthy negative `amount` subtracts from `total_donations_amount`. A missing amount increments `community_stats` by 1 (`donations.controller.ts` 525–541). `PUT` and `DELETE` leave both counters unchanged (698–780). Recommendation: Reject non-positive money amounts. Adjust both counters by the delta inside the same transaction.

 * **Anonymous hierarchy read can `ALTER TABLE` (2026-09-28, re-verified 2026-10-06).** `ensureSalarySeniorityColumns` adds `salary`, `seniority_start_date`, and `parent_manager_id` (`user-hierarchy.service.ts` 436–483). Recommendation: Apply those columns in an offline migration.

 * **Hierarchy pull check fails open (2026-09-27, re-verified 2026-10-06).** `assertRequesterMayPullTargetUnderSelf` returns `{ ok: true }` at line 149 when neither ancestor check matches. Recommendation: Default to deny.

 * **Comment handlers return `error.message` (re-verified 2026-10-06).** Update, delete, and list catch blocks interpolate the driver message (`posts.controller.ts` 1803–1805, 2042–2045, 2134–2137). Recommendation: Return a generic error and log the driver message server-side.

 * **`GET /rate-limit/stats` lists every limiter key with no auth (re-verified 2026-10-06).** `getRateLimitStats` runs `KEYS rate_limit:*` and `KEYS blocked:*` (`rate-limit.service.ts` 238–256). Recommendation: Remove the route from deployed builds.

 * **Rate limiter fails open when Redis errors (re-verified 2026-10-06).** `checkRateLimit` returns `allowed: true` if the block read or the counter read throws (`rate-limit.service.ts` 87–89, 106–111). Recommendation: Fail closed on auth routes.

 * **Unauthenticated `POST /api/stats/track-visit` inflates production metrics (re-verified 2026-10-06).** No guard. Increments `community_stats.site_visits` (373–401). Recommendation: Require a bot-resistant token, or drop the public increment.

 * **Items-delivery static route is shadowed (re-verified 2026-10-06).** `GET /api/items-delivery/:id` is declared before `GET requests` (180–223), so the request list is captured as an item id. Dedicated-items `GET :id` still shadows `GET search` (69 vs 166). Recommendation: Declare static routes before parameterized routes.

 * **`loginUser` and `JwtAuthGuard` never consult `user_profiles.is_active` (re-verified 2026-10-06).** Deactivated rows can still obtain a session via email-only login or an existing refresh token. Recommendation: Fail closed on `is_active = false`.

 * **Anonymity filtering is specified and not implemented (re-verified 2026-10-06).** SRS §2.5.7 / NFR §3.2 require server-side redaction for `anonymity_level < 4`. The column is still absent (0 matches under `apps/`). Recommendation: Add the column and the feed projection.

## 🏗️ Architecture & Clean Code

 * **No Domain / Application / Infrastructure folders** under `apps/` or `packages/` (count 0). The target in `docs/SSOT/CODE_QUALITY/layers-and-boundaries.md` is Infrastructure → Application → Domain. The monorepo remains NestJS feature folders plus React Native screens. `packages/` still only contains `config-eslint`. The closest pure islands remain `apps/api/src/tasks/task-completion-participants.ts`, `tasks-validation.ts`, `tasks-query-params.ts`, and `tasks.types.ts`.

 * **Fat HTTP layer owns SQL and policy.** Largest API files: `posts.controller.ts` (2741), `stats.controller.ts` (1709), `user-hierarchy.service.ts` (1675), `database.init.ts` (1374), `community-group-challenges.controller.ts` (1097), `donations.controller.ts` (892), `chat.controller.ts` (813), `rides.controller.ts` (779). `items-delivery.service.ts` remains under `controllers/`. `CommunityMembersController` imports `pg` and runs `SELECT` / `INSERT` / `UPDATE` / `DELETE`, plus request-path DDL, with no authenticated subject. `CrmController` imports `pg` and runs `SELECT *` / `INSERT` / `UPDATE` / `DELETE`, plus request-path `CREATE TABLE`, with no authenticated subject (`crm.controller.ts` 38–268). `TasksReadService` returns another manager's team names and task hours to any JWT (`tasks-read.service.ts` 194–309) while the route guard is only `JwtAuthGuard` (`tasks.controller.ts` 568–570). `RidesController` imports `pg` and writes `user_profiles`, `rides`, `posts`, `user_activities`, and `community_stats` in one method. `DedicatedItemsService` still writes both `items` and `posts`. Donation reads and money totals are still computed in the controller. Item completion policy still authorizes nobody. Hierarchy permission policy authorizes a body id.

 * **Privilege checks disagree inside the same product.** Notifications `validateOwnership` compares `:userId` to `req.user.userId` (94–110). Admin tables use a class-level `AdminAuthGuard`. Community-members, CRM, and ride create never read a session. Item request updates compare `owner_id` to a query string. Dedicated-item create writes `posts.author_id` from a client identifier. Post DELETE uses `getSessionUserId`; comment PUT/DELETE use the client id. Donation create checks that some JWT is present and then trusts `donor_id`. Donation `GET :id` checks nobody. `GET hierarchy/tree` has no actor at all.

 * **Database design and the community-members table disagree.** SRS database design lists `email` and `phone` columns on `community_members` (`docs/SSOT/SRS/06-database-design.md`). `schema.sql` stores one `contact_info` JSONB object (1072–1077). The controller reads and writes that JSON.

 * **CRM table is absent from the committed schema.** `schema.sql` and `docs/SSOT/SRS/06-database-design.md` do not define `crm_contacts`. `CrmController.ensureTable` creates that table on the first request (62–97). SRS §2.11.3 still lists the four CRM routes.

 * **Positive in-folder contrasts (do not regress):** community-group challenges bind the creator on create, join, entry, PUT, and DELETE; personal challenges scope timer reads to `CurrentUser()`; knowledge contribution-request binds `req.user.userId`; sync user/all/status use `AdminAuthGuard`; authenticated chat send/read checks `ANY(participants)` when a JWT is present; `/session/login` requires argon2 once the shared limiter allows the call; CRM PATCH uses hardcoded column names; community-challenge `ORDER BY` uses an allowlist plus `pg-format` `%I`; item list `ORDER BY` uses an allowlisted column; ride list `ORDER BY` uses an allowlisted column; dedicated-item and personal-challenge updates go through class-validator DTOs (the dedicated-item column list is allowlisted; the missing check is the owner). Collection names are checked against `ALLOWED_COLLECTIONS` before SQL. Places autocomplete encodes its query string; place-details does not.

 * **Operator matching workspace is specified and not implemented.** `OperatorAuthGuard` exists and there is no `/api/operator/*` module. Anonymity and matching-case tables remain SRS §10 gaps.

Critical is still **4** (`handlebars`, `shell-quote`, `tar`, `websocket-driver`). The lockfile did not change. The advisory totals match the 2026-10-04 snapshot. Files >200 LOC: **196**. `databaseService.ts` measured **1225** lines this run (`wc -l`). `crm.controller.ts` is **269**.

## 🚨 Critical Vulnerabilities

 * **Unauthenticated CRM contact book returns volunteer notes and accepts writes (2026-10-05).** `CrmController` has no `UseGuards` (`crm.controller.ts` 38; zero `UseGuards` and zero `req.user` in the file) and is registered from `app.module.ts` (117). SRS §2.11.3 lists `GET /api/crm`, `POST /api/crm`, `PATCH /api/crm/:id`, and `DELETE /api/crm/:id` and does not name a guard. The routes sit in the admin module (§2.11), beside `/api/admin/tables`, which requires `AdminAuthGuard` (§2.11.1). `schema.sql` and `docs/SSOT/SRS/06-database-design.md` do not define `crm_contacts`. The first request runs `ensureTable`, which executes `CREATE TABLE crm_contacts` (`name`, `capabilities`, `desire`, `time_availability`, `source`, `referrer`, `status`, `created_by`) and attaches trigger `update_crm_contacts_updated_at` to `update_updated_at_column()` (48–104). `GET /api/crm` runs `SELECT *` with no `LIMIT` (106–147). `status` and `search` are bound parameters. The full row set is cached for 10 minutes (113–140). `POST` inserts client `name`, `capabilities`, `desire`, `time_availability`, `source`, `referrer`, `status`, and `created_by` (149–183). `CreateContactDto` and `UpdateContactDto` are TypeScript interfaces (17–36), so the global `ValidationPipe` does not whitelist the body. `PATCH` updates any id; the column list is hardcoded (185–248). `DELETE` removes any id (250–268). Concrete trigger: `POST /api/crm` with `name`, `capabilities`, `desire`, and `referrer`, and no `Authorization`. `GET /api/crm` returns that row, including the free-text fields. NFR §3.5 requires omitting fields the caller may not see. The 2026-10-04 bullet is `community_members.contact_info`. This bullet is the CRM contact book. - File: `apps/api/src/controllers/crm.controller.ts` (17–36, 38, 48–268); `apps/api/src/app.module.ts` (117) -> Action: Require `AdminAuthGuard` on every method. Bind `created_by` to `req.user.userId`. Cap the list. Move `CREATE TABLE` and the trigger into an offline migration.

 * **Unauthenticated community-members directory returns phone and email and accepts writes (2026-10-04, re-verified 2026-10-05).** `CommunityMembersController` has no `UseGuards` (`community-members.controller.ts` 48) and is registered from `app.module.ts` (115). SRS §2.11.5 lists list, get, create, update, and delete and does not name a guard. The routes sit in the admin module (§2.11), beside `/api/admin/tables`, which requires `AdminAuthGuard` (§2.11.1). `GET /api/community-members` selects `contact_info` for every row and has no `LIMIT` (186–236). `GET :id` repeats that column (247–284). `schema.sql` documents `contact_info` as `{email, phone, etc.}` (1072–1077; `database.init.ts` 882–894). `POST` inserts `name`, `role`, `description`, `contact_info`, `status`, and `created_by` (294–339). `PATCH` updates those fields for any id (354–429). `DELETE` removes any id (439–462). `CreateMemberDto` and `UpdateMemberDto` are TypeScript interfaces (23–46), so the global `ValidationPipe` does not whitelist `contact_info`. `resolveUserIdToUUID` maps a client email, `firebase_uid`, or UUID onto `created_by` (63–97, 307–316). When `community_members` is absent, the same request runs `CREATE TABLE` and `CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION update_updated_at_column()` (102–176). That function is shared by other `updated_at` triggers. The list is cached for 10 minutes, including `contact_info` (193–234). Concrete trigger: `GET /api/community-members` with no `Authorization`. Each row includes `contact_info`. `POST /api/community-members` with `name`, `role`, and `contact_info.email` / `contact_info.phone` stores that record. NFR §3.5 requires omitting fields the caller may not see. - File: `apps/api/src/controllers/community-members.controller.ts` (23–46, 48, 63–97, 102–176, 186–470); `apps/api/src/app.module.ts` (115); `apps/api/src/database/schema.sql` (1071–1092) -> Action: Require `AdminAuthGuard` on every method. Omit `contact_info` unless the caller is an admin. Bind `created_by` to `req.user.userId`. Cap the list. Move table and function DDL into an offline migration.

 * **Unauthenticated ride create forges a public feed post and can insert a passwordless profile (2026-10-03, re-verified 2026-10-05).** `RidesController` has no `UseGuards` (`rides.controller.ts` 37). SRS §2.4.1 lists create, book, booking-status, update, and delete and does not name a guard. `createRide` accepts client `driver_id`. When that value matches a UUID it is used as-is (74–75). When it does not, the handler looks up `settings->>'legacy_id'` or email `<id>@legacy.com`, and if neither exists it `INSERT`s `user_profiles` with that email, a display name, and `settings.legacy_id` (80–113). `user_profiles.roles` defaults to `user` and `password_hash` is nullable (`schema.sql` 15–33). The same transaction inserts `rides` and then `posts` with `author_id` set to that driver and `post_type` `ride` (121–175). `posts.ride_id` exists (`schema.sql` 524; `posts.controller.ts` 211). Client `metadata` is spread into the post JSON (169–171). `GET /api/posts` has no guard and keeps rows whose status is not `hidden` (754, 830–831). `GET /api/rides` returns `up.phone as driver_phone` (247–250). `GET /api/rides/:id` adds `driver_email` (347–351). `limit` is `parseInt` with no cap (314–316). `POST :id/book` resolves `passenger_id` by email, `firebase_uid`, or UUID and inserts `ride_bookings` plus `user_activities` (412–488). `PUT bookings/:bookingId/status` writes the body status, including `approved`, with no driver comparison (505–522). `PUT :id` and `DELETE :id` change or cancel any ride (695–743). `GET user/:userId` returns that user's rides, and the passenger branch includes `driver_phone` (579–646). Concrete trigger: `GET /api/users`, then `POST /api/rides` with that `id` as `driver_id`, `from_location`, `to_location`, and `departure_time`, and no `Authorization`. The public feed shows a ride post authored by that user. A second trigger uses a non-UUID `driver_id` and then `POST /api/users/resolve-id` with email `<id>@legacy.com`, which mints a token pair for the new row (`user-auth.service.ts` 328–342, 645–660). NFR §3.5 requires omitting fields the caller may not see. §2.5.4 requires `JwtAuthGuard` to change a post; this path creates one with no JWT. The 2026-10-01 bullet is `POST /api/dedicated-items`. This bullet is the ride path. - File: `apps/api/src/controllers/rides.controller.ts` (37–225, 247–251, 314–316, 338–522, 579–646, 695–743); `apps/api/src/database/schema.sql` (11–33, 185–210, 520–534); `apps/api/src/controllers/posts.controller.ts` (211, 754, 830–831) -> Action: Require `JwtAuthGuard` on create, book, status, update, and delete. Bind `driver_id`, `posts.author_id`, and booking approval to `req.user.userId`. Bind `passenger_id` to the JWT subject. Do not insert `user_profiles` from a ride body. Omit driver phone and email from public reads. Cap `limit`. Allowlist booking status.

 * **Unauthenticated item delivery completion (2026-09-30, re-verified 2026-10-05).** `ItemsDeliveryController` has no `UseGuards` (`items-delivery.controller.ts` 25–26). SRS §2.6.3 lists `POST /api/items-delivery/:id/deliver` and does not name an auth guard. `markAsDelivered` calls `updateItem(itemId, { status: "delivered" })` and only afterwards looks at `body.requestId` (241–260). `updateItem` writes `status` with no owner comparison (service 261–265, 292–299). Bind the actor to `req.user.userId`. Allow deliver and status changes only for the item owner, or for an approved requester when the product rule says so. Run the item update and the request update in one transaction. Stop taking owner identity from the query string. Omit `owner_id` and owner contact fields from public reads.

 * **Donation create forges money totals with an unbound donor and an unchecked amount (2026-09-29, re-verified 2026-10-05).** SRS §2.3.2 requires `JwtAuthGuard` on `POST /api/donations`. ## 🐞 Bugs & Logic Issues

 * **CRM list has no cap, and a missing table is created on the public GET (2026-10-05).** `GET /api/crm` appends `ORDER BY created_at DESC` with no `LIMIT` (`crm.controller.ts` 137). `ensureTable` runs on that same request and executes `CREATE TABLE` plus `CREATE TRIGGER` (62–97). The trigger calls `update_updated_at_column()`. A failure inside `ensureTable` is logged and swallowed (101–103), so the following `SELECT` still runs. Recommendation: Cap the list. Create `crm_contacts` in an offline migration. Leave the shared `updated_at` function untouched on the request path.

 * **Community-members list has no cap, and a missing table replaces a shared trigger function (2026-10-04, re-verified 2026-10-05).** `GET /api/community-members` appends `ORDER BY created_at DESC` with no `LIMIT` (`community-members.controller.ts` 230). `ensureTable` runs only when the table is absent and then executes `CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION update_updated_at_column()` (157–165) plus `DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS` (169). Other tables use that function for `updated_at`. Recommendation: Cap the list. Create the table in an offline migration. Leave the shared function untouched on the request path.

 * **Ride booking approval has no driver and no seat lock (2026-10-03, re-verified 2026-10-05).** `PUT /api/rides/bookings/:bookingId/status` sets the body status, including `approved`, before it counts remaining seats (`rides.controller.ts` 505–555). It does not reject when approved seats would exceed `available_seats`, and it accepts any status string. The book path checks remaining seats only against already-approved rows (384–410), so two pending bookings can both be approved. Recommendation: `SELECT … FOR UPDATE` on the ride. Allowlist status. Approve only when the JWT subject is the driver and remaining seats are sufficient.

 * **Places details interpolates `place_id` and publishes search terms (2026-10-02, re-verified 2026-10-05).** `PlacesController` has no guard (`places.controller.ts` 9–13). Autocomplete encodes `input` (38–40). `GET /place-details` concatenates `place_id` into the Google URL (75). A value that contains `&` adds extra query parameters on the request that uses `GOOGLE_API_KEY`. The handler returns Google's `error_message` (82). `GET /search-stats` lists the top stored search strings with no auth (88–91, 139–166). SRS §2.13.2 lists these routes and does not name a guard. Recommendation: `encodeURIComponent` on `place_id`. Allowlist Google fields. Do not return the upstream error string. Require an app credential or a tight limiter before spending the key. Drop public search-term stats.

 * **Companion item post is best-effort, and the caller chooses the item id (2026-10-01, re-verified 2026-10-05).** A failed `INSERT INTO posts` is caught and the item still commits (`dedicated-items.service.ts` 170–177). If the provided id is not a 10–13 digit timestamp, it becomes the primary key (78–88). `PUT` can set `is_deleted` to false and clear the soft-delete (dto 136–142; service 262–279). Recommendation: One transaction. Generate the id on the server. Allow delete and restore only for the JWT subject.

 * **Item deliver commits `delivered` before the request permission check (2026-09-30, re-verified 2026-10-05).** `markAsDelivered` updates the item, then optionally calls `updateItemRequest` (`items-delivery.controller.ts` 247–258). A mismatched `userId` returns Unauthorized from the request update while the item stays `delivered`. `completed` is not restricted to the owner (`items-delivery.service.ts` 507–551). Recommendation: One transaction. Check the JWT subject before either write. Limit `completed` to the owner.

 * **Money donation counters ignore sign, zero, and later edits (2026-09-29, re-verified 2026-10-05).** A truthy negative `amount` subtracts from `total_donations_amount`. A missing amount increments `community_stats` by 1 (`donations.controller.ts` 525–541). `PUT` and `DELETE` leave both counters unchanged (698–780). Recommendation: Reject non-positive money amounts. Adjust both counters by the delta inside the same transaction.

 * **Anonymous hierarchy read can `ALTER TABLE` (2026-09-28, re-verified 2026-10-05).** `ensureSalarySeniorityColumns` adds `salary`, `seniority_start_date`, and `parent_manager_id` (`user-hierarchy.service.ts` 436–483). Recommendation: Apply those columns in an offline migration.

 * **Hierarchy pull check fails open (2026-09-27, re-verified 2026-10-05).** `assertRequesterMayPullTargetUnderSelf` returns `{ ok: true }` at line 149 when neither ancestor check matches. Recommendation: Default to deny.

 * **Comment handlers return `error.message` (re-verified 2026-10-05).** Update, delete, and list catch blocks interpolate the driver message (`posts.controller.ts` 1803–1805, 2042–2045, 2134–2137). Recommendation: Return a generic error and log the driver message server-side.

 * **`GET /rate-limit/stats` lists every limiter key with no auth (re-verified 2026-10-05).** `getRateLimitStats` runs `KEYS rate_limit:*` and `KEYS blocked:*` (`rate-limit.service.ts` 238–256). Recommendation: Remove the route from deployed builds.

 * **Rate limiter fails open when Redis errors (re-verified 2026-10-05).** `checkRateLimit` returns `allowed: true` if the block read or the counter read throws (`rate-limit.service.ts` 87–89, 106–111). Recommendation: Fail closed on auth routes.

 * **Unauthenticated `POST /api/stats/track-visit` inflates production metrics (re-verified 2026-10-05).** No guard. Increments `community_stats.site_visits` (373–401). Recommendation: Require a bot-resistant token, or drop the public increment.

 * **Items-delivery static route is shadowed (re-verified 2026-10-05).** `GET /api/items-delivery/:id` is declared before `GET requests` (180–223), so the request list is captured as an item id. Dedicated-items `GET :id` still shadows `GET search` (69 vs 166). Recommendation: Declare static routes before parameterized routes.

 * **`loginUser` and `JwtAuthGuard` never consult `user_profiles.is_active` (re-verified 2026-10-05).** Deactivated rows can still obtain a session via email-only login or an existing refresh token. Recommendation: Fail closed on `is_active = false`.

 * **Anonymity filtering is specified and not implemented (re-verified 2026-10-05).** SRS §2.5.7 / NFR §3.2 require server-side redaction for `anonymity_level < 4`. The column is still absent (0 matches under `apps/`). Recommendation: Add the column and the feed projection.

## 🏗️ Architecture & Clean Code

 * **No Domain / Application / Infrastructure folders** under `apps/` or `packages/` (count 0). The target in `docs/SSOT/CODE_QUALITY/layers-and-boundaries.md` is Infrastructure → Application → Domain. The monorepo remains NestJS feature folders plus React Native screens. `packages/` still only contains `config-eslint`. The closest pure islands remain `apps/api/src/tasks/task-completion-participants.ts`, `tasks-validation.ts`, `tasks-query-params.ts`, and `tasks.types.ts`.

 * **Fat HTTP layer owns SQL and policy.** Largest API files: `posts.controller.ts` (2741), `stats.controller.ts` (1709), `user-hierarchy.service.ts` (1675), `database.init.ts` (1374), `community-group-challenges.controller.ts` (1097), `donations.controller.ts` (892), `chat.controller.ts` (813), `rides.controller.ts` (779). `items-delivery.service.ts` remains under `controllers/`. `CommunityMembersController` imports `pg` and runs `SELECT` / `INSERT` / `UPDATE` / `DELETE`, plus request-path DDL, with no authenticated subject. `CrmController` imports `pg` and runs `SELECT *` / `INSERT` / `UPDATE` / `DELETE`, plus request-path `CREATE TABLE`, with no authenticated subject (`crm.controller.ts` 38–268). `RidesController` imports `pg` and writes `user_profiles`, `rides`, `posts`, `user_activities`, and `community_stats` in one method. `DedicatedItemsService` still writes both `items` and `posts`. Donation reads and money totals are still computed in the controller. Item completion policy still authorizes nobody. Hierarchy permission policy authorizes a body id.

 * **Privilege checks disagree inside the same product.** Notifications `validateOwnership` compares `:userId` to `req.user.userId` (94–110). Admin tables use a class-level `AdminAuthGuard`. Community-members, CRM, and ride create never read a session. Item request updates compare `owner_id` to a query string. Dedicated-item create writes `posts.author_id` from a client identifier. Post DELETE uses `getSessionUserId`; comment PUT/DELETE use the client id. Donation create checks that some JWT is present and then trusts `donor_id`. Donation `GET :id` checks nobody. `GET hierarchy/tree` has no actor at all.

 * **Database design and the community-members table disagree.** SRS database design lists `email` and `phone` columns on `community_members` (`docs/SSOT/SRS/06-database-design.md`). `schema.sql` stores one `contact_info` JSONB object (1072–1077). The controller reads and writes that JSON.

 * **CRM table is absent from the committed schema.** `schema.sql` and `docs/SSOT/SRS/06-database-design.md` do not define `crm_contacts`. `CrmController.ensureTable` creates that table on the first request (62–97). SRS §2.11.3 still lists the four CRM routes.

 * **Positive in-folder contrasts (do not regress):** community-group challenges bind the creator on create, join, entry, PUT, and DELETE; personal challenges scope timer reads to `CurrentUser()`; knowledge contribution-request binds `req.user.userId`; sync user/all/status use `AdminAuthGuard`; authenticated chat send/read checks `ANY(participants)` when a JWT is present; `/session/login` requires argon2 once the shared limiter allows the call; CRM PATCH uses hardcoded column names; community-challenge `ORDER BY` uses an allowlist plus `pg-format` `%I`; item list `ORDER BY` uses an allowlisted column; ride list `ORDER BY` uses an allowlisted column; dedicated-item and personal-challenge updates go through class-validator DTOs (the dedicated-item column list is allowlisted; the missing check is the owner). Collection names are checked against `ALLOWED_COLLECTIONS` before SQL. Places autocomplete encodes its query string; place-details does not.

 * **Operator matching workspace is specified and not implemented.** `OperatorAuthGuard` exists and there is no `/api/operator/*` module. Anonymity and matching-case tables remain SRS §10 gaps.

This bullet is the read. - File: `apps/api/src/controllers/donations.controller.ts` (79, 577–660, 667–696, 782–831); `apps/api/src/database/schema.sql` (161–181) -> Action: Keep a public donation card to title, category, city, and status. Require `JwtAuthGuard` on `GET user/:userId` and bind `:userId` to `req.user.userId` unless the caller is an admin.
