## 🐞 Bugs & Logic Issues

 * **Community-members list has no cap, and a missing table replaces a shared trigger function (2026-10-04).** `GET /api/community-members` appends `ORDER BY created_at DESC` with no `LIMIT` (`community-members.controller.ts` 230). `ensureTable` runs only when the table is absent and then executes `CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION update_updated_at_column()` (157–165) plus `DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS` (169). Other tables use that function for `updated_at`. Recommendation: Cap the list. Create the table in an offline migration. Leave the shared function untouched on the request path.

 * **Ride booking approval has no driver and no seat lock (2026-10-03, re-verified 2026-10-04).** `PUT /api/rides/bookings/:bookingId/status` sets the body status, including `approved`, before it counts remaining seats (`rides.controller.ts` 505–555). It does not reject when approved seats would exceed `available_seats`, and it accepts any status string. The book path checks remaining seats only against already-approved rows (384–410), so two pending bookings can both be approved. Recommendation: `SELECT … FOR UPDATE` on the ride. Allowlist status. Approve only when the JWT subject is the driver and remaining seats are sufficient.

 * **Places details interpolates `place_id` and publishes search terms (2026-10-02, re-verified 2026-10-04).** `PlacesController` has no guard (`places.controller.ts` 9–13). Autocomplete encodes `input` (38–40). `GET /place-details` concatenates `place_id` into the Google URL (75). A value that contains `&` adds extra query parameters on the request that uses `GOOGLE_API_KEY`. The handler returns Google's `error_message` (82). `GET /search-stats` lists the top stored search strings with no auth (88–91, 139–166). SRS §2.13.2 lists these routes and does not name a guard. Recommendation: `encodeURIComponent` on `place_id`. Allowlist Google fields. Do not return the upstream error string. Require an app credential or a tight limiter before spending the key. Drop public search-term stats.

 * **Companion item post is best-effort, and the caller chooses the item id (2026-10-01, re-verified 2026-10-04).** A failed `INSERT INTO posts` is caught and the item still commits (`dedicated-items.service.ts` 170–177). If the provided id is not a 10–13 digit timestamp, it becomes the primary key (78–88). `PUT` can set `is_deleted` to false and clear the soft-delete (dto 136–142; service 262–279). Recommendation: One transaction. Generate the id on the server. Allow delete and restore only for the JWT subject.

 * **Item deliver commits `delivered` before the request permission check (2026-09-30, re-verified 2026-10-04).** `markAsDelivered` updates the item, then optionally calls `updateItemRequest` (`items-delivery.controller.ts` 247–258). A mismatched `userId` returns Unauthorized from the request update while the item stays `delivered`. `completed` is not restricted to the owner (`items-delivery.service.ts` 507–551). Recommendation: One transaction. Check the JWT subject before either write. Limit `completed` to the owner.

 * **Money donation counters ignore sign, zero, and later edits (2026-09-29, re-verified 2026-10-04).** A truthy negative `amount` subtracts from `total_donations_amount`. A missing amount increments `community_stats` by 1 (`donations.controller.ts` 525–541). `PUT` and `DELETE` leave both counters unchanged (698–780). Recommendation: Reject non-positive money amounts. Adjust both counters by the delta inside the same transaction.

 * **Anonymous hierarchy read can `ALTER TABLE` (2026-09-28, re-verified 2026-10-04).** `ensureSalarySeniorityColumns` adds `salary`, `seniority_start_date`, and `parent_manager_id` (`user-hierarchy.service.ts` 436–483). Recommendation: Apply those columns in an offline migration.

 * **Hierarchy pull check fails open (2026-09-27, re-verified 2026-10-04).** `assertRequesterMayPullTargetUnderSelf` returns `{ ok: true }` at line 149 when neither ancestor check matches. Recommendation: Default to deny.

 * **Comment handlers return `error.message` (re-verified 2026-10-04).** Update, delete, and list catch blocks interpolate the driver message (`posts.controller.ts` 1803–1805, 2042–2045, 2134–2137). Recommendation: Return a generic error and log the driver message server-side.

 * **`GET /rate-limit/stats` lists every limiter key with no auth (re-verified 2026-10-04).** `getRateLimitStats` runs `KEYS rate_limit:*` and `KEYS blocked:*` (`rate-limit.service.ts` 238–256). Recommendation: Remove the route from deployed builds.

 * **Rate limiter fails open when Redis errors (re-verified 2026-10-04).** `checkRateLimit` returns `allowed: true` if the block read or the counter read throws (`rate-limit.service.ts` 87–89, 106–111). Recommendation: Fail closed on auth routes.

 * **Unauthenticated `POST /api/stats/track-visit` inflates production metrics (re-verified 2026-10-04).** No guard. Increments `community_stats.site_visits` (373–401). Recommendation: Require a bot-resistant token, or drop the public increment.

 * **Items-delivery static route is shadowed (re-verified 2026-10-04).** `GET /api/items-delivery/:id` is declared before `GET requests` (180–223), so the request list is captured as an item id. Dedicated-items `GET :id` still shadows `GET search` (69 vs 166). Recommendation: Declare static routes before parameterized routes.

 * **`loginUser` and `JwtAuthGuard` never consult `user_profiles.is_active` (re-verified 2026-10-04).** Deactivated rows can still obtain a session via email-only login or an existing refresh token. Recommendation: Fail closed on `is_active = false`.

 * **Anonymity filtering is specified and not implemented (re-verified 2026-10-04).** SRS §2.5.7 / NFR §3.2 require server-side redaction for `anonymity_level < 4`. The column is still absent (0 matches under `apps/`). Recommendation: Add the column and the feed projection.

## 🏗️ Architecture & Clean Code

 * **No Domain / Application / Infrastructure folders** under `apps/` or `packages/` (count 0). The target in `docs/SSOT/CODE_QUALITY/layers-and-boundaries.md` is Infrastructure → Application → Domain. The monorepo remains NestJS feature folders plus React Native screens. `packages/` still only contains `config-eslint`. The closest pure islands remain `apps/api/src/tasks/task-completion-participants.ts`, `tasks-validation.ts`, `tasks-query-params.ts`, and `tasks.types.ts`.

 * **Fat HTTP layer owns SQL and policy.** Largest API files: `posts.controller.ts` (2741), `stats.controller.ts` (1709), `user-hierarchy.service.ts` (1675), `database.init.ts` (1374), `community-group-challenges.controller.ts` (1097), `donations.controller.ts` (892), `chat.controller.ts` (813), `rides.controller.ts` (779). `items-delivery.service.ts` remains under `controllers/`. `CommunityMembersController` imports `pg` and runs `SELECT` / `INSERT` / `UPDATE` / `DELETE`, plus request-path DDL, with no authenticated subject. `RidesController` imports `pg` and writes `user_profiles`, `rides`, `posts`, `user_activities`, and `community_stats` in one method. `DedicatedItemsService` still writes both `items` and `posts`. Donation reads and money totals are still computed in the controller. Item completion policy still authorizes nobody. Hierarchy permission policy authorizes a body id.

 * **Privilege checks disagree inside the same product.** Notifications `validateOwnership` compares `:userId` to `req.user.userId` (94–110). Admin tables use a class-level `AdminAuthGuard`. Community-members, CRM, and ride create never read a session. Item request updates compare `owner_id` to a query string. Dedicated-item create writes `posts.author_id` from a client identifier. Post DELETE uses `getSessionUserId`; comment PUT/DELETE use the client id. Donation create checks that some JWT is present and then trusts `donor_id`. Donation `GET :id` checks nobody. `GET hierarchy/tree` has no actor at all.

 * **Database design and the community-members table disagree.** SRS database design lists `email` and `phone` columns on `community_members` (`docs/SSOT/SRS/06-database-design.md`). `schema.sql` stores one `contact_info` JSONB object (1072–1077). The controller reads and writes that JSON.

## 🚨 Critical Vulnerabilities

 * **Unauthenticated ride create forges a public feed post and can insert a passwordless profile (2026-10-03).** `RidesController` has no `UseGuards` (`rides.controller.ts` 37). SRS §2.4.1 lists create, book, booking-status, update, and delete and does not name a guard. `createRide` accepts client `driver_id`. When that value matches a UUID it is used as-is (74–75). When it does not, the handler looks up `settings->>'legacy_id'` or email `<id>@legacy.com`, and if neither exists it `INSERT`s `user_profiles` with that email, a display name, and `settings.legacy_id` (80–113). `user_profiles.roles` defaults to `user` and `password_hash` is nullable (`schema.sql` 15–33). The same transaction inserts `rides` and then `posts` with `author_id` set to that driver and `post_type` `ride` (121–175). `posts.ride_id` exists (`schema.sql` 524; `posts.controller.ts` 211). Client `metadata` is spread into the post JSON (169–171). `GET /api/posts` has no guard and keeps rows whose status is not `hidden` (754, 830–831). `GET /api/rides` returns `up.phone as driver_phone` (247–250). `GET /api/rides/:id` adds `driver_email` (347–351). `limit` is `parseInt` with no cap (314–316). `POST :id/book` resolves `passenger_id` by email, `firebase_uid`, or UUID and inserts `ride_bookings` plus `user_activities` (412–488). `PUT bookings/:bookingId/status` writes the body status, including `approved`, with no driver comparison (505–522). `PUT :id` and `DELETE :id` change or cancel any ride (695–743). `GET user/:userId` returns that user's rides, and the passenger branch includes `driver_phone` (579–646). Concrete trigger: `GET /api/users`, then `POST /api/rides` with that `id` as `driver_id`, `from_location`, `to_location`, and `departure_time`, and no `Authorization`. The public feed shows a ride post authored by that user. A second trigger uses a non-UUID `driver_id` and then `POST /api/users/resolve-id` with email `<id>@legacy.com`, which mints a token pair for the new row (`user-auth.service.ts` 328–342, 645–660). NFR §3.5 requires omitting fields the caller may not see. §2.5.4 requires `JwtAuthGuard` to change a post; this path creates one with no JWT. The 2026-10-01 bullet is `POST /api/dedicated-items`. This bullet is the ride path. - File: `apps/api/src/controllers/rides.controller.ts` (37–225, 247–251, 314–316, 338–522, 579–646, 695–743); `apps/api/src/database/schema.sql` (11–33, 185–210, 520–534); `apps/api/src/controllers/posts.controller.ts` (211, 754, 830–831) -> Action: Require `JwtAuthGuard` on create, book, status, update, and delete. Bind `driver_id`, `posts.author_id`, and booking approval to `req.user.userId`. Bind `passenger_id` to the JWT subject. Do not insert `user_profiles` from a ride body. Omit driver phone and email from public reads. Cap `limit`. Allowlist booking status.

Guest `POST /api/chat/messages` accepts `sender_id` and skips membership (456–570). - File: `apps/api/src/controllers/chat.controller.ts` (45–46, 107–230, 246–330, 341–420, 441–669, 671–812) -> Action: Require JWT. Bind the sender and the reader to `req.user.userId`. Require the caller to be a participant before read or send.

Require a verified ID token.

Register with the committed fallback mailbox sets `admin` (101–102). A profile created by ride insert has a null `password_hash`, so this login path accepts that email with no password. - File: `apps/api/src/services/user-auth.service.ts` (97–139, 212–263); `apps/api/src/config/kc-root-admin.defaults.ts` -> Action: Fail closed unless a password verifies. Never mutate roles before `argon2.verify`.

Strip privileged fields from the public DTO.

Knowledge-link `POST` is public. Task `log-hours` upserts body `user_id`. `GET /api/stats/details/:statType` is JWT-only and `totalUsers` returns name, email, and city (834–876). ## 🐞 Bugs & Logic Issues

 * **Ride booking approval has no driver and no seat lock (2026-10-03).** `PUT /api/rides/bookings/:bookingId/status` sets the body status, including `approved`, before it counts remaining seats (`rides.controller.ts` 505–555). It does not reject when approved seats would exceed `available_seats`, and it accepts any status string. The book path checks remaining seats only against already-approved rows (384–410), so two pending bookings can both be approved. Recommendation: `SELECT … FOR UPDATE` on the ride. Allowlist status. Approve only when the JWT subject is the driver and remaining seats are sufficient.

 * **Places details interpolates `place_id` and publishes search terms (2026-10-02, re-verified 2026-10-03).** `PlacesController` has no guard (`places.controller.ts` 9–13). Autocomplete encodes `input` (38–40). `GET /place-details` concatenates `place_id` into the Google URL (75). A value that contains `&` adds extra query parameters on the request that uses `GOOGLE_API_KEY`. The handler returns Google's `error_message` (82). `GET /search-stats` lists the top stored search strings with no auth (88–91, 139–166). SRS §2.13.2 lists these routes and does not name a guard. Recommendation: `encodeURIComponent` on `place_id`. Allowlist Google fields. Do not return the upstream error string. Require an app credential or a tight limiter before spending the key. Drop public search-term stats.

 * **Companion item post is best-effort, and the caller chooses the item id (2026-10-01, re-verified 2026-10-03).** A failed `INSERT INTO posts` is caught and the item still commits (`dedicated-items.service.ts` 170–177). If the provided id is not a 10–13 digit timestamp, it becomes the primary key (78–88). `PUT` can set `is_deleted` to false and clear the soft-delete (dto 136–142; service 262–279). Recommendation: One transaction. Generate the id on the server. Allow delete and restore only for the JWT subject.

 * **Item deliver commits `delivered` before the request permission check (2026-09-30, re-verified 2026-10-03).** `markAsDelivered` updates the item, then optionally calls `updateItemRequest` (`items-delivery.controller.ts` 247–258). A mismatched `userId` returns Unauthorized from the request update while the item stays `delivered`. `completed` is not restricted to the owner (`items-delivery.service.ts` 507–551). Recommendation: One transaction. Check the JWT subject before either write. Limit `completed` to the owner.

 * **Money donation counters ignore sign, zero, and later edits (2026-09-29, re-verified 2026-10-03).** A truthy negative `amount` subtracts from `total_donations_amount`. A missing amount increments `community_stats` by 1 (`donations.controller.ts` 525–541). `PUT` and `DELETE` leave both counters unchanged (698–780). Recommendation: Reject non-positive money amounts. Adjust both counters by the delta inside the same transaction.

 * **Anonymous hierarchy read can `ALTER TABLE` (2026-09-28, re-verified 2026-10-03).** `ensureSalarySeniorityColumns` adds `salary`, `seniority_start_date`, and `parent_manager_id` (`user-hierarchy.service.ts` 436–483). Recommendation: Apply those columns in an offline migration.

 * **Hierarchy pull check fails open (2026-09-27, re-verified 2026-10-03).** `assertRequesterMayPullTargetUnderSelf` returns `{ ok: true }` at line 149 when neither ancestor check matches. Recommendation: Default to deny.

 * **Comment handlers return `error.message` (re-verified 2026-10-03).** Update, delete, and list catch blocks interpolate the driver message (`posts.controller.ts` 1803–1805, 2042–2045, 2134–2137). Recommendation: Return a generic error and log the driver message server-side.

 * **`GET /rate-limit/stats` lists every limiter key with no auth (re-verified 2026-10-03).** `getRateLimitStats` runs `KEYS rate_limit:*` and `KEYS blocked:*` (`rate-limit.service.ts` 238–256). Recommendation: Remove the route from deployed builds.

 * **Rate limiter fails open when Redis errors (re-verified 2026-10-03).** `checkRateLimit` returns `allowed: true` if the block read or the counter read throws (`rate-limit.service.ts` 87–89, 106–111). Recommendation: Fail closed on auth routes.

 * **Unauthenticated `POST /api/stats/track-visit` inflates production metrics (re-verified 2026-10-03).** No guard. Increments `community_stats.site_visits` (373–401). Recommendation: Require a bot-resistant token, or drop the public increment.

 * **Items-delivery static route is shadowed (re-verified 2026-10-03).** `GET /api/items-delivery/:id` is declared before `GET requests` (180–223), so the request list is captured as an item id. Dedicated-items `GET :id` still shadows `GET search` (69 vs 166). Recommendation: Declare static routes before parameterized routes.

 * **`loginUser` and `JwtAuthGuard` never consult `user_profiles.is_active` (re-verified 2026-10-03).** Deactivated rows can still obtain a session via email-only login or an existing refresh token. Recommendation: Fail closed on `is_active = false`.

 * **Anonymity filtering is specified and not implemented (re-verified 2026-10-03).** SRS §2.5.7 / NFR §3.2 require server-side redaction for `anonymity_level < 4`. The column is still absent (0 matches under `apps/`). Recommendation: Add the column and the feed projection.

## 🏗️ Architecture & Clean Code

 * **No Domain / Application / Infrastructure folders** under `apps/` or `packages/` (count 0). The target in `docs/SSOT/CODE_QUALITY/layers-and-boundaries.md` is Infrastructure → Application → Domain. The monorepo remains NestJS feature folders plus React Native screens. `packages/` still only contains `config-eslint`. The closest pure islands remain `apps/api/src/tasks/task-completion-participants.ts`, `tasks-validation.ts`, `tasks-query-params.ts`, and `tasks.types.ts`.

 * **Fat HTTP layer owns SQL and policy.** Largest API files: `posts.controller.ts` (2741), `stats.controller.ts` (1709), `user-hierarchy.service.ts` (1675), `database.init.ts` (1374), `community-group-challenges.controller.ts` (1097), `donations.controller.ts` (892), `chat.controller.ts` (813), `rides.controller.ts` (779). `items-delivery.service.ts` remains under `controllers/`. `RidesController` imports `pg` and writes `user_profiles`, `rides`, `posts`, `user_activities`, and `community_stats` in one method, with no authenticated subject. `DedicatedItemsService` still writes both `items` and `posts`. Donation reads and money totals are still computed in the controller. Item completion policy still authorizes nobody. Hierarchy permission policy authorizes a body id.

 * **Privilege checks disagree inside the same product.** Notifications `validateOwnership` compares `:userId` to `req.user.userId` (94–110). Item request updates compare `owner_id` to a query string. Dedicated-item create and ride create never read a session and write `posts.author_id` from a client identifier. Post DELETE uses `getSessionUserId`; comment PUT/DELETE use the client id. Donation create checks that some JWT is present and then trusts `donor_id`. Donation `GET :id` checks nobody. `GET hierarchy/tree` has no actor at all.

 * **Positive in-folder contrasts (do not regress):** community-group challenges bind the creator on create, join, entry, PUT, and DELETE; personal challenges scope timer reads to `CurrentUser()`; knowledge contribution-request binds `req.user.userId`; sync user/all/status use `AdminAuthGuard`; authenticated chat send/read checks `ANY(participants)` when a JWT is present; `/session/login` requires argon2 once the shared limiter allows the call; CRM PATCH uses hardcoded column names; community-challenge `ORDER BY` uses an allowlist plus `pg-format` `%I`; item list `ORDER BY` uses an allowlisted column; ride list `ORDER BY` uses an allowlisted column; dedicated-item and personal-challenge updates go through class-validator DTOs (the dedicated-item column list is allowlisted; the missing check is the owner). Collection names are checked against `ALLOWED_COLLECTIONS` before SQL. Places autocomplete encodes its query string; place-details does not.

 * **Operator matching workspace is specified and not implemented.** `OperatorAuthGuard` exists and there is no `/api/operator/*` module. Anonymity and matching-case tables remain SRS §10 gaps.

## 🚨 Critical Vulnerabilities

 * **Unauthenticated donation reads return donor phone, email, and street location (2026-10-02).** `DonationsController` has no class-level `UseGuards` (`donations.controller.ts` 79). SRS §2.3.2 lists `GET /api/donations`, `GET /api/donations/:id`, and `GET /api/donations/user/:userId` and does not name a guard. The list query selects `d.*` plus donor name, city, and avatar (595–600). `donations` stores `amount`, `donor_id`, `recipient_id`, and `location` JSONB `{city, address, coordinates}` (`schema.sql` 161–181). When `status` is omitted the list keeps `active` rows; any other query status is accepted (625–631). `limit` is `parseInt` with no cap (641–647). `GET :id` repeats `d.*` and adds `up.phone as donor_phone` and `up.email as donor_email` (667–680). There is no owner check. `GET user/:userId` returns every donation row for that `donor_id` (782–799). `GET stats/summary` returns 30-day money totals with no guard (806–825). Concrete trigger: `GET /api/donations` with no `Authorization`, then `GET /api/donations/<id>` using the listed id. The detail body includes the donation address, coordinates, amount, donor phone, and donor email. NFR §3.5 requires omitting fields the caller may not see. The 2026-09-29 bullet covers `POST` forging `total_donations_amount`. This bullet is the read. - File: `apps/api/src/controllers/donations.controller.ts` (79, 577–660, 667–696, 782–831); `apps/api/src/database/schema.sql` (161–181) -> Action: Keep a public donation card to title, category, city, and status. Omit phone, email, street address, coordinates, `donor_id`, and `recipient_id` unless the caller is the donor, the recipient, or an admin. Cap `limit`. Require `JwtAuthGuard` on `GET user/:userId` and bind `:userId` to `req.user.userId` unless the caller is an admin.

 * **Unauthenticated dedicated-item create forges a public feed post as any directory user (2026-10-01, re-verified 2026-10-02).** `DedicatedItemsController` has no `UseGuards` (`dedicated-items.controller.ts` 19–28). `ItemsModule` registers it (`items.module.ts` 16–18; `app.module.ts` 86). The insert stores client `address`, `coordinates`, and `image_base64` (101–125), then inserts `posts` with `author_id` set to that owner (130–166). `posts.item_id` is TEXT and has no FK (`posts.controller.ts` 212), so the text item id is accepted. Client `metadata` is spread into the post JSON (148–151). When `price` is missing or not greater than 0, `post_type` is `donation` (133). A post-insert error is logged and the item still commits (170–177). `GET /api/posts` has no guard and keeps rows whose status is not `hidden` (754, 830–831). Public `GET :id` and `GET owner/:ownerId` are `SELECT *` (203–208, 230–232). `PUT :id` writes every whitelisted field, including `is_deleted` and `deleted_at` (dto 136–142; service 262–279). `DELETE :id` soft-deletes any id (controller 128–131; service 300–310). Concrete trigger: `GET /api/users`, then `POST /api/dedicated-items` with that user's email as `owner_id` plus `title` and `category`, and no `Authorization`. NFR §3.5 requires omitting fields the caller may not see. §2.5.4 requires `JwtAuthGuard` to change a post; this path creates one with no JWT. - File: `apps/api/src/items/dedicated-items.controller.ts` (19–28, 50–70, 98–131, 166–167); `apps/api/src/items/dedicated-items.service.ts` (20–66, 78–177, 203–232, 253–310); `apps/api/src/items/dto/dedicated-item.dto.ts` (10–16, 37–51, 77–80, 136–142); `apps/api/src/controllers/posts.controller.ts` (212, 754, 830–831) -> Action: Require `JwtAuthGuard`. Bind `owner_id` and `posts.author_id` to `req.user.userId`. Reject a mismatched client owner. Stop accepting a client item id and arbitrary `metadata`. ## 🐞 Bugs & Logic Issues

 * **Places details interpolates `place_id` and publishes search terms (2026-10-02).** `PlacesController` has no guard (`places.controller.ts` 9–13). Autocomplete encodes `input` (38–40). `GET /place-details` concatenates `place_id` into the Google URL (75). A value that contains `&` adds extra query parameters on the request that uses `GOOGLE_API_KEY`. The handler returns Google's `error_message` (82). `GET /search-stats` lists the top stored search strings with no auth (88–91, 139–166). SRS §2.13.2 lists these routes and does not name a guard. Recommendation: `encodeURIComponent` on `place_id`. Allowlist Google fields. Do not return the upstream error string. Require an app credential or a tight limiter before spending the key. Drop public search-term stats.

 * **Companion item post is best-effort, and the caller chooses the item id (2026-10-01, re-verified 2026-10-02).** A failed `INSERT INTO posts` is caught and the item still commits (`dedicated-items.service.ts` 170–177). If the provided id is not a 10–13 digit timestamp, it becomes the primary key (78–88). `PUT` can set `is_deleted` to false and clear the soft-delete (dto 136–142; service 262–279). Recommendation: One transaction. Generate the id on the server. Allow delete and restore only for the JWT subject.

 * **Item deliver commits `delivered` before the request permission check (2026-09-30, re-verified 2026-10-02).** `markAsDelivered` updates the item, then optionally calls `updateItemRequest` (`items-delivery.controller.ts` 247–258). A mismatched `userId` returns Unauthorized from the request update while the item stays `delivered`. `completed` is not restricted to the owner (`items-delivery.service.ts` 507–551). Recommendation: One transaction. Check the JWT subject before either write. Limit `completed` to the owner.

 * **Money donation counters ignore sign, zero, and later edits (2026-09-29, re-verified 2026-10-02).** A truthy negative `amount` subtracts from `total_donations_amount`. A missing amount increments `community_stats` by 1 (`donations.controller.ts` 525–541). `PUT` and `DELETE` leave both counters unchanged (698–780). Recommendation: Reject non-positive money amounts. Adjust both counters by the delta inside the same transaction.

 * **Anonymous hierarchy read can `ALTER TABLE` (2026-09-28, re-verified 2026-10-02).** `ensureSalarySeniorityColumns` adds `salary`, `seniority_start_date`, and `parent_manager_id` (`user-hierarchy.service.ts` 436–483). Recommendation: Apply those columns in an offline migration.

 * **Hierarchy pull check fails open (2026-09-27, re-verified 2026-10-02).** `assertRequesterMayPullTargetUnderSelf` returns `{ ok: true }` at line 149 when neither ancestor check matches. Recommendation: Default to deny.

 * **Comment handlers return `error.message` (re-verified 2026-10-02).** Update, delete, and list catch blocks interpolate the driver message (`posts.controller.ts` 1803–1805, 2042–2045, 2134–2137). Recommendation: Return a generic error and log the driver message server-side.

 * **`GET /rate-limit/stats` lists every limiter key with no auth (re-verified 2026-10-02).** `getRateLimitStats` runs `KEYS rate_limit:*` and `KEYS blocked:*` (`rate-limit.service.ts` 238–256). Recommendation: Remove the route from deployed builds.

 * **Rate limiter fails open when Redis errors (re-verified 2026-10-02).** `checkRateLimit` returns `allowed: true` if the block read or the counter read throws (`rate-limit.service.ts` 87–89, 106–111). Recommendation: Fail closed on auth routes.

 * **Unauthenticated `POST /api/stats/track-visit` inflates production metrics (re-verified 2026-10-02).** No guard. Increments `community_stats.site_visits` (373–401). Recommendation: Require a bot-resistant token, or drop the public increment.

 * **Ride booking approval oversell (re-verified 2026-10-02).** `PUT /api/rides/bookings/:bookingId/status` sets `approved` and only then flips the ride to `full` (505–555). It does not reject when approved seats would exceed `available_seats`. Recommendation: `SELECT … FOR UPDATE` and reject when remaining seats are insufficient.

 * **Items-delivery static route is shadowed (re-verified 2026-10-02).** `GET /api/items-delivery/:id` is declared before `GET requests` (180–223), so the request list is captured as an item id. Dedicated-items `GET :id` still shadows `GET search` (69 vs 166). Recommendation: Declare static routes before parameterized routes.

 * **`loginUser` and `JwtAuthGuard` never consult `user_profiles.is_active` (re-verified 2026-10-02).** Deactivated rows can still obtain a session via email-only login or an existing refresh token. Recommendation: Fail closed on `is_active = false`.

 * **Anonymity filtering is specified and not implemented (re-verified 2026-10-02).** SRS §2.5.7 / NFR §3.2 require server-side redaction for `anonymity_level < 4`. The column is still absent (0 matches under `apps/`). Recommendation: Add the column and the feed projection.

## 🏗️ Architecture & Clean Code

 * **No Domain / Application / Infrastructure folders** under `apps/` or `packages/` (count 0). The target in `docs/SSOT/CODE_QUALITY/layers-and-boundaries.md` is Infrastructure → Application → Domain. The monorepo remains NestJS feature folders plus React Native screens. `packages/` still only contains `config-eslint`. The closest pure islands remain `apps/api/src/tasks/task-completion-participants.ts`, `tasks-validation.ts`, `tasks-query-params.ts`, and `tasks.types.ts`.

 * **Fat HTTP layer owns SQL and policy.** Largest API files: `posts.controller.ts` (2741), `stats.controller.ts` (1709), `user-hierarchy.service.ts` (1675), `database.init.ts` (1374), `community-group-challenges.controller.ts` (1097), `donations.controller.ts` (892), `chat.controller.ts` (813). `items-delivery.service.ts` remains under `controllers/`. `DedicatedItemsService` imports `pg` and writes both `items` and `posts` in one method, so item persistence and feed authorship are one infrastructure routine with no authenticated subject. Donation reads and money totals are still computed in the controller. The detail query joins `user_profiles` phone and email with no subject. Item completion policy still authorizes nobody. Hierarchy permission policy authorizes a body id.

 * **Privilege checks disagree inside the same product.** Notifications `validateOwnership` compares `:userId` to `req.user.userId` (94–110). Item request updates compare `owner_id` to a query string. Dedicated-item create never reads a session and writes `posts.author_id` from a client identifier. Post DELETE uses `getSessionUserId`; comment PUT/DELETE use the client id. Donation create checks that some JWT is present and then trusts `donor_id`. Donation `GET :id` checks nobody. `GET hierarchy/tree` has no actor at all.

 * **Positive in-folder contrasts (do not regress):** community-group challenges bind the creator on create, join, entry, PUT, and DELETE; personal challenges scope timer reads to `CurrentUser()`; knowledge contribution-request binds `req.user.userId`; sync user/all/status use `AdminAuthGuard`; authenticated chat send/read checks `ANY(participants)`; `/session/login` requires argon2 once the shared limiter allows the call; CRM PATCH uses hardcoded column names; community-challenge `ORDER BY` uses an allowlist plus `pg-format` `%I`; item list `ORDER BY` uses an allowlisted column; dedicated-item and personal-challenge updates go through class-validator DTOs (the dedicated-item column list is allowlisted; the missing check is the owner). Collection names are checked against `ALLOWED_COLLECTIONS` before SQL. Places autocomplete encodes its query string; place-details does not.

 * **Operator matching workspace is specified and not implemented.** `OperatorAuthGuard` exists and there is no `/api/operator/*` module. Anonymity and matching-case tables remain SRS §10 gaps.

**SRS mapping:** NFR §3.1–3.2 and §3.5 (`docs/SSOT/SRS/03-non-functional-requirements.md`); items §2.6.2–2.6.3 (`docs/SSOT/SRS/functional/02-06-items.md`); posts §2.5.4 (`docs/SSOT/SRS/functional/02-05-posts.md`); users §2.2.3 (`docs/SSOT/SRS/functional/02-02-users.md`); donations §2.3.2 (`docs/SSOT/SRS/functional/02-03-donations.md`); auth §2.1, rides §2.4, chat §2.7, challenges §2.8, stats §2.10, admin §2.11 (`docs/SSOT/SRS/functional/*`); backend §5; gaps §10.3 (row added this run)
**Mode:** Report-only for product code (no auth/controller fixes in this pass). Spec gaps logged: SRS §10.3 and `docs/SSOT/CODE_QUALITY/tech-debt-log.md`. The 2026-09-23 through 2026-09-30 rows were absent from `dev` (open PRs `#169` through `#176`) and are carried forward. A 2026-10-01 row was added for dedicated-item feed impersonation.
**Delta vs 2026-09-30:** No product commits (`HEAD` still `3d92f9d`). Previously confirmed critical items re-verified at the same line numbers. **New first-class critical:** `POST /api/dedicated-items` has no guard and resolves client `owner_id` by email (`dedicated-items.controller.ts` 19–28; `dedicated-items.service.ts` 20–66). It then inserts a `posts` row with that user's `author_id` (130–166). `posts.item_id` is TEXT with no FK (`posts.controller.ts` 212), so the companion row is stored. The 2026-09-30 aggregate named this controller as unguarded. This bullet is the feed write. Near-misses that stay non-new: dedicated-item dynamic UPDATE remains allowlisted by class-validator plus the global `ValidationPipe` (`main.ts` 427–430) — the column names are not attacker SQL, the authorization is; item list `ORDER BY` remains an allowlisted column (`items-delivery.service.ts` 177–191); `anonymity_level` remains absent under `apps/` (0 matches); request-path XSS patterns remain absent (`dangerouslySetInnerHTML` none). Unguarded controllers unchanged: community-members, crm, items-delivery, places, rate-limit, redis-test, rides, dedicated-items, collections, session (health excluded). `ThrottlerModule` still has no `APP_GUARD`. No `trust proxy` under `apps/api`. Domain / application / infrastructure folders: 0. npm (2026-10-01, two root passes + workspaces, 06:09 UTC): root `metadata.vulnerabilities.total` was **46** then **68**; `--workspaces` was **97** (same split as 2026-09-30). Critical is **4** (`handlebars`, `shell-quote`, `tar`, `websocket-driver`). The lockfile did not change. Files >200 LOC: **196**. `databaseService.ts` measured **1225** lines this run (`wc -l`).

## 🚨 Critical Vulnerabilities

 * **Unauthenticated dedicated-item create forges a public feed post as any directory user (2026-10-01).** `DedicatedItemsController` has no `UseGuards` (`dedicated-items.controller.ts` 19–28). `ItemsModule` registers it (`items.module.ts` 16–18; `app.module.ts` 86). SRS §2.6.2 lists `POST /api/dedicated-items` and does not name a guard. `createItem` resolves `dto.owner_id` by UUID, email, `firebase_uid`, or `google_id` (`dedicated-items.service.ts` 20–55, 66). Unguarded `GET /api/users` and `GET /api/users/search` return `id` and `email` (`users.controller.ts` 40–42, 135–142; `user-profile.service.ts` 68–75, 503–516). The insert stores client `address`, `coordinates`, and `image_base64` (101–125), then inserts `posts` with `author_id` set to that owner (130–166). `posts.item_id` is TEXT and has no FK (`posts.controller.ts` 212), so the text item id is accepted. Client `metadata` is spread into the post JSON (148–151). When `price` is missing or not greater than 0, `post_type` is `donation` (133). A post-insert error is logged and the item still commits (170–177). `GET /api/posts` has no guard and keeps rows whose status is not `hidden` (754, 830–831). Public `GET :id` and `GET owner/:ownerId` are `SELECT *` (203–208, 230–232). `PUT :id` writes every whitelisted field, including `is_deleted` and `deleted_at` (dto 136–142; service 262–279). `DELETE :id` soft-deletes any id (controller 128–131; service 300–310). Concrete trigger: `GET /api/users`, then `POST /api/dedicated-items` with that user's email as `owner_id` plus `title` and `category`, and no `Authorization`. NFR §3.5 requires omitting fields the caller may not see. §2.5.4 requires `JwtAuthGuard` to change a post; this path creates one with no JWT. - File: `apps/api/src/items/dedicated-items.controller.ts` (19–28, 50–70, 98–131, 166–167); `apps/api/src/items/dedicated-items.service.ts` (20–66, 78–177, 203–232, 253–310); `apps/api/src/items/dto/dedicated-item.dto.ts` (10–16, 37–51, 77–80, 136–142); `apps/api/src/controllers/posts.controller.ts` (212, 754, 830–831) -> Action: Require `JwtAuthGuard`. Bind `owner_id` and `posts.author_id` to `req.user.userId`. Reject a mismatched client owner. Stop accepting a client item id and arbitrary `metadata`. Omit `address`, `coordinates`, and `image_base64` from public reads. Roll back the item when the companion post fails.

 * **Unauthenticated item delivery completion (2026-09-30, re-verified 2026-10-01).** `ItemsDeliveryController` has no `UseGuards` (`items-delivery.controller.ts` 25–26). SRS §2.6.3 lists `POST /api/items-delivery/:id/deliver` and does not name an auth guard. `markAsDelivered` calls `updateItem(itemId, { status: "delivered" })` and only afterwards looks at `body.requestId` (241–260). `updateItem` writes `status` with no owner comparison (service 261–265, 292–299). The handler body is an inline type, so the global `ValidationPipe` does not require `userId`. Concrete trigger: `GET /api/items-delivery` (public list), then `POST /api/items-delivery/<id>/deliver` with `{}`. The item row becomes `delivered`. If a `requestId` is also sent, that request update runs after the item write and is not in the same transaction; `updateItemRequest` may return Unauthorized while the item stays delivered (466–499). `PUT /api/items-delivery/:id` accepts class-validator `UpdateItemDto.status`, including `delivered` (dto 127–128; controller 185–191). `DELETE :id` removes the row with no actor (193–196, service 319–326). `PUT /api/items-delivery/requests/:requestId` requires only a query `userId` (225–238). The service treats that string as the owner or the requester (493–499). `approved` and `rejected` require the owner string; `cancelled` requires the requester string; `completed` has no extra role check and then sets the item to `delivered` (507–551). Public `GET :id` returns `i.*` plus `owner_name` and `owner_city` (service 74–96). - File: `apps/api/src/controllers/items-delivery.controller.ts` (25–26, 180–196, 225–260); `apps/api/src/controllers/items-delivery.service.ts` (74–110, 209–326, 466–551); `apps/api/src/controllers/dto/items.dto.ts` (127–128, 273–283) -> Action: Require `JwtAuthGuard`. Bind the actor to `req.user.userId`. Allow deliver and status changes only for the item owner, or for an approved requester when the product rule says so. Run the item update and the request update in one transaction. Stop taking owner identity from the query string. Omit `owner_id` and owner contact fields from public reads.

 * **Donation create forges money totals with an unbound donor and an unchecked amount (2026-09-29, re-verified 2026-10-01).** SRS §2.3.2 requires `JwtAuthGuard` on `POST /api/donations`. The guard is present and the handler never reads `req.user` (`donations.controller.ts` 478–479). `CreateDonationDto` is a TypeScript interface (45–63). Nest skips `ValidationPipe` for that erased type, so a negative `amount` is accepted (`main.ts` 427–430). A money create adds that amount to `user_profiles.total_donations_amount` for client `donor_id` (525–534) and to `community_stats` (538–541, 833–855). `PUT :id` can change `amount` without moving the counters (698–744). The JWT can come from unauthenticated `resolve-id`. - File: `apps/api/src/controllers/donations.controller.ts` (45–77, 478–575, 698–780, 833–855); `apps/api/src/main.ts` (427–430) -> Action: Bind `donor_id` to `req.user.userId`. Require a finite money `amount` greater than 0. Adjust both counters in the same transaction as create, update, and delete.

## 🐞 Bugs & Logic Issues

 * **Companion item post is best-effort, and the caller chooses the item id (2026-10-01).** A failed `INSERT INTO posts` is caught and the item still commits (`dedicated-items.service.ts` 170–177). If the provided id is not a 10–13 digit timestamp, it becomes the primary key (78–88). `PUT` can set `is_deleted` to false and clear the soft-delete (dto 136–142; service 262–279). Recommendation: One transaction. Generate the id on the server. Allow delete and restore only for the JWT subject.

 * **Item deliver commits `delivered` before the request permission check (2026-09-30, re-verified 2026-10-01).** `markAsDelivered` updates the item, then optionally calls `updateItemRequest` (`items-delivery.controller.ts` 247–258). A mismatched `userId` returns Unauthorized from the request update while the item stays `delivered`. `completed` is not restricted to the owner (`items-delivery.service.ts` 507–551). Recommendation: One transaction. Check the JWT subject before either write. Limit `completed` to the owner.

 * **Money donation counters ignore sign, zero, and later edits (2026-09-29, re-verified 2026-10-01).** A truthy negative `amount` subtracts from `total_donations_amount`. A missing amount increments `community_stats` by 1 (`donations.controller.ts` 525–541). `PUT` and `DELETE` leave both counters unchanged (698–780). Recommendation: Reject non-positive money amounts. Adjust both counters by the delta inside the same transaction.

 * **Anonymous hierarchy read can `ALTER TABLE` (2026-09-28, re-verified 2026-10-01).** `ensureSalarySeniorityColumns` adds `salary`, `seniority_start_date`, and `parent_manager_id` (`user-hierarchy.service.ts` 436–483). Recommendation: Apply those columns in an offline migration.

 * **Hierarchy pull check fails open (2026-09-27, re-verified 2026-10-01).** `assertRequesterMayPullTargetUnderSelf` returns `{ ok: true }` at line 149 when neither ancestor check matches. Recommendation: Default to deny.

 * **Comment handlers return `error.message` (re-verified 2026-10-01).** Update, delete, and list catch blocks interpolate the driver message (`posts.controller.ts` 1803–1805, 2042–2045, 2134–2137). Recommendation: Return a generic error and log the driver message server-side.

 * **`GET /rate-limit/stats` lists every limiter key with no auth (re-verified 2026-10-01).** `getRateLimitStats` runs `KEYS rate_limit:*` and `KEYS blocked:*` (`rate-limit.service.ts` 238–256). Recommendation: Remove the route from deployed builds.

 * **Rate limiter fails open when Redis errors (re-verified 2026-10-01).** `checkRateLimit` returns `allowed: true` if the block read or the counter read throws (`rate-limit.service.ts` 87–89, 106–111). Recommendation: Fail closed on auth routes.

 * **Unauthenticated `POST /api/stats/track-visit` inflates production metrics (re-verified 2026-10-01).** No guard. Increments `community_stats.site_visits` (373–401). Recommendation: Require a bot-resistant token, or drop the public increment.

 * **Ride booking approval oversell (re-verified 2026-10-01).** `PUT /api/rides/bookings/:bookingId/status` sets `approved` and only then flips the ride to `full` (505–555). It does not reject when approved seats would exceed `available_seats`. Recommendation: `SELECT … FOR UPDATE` and reject when remaining seats are insufficient.

 * **Items-delivery static route is shadowed (re-verified 2026-10-01).** `GET /api/items-delivery/:id` is declared before `GET requests` (180–223), so the request list is captured as an item id. Dedicated-items `GET :id` still shadows `GET search` (69 vs 166). Recommendation: Declare static routes before parameterized routes.

 * **`loginUser` and `JwtAuthGuard` never consult `user_profiles.is_active` (re-verified 2026-10-01).** Deactivated rows can still obtain a session via email-only login or an existing refresh token. Recommendation: Fail closed on `is_active = false`.

 * **Anonymity filtering is specified and not implemented (re-verified 2026-10-01).** SRS §2.5.7 / NFR §3.2 require server-side redaction for `anonymity_level < 4`. The column is still absent (0 matches under `apps/`). Recommendation: Add the column and the feed projection.

## 🏗️ Architecture & Clean Code

 * **No Domain / Application / Infrastructure folders** under `apps/` or `packages/` (count 0). The target in `docs/SSOT/CODE_QUALITY/layers-and-boundaries.md` is Infrastructure → Application → Domain. The monorepo remains NestJS feature folders plus React Native screens. `packages/` still only contains `config-eslint`. The closest pure islands remain `apps/api/src/tasks/task-completion-participants.ts`, `tasks-validation.ts`, `tasks-query-params.ts`, and `tasks.types.ts`.

 * **Fat HTTP layer owns SQL and policy.** Largest API files: `posts.controller.ts` (2741), `stats.controller.ts` (1709), `user-hierarchy.service.ts` (1675), `database.init.ts` (1374), `community-group-challenges.controller.ts` (1097), `donations.controller.ts` (892), `chat.controller.ts` (813). `items-delivery.service.ts` remains under `controllers/`. `DedicatedItemsService` imports `pg` and writes both `items` and `posts` in one method, so item persistence and feed authorship are one infrastructure routine with no authenticated subject. Item completion policy still authorizes nobody. Donation money totals are still computed in the controller from client fields. Hierarchy permission policy authorizes a body id.

 * **Privilege checks disagree inside the same product.** Notifications `validateOwnership` compares `:userId` to `req.user.userId` (94–110). Item request updates compare `owner_id` to a query string. Dedicated-item create never reads a session and writes `posts.author_id` from a client identifier. Post DELETE uses `getSessionUserId`; comment PUT/DELETE use the client id. Donation create checks that some JWT is present and then trusts `donor_id`. `GET hierarchy/tree` has no actor at all.

 * **Positive in-folder contrasts (do not regress):** community-group challenges bind the creator on create, join, entry, PUT, and DELETE; personal challenges scope timer reads to `CurrentUser()`; knowledge contribution-request binds `req.user.userId`; sync user/all/status use `AdminAuthGuard`; authenticated chat send/read checks `ANY(participants)`; `/session/login` requires argon2 once the shared limiter allows the call; CRM PATCH uses hardcoded column names; community-challenge `ORDER BY` uses an allowlist plus `pg-format` `%I`; item list `ORDER BY` uses an allowlisted column; dedicated-item and personal-challenge updates go through class-validator DTOs (the dedicated-item column list is allowlisted; the missing check is the owner). Collection names are checked against `ALLOWED_COLLECTIONS` before SQL.

 * **Operator matching workspace is specified and not implemented.** `OperatorAuthGuard` exists and there is no `/api/operator/*` module. Anonymity and matching-case tables remain SRS §10 gaps.

## 🚨 Critical Vulnerabilities

 * **Unauthenticated item delivery completion (2026-09-30).** `ItemsDeliveryController` has no `UseGuards` (`items-delivery.controller.ts` 25–26). SRS §2.6.3 lists `POST /api/items-delivery/:id/deliver` and does not name an auth guard. `markAsDelivered` calls `updateItem(itemId, { status: "delivered" })` and only afterwards looks at `body.requestId` (241–260). `updateItem` writes `status` with no owner comparison (service 261–265, 292–299). The handler body is an inline type, so the global `ValidationPipe` does not require `userId`. Concrete trigger: `GET /api/items-delivery` (public list), then `POST /api/items-delivery/<id>/deliver` with `{}`. The item row becomes `delivered`. If a `requestId` is also sent, that request update runs after the item write and is not in the same transaction; `updateItemRequest` may return Unauthorized while the item stays delivered (466–499). `PUT /api/items-delivery/:id` accepts class-validator `UpdateItemDto.status`, including `delivered` (dto 127–128; controller 185–191). `DELETE :id` removes the row with no actor (193–196, service 319–326). `PUT /api/items-delivery/requests/:requestId` requires only a query `userId` (225–238). The service treats that string as the owner or the requester (493–499). `approved` and `rejected` require the owner string; `cancelled` requires the requester string; `completed` has no extra role check and then sets the item to `delivered` (507–551). ## 🐞 Bugs & Logic Issues

 * **Item deliver commits `delivered` before the request permission check (2026-09-30).** `markAsDelivered` updates the item, then optionally calls `updateItemRequest` (`items-delivery.controller.ts` 247–258). A mismatched `userId` returns Unauthorized from the request update while the item stays `delivered`. `completed` is not restricted to the owner (`items-delivery.service.ts` 507–551). Recommendation: One transaction. Check the JWT subject before either write. Limit `completed` to the owner.

 * **Money donation counters ignore sign, zero, and later edits (2026-09-29, re-verified 2026-09-30).** A truthy negative `amount` subtracts from `total_donations_amount`. A missing amount increments `community_stats` by 1 (`donations.controller.ts` 525–541). `PUT` and `DELETE` leave both counters unchanged (698–780). Recommendation: Reject non-positive money amounts. Adjust both counters by the delta inside the same transaction.

 * **Anonymous hierarchy read can `ALTER TABLE` (2026-09-28, re-verified 2026-09-30).** `ensureSalarySeniorityColumns` adds `salary`, `seniority_start_date`, and `parent_manager_id` (`user-hierarchy.service.ts` 436–483). Recommendation: Apply those columns in an offline migration.

 * **Hierarchy pull check fails open (2026-09-27, re-verified 2026-09-30).** `assertRequesterMayPullTargetUnderSelf` returns `{ ok: true }` at line 149 when neither ancestor check matches. Recommendation: Default to deny.

 * **Comment handlers return `error.message` (re-verified 2026-09-30).** Update, delete, and list catch blocks interpolate the driver message (`posts.controller.ts` 1803–1805, 2042–2045, 2134–2137). Recommendation: Return a generic error and log the driver message server-side.

 * **`GET /rate-limit/stats` lists every limiter key with no auth (re-verified 2026-09-30).** `getRateLimitStats` runs `KEYS rate_limit:*` and `KEYS blocked:*` (`rate-limit.service.ts` 238–256). Recommendation: Remove the route from deployed builds.

 * **Rate limiter fails open when Redis errors (re-verified 2026-09-30).** `checkRateLimit` returns `allowed: true` if the block read or the counter read throws (`rate-limit.service.ts` 87–89, 106–111). Recommendation: Fail closed on auth routes.

 * **Unauthenticated `POST /api/stats/track-visit` inflates production metrics (re-verified 2026-09-30).** No guard. Increments `community_stats.site_visits` (373–401). Recommendation: Require a bot-resistant token, or drop the public increment.

 * **Ride booking approval oversell (re-verified 2026-09-30).** `PUT /api/rides/bookings/:bookingId/status` sets `approved` and only then flips the ride to `full` (505–555). It does not reject when approved seats would exceed `available_seats`. Recommendation: `SELECT … FOR UPDATE` and reject when remaining seats are insufficient.

 * **Items-delivery static route is shadowed (re-verified 2026-09-30).** `GET /api/items-delivery/:id` is declared before `GET requests` (180–223), so the request list is captured as an item id. Dedicated-items `GET :id` still shadows `GET search`. Recommendation: Declare static routes before parameterized routes.

 * **`loginUser` and `JwtAuthGuard` never consult `user_profiles.is_active` (re-verified 2026-09-30).** Deactivated rows can still obtain a session via email-only login or an existing refresh token. Recommendation: Fail closed on `is_active = false`.

 * **Anonymity filtering is specified and not implemented (re-verified 2026-09-30).** SRS §2.5.7 / NFR §3.2 require server-side redaction for `anonymity_level < 4`. The column is still absent (0 matches under `apps/`). Recommendation: Add the column and the feed projection.

The target in `docs/SSOT/CODE_QUALITY/layers-and-boundaries.md` is Infrastructure → Application → Domain. ## 🚨 Critical Vulnerabilities

 * **Donation create forges money totals with an unbound donor and an unchecked amount (2026-09-29).** SRS §2.3.2 requires `JwtAuthGuard` on `POST /api/donations`. The guard is present and the handler never reads `req.user` (`donations.controller.ts` 478–479). `CreateDonationDto` is a TypeScript interface (45–63). Nest skips `ValidationPipe` for that erased type, so `whitelist` / `forbidNonWhitelisted` in `main.ts` (427–430) do not apply and a negative `amount` is accepted. The insert stores client `donor_id` and `amount` (493–519). When `type` is `money` and `amount` is truthy, including a negative number, the same value is added to `user_profiles.total_donations_amount` for that donor (525–534) and to `community_stats.stat_value` via `updateCommunityStats` (538–541, 833–855). A missing or zero money amount is falsy, so the profile update is skipped, while the community-stat argument falls back to 1 and still increments `money_donations`. `PUT /api/donations/:id` is JWT-only, also takes an interface body, and can rewrite `amount` on any row without adjusting either counter (698–744). `DELETE` removes the row and leaves the counters in place (746–780). Concrete trigger: obtain any access token (including `POST /api/users/resolve-id` with a known email), then `POST /api/donations` with another user's id as `donor_id`, `type: "money"`, and a negative `amount`. The 2026-09-28 aggregate bullet named the `donor_id` insert. This bullet is the ledger write. - File: `apps/api/src/controllers/donations.controller.ts` (45–77, 478–575, 698–780, 833–855); `apps/api/src/main.ts` (427–430) -> Action: Bind `donor_id` to `req.user.userId`. Replace the interface with a class-validator DTO that requires a finite `amount` greater than 0 for money. Apply later edits and deletes to `total_donations_amount` and `community_stats` in the same transaction, or stop deriving those counters from the client payload.

 * **Unauthenticated hierarchy tree returns salary and seniority (2026-09-28, re-verified 2026-09-29).** SRS §2.2.3 lists `GET /api/users/hierarchy/tree` with the hierarchy routes that require `JwtAuthGuard`. The handler has no guard and calls `getFullHierarchyTree` (`users.controller.ts` 96–98). That method loads every profile under the root admin and selects `salary` and `seniority_start_date` (`user-hierarchy.service.ts` 1529–1566). `buildHierarchyTreeFromRows` copies both fields onto each node (411–425), along with `id`, `name`, `email`, `roles`, and `parent_manager_id`. The same request calls `ensureSalarySeniorityColumns` (1506), which issues `ALTER TABLE user_profiles` for `salary`, `seniority_start_date`, and `parent_manager_id` when a column is missing (436–483). Concrete trigger: `GET /api/users/hierarchy/tree` with no `Authorization`. `GET /api/users/:id/hierarchy` is a separate unguarded email roster (106–108, 1647–1666) and does not select salary. NFR §3.5 requires the server to omit fields the caller is not allowed to see. - File: `apps/api/src/controllers/users.controller.ts` (96–108); `apps/api/src/services/user-hierarchy.service.ts` (411–425, 436–483, 1499–1666) -> Action: Require `JwtAuthGuard` and limit the tree to an admin or the node's manager. Omit `salary` and `seniority_start_date` unless the caller is allowed to see payroll. Move the `ALTER TABLE` out of the request path.

 * **Public admin UUID grants the `admin` role (2026-09-27, re-verified 2026-09-29).** `POST /api/users/:id/promote-admin` requires only `JwtAuthGuard`. Guest chat create and send sit behind the always-true optional guard. - File: `apps/api/src/controllers/items-delivery.controller.ts`; `apps/api/src/items/dedicated-items.controller.ts`; `apps/api/src/items/items.controller.ts`; `apps/api/src/controllers/crm.controller.ts`; `apps/api/src/controllers/community-members.controller.ts`; `apps/api/src/controllers/places.controller.ts`; `apps/api/src/controllers/rides.controller.ts`; `apps/api/src/controllers/donations.controller.ts`; `apps/api/src/tasks/tasks.controller.ts`; `apps/api/src/controllers/stats.controller.ts`; `apps/api/src/controllers/admin-files.controller.ts`; `apps/api/src/controllers/community-group-challenges.controller.ts`; `apps/api/src/controllers/chat.controller.ts` -> Action: Add `JwtAuthGuard` (admin where appropriate). Bind owners and actors to the JWT. Put stats detail and admin-file list behind `AdminAuthGuard`. Apply the hidden-status and `is_public` predicates on every read and join.

CASCADE` (re-verified 2026-09-29).** `ensurePostsTable` drops `posts` when legacy columns are detected (78) and drops likes/comments (309, 373–374). `tasks-schema.service.ts` (41) can drop `posts`. `DatabaseInit` drops donations and rides on startup when it treats the schema as legacy (568, 670). ## 🐞 Bugs & Logic Issues

 * **Money donation counters ignore sign, zero, and later edits (2026-09-29).** The profile update runs only when `amount` is truthy, so a negative amount subtracts and a zero amount does nothing (`donations.controller.ts` 525–534). The community-stat call always runs and substitutes 1 when `amount` is missing or zero (538–541). `PUT` and `DELETE` change the donation row and leave both counters unchanged (698–780). Recommendation: Reject non-positive money amounts. Adjust both counters by the delta inside the same transaction as create, update, and delete.

 * **Anonymous `GET /api/users/hierarchy/tree` can mutate schema (2026-09-28, re-verified 2026-09-29).** `ensureSalarySeniorityColumns` runs `ALTER TABLE ... ADD COLUMN` for `salary`, `seniority_start_date`, and `parent_manager_id` when the information-schema check misses them (`user-hierarchy.service.ts` 436–483). Two concurrent first calls can race on the same `ALTER`. Recommendation: Apply those columns in an offline migration. Keep the read handler free of DDL.

 * **Hierarchy pull check fails open (2026-09-27, re-verified 2026-09-29).** `assertRequesterMayPullTargetUnderSelf` returns `{ ok: true }` when neither “admin is above target” nor “target is an ancestor of the admin” is true (`user-hierarchy.service.ts` 149). A profile with `parent_manager_id` null therefore always passes. Recommendation: Default to deny. Allow the pull only when the authenticated admin is already the manager, or when an explicit super-admin rule says so.

 * **Comment handlers return `error.message` to the client (re-verified 2026-09-29).** Update, delete, and list catch blocks interpolate the driver message into the JSON body (`posts.controller.ts` 2042–2045, 2134–2137, 1803–1805). `getUserById`, sync, and admin-tables do the same. Recommendation: Return a generic error and log the driver message server-side.

 * **`GET /rate-limit/stats` lists every limiter key with no auth (re-verified 2026-09-29).** `getRateLimitStats` runs `KEYS rate_limit:*` and `KEYS blocked:*` (`rate-limit.service.ts` 238–256; controller 213–221). `GET /rate-limit/status` answers the same question for a chosen identifier. Recommendation: Remove both routes from deployed builds.

 * **Rate limiter fails open when Redis errors (re-verified 2026-09-29).** `checkRateLimit` returns `allowed: true` if the block read or the counter read throws (`rate-limit.service.ts` 87–89, 106–111). Recommendation: Fail closed on auth routes when the limiter cannot be read.

 * **Unauthenticated `POST /api/stats/track-visit` inflates production metrics (re-verified 2026-09-29).** No guard. Increments `community_stats.site_visits` and clears stats caches (373–401). `POST /api/stats/increment` uses `AdminAuthGuard`. Recommendation: Require a bot-resistant token, or drop the public increment.

 * **Unauthenticated posts feed treats query `user_id` as the viewer (re-verified 2026-09-29).** `GET /api/posts` has no guard. `feed_scope=friends` plus `user_id` filters to that user’s posts and follows (776–782). Recommendation: Require JWT and bind the viewer to `req.user.userId`.

 * **Ride booking approval oversell (re-verified 2026-09-29).** `PUT /api/rides/bookings/:bookingId/status` (505–555) sets `approved` and only then flips the ride to `full`. It does not reject when approved seats would exceed `available_seats`. Recommendation: `SELECT … FOR UPDATE` and reject when remaining seats are insufficient.

 * **Task hours-report catch returns success (re-verified 2026-09-29).** `GET /api/tasks/hours-report/:managerId` catch returns `success: true` with empty zeros (568–586). `POST :id/log-hours` replaces `actual_hours` on conflict instead of adding (437–445) and trusts body `user_id`. Recommendation: Return `success: false` on the report error. Bind the logger to `req.user.userId` and add hours.

 * **Items-delivery / dedicated-items / collections static-route shadows (re-verified 2026-09-29).** `GET /api/items-delivery/:id` is declared before `GET requests`. Dedicated-items `GET :id` shadows `GET search`. Collections `GET :collection` precedes `popular-collections` and `cache-stats`. Recommendation: Declare static routes before parameterized routes.

 * **`loginUser` and `JwtAuthGuard` never consult `user_profiles.is_active` (re-verified 2026-09-29).** Deactivated rows can still obtain a session via email-only login or an existing refresh token. Recommendation: Fail closed on `is_active = false` in login, resolve-id, refresh, and `JwtAuthGuard`.

 * **Anonymity filtering is specified and not implemented (re-verified 2026-09-29).** SRS §2.5.7 / NFR §3.2 require server-side redaction for `anonymity_level < 4`. The column is still absent (0 matches under `apps/`). Recommendation: Add the column and the feed projection. Do not treat that as a drive-by security hotfix.

 * **Personal-challenge reset-log and record-break `challengeId` is not ownership-checked (re-verified 2026-09-29).** `POST /api/challenges/reset-logs` (502–546) and `POST /api/challenges/record-breaks` (584–627) overwrite `userId` from the JWT and then insert any `challengeId`. Recommendation: Insert only when `challenge_id` belongs to `CurrentUser()`.

 * **JwtAuthGuard non-access tokens fall through to Firebase JWKS (re-verified 2026-09-29).** After `verifyToken` succeeds, `payload.type !== "access"` throws (123–125) and the inner catch tries Firebase (126–133). An HS256 refresh token does not verify as a Firebase ID token. Recommendation: Re-throw `UnauthorizedException` from the type check.

 * **Hand-rolled JWT signature compare is not constant-time (re-verified 2026-09-29).** `verifyTokenSignature` (`jwt.service.ts` 308) uses `!==` on the HMAC digest. Verification always uses HMAC-SHA256, so `none` / RS256 confusion does not apply to this verifier. Recommendation: Use `crypto.timingSafeEqual` after a length check.

 * **Places `place_id` is interpolated unencoded (re-verified 2026-09-29).** `GET /place-details?place_id=` concatenates the query into the Google URL (75). Autocomplete encodes `input`. Recommendation: Encode `place_id`.

 * **`POST /auth/google` identity OR-lookup and register enumeration (re-verified 2026-09-29).** After a valid Google token, the handler matches `email OR firebase_uid OR google_id` using body `firebaseUid` (723–746). `POST /auth/register` returns `Email already registered` (415–418). Recommendation: Match only the verified Google `sub` or verified email. Return a generic register result.

 * **Web refresh tokens sit in AsyncStorage (re-verified 2026-09-29).** `tokenManager.web.ts` writes `auth_access_token` and `auth_refresh_token` through AsyncStorage, which is `localStorage` on web. Recommendation: Keep the refresh token in an HttpOnly cookie on web.

 * **ClosedRoute still uses an inline `require` of `databaseService` (re-verified 2026-09-29).** File: `apps/mobile/bottomBarScreens/profile/ClosedRoute.tsx`. Recommendation: Use the shared logger and drop the inline `require`.

## 🏗️ Architecture & Clean Code

 * **No Domain / Application / Infrastructure folders** under `apps/` or `packages/` (count 0). The target in `docs/SSOT/CODE_QUALITY/layers-and-boundaries.md` is Infrastructure → Application → Domain. The monorepo remains NestJS feature folders plus React Native screens. `packages/` still only contains `config-eslint`. The closest pure islands remain `apps/api/src/tasks/task-completion-participants.ts`, `tasks-validation.ts`, `tasks-query-params.ts`, and `tasks.types.ts` (no Nest or `pg` imports). `orderByClause` stays an allowlisted switch.

 * **Fat HTTP layer owns SQL and policy.** Largest API files: `posts.controller.ts` (2741), `stats.controller.ts` (1709), `user-hierarchy.service.ts` (1675), `database.init.ts` (1374), `community-group-challenges.controller.ts` (1097), `donations.controller.ts` (892), `chat.controller.ts` (813). `items-delivery.service.ts` remains under `controllers/`. Hierarchy permission policy lives in the service, but the HTTP layer never supplies the authenticated subject, so promote/demote/set-manager authorize a body id. The same service returns payroll fields from an unauthenticated read and can `ALTER TABLE` on that path. Comment ownership compares the stored author to a client field. Donation money totals are computed inside the controller from client fields, with no domain invariant that an amount must be positive or that the donor is the caller.

 * **Privilege checks disagree inside the same controllers.** Notifications `validateOwnership` compares `:userId` to `req.user.userId` (94–110). Community-challenge PUT/DELETE require the creator (908–1072) while get and join ignore `is_public`. Post DELETE uses `getSessionUserId`; comment PUT/DELETE use the client id. `setManager` checks admin only when a requester id is supplied. `promoteToAdmin` checks the body id's roles and then fails open on the pull. `GET hierarchy/tree` has no actor at all. Donation create checks that some JWT is present and then trusts `donor_id`. `AdminAuthGuard` is role-based (249–253) and therefore trusts whatever roles `resolve-id` copied after that write. `SessionController` is registered in every environment. `RedisTestController` is gated on `NODE_ENV !== "production"`.

 * **Positive in-folder contrasts (do not regress):** community-group challenges bind the creator on create/join/entry and use `CurrentUser()` on stats, entries, PUT, and DELETE; personal challenges scope timer reads to `CurrentUser()`; knowledge contribution-request binds `req.user.userId`; sync user/all/status use `AdminAuthGuard`; authenticated chat send/read checks `ANY(participants)`; `/session/login` requires argon2 once the shared limiter allows the call; CRM PATCH uses hardcoded column names; community-challenge `ORDER BY` uses an allowlist plus `pg-format` `%I`; `WebViewScreen` loads the constant `https://www.jgive.com/`; admin tables sit behind `AdminAuthGuard`; dedicated-item and personal-challenge updates go through class-validator DTOs. Collection names are checked against `ALLOWED_COLLECTIONS` before SQL.

 * **Operator matching workspace is specified and not implemented.** `OperatorAuthGuard` exists and there is no `/api/operator/*` module. Anonymity and matching-case tables remain SRS §10 gaps. NFR §3.2 says admin access is role-based only, while register/login still promote the committed fallback mailbox, and promote-admin can add that role for any directory admin id. NFR §3.5 data minimization is missed by the public hierarchy tree and by the donation counter write.

## 🚨 Critical Vulnerabilities

 * **Unauthenticated hierarchy tree returns salary and seniority (2026-09-28).** SRS §2.2.3 lists `GET /api/users/hierarchy/tree` with the hierarchy routes that require `JwtAuthGuard`. The handler has no guard and calls `getFullHierarchyTree` (`users.controller.ts` 96–98). That method loads every profile under the root admin and selects `salary` and `seniority_start_date` (`user-hierarchy.service.ts` 1529–1566). `buildHierarchyTreeFromRows` copies both fields onto each node (411–425), along with `id`, `name`, `email`, `roles`, and `parent_manager_id`. The same request calls `ensureSalarySeniorityColumns` (1506), which issues `ALTER TABLE user_profiles` for `salary`, `seniority_start_date`, and `parent_manager_id` when a column is missing (436–483). Concrete trigger: `GET /api/users/hierarchy/tree` with no `Authorization`. `GET /api/users/:id/hierarchy` is a separate unguarded email roster (106–108, 1647–1666) and does not select salary. NFR §3.5 requires the server to omit fields the caller is not allowed to see. The 2026-09-27 promote-admin bullet is the write path that uses a public admin id; this bullet is the payroll read. - File: `apps/api/src/controllers/users.controller.ts` (96–108); `apps/api/src/services/user-hierarchy.service.ts` (411–425, 436–483, 1499–1666) -> Action: Require `JwtAuthGuard` and limit the tree to an admin or the node's manager. Omit `salary` and `seniority_start_date` unless the caller is allowed to see payroll. Move the `ALTER TABLE` out of the request path.

 * **Public admin UUID grants the `admin` role (2026-09-27, re-verified 2026-09-28).** `POST /api/users/:id/promote-admin` requires only `JwtAuthGuard`. The handler forwards `{ requestingAdminId }` and never reads `req.user` (`users.controller.ts` 64–70). `promoteToAdmin` requires that body id, loads that row, and continues when its `roles` include `admin` or `super_admin` (`user-hierarchy.service.ts` 945–981, 1035–1049). The hierarchy helper returns success when the named admin is not already above the target and the target is not an ancestor (93–149). `GET /api/users` (no guard) selects `id`, `email`, and `roles` (`user-profile.service.ts` 503–516); search does the same (68–75). Register inserts no `parent_manager_id` (`user-auth.service.ts` 101–112), so a new account is eligible. Concrete trigger: read an admin id from `GET /api/users`, obtain any access token (including `POST /api/users/resolve-id` with a known email), then `POST /api/users/<targetId>/promote-admin` with that admin id. A second `resolve-id` mints a JWT whose `roles` come from the database (645–660) and passes `AdminAuthGuard` (`jwt-auth.guard.ts` 238–264). The root-admin mailbox is still rejected as the promote target (993–1002). `POST :id/promote-volunteer` is the same actor spoof and adds `volunteer` (82–88, 1306–1407). `POST :id/demote-admin` applies the named admin's authority to that admin's subtree, and a public `super_admin` id skips the subordinate check (75–80, 1120–1194). - File: `apps/api/src/controllers/users.controller.ts` (40–43, 64–88, 135–150, 183–188); `apps/api/src/services/user-hierarchy.service.ts` (93–149, 945–1068, 1120–1194, 1306–1407); `apps/api/src/services/user-profile.service.ts` (68–75, 503–516); `apps/api/src/services/user-auth.service.ts` (101–112, 645–660) -> Action: Bind the actor to `req.user.userId` and require `AdminAuthGuard` on promote, demote, and promote-volunteer. Fail closed in `assertRequesterMayPullTargetUnderSelf`. Stop returning `roles` from unauthenticated directory and search. Stop minting tokens from `resolve-id`.

 * **Comment edit/delete IDOR: ownership is the client `user_id`, not the JWT subject (2026-09-26, re-verified 2026-09-28).** `PUT` and `DELETE /api/posts/:postId/comments/:commentId` use `JwtAuthGuard` and then ignore `req.user`. Update allows the write when `body.user_id` equals `post_comments.user_id` (`posts.controller.ts` 1975–2024). Delete uses query `user_id` (2053–2106) and rewrites `posts.comments`. Unguarded `GET :postId/comments` returns `c.user_id` (1726–1743). Any access token, including one from `resolve-id`, can edit or delete. Post PUT/hide/unhide still prefer `req.user.userId`; post DELETE uses `getSessionUserId` with no body fallback. - File: `apps/api/src/controllers/posts.controller.ts` (1726–1743, 1975–2142) -> Action: Bind the actor to `req.user.userId`. Reject a mismatched body or query `user_id`. Do not return raw `error.message` from the catch blocks.

 * **Unauthenticated org-tree rewrite via email-only `resolve-id` and omitted `requestingUserId` (2026-09-25, re-verified 2026-09-28).** `POST /api/users/resolve-id` mints a JWT from email, `google_id`, or `firebase_uid` (`user-auth.service.ts` 270–342, 645–660). `POST /api/users/:id/set-manager` never reads `req.user` (`users.controller.ts` 45–52). Omitting `requestingUserId`, or sending an unknown id, skips the admin check (`user-hierarchy.service.ts` 492–516) and writes `parent_manager_id` (600–628). `POST :id/hierarchy/manage` has no actor field (55–62, 871–914). The root-admin email cannot be the set-manager target. ## 🐞 Bugs & Logic Issues

 * **Anonymous `GET /api/users/hierarchy/tree` can mutate schema (2026-09-28).** `ensureSalarySeniorityColumns` runs `ALTER TABLE ... ADD COLUMN` for `salary`, `seniority_start_date`, and `parent_manager_id` when the information-schema check misses them (`user-hierarchy.service.ts` 436–483). Two concurrent first calls can race on the same `ALTER`. Recommendation: Apply those columns in an offline migration. Keep the read handler free of DDL.

 * **Hierarchy pull check fails open (2026-09-27, re-verified 2026-09-28).** `assertRequesterMayPullTargetUnderSelf` returns `{ ok: true }` when neither “admin is above target” nor “target is an ancestor of the admin” is true (`user-hierarchy.service.ts` 149). A profile with `parent_manager_id` null therefore always passes. Recommendation: Default to deny. Allow the pull only when the authenticated admin is already the manager, or when an explicit super-admin rule says so.

 * **Comment handlers return `error.message` to the client (re-verified 2026-09-28).** Update, delete, and list catch blocks interpolate the driver message into the JSON body (`posts.controller.ts` 2042–2045, 2134–2137, 1803–1805). `getUserById`, sync, and admin-tables do the same. Recommendation: Return a generic error and log the driver message server-side.

 * **`GET /rate-limit/stats` lists every limiter key with no auth (re-verified 2026-09-28).** `getRateLimitStats` runs `KEYS rate_limit:*` and `KEYS blocked:*` (`rate-limit.service.ts` 238–256; controller 213–221). `GET /rate-limit/status` answers the same question for a chosen identifier. Recommendation: Remove both routes from deployed builds.

 * **Rate limiter fails open when Redis errors (re-verified 2026-09-28).** `checkRateLimit` returns `allowed: true` if the block read or the counter read throws (`rate-limit.service.ts` 87–89, 106–111). Recommendation: Fail closed on auth routes when the limiter cannot be read.

 * **Unauthenticated `POST /api/stats/track-visit` inflates production metrics (re-verified 2026-09-28).** No guard. Increments `community_stats.site_visits` and clears stats caches (373–401). `POST /api/stats/increment` uses `AdminAuthGuard`. Recommendation: Require a bot-resistant token, or drop the public increment.

 * **Unauthenticated posts feed treats query `user_id` as the viewer (re-verified 2026-09-28).** `GET /api/posts` has no guard. `feed_scope=friends` plus `user_id` filters to that user’s posts and follows (776–782). Recommendation: Require JWT and bind the viewer to `req.user.userId`.

 * **Ride booking approval oversell (re-verified 2026-09-28).** `PUT /api/rides/bookings/:bookingId/status` (505–555) sets `approved` and only then flips the ride to `full`. It does not reject when approved seats would exceed `available_seats`. Recommendation: `SELECT … FOR UPDATE` and reject when remaining seats are insufficient.

 * **Task hours-report catch returns success (re-verified 2026-09-28).** `GET /api/tasks/hours-report/:managerId` catch returns `success: true` with empty zeros. Recommendation: Return `success: false` and a generic error.

 * **Items-delivery / dedicated-items / collections static-route shadows (re-verified 2026-09-28).** `GET /api/items-delivery/:id` is declared before `GET requests`. Dedicated-items `GET :id` shadows `GET search`. Collections `GET :collection` precedes `popular-collections` and `cache-stats`. Recommendation: Declare static routes before parameterized routes.

 * **`loginUser` and `JwtAuthGuard` never consult `user_profiles.is_active` (re-verified 2026-09-28).** Deactivated rows can still obtain a session via email-only login or an existing refresh token. Recommendation: Fail closed on `is_active = false` in login, resolve-id, refresh, and `JwtAuthGuard`.

 * **Anonymity filtering is specified and not implemented (re-verified 2026-09-28).** SRS §2.5.7 / NFR §3.2 require server-side redaction for `anonymity_level < 4`. The column is still absent (0 matches under `apps/`). Recommendation: Add the column and the feed projection. Do not treat that as a drive-by security hotfix.

 * **Personal-challenge reset-log and record-break `challengeId` is not ownership-checked (re-verified 2026-09-28).** `POST /api/challenges/reset-logs` (502–546) and `POST /api/challenges/record-breaks` (584–627) overwrite `userId` from the JWT and then insert any `challengeId`. Recommendation: Insert only when `challenge_id` belongs to `CurrentUser()`.

 * **JwtAuthGuard non-access tokens fall through to Firebase JWKS (re-verified 2026-09-28).** After `verifyToken` succeeds, `payload.type !== "access"` throws (123–125) and the inner catch tries Firebase (126–133). An HS256 refresh token does not verify as a Firebase ID token. Recommendation: Re-throw `UnauthorizedException` from the type check.

 * **Hand-rolled JWT signature compare is not constant-time (re-verified 2026-09-28).** `verifyTokenSignature` (`jwt.service.ts` 308) uses `!==` on the HMAC digest. Verification always uses HMAC-SHA256, so `none` / RS256 confusion does not apply to this verifier. Recommendation: Use `crypto.timingSafeEqual` after a length check.

 * **Places `place_id` is interpolated unencoded (re-verified 2026-09-28).** `GET /place-details?place_id=` concatenates the query into the Google URL (75). Autocomplete encodes `input`. Recommendation: Encode `place_id`.

 * **`POST /auth/google` identity OR-lookup and register enumeration (re-verified 2026-09-28).** After a valid Google token, the handler matches `email OR firebase_uid OR google_id` using body `firebaseUid` (723–746). `POST /auth/register` returns `Email already registered` (415–418). Recommendation: Match only the verified Google `sub` or verified email. Return a generic register result.

 * **Web refresh tokens sit in AsyncStorage (re-verified 2026-09-28).** `tokenManager.web.ts` writes `auth_access_token` and `auth_refresh_token` through AsyncStorage, which is `localStorage` on web. Recommendation: Keep the refresh token in an HttpOnly cookie on web.

 * **ClosedRoute still uses an inline `require` of `databaseService` (re-verified 2026-09-28).** File: `apps/mobile/bottomBarScreens/profile/ClosedRoute.tsx`. Recommendation: Use the shared logger and drop the inline `require`.
