## 🚨 Critical Vulnerabilities

 * **Unauthenticated JWT refresh-token harvest / arbitrary Redis R/W (2026-09-17).** `RedisTestController` has no `UseGuards`. It is registered whenever `NODE_ENV !== "production"` (`app.module.ts` 122). `apps/api/railway.toml.dev` sets `NODE_ENV = "development"` (and `ENVIRONMENT = "development"`), so the controller is mounted on the committed dev Railway template. `GET /redis-test/keys?pattern=refresh_token:*` calls `redis.keys` (`redis-cache.service.ts` 102–106) and returns every JWT refresh-token key (`jwt.service.ts` 33, 338–343). `GET /redis-test/get/:key` (74–91) JSON-parses the stored refresh JWT. Concrete trigger: with Redis up on that service, `GET /redis-test/keys?pattern=refresh_token:*` → `GET /redis-test/get/refresh_token/<sessionId>` → `POST /auth/refresh` `{ "refreshToken": "<stolen>" }` mints a new access token copying `payload.roles` (no DB role reload — already first-classed  JWT-refresh stale roles). `GET /redis-test/keys?pattern=*` also dumps `session:*`, `blacklisted_token:*`, `user_sessions:*`, and cache keys. `POST /redis-test/set` overwrites any key; `DELETE /redis-test/delete/:key` deletes refresh tokens (force-logout) or blacklist entries (un-revoke). Distinct from 2026-09-14: `GET /session/stats` only returns `session:*` demo blobs (`SessionService.SESSION_PREFIX`), not `/auth` refresh JWTs. - File: `apps/api/src/controllers/redis-test.controller.ts` (16–137); `apps/api/src/app.module.ts` (122); `apps/api/railway.toml.dev` (25); `apps/api/src/auth/services/jwt.service.ts` (33, 123–130, 146–177, 338–343); `apps/api/src/redis/redis-cache.service.ts` (23–106) -> Action: Do not register `RedisTestController` in any deployed environment (gate on an explicit local-only flag, not `NODE_ENV`); never expose `KEYS`/`GET`/`SET`/`DEL` on the shared Redis used for refresh tokens and sessions.

 * **Unauthenticated guest read-receipt forge / unread wipe (2026-09-16, re-verified 2026-09-17).** Class `OptionalAuthGuard` always returns true (`jwt-auth.guard.ts` 338). `POST /api/chat/conversations/:conversationId/read-all` (671–743) sets `authenticatedUserId = req.user?.userId || body?.user_id` (679). With no JWT, the body value is resolved (email / firebase_uid / UUID) and, if that id is in `participants`, the handler INSERTs `message_read_receipts` for every unread message in the thread. `POST /api/chat/messages/:messageId/read` (751–812) uses the same fallback (759). Concrete trigger: `GET /api/users` (or `GET /api/users/search?q=ab`) yields a victim UUID/email; `GET /api/chat/conversations/user/<victim>` with no `Authorization` (09-15) returns conversation ids; `POST /api/chat/conversations/<id>/read-all` `{ "user_id": "<victim>" }` with no JWT marks the victim’s inbox read. Distinct from 09-09 (injects message *content*), 09-10 (creates/oracles DMs), and 09-15 (read-only roster). Authenticated callers already bind `req.user.userId` first — the hole is the guest `|| body.user_id` path. - File: `apps/api/src/controllers/chat.controller.ts` (46, 671–743, 751–812); `apps/api/src/auth/guards/jwt-auth.guard.ts` (338); `apps/api/src/services/user-resolution.service.ts` (38–90) -> Action: Require JWT on mark-read; bind the reader exclusively to `req.user.userId`; delete the body `user_id` fallback.

 * **Unauthenticated guest conversation roster harvest (auth inversion) (2026-09-15, re-verified 2026-09-17).** Class `OptionalAuthGuard` always returns true (`jwt-auth.guard.ts` 338). `GET /api/chat/conversations/user/:userId` (246–330) **does** bind JWT callers to self (`resolvedParamUserId !== resolvedAuthUserId` → access denied, 257–266). The `else` branch (267–269) runs when `req.user` is missing and uses the URL param as-is, then `SELECT cc.*` plus last-message content, last-sender name, participants, and unread counts (`WHERE $1::uuid = ANY(cc.participants)`). `UserResolutionService` also maps email / firebase_uid, so the param need not be a UUID. Concrete trigger: `GET /api/users` yields victim UUID (or email); `GET /api/chat/conversations/user/<victim>` with no `Authorization` returns the full inbox roster and last-message plaintext; follow with already-first-classed `GET /api/chat/conversations/<id>/messages` (378–387) for history, or with 09-16 mark-read write. Logging in as a different user **blocks** the same URL. Distinct from 2026-09-09/10 (pairwise-DM factory needs both participant ids; guest message inject / history dump needs a conversation id). - File: `apps/api/src/controllers/chat.controller.ts` (46, 246–330, 378–387); `apps/api/src/auth/guards/jwt-auth.guard.ts` (338) -> Action: Require JWT on conversation list; bind `:userId` exclusively to `req.user.userId` (same as the authenticated branch); delete the guest `else` path.

 * **Unauthenticated Redis session-key harvest + session-blob PII (2026-09-14, re-verified 2026-09-17).** `SessionController` has no `UseGuards`. `GET /session/stats` (235–249) calls `getSessionStats()` which `KEYS session:*` and returns `{ totalActiveSessions, sessionKeys }` (`session.service.ts` 192–203). Strip the `session:` prefix and call `GET /session/validate/{sessionId}` (136–153) — `validateSession` is an alias of `getSession` and returns the full blob (`userId`, `email`, `username`, `loginTime`, `lastActivity`, `ipAddress`, `userAgent`). Concrete trigger: with Redis up, `GET /session/stats` → for each key, `GET /session/validate/<id>` harvests every live user’s email and UUID with no prior knowledge of a victim id; `DELETE /session/logout/<id>` or `DELETE /session/logout-all/<userId>` then force-logs them out. Distinct from the previously first-classed user-scoped session reads/deletes, which require knowing a UUID first, and from today’s `/redis-test` JWT-refresh harvest. File comment already warns this controller must not ship. - File: `apps/api/src/auth/controllers/session.controller.ts` (136–249); `apps/api/src/auth/services/session.service.ts` (91–93, 192–203) -> Action: Remove `/session` from production builds (or require admin JWT); never return raw Redis keys or full session blobs; bind logout to the caller’s own session.

 * **JWT-gated social-engagement actor spoof (2026-09-13, re-verified 2026-09-17).** `JwtAuthGuard` is not enough. `POST /api/posts/:postId/like` (1343–1396) reads `body.user_id` and INSERTs/DELETEs `post_likes` for that id with no `req.user` bind. `POST /api/posts/:postId/comments` (1573–1643) INSERTs `post_comments.user_id` from the same body field. `POST /api/posts/:postId/comments/:commentId/like` (2152–2209) does the same for `comment_likes`. Concrete trigger: any valid JWT user A calls `POST /api/posts/<id>/comments` with `{ "user_id": "<victim>", "text": "..." }` and the comment is attributed to the victim; the same body forges or removes the victim’s post/comment likes. Contrast: post DELETE (2626–2663) binds `getSessionUserId(req)` and does not fall back to the body. Complements the previously first-classed comment PUT/DELETE spoof (1985–2058) and follow `follower_id` spoof. - File: `apps/api/src/controllers/posts.controller.ts` (1343–1396, 1573–1643, 2152–2209) -> Action: Bind like/comment actors exclusively to `req.user.userId`; reject a mismatched body `user_id`; stop requiring the client to send `user_id`.

 * **Private community-challenge join/write ignores `is_public` (2026-09-11, re-verified 2026-09-17).** Class-level `JwtAuthGuard` is not enough. Default list applies `AND COALESCE(c.is_public, true) = true` only when `creator_id` is omitted (`community-group-challenges.controller.ts` 232–238). `GET :id` (496–546) returns `c.*`, creator name/avatar, and the participant roster with no public/membership check. `POST :id/join` (574–616) selects only `id, is_active` and inserts the caller as a participant. `POST :id/entries` (667–685) accepts any participant. Concrete trigger: authenticated user A calls `GET /api/community-challenges?creator_id=<B>` (or guesses a UUID), then `POST /api/community-challenges/<id>/join`, then `POST /<id>/entries` with a value. B’s private challenge (no feed post, 138–141) now has a stranger participant and attacker-written entries. Contrast: `PUT :id` / `DELETE :id` correctly require `creator_id === CurrentUser()` (908–1072). - File: `apps/api/src/controllers/community-group-challenges.controller.ts` (183–238, 496–546, 560–631, 651–677) -> Action: Keep the public filter even when `creator_id` is set unless the caller is that creator or an admin; require membership or `is_public` on `GET :id`; reject `join` when `is_public = false` unless invited/creator.

 * **Unauthenticated identifier-only account takeover via `POST /api/users/resolve-id`.** No `JwtAuthGuard`. Supplying a known `email`, `google_id`, or `firebase_uid` looks up `user_profiles`, optionally **links** a caller-supplied `firebase_uid`/`google_id` onto that row, then **mints a full JWT pair** for that user. If Admin SDK is initialized and no local row matches, `tryAutoCreateUserFromFirebase` calls `admin.auth().getUser(firebase_uid)` **without an ID token** and provisions a KC user + tokens. Concrete trigger: `POST /api/users/resolve-id` with `{ "email": "<victim>" }` returns tokens with the victim’s `roles`. - File: `apps/api/src/controllers/users.controller.ts` (183–188) → `apps/api/src/services/user-auth.service.ts` (`resolveUserId` 270–342, `linkResolveIdentifiers` 580–627, `buildResolveSuccessResponse` 645–672) -> Action: Remove token minting from resolve-id; require a verified ID token; never link identifiers from an unauthenticated body.

 * **Primary mobile login accepts email-only (password verification skipped, including empty string).** `POST /api/users/login` verifies argon2 **only when both** `loginData.password` and `user.password_hash` are truthy (223–231). Omitting `password`, sending `password: ""`, or targeting a null hash falls through to `success: true` and returns email, phone, roles, and `parent_manager_id`. `/auth/login` correctly rejects missing hash and invalid passwords. Combined with resolve-id, the documented mobile sequence is an email-only takeover. Contrasts SRS §2.1.2. - File: `apps/api/src/controllers/users.controller.ts` (116–118); `apps/api/src/services/user-auth.service.ts` (190–263, especially 223–231) -> Action: Always require a non-empty password; fail closed if hash is missing; never return `success: true` without `argon2.verify`.

 * **Unauthenticated root-admin bootstrap via committed fallback email (identity-source split).** `KC_ROOT_ADMIN_EMAIL_FALLBACK` is committed in `kc-root-admin.defaults.ts`. Unauthenticated `POST /api/users/register` with that email sets `initialRoles = ["user", "admin"]` (101–102). Unauthenticated `POST /api/users/login` with the same email runs `array_append(roles, 'admin')` **before** the optional password check (212–220), then succeeds without a password. `getRootAdminEmail()` reads only `ROOT_ADMIN_EMAIL` (empty if unset) and is used solely to skip `roles` writes. The PUT role/hierarchy **block** (281–297) compares a **hardcoded Gmail literal**, not the env var and not the shared constant. Setting `ROOT_ADMIN_EMAIL` to a different mailbox does not stop bootstrap of the fallback address. - File: `apps/api/src/config/kc-root-admin.defaults.ts`; `apps/api/src/services/user-auth.service.ts` (101–102, 212–231); `apps/api/src/services/user-profile.service.ts` (52–56, 281–297, 349–361) -> Action: Single source of truth for root-admin identity; require verified secret/env match plus password; never mutate roles before `argon2.verify`.

 * **Unauthenticated register binds attacker-chosen Firebase UID.** `POST /api/users/register` has no guard. INSERT writes `userData.firebase_uid || userData.id || null` into `user_profiles.firebase_uid` (139). Password is optional (97–99). The victim’s later Firebase ID-token path attaches the attacker’s KC row. - File: `apps/api/src/services/user-auth.service.ts` (97–99, 139) -> Action: Ignore client `firebase_uid`/`id` on public register; require a verified Firebase ID token before binding.

 * **JWT-gated profile mass-assignment + password IDOR (`PUT /api/users/:id`).** `UpdateUserBody` accepts `password`, `roles`, and `firebase_uid`. Controller uses `JwtAuthGuard` only — **no ownership check and no `req.user` binding**. Lookup matches UUID **or** email / `firebase_uid` / `google_id` (267). Root-admin block covers roles/hierarchy only; `password` and `firebase_uid` are still written (303–347). Any JWT (including one minted by resolve-id) can reset any other user’s password or steal their Firebase identity. - File: `apps/api/src/controllers/users.controller.ts` (126–133); `apps/api/src/services/user-profile.service.ts` (18–32, 267, 281–361) -> Action: Bind `:id` to `req.user.userId` unless admin; strip `password`/`roles`/`firebase_uid` from the public DTO; extend the root-admin carve-out to password and identity fields.

 * **Unauthenticated user directory and profile PII.** `GET /api/users`, `GET /api/users/:id`, `GET /api/users/search`, and `GET /api/users/stats/summary` have no guards. `getUserById` / `searchUsers` return email, phone, and roles. Activity/stats-by-id reads remain first-classed (2026-09-08). - File: `apps/api/src/controllers/users.controller.ts` (40–43, 101–123, 135–149) -> Action: Require auth (and minimize fields) on list/search/profile/summary reads.

 * **Unauthenticated activity stream is a hidden-post / social-graph / financial discovery oracle (2026-09-08).** `GET /api/users/:id/activities` (152–158) has no `UseGuards` and returns `activity_type` + `activity_data` (`user-stats.service.ts` 35–44). Writers persist hide `{post_id}`, follow `{followed_user_id}`, chat `{conversation_id}`, ride `{ride_id, from, to, seats}`, donation `{donation_id, type, amount}`. Concrete trigger: hide a post then `GET /api/users/<authorId>/activities` discloses `post_hidden` + id; 09-06/09-07 endpoints then return hidden content and likers. - File: `apps/api/src/controllers/users.controller.ts` (152–158); `apps/api/src/services/user-stats.service.ts` (24–47) -> Action: Require JWT + ownership (or admin); redact `activity_data` for non-owners.

 * **Unauthenticated pairwise-DM factory / existence oracle + guest message inject (2026-09-09 / 2026-09-10).** Class `OptionalAuthGuard` always returns true (`jwt-auth.guard.ts` 338). `POST /api/chat/conversations` (107–244): no JWT → body `created_by` used as-is (134–141); `SELECT *` of the exact participant set returns the existing DM (183–196) or INSERTs a new one (199–214); `created_by` is not required in `participants`. `POST /api/chat/messages` without JWT uses body `sender_id` (456–464); conversation lookup is `WHERE id = $1` only (564–569) vs authenticated `ANY(participants)` (555–563). Without `conversation_id` but with `participants` (481–541) it finds or creates that thread; sender need not be in `participants`. Guest `GET conversations/:id/messages` (378–387) dumps history. Concrete trigger: `GET /api/users` yields A/B; `POST /conversations` `{participants:[A,B], created_by:A}` returns or creates the DM; `POST /messages` `{conversation_id, sender_id, content}` injects. One-shot: `POST /messages` `{participants:[A,B], sender_id:A, content}`. Complements the 2026-09-15 roster harvest and 09-16 read-receipt write. - File: `apps/api/src/controllers/chat.controller.ts` (46, 107–244, 378–387, 441–569); `apps/api/src/auth/guards/jwt-auth.guard.ts` (338) -> Action: Require JWT on all chat writes and message reads; bind `created_by`/`sender_id` to `req.user`; always enforce `ANY(participants)`; do not create DMs from a guest body.

 * **Client-supplied hierarchy actors + unauthenticated hierarchy tree.** JWT-gated promote/demote/set-manager still trust body `requestingAdminId` / `requestingUserId`; omit or not-found **skips** the admin check (`user-hierarchy.service.ts` 492–517). `POST :id/hierarchy/manage` (55–62) has **no actor field at all** — `manageHierarchy` (871–942) applies add/remove for any JWT. `GET eligible-for-promotion/:adminId`, `GET hierarchy/tree`, and `GET :id/hierarchy` have no guards (`users.controller.ts` 91–108). - File: `apps/api/src/controllers/users.controller.ts` (45–108); `apps/api/src/services/user-hierarchy.service.ts` (492–517, 871–942) -> Action: Bind actor to `req.user`; require `AdminAuthGuard` on manage/promote; fail closed when requester is missing; auth-gate tree/eligible reads.

 * **Spoofable follow `follower_id`.** `POST`/`DELETE /api/users/:id/follow` are JWT-gated but insert/delete using body `follower_id` (`user-follow.service.ts` 19–34), not `req.user.userId`. - File: `apps/api/src/services/user-follow.service.ts` (6–34) -> Action: Bind follower exclusively to the JWT subject.

 * **JWT refresh copies stale `payload.roles` and never reloads DB roles.** `refreshAccessToken` (`jwt.service.ts` 146–177) copies `payload.roles` into the new access token. A revoked admin keeps admin until the refresh token expires (30 days). Contrasts SRS §2.1.4. Combined with today’s `/redis-test` harvest, a stolen refresh token also preserves whatever roles were baked in at mint time. - File: `apps/api/src/auth/services/jwt.service.ts` (146–177) -> Action: Reload roles from `user_profiles` on refresh; reject refresh if the user is inactive.

 * **Firebase JWKS accepts any project when env project id is unset.** `verifyIdTokenWithPublicJwks` derives `aud` from the token; `resolveFirebaseProjectIdForJwks` only rejects a *different* env project when `FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID` / `GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT` / service-account `project_id` is set (`firebase-admin.service.ts` 177–182). If those are empty, any Firebase project’s ID token verifies. JwtAuthGuard then maps `firebase_uid` to a KC row. - File: `apps/api/src/auth/services/firebase-admin.service.ts` (11–14, 164–200, 242–264) -> Action: Require a configured project id and reject tokens whose `aud` does not match.

 * **Google `/auth/google` access-token fallback.** If `idToken` verification fails, the handler fetches Google userinfo with a client-supplied `accessToken` (`auth.controller.ts` 669–673) and provisions/logs in from that profile. - File: `apps/api/src/auth/controllers/auth.controller.ts` (588–673) -> Action: Accept only verified Google/Firebase ID tokens; do not treat a bearer access token as login proof.

 * **JwtAuthGuard rate-limit identifier is the shared HS256 token prefix.** `checkRateLimit(token.substring(0, 16), "api_access")` (`jwt-auth.guard.ts` 97–100) is identical for every token signed with the same secret (JWT header + start of payload). One noisy client can trip the 100/60s bucket for all users. `ThrottlerModule` is registered (`app.module.ts` 72–77) but there is **no** global `APP_GUARD` for `ThrottlerGuard` (zero matches under `apps/api/src`). Primary mobile `POST /api/users/login` and `POST /api/users/register` are unthrottled (contrast `/auth/*` which uses `@UseGuards(ThrottlerGuard)`). Unauthenticated `DELETE /rate-limit/clear` and `POST /rate-limit/custom` can clear or plant the shared bucket. - File: `apps/api/src/auth/guards/jwt-auth.guard.ts` (96–100); `apps/api/src/app.module.ts` (72–77, no `APP_GUARD`); `apps/api/src/controllers/users.controller.ts` (111–118); `apps/api/src/controllers/rate-limit.controller.ts` -> Action: Rate-limit by user id / IP; register `ThrottlerGuard` globally; throttle login/register; admin-gate `/rate-limit/*`.

 * **Unauthenticated ride POST/PUT/DELETE + public driver PII + spoofable actors.** No `UseGuards` on `RidesController`. `POST /` trusts body `driver_id` and can INSERT `user_profiles` (47–80+). `PUT :id` / `DELETE :id` (695–755) are unauthenticated. `GET /` returns `driver_phone` (247–250); `GET :id` returns `driver_phone` + `driver_email` (347–351). `GET stats/summary` (656–692) is unauthenticated. Booking approval can oversell (505–555). - File: `apps/api/src/controllers/rides.controller.ts` -> Action: Require JWT on all ride writes; bind driver/passenger to `req.user`; never INSERT `user_profiles` from an unauthenticated body; `SELECT … FOR UPDATE` and reject oversell; strip phone/email from public GET.

 * **Unauthenticated hidden-post bypass (2026-09-06) and liker roster (2026-09-07).** Public feed filters `(p.status IS NULL OR p.status != 'hidden')` (754). `GET /api/posts/user/:userId` uses `WHERE p.author_id = $1` only (1159–1161). `GET /api/posts/:postId` uses `WHERE p.id = $1` only. `GET :postId/comments` ignores `posts.status`. `GET :postId/likes` (1463–1520) and `GET :postId/likes/check/:userId` (1527–1546) have no guard and no status join. - File: `apps/api/src/controllers/posts.controller.ts` (754 vs 1023–1167, 1463–1546, 1726–1772, 1813–1955) -> Action: Apply the hidden-status predicate on user-posts, by-id, likes, comments, and the activity stream unless the caller is the author or an admin.

 * **Comment PUT/DELETE actor spoof.** JWT-gated `PUT :postId/comments/:commentId` compares ownership to body `user_id` (1985–2014), not `req.user`. `DELETE` uses query `user_id` (2053–2058). - File: `apps/api/src/controllers/posts.controller.ts` (1975–2058) -> Action: Bind actor to `req.user.userId`.

 * **Friends-feed viewer impersonation.** Unauthenticated `GET /api/posts?feed_scope=friends&user_id=<victim>` treats query `user_id` as the viewer (776–782). - File: `apps/api/src/controllers/posts.controller.ts` (830–853, 776–782) -> Action: Require JWT; bind viewer exclusively to `req.user.userId`.

 * **JWT-gated but unscoped tasks + email dump + hours IDOR.** `GET /api/tasks` (74–166) is JwtAuthGuard but unscoped. `GET :id` / `:id/subtasks` / `:id/tree` dump assignee/creator emails. `POST :id/log-hours` trusts body `user_id` (384–412). `GET hours-report/:managerId` (568–587) has no manager/self check; catch returns `success: true` with zeros. - File: `apps/api/src/tasks/tasks.controller.ts` -> Action: Scope list/read to assignee/creator/admin; bind `user_id` to JWT; authorize hours-report; fail closed on errors.

 * **Donation actor spoof + unauthenticated dumps + JWT PUT/DELETE IDOR.** JWT `POST /api/donations` inserts body `donor_id` (478–519). `PUT :id` / `DELETE :id` (698–779) are JwtAuthGuard only — any JWT can rewrite or delete any donation (no `req.user` / donor bind). `GET /` `SELECT d.*` (577–661); `GET user/:userId` (782–804); `GET :id` returns donor phone/email (667–696); `GET stats/summary` (806–831) is unauthenticated. Knowledge-link `POST /api/donations/knowledge/links` (226–291) remains public and accepts spoofable `createdByUserId` / `displayName`; DELETE checks admin roles in-handler (305–319). - File: `apps/api/src/controllers/donations.controller.ts` -> Action: Bind `donor_id` to JWT; require ownership or admin on PUT/DELETE; auth-gate list/by-user/detail; strip donor PII; require JWT (or moderation) on knowledge-link create.

 * **Unauthenticated stats money/activity oracles + JWT-gated email export.** `GET /api/stats/analytics/categories` (439–463) returns donation money totals. `GET /api/stats/real-time` (782–810) returns last-hour activity and online counts. `GET /api/stats/details/:statType` is JWT-gated (not `AdminAuthGuard`) and `totalUsers` SELECTs `name, email, city` for up to 500 rows (834–876); cache key `stat_details_${statType}` is global. Users/rides donations `stats/summary` remain unauthenticated. - File: `apps/api/src/controllers/stats.controller.ts` (439–463, 782–810, 834–876) -> Action: Admin-gate money/PII analytics; drop email from default export; keep only non-sensitive aggregates public.

 * **Unauthenticated community-members `contact_info` dump + CRM `SELECT *` + collections `userId=all` JSONB dump.** No `UseGuards` on those controllers. Community-members GET returns `contact_info` (186–245); `POST`/`PATCH`/`DELETE` remain unauthenticated writes. CRM `GET /api/crm` runs `SELECT * FROM crm_contacts` (106–147); writes are also unauthenticated. Collections `GET :collection` calls `listAll` when `userId=all` or omitted for `links` (57–62); `ALLOWED_COLLECTIONS` includes `users`, `chats`, `messages`, `notifications`, `settings`; unauthenticated POST/PUT/DELETE remain open. - File: `apps/api/src/controllers/community-members.controller.ts`; `apps/api/src/controllers/crm.controller.ts`; `apps/api/src/items/items.controller.ts` (43–108) -> Action: Require `AdminAuthGuard` (or JWT + owner bind); delete or admin-gate `userId=all`.

 * **Fully unguarded write surfaces (items-delivery, dedicated-items, session logout-all, places proxy, rate-limit).** Items-delivery: `POST` trusts `owner_id` (32–71); `PUT`/`DELETE :id` unscoped; reserve/requests/deliver spoofable. Dedicated-items: unauthenticated CRUD; `GET :id` shadows `GET search`. Session `GET user/:userId`, `DELETE logout/:sessionId`, `DELETE logout-all/:userId` are unauthenticated. Places `/autocomplete`, `/place-details`, `/search-stats` proxy `GOOGLE_API_KEY`; `/place-details` interpolates `place_id` without `encodeURIComponent` (75). Rate-limit `POST custom` / `DELETE clear` / `POST stress-test` are unauthenticated. Redis-test is first-classed separately today (JWT refresh harvest); it remains in this unguarded set. - File: `apps/api/src/controllers/items-delivery.controller.ts`; `apps/api/src/items/dedicated-items.controller.ts`; `apps/api/src/auth/controllers/session.controller.ts`; `apps/api/src/controllers/places.controller.ts` (9–103); `apps/api/src/controllers/rate-limit.controller.ts` -> Action: Add `JwtAuthGuard` (admin where appropriate); bind owners to JWT; encode `place_id`; disable redis-test, session demo, and rate-limit mutation in deployed environments.

 * **Admin-files list ACL too weak.** `GET /api/admin-files` and `GET folders` are `JwtAuthGuard` only; POST/DELETE correctly use `AdminAuthGuard`. Any authenticated user can list Finance/HR file URLs. - File: `apps/api/src/controllers/admin-files.controller.ts` (80–140 vs 142–203) -> Action: Put list/folders behind `AdminAuthGuard`.

 * **Community daily-tracker IDOR.** Class JWT, but `GET daily-tracker` uses query `user_id` (288–336), not `req.user`. Entries themselves are filtered to that `user_id` (364), so this dumps another user’s streaks/notes, not the whole challenge. - File: `apps/api/src/controllers/community-group-challenges.controller.ts` (288–336) -> Action: Bind `user_id` to `CurrentUser()` (same as `GET user/:userId/stats`).

 * **Request-path `DROP TABLE ... CASCADE`.** `ensurePostsTable` (invoked from GET/POST post routes) can `DROP TABLE IF EXISTS posts CASCADE` when legacy columns are detected (78), plus likes/comments drops (309, 373–374). `tasks-schema.service.ts` (41) can drop `posts`. `DatabaseInit` drops donations/rides on startup (568, 670) when it decides the schema is legacy. - File: `apps/api/src/controllers/posts.controller.ts` (78, 309, 373–374); `apps/api/src/tasks/tasks-schema.service.ts` (41); `apps/api/src/database/database.init.ts` (568, 670) -> Action: Never DROP on a request path; gate destructive DDL behind an explicit offline migration.

 * **Committed credentials, backups, and env fingerprints.** `apps/api/railway.toml.dev` line 34 commits a `JWT_SECRET`. `docs/SSOT/runbooks/api/environment-separation.md` line 126 documents a real-looking JWT value (do not copy). `main.ts` 149–218 fingerprints env using committed DB/Redis password/host **substrings**. 49 tracked JSON backups under `apps/api/data-backups/20251224-162421/` include `user_profiles` keys (email/phone/`password_hash`). - File: `apps/api/railway.toml.dev` (34); `apps/api/src/main.ts` (149–218); `apps/api/data-backups/` -> Action: Rotate all fingerprinted credentials; replace substring detection with an explicit `ENVIRONMENT` flag; purge backups from git history; move JWT secrets to the secret store.

## 🐞 Bugs & Logic Issues

 * **Unauthenticated posts feed treats query `user_id` as the viewer.** `GET /api/posts` has no guard. `feed_scope=friends` plus `user_id` filters to that user’s own posts and the people they follow (776–782) and the same id drives `is_liked`. Recommendation: Require JWT; bind viewer exclusively to `req.user.userId`; delete or auth-gate the likes/check and `viewer_id` query.

 * **Ride booking approval oversell.** `PUT /api/rides/bookings/:bookingId/status` (505–555) sets `approved` then only flips the ride to `full` after the fact — it does not reject when `approved + requested > available_seats`. Concurrent books can oversell. Recommendation: `SELECT … FOR UPDATE` and reject when remaining seats are insufficient.

 * **Task hours-report catch returns success.** `GET /api/tasks/hours-report/:managerId` catch returns `success: true` with empty zeros, hiding failures. Recommendation: Return `success: false` and a generic error.

 * **Items-delivery / dedicated-items / collections static-route shadows.** `GET /api/items-delivery/:id` is declared before `GET requests`, so `GET /api/items-delivery/requests` hits `getItemById("requests")`. Dedicated-items `GET :id` shadows `GET search`. Collections `GET :collection` precedes `GET popular-collections` / `GET cache-stats` (those return 400 Invalid collection). Recommendation: Declare static routes before parameterized `:id` / `:collection`.

 * **`loginUser` / JWT guard never consult `user_profiles.is_active`.** Deactivated rows can still obtain a session via email-only login or an existing refresh token. Recommendation: Fail closed on `is_active = false` in login, resolve-id, refresh, and `JwtAuthGuard`.

 * **Anonymity filtering is specified but not implemented.** SRS §2.5.7 / NFR §3.2 require server-side redaction for `anonymity_level < 4`. The column is still absent from posts DDL (SRS §10). Public feed returns author `id` / `name` / `avatar_url` for every post. Recommendation: Add the column + feed/by-id projection per SRS; do not treat this as a new product feature in a security hotfix PR.

 * **Personal-challenge reset-log `challengeId` is not ownership-checked.** `POST /api/challenges/reset-logs` overwrites `createDto.userId` from the JWT (507) then INSERTs any `challengeId` with no `challenges.user_id` match. A caller can attach reset-log rows to another user’s timer (own `user_id` on the log). Recommendation: INSERT only when `challenge_id` belongs to `CurrentUser()`.

 * **ClosedRoute task-type / duplicate handling.** `apps/mobile/bottomBarScreens/profile/ClosedRoute.tsx` still uses an inline `require` of `databaseService`, `console.error`, and a loose `user?: any` prop. Duplicate-task skip only compares `taskData.id` after mapping posts as `type === 'task'`. Recommendation: Use the shared logger; unify closed-content type tags; drop the inline `require`.

 * **Hand-rolled JWT signature compare is not constant-time.** `verifyTokenSignature` (`jwt.service.ts` 308) uses `!==` on the HMAC digest. Combined with the committed `JWT_SECRET` in `railway.toml.dev`, this is secondary to secret rotation. Recommendation: Use `crypto.timingSafeEqual` after length-checking; still rotate the committed secret.

 * **`getUserById` leaks `error.message` to clients.** Catch returns `{ success: false, error: "Failed to get user", details: error?.message }` (`user-profile.service.ts` 239–249). Production `ValidationPipe` `disableErrorMessages` does not cover this hand-rolled envelope. Recommendation: Return a generic error; log the details server-side only.

 * **Places `place_id` is interpolated unencoded.** `GET /place-details?place_id=` concatenates the query into the Google URL without `encodeURIComponent` (75). Autocomplete correctly encodes `input`. Recommendation: Encode `place_id`; consider allowlisting Place ID shape.

 * **No Domain / Application / Infrastructure folders** under `apps/` or `packages/` (count 0). Target in `docs/SSOT/CODE_QUALITY/layers-and-boundaries.md` is Infrastructure → Application → Domain. The monorepo remains NestJS feature folders + RN screens; `packages/` still only `config-eslint`. Closest pure islands remain `apps/api/src/tasks/task-completion-participants.ts`, `tasks-validation.ts`, `tasks-query-params.ts`, `tasks.types.ts` (no Nest/pg imports).

 * **Fat HTTP layer owns SQL + policy.** Worst API files: `posts.controller.ts` (2741), `stats.controller.ts` (1709), `user-hierarchy.service.ts` (1675), `database.init.ts` (1374), `community-group-challenges.controller.ts` (1097), `chat.controller.ts` (813), `rides.controller.ts` (779). `items-delivery.service.ts` is misplaced under `controllers/`.

 * **Privilege checks are inconsistent inside the same controller (authorization-in-one-file smell).** Chat JWT conversation list binds `:userId` to self while the guest branch dumps any inbox (2026-09-15); JWT send/read checks `ANY(participants)` while the guest branch skips it and `createConversation` returns `SELECT *` of an existing DM; mark-read prefers JWT then falls back to body `user_id` (2026-09-16). Community-group-challenges binds JWT on create/join/entry and correctly gates PUT/DELETE to the creator, but list/`GET :id`/join ignore `is_public`. Posts hide on the public feed only; likes/comments writes are JWT-gated but bind `body.user_id`. Users JWT-gates follow/hierarchy writes but leaves `:id/activities` and `:id/stats` public. Stats admin-gates `analytics/users` but JWT-only-gates `details/:statType`. Rides has no guards at all. `SessionController` is registered in every environment despite DEMO/TEST file comments. `RedisTestController` is gated on `NODE_ENV !== "production"` rather than an explicit local-only flag, so the committed dev Railway template ships live Redis KEYS/GET/SET/DEL (2026-09-17).

 * **Positive in-folder contrasts (do not regress):** community-group-challenges binds creator from JWT on create/join/entry and uses `CurrentUser()` on `GET user/:userId/stats`, `GET :id/entries`, `PUT :id`, and `DELETE :id`; ChallengesController scopes personal timers to `CurrentUser()`; NotificationsController.`validateOwnership`; knowledge contribution-request binds `req.user.userId`; SyncController user/all/status use `AdminAuthGuard`; post DELETE binds session user without body fallback; authenticated chat send/read checks `ANY(participants)`; authenticated `GET conversations/user/:userId` already denies cross-user reads (do not delete that branch — apply it to guests too); `/session/login` correctly requires argon2 (contrast `/api/users/login`).

 * **Operator matching workspace is specified, not implemented.** `OperatorAuthGuard` exists (`jwt-auth.guard.ts`) but there is no `/api/operator/*` module (zero operator controller files). Anonymity + matching-case audit tables remain SRS §10 gaps.

 * **197 source `.ts`/`.tsx` files exceed the ~200 LOC guideline.** Largest tracked source: `apps/mobile/utils/bubbles_Data.tsx` (4852). Mobile debt hubs: `databaseService.ts` (1225), `apiService.ts` (1055), `enhancedDatabaseService.ts`, duplicate `google_auth/SecureApiService.ts` (1165).

## 🚨 Critical Vulnerabilities

 * **Unauthenticated guest read-receipt forge / unread wipe (2026-09-16).** Class `OptionalAuthGuard` always returns true (`jwt-auth.guard.ts` 338). `POST /api/chat/conversations/:conversationId/read-all` (671–743) sets `authenticatedUserId = req.user?.userId || body?.user_id` (679). With no JWT, the body value is resolved (email / firebase_uid / UUID) and, if that id is in `participants`, the handler INSERTs `message_read_receipts` for every unread message in the thread. `POST /api/chat/messages/:messageId/read` (751–812) uses the same fallback (759). Concrete trigger: `GET /api/users` (or `GET /api/users/search?q=ab`) yields a victim UUID/email; `GET /api/chat/conversations/user/<victim>` with no `Authorization` (09-15) returns conversation ids; `POST /api/chat/conversations/<id>/read-all` `{ "user_id": "<victim>" }` with no JWT marks the victim’s inbox read. Distinct from 09-09 (injects message *content*), 09-10 (creates/oracles DMs), and 09-15 (read-only roster). Authenticated callers already bind `req.user.userId` first — the hole is the guest `|| body.user_id` path. - File: `apps/api/src/controllers/chat.controller.ts` (46, 671–743, 751–812); `apps/api/src/auth/guards/jwt-auth.guard.ts` (338); `apps/api/src/services/user-resolution.service.ts` (38–90) -> Action: Require JWT on mark-read; bind the reader exclusively to `req.user.userId`; delete the body `user_id` fallback.

 * **Unauthenticated guest conversation roster harvest (auth inversion) (2026-09-15, re-verified 2026-09-16).** Class `OptionalAuthGuard` always returns true (`jwt-auth.guard.ts` 338). `GET /api/chat/conversations/user/:userId` (246–330) **does** bind JWT callers to self (`resolvedParamUserId !== resolvedAuthUserId` → access denied, 257–266). The `else` branch (267–269) runs when `req.user` is missing and uses the URL param as-is, then `SELECT cc.*` plus last-message content, last-sender name, participants, and unread counts (`WHERE $1::uuid = ANY(cc.participants)`). `UserResolutionService` also maps email / firebase_uid, so the param need not be a UUID. Concrete trigger: `GET /api/users` yields victim UUID (or email); `GET /api/chat/conversations/user/<victim>` with no `Authorization` returns the full inbox roster and last-message plaintext; follow with already-first-classed `GET /api/chat/conversations/<id>/messages` (378–387) for history, or with today’s mark-read write. Logging in as a different user **blocks** the same URL. Distinct from 2026-09-09/10 (pairwise-DM factory needs both participant ids; guest message inject / history dump needs a conversation id). - File: `apps/api/src/controllers/chat.controller.ts` (46, 246–330, 378–387); `apps/api/src/auth/guards/jwt-auth.guard.ts` (338) -> Action: Require JWT on conversation list; bind `:userId` exclusively to `req.user.userId` (same as the authenticated branch); delete the guest `else` path.

 * **Unauthenticated Redis session-key harvest + session-blob PII (2026-09-14, re-verified 2026-09-16).** `SessionController` has no `UseGuards`. `GET /session/stats` (235–249) calls `getSessionStats()` which `KEYS session:*` and returns `{ totalActiveSessions, sessionKeys }` (`session.service.ts` 192–203). Strip the `session:` prefix and call `GET /session/validate/{sessionId}` (136–153) — `validateSession` is an alias of `getSession` and returns the full blob (`userId`, `email`, `username`, `loginTime`, `lastActivity`, `ipAddress`, `userAgent`). Concrete trigger: with Redis up, `GET /session/stats` → for each key, `GET /session/validate/<id>` harvests every live user’s email and UUID with no prior knowledge of a victim id; `DELETE /session/logout/<id>` or `DELETE /session/logout-all/<userId>` then force-logs them out. Distinct from the previously first-classed user-scoped session reads/deletes, which require knowing a UUID first. File comment already warns this controller must not ship. - File: `apps/api/src/auth/controllers/session.controller.ts` (136–249); `apps/api/src/auth/services/session.service.ts` (91–93, 192–203) -> Action: Remove `/session` from production builds (or require admin JWT); never return raw Redis keys or full session blobs; bind logout to the caller’s own session.

 * **JWT-gated social-engagement actor spoof (2026-09-13, re-verified 2026-09-16).** `JwtAuthGuard` is not enough. `POST /api/posts/:postId/like` (1343–1396) reads `body.user_id` and INSERTs/DELETEs `post_likes` for that id with no `req.user` bind. `POST /api/posts/:postId/comments` (1573–1643) INSERTs `post_comments.user_id` from the same body field. `POST /api/posts/:postId/comments/:commentId/like` (2152–2209) does the same for `comment_likes`. Concrete trigger: any valid JWT user A calls `POST /api/posts/<id>/comments` with `{ "user_id": "<victim>", "text": "..." }` and the comment is attributed to the victim; the same body forges or removes the victim’s post/comment likes. Contrast: post DELETE (2626–2663) binds `getSessionUserId(req)` and does not fall back to the body. Complements the previously first-classed comment PUT/DELETE spoof (1985–2058) and follow `follower_id` spoof. - File: `apps/api/src/controllers/posts.controller.ts` (1343–1396, 1573–1643, 2152–2209) -> Action: Bind like/comment actors exclusively to `req.user.userId`; reject a mismatched body `user_id`; stop requiring the client to send `user_id`.

 * **Private community-challenge join/write ignores `is_public` (2026-09-11, re-verified 2026-09-16).** Class-level `JwtAuthGuard` is not enough. Default list applies `AND COALESCE(c.is_public, true) = true` only when `creator_id` is omitted (`community-group-challenges.controller.ts` 232–238). `GET :id` (496–546) returns `c.*`, creator name/avatar, and the participant roster with no public/membership check. `POST :id/join` (574–616) selects only `id, is_active` and inserts the caller as a participant. `POST :id/entries` (667–685) accepts any participant. Concrete trigger: authenticated user A calls `GET /api/community-challenges?creator_id=<B>` (or guesses a UUID), then `POST /api/community-challenges/<id>/join`, then `POST /<id>/entries` with a value. B’s private challenge (no feed post, 138–141) now has a stranger participant and attacker-written entries. Contrast: `PUT :id` / `DELETE :id` correctly require `creator_id === CurrentUser()` (908–1072). - File: `apps/api/src/controllers/community-group-challenges.controller.ts` (183–238, 496–546, 560–631, 651–677) -> Action: Keep the public filter even when `creator_id` is set unless the caller is that creator or an admin; require membership or `is_public` on `GET :id`; reject `join` when `is_public = false` unless invited/creator.

 * **Unauthenticated identifier-only account takeover via `POST /api/users/resolve-id`.** No `JwtAuthGuard`. Supplying a known `email`, `google_id`, or `firebase_uid` looks up `user_profiles`, optionally **links** a caller-supplied `firebase_uid`/`google_id` onto that row, then **mints a full JWT pair** for that user. If Admin SDK is initialized and no local row matches, `tryAutoCreateUserFromFirebase` calls `admin.auth().getUser(firebase_uid)` **without an ID token** and provisions a KC user + tokens. Concrete trigger: `POST /api/users/resolve-id` with `{ "email": "<victim>" }` returns tokens with the victim’s `roles`. - File: `apps/api/src/controllers/users.controller.ts` (183–188) → `apps/api/src/services/user-auth.service.ts` (`resolveUserId` 270–342, `linkResolveIdentifiers` 580–627, `buildResolveSuccessResponse` 645–672) -> Action: Remove token minting from resolve-id; require a verified ID token; never link identifiers from an unauthenticated body.

 * **Primary mobile login accepts email-only (password verification skipped, including empty string).** `POST /api/users/login` verifies argon2 **only when both** `loginData.password` and `user.password_hash` are truthy (223–231). Omitting `password`, sending `password: ""`, or targeting a null hash falls through to `success: true` and returns email, phone, roles, and `parent_manager_id`. `/auth/login` correctly rejects missing hash and invalid passwords. Combined with resolve-id, the documented mobile sequence is an email-only takeover. Contrasts SRS §2.1.2. - File: `apps/api/src/controllers/users.controller.ts` (116–118); `apps/api/src/services/user-auth.service.ts` (190–263, especially 223–231) -> Action: Always require a non-empty password; fail closed if hash is missing; never return `success: true` without `argon2.verify`.

 * **Unauthenticated root-admin bootstrap via committed fallback email (identity-source split).** `KC_ROOT_ADMIN_EMAIL_FALLBACK` is committed in `kc-root-admin.defaults.ts`. Unauthenticated `POST /api/users/register` with that email sets `initialRoles = ["user", "admin"]` (101–102). Unauthenticated `POST /api/users/login` with the same email runs `array_append(roles, 'admin')` **before** the optional password check (212–220), then succeeds without a password. `getRootAdminEmail()` reads only `ROOT_ADMIN_EMAIL` (empty if unset) and is used solely to skip `roles` writes. The PUT role/hierarchy **block** (281–297) compares a **hardcoded Gmail literal**, not the env var and not the shared constant. Setting `ROOT_ADMIN_EMAIL` to a different mailbox does not stop bootstrap of the fallback address. - File: `apps/api/src/config/kc-root-admin.defaults.ts`; `apps/api/src/services/user-auth.service.ts` (101–102, 212–231); `apps/api/src/services/user-profile.service.ts` (52–56, 281–297, 349–361) -> Action: Single source of truth for root-admin identity; require verified secret/env match plus password; never mutate roles before `argon2.verify`.

 * **Unauthenticated register binds attacker-chosen Firebase UID.** `POST /api/users/register` has no guard. INSERT writes `userData.firebase_uid || userData.id || null` into `user_profiles.firebase_uid` (139). Password is optional (97–99). The victim’s later Firebase ID-token path attaches the attacker’s KC row. - File: `apps/api/src/services/user-auth.service.ts` (97–99, 139) -> Action: Ignore client `firebase_uid`/`id` on public register; require a verified Firebase ID token before binding.

 * **JWT-gated profile mass-assignment + password IDOR (`PUT /api/users/:id`).** `UpdateUserBody` accepts `password`, `roles`, and `firebase_uid`. Controller uses `JwtAuthGuard` only — **no ownership check and no `req.user` binding**. Lookup matches UUID **or** email / `firebase_uid` / `google_id` (267). Root-admin block covers roles/hierarchy only; `password` and `firebase_uid` are still written (303–347). Any JWT (including one minted by resolve-id) can reset any other user’s password or steal their Firebase identity. - File: `apps/api/src/controllers/users.controller.ts` (126–133); `apps/api/src/services/user-profile.service.ts` (18–32, 267, 281–361) -> Action: Bind `:id` to `req.user.userId` unless admin; strip `password`/`roles`/`firebase_uid` from the public DTO; extend the root-admin carve-out to password and identity fields.

 * **Unauthenticated user directory and profile PII.** `GET /api/users`, `GET /api/users/:id`, `GET /api/users/search`, and `GET /api/users/stats/summary` have no guards. `getUserById` / `searchUsers` return email, phone, and roles. Activity/stats-by-id reads remain first-classed (2026-09-08). - File: `apps/api/src/controllers/users.controller.ts` (40–43, 101–123, 135–149) -> Action: Require auth (and minimize fields) on list/search/profile/summary reads.

## 🐞 Bugs & Logic Issues

 * **Unauthenticated posts feed treats query `user_id` as the viewer.** `GET /api/posts` has no guard. `feed_scope=friends` plus `user_id` filters to that user’s own posts and the people they follow (776–782) and the same id drives `is_liked`. Recommendation: Require JWT; bind viewer exclusively to `req.user.userId`; delete or auth-gate the likes/check and `viewer_id` query.

 * **Ride booking approval oversell.** `PUT /api/rides/bookings/:bookingId/status` (505–555) sets `approved` then only flips the ride to `full` after the fact — it does not reject when `approved + requested > available_seats`. Concurrent books can oversell. Recommendation: `SELECT … FOR UPDATE` and reject when remaining seats are insufficient.

 * **Task hours-report catch returns success.** `GET /api/tasks/hours-report/:managerId` catch returns `success: true` with empty zeros, hiding failures. Recommendation: Return `success: false` and a generic error.

 * **Items-delivery / dedicated-items / collections static-route shadows.** `GET /api/items-delivery/:id` is declared before `GET requests`, so `GET /api/items-delivery/requests` hits `getItemById("requests")`. Dedicated-items `GET :id` shadows `GET search`. Collections `GET :collection` precedes `GET popular-collections` / `GET cache-stats` (those return 400 Invalid collection). Recommendation: Declare static routes before parameterized `:id` / `:collection`.

 * **`loginUser` / JWT guard never consult `user_profiles.is_active`.** Deactivated rows can still obtain a session via email-only login or an existing refresh token. Recommendation: Fail closed on `is_active = false` in login, resolve-id, refresh, and `JwtAuthGuard`.

 * **Anonymity filtering is specified but not implemented.** SRS §2.5.7 / NFR §3.2 require server-side redaction for `anonymity_level < 4`. The column is still absent from posts DDL (SRS §10). Public feed returns author `id` / `name` / `avatar_url` for every post. Recommendation: Add the column + feed/by-id projection per SRS; do not treat this as a new product feature in a security hotfix PR.

 * **Personal-challenge reset-log `challengeId` is not ownership-checked.** `POST /api/challenges/reset-logs` overwrites `createDto.userId` from the JWT (507) then INSERTs any `challengeId` with no `challenges.user_id` match. A caller can attach reset-log rows to another user’s timer (own `user_id` on the log). Recommendation: INSERT only when `challenge_id` belongs to `CurrentUser()`.

 * **ClosedRoute task-type / duplicate handling.** `apps/mobile/bottomBarScreens/profile/ClosedRoute.tsx` still uses an inline `require` of `databaseService`, `console.error`, and a loose `user?: any` prop. Duplicate-task skip only compares `taskData.id` after mapping posts as `type === 'task'`. Recommendation: Use the shared logger; unify closed-content type tags; drop the inline `require`.

 * **Hand-rolled JWT signature compare is not constant-time.** `verifyTokenSignature` (`jwt.service.ts` 308) uses `!==` on the HMAC digest. Combined with the committed `JWT_SECRET` in `railway.toml.dev`, this is secondary to secret rotation. Recommendation: Use `crypto.timingSafeEqual` after length-checking; still rotate the committed secret.

 * **`getUserById` leaks `error.message` to clients.** Catch returns `{ success: false, error: "Failed to get user", details: error?.message }` (`user-profile.service.ts` 239–249). Production `ValidationPipe` `disableErrorMessages` does not cover this hand-rolled envelope. Recommendation: Return a generic error; log the details server-side only.

## 🏗️ Architecture & Clean Code

 * **No Domain / Application / Infrastructure folders** under `apps/` or `packages/` (count 0). Target in `docs/SSOT/CODE_QUALITY/layers-and-boundaries.md` is Infrastructure → Application → Domain. The monorepo remains NestJS feature folders + RN screens; `packages/` still only `config-eslint`. Closest pure islands remain `apps/api/src/tasks/task-completion-participants.ts`, `tasks-validation.ts`, `tasks-query-params.ts`, `tasks.types.ts` (no Nest/pg imports).

 * **Fat HTTP layer owns SQL + policy.** Worst API files: `posts.controller.ts` (2741), `stats.controller.ts` (1709), `user-hierarchy.service.ts` (1675), `database.init.ts` (1374), `community-group-challenges.controller.ts` (1097), `chat.controller.ts` (813), `rides.controller.ts` (779). `items-delivery.service.ts` is misplaced under `controllers/`.

 * **Privilege checks are inconsistent inside the same controller (authorization-in-one-file smell).** Chat JWT conversation list binds `:userId` to self while the guest branch dumps any inbox (2026-09-15); JWT send/read checks `ANY(participants)` while the guest branch skips it and `createConversation` returns `SELECT *` of an existing DM; mark-read prefers JWT then falls back to body `user_id` (2026-09-16). Community-group-challenges binds JWT on create/join/entry and correctly gates PUT/DELETE to the creator, but list/`GET :id`/join ignore `is_public`. Posts hide on the public feed only; likes/comments writes are JWT-gated but bind `body.user_id`. Users JWT-gates follow/hierarchy writes but leaves `:id/activities` and `:id/stats` public. Stats admin-gates `analytics/users` but JWT-only-gates `details/:statType`. Rides has no guards at all. `SessionController` is registered in every environment despite DEMO/TEST file comments.

 * **Positive in-folder contrasts (do not regress):** community-group-challenges binds creator from JWT on create/join/entry and uses `CurrentUser()` on `GET user/:userId/stats`, `GET :id/entries`, `PUT :id`, and `DELETE :id`; ChallengesController scopes personal timers to `CurrentUser()`; NotificationsController.`validateOwnership`; knowledge contribution-request binds `req.user.userId`; SyncController user/all/status use `AdminAuthGuard`; post DELETE binds session user without body fallback; authenticated chat send/read checks `ANY(participants)`; authenticated `GET conversations/user/:userId` already denies cross-user reads (do not delete that branch — apply it to guests too); `/session/login` correctly requires argon2 (contrast `/api/users/login`).

 * **Operator matching workspace is specified, not implemented.** `OperatorAuthGuard` exists (`jwt-auth.guard.ts`) but there is no `/api/operator/*` module (zero operator controller files). Anonymity + matching-case audit tables remain SRS §10 gaps.

 * **197 source `.ts`/`.tsx` files exceed the ~200 LOC guideline.** Largest tracked source: `apps/mobile/utils/bubbles_Data.tsx` (4852). Mobile debt hubs: `databaseService.ts` (1225), `apiService.ts` (1055), `enhancedDatabaseService.ts`, duplicate `google_auth/SecureApiService.ts` (1165).

All previously confirmed critical items re-verified at the same line numbers. **New first-class critical:** unauthenticated guest conversation roster harvest — `GET /api/chat/conversations/user/:userId` with no JWT dumps `cc.*`, last-message text, last sender name, participants, and unread counts for any user; the same handler **denies** that access when a JWT is present and the param is not self (auth inversion). Distinct from the already-first-classed pairwise-DM factory (needs both participant UUIDs) and guest `GET …/messages` (needs a conversation id). Near-misses that stay non-new: hide/unhide/update prefer `req.user.userId` so the `body.user_id` fallback is unreachable under `JwtAuthGuard`; dedicated-items `UpdateItemDto` is a class-validator DTO so ValidationPipe `whitelist`/`forbidNonWhitelisted` blocks identifier SQLi (unauthenticated CRUD remains first-classed); `PUT`/`DELETE /api/community-challenges/:id` correctly bind `creator_id` to `CurrentUser()` (908–1072); `NotificationsController.validateOwnership` binds URL `userId` to `req.user`; personal `ChallengesController` scopes CRUD to session (reset-logs still accept a foreign `challengeId` — medium, see Bugs); `SyncController` user/all/status use `AdminAuthGuard`. `anonymity_level` remains an SRS §10 gap. npm: root `npm audit --json` `metadata.vulnerabilities.total` was **57 → 101**; `--workspaces` was **100 → 101**; critical still **4** (`handlebars`, `shell-quote`, `tar`, `websocket-driver`). Files >200 LOC: **196**. Request-path XSS/SQLi patterns remain absent (`dangerouslySetInnerHTML` none; no runtime `eval(` in apps). Unguarded controllers unchanged: community-members, crm, items-delivery, places, rate-limit, redis-test, rides, dedicated-items, collections, session (health excluded).

## 🚨 Critical Vulnerabilities

 * **Unauthenticated guest conversation roster harvest (auth inversion) (2026-09-15).** Class `OptionalAuthGuard` always returns true (`jwt-auth.guard.ts` 338). `GET /api/chat/conversations/user/:userId` (246–330) **does** bind JWT callers to self (`resolvedParamUserId !== resolvedAuthUserId` → access denied, 257–266). The `else` branch (267–269) runs when `req.user` is missing and uses the URL param as-is, then `SELECT cc.*` plus last-message content, last-sender name, participants, and unread counts (`WHERE $1::uuid = ANY(cc.participants)`). Concrete trigger: `GET /api/users` yields victim UUID; `GET /api/chat/conversations/user/<victim>` with no `Authorization` returns the full inbox roster and last-message plaintext; follow with already-first-classed `GET /api/chat/conversations/<id>/messages` (378–387) for history. Logging in as a different user **blocks** the same URL. Distinct from 2026-09-09/10 (pairwise-DM factory needs both participant ids; guest message inject / history dump needs a conversation id). - File: `apps/api/src/controllers/chat.controller.ts` (46, 246–330, 378–387); `apps/api/src/auth/guards/jwt-auth.guard.ts` (338) -> Action: Require JWT on conversation list; bind `:userId` exclusively to `req.user.userId` (same as the authenticated branch); delete the guest `else` path.

 * **Unauthenticated Redis session-key harvest + session-blob PII (2026-09-14, re-verified 2026-09-15).** `SessionController` has no `UseGuards`. `GET /session/stats` (235–249) calls `getSessionStats()` which `KEYS session:*` and returns `{ totalActiveSessions, sessionKeys }` (`session.service.ts` 192–203). Strip the `session:` prefix and call `GET /session/validate/{sessionId}` (136–153) — `validateSession` is an alias of `getSession` and returns the full blob (`userId`, `email`, `username`, `loginTime`, `lastActivity`, `ipAddress`, `userAgent`). Concrete trigger: with Redis up, `GET /session/stats` → for each key, `GET /session/validate/<id>` harvests every live user’s email and UUID with no prior knowledge of a victim id; `DELETE /session/logout/<id>` or `DELETE /session/logout-all/<userId>` then force-logs them out. Distinct from the previously first-classed user-scoped session reads/deletes, which require knowing a UUID first. File comment already warns this controller must not ship. - File: `apps/api/src/auth/controllers/session.controller.ts` (136–249); `apps/api/src/auth/services/session.service.ts` (91–93, 192–203) -> Action: Remove `/session` from production builds (or require admin JWT); never return raw Redis keys or full session blobs; bind logout to the caller’s own session.

 * **JWT-gated social-engagement actor spoof (2026-09-13, re-verified 2026-09-15).** `JwtAuthGuard` is not enough. `POST /api/posts/:postId/like` (1343–1396) reads `body.user_id` and INSERTs/DELETEs `post_likes` for that id with no `req.user` bind. `POST /api/posts/:postId/comments` (1573–1643) INSERTs `post_comments.user_id` from the same body field. `POST /api/posts/:postId/comments/:commentId/like` (2152–2209) does the same for `comment_likes`. Concrete trigger: any valid JWT user A calls `POST /api/posts/<id>/comments` with `{ "user_id": "<victim>", "text": "..." }` and the comment is attributed to the victim; the same body forges or removes the victim’s post/comment likes. Contrast: post DELETE (2626–2663) binds `getSessionUserId(req)` and does not fall back to the body. Complements the previously first-classed comment PUT/DELETE spoof (1985–2058) and follow `follower_id` spoof. - File: `apps/api/src/controllers/posts.controller.ts` (1343–1396, 1573–1643, 2152–2209) -> Action: Bind like/comment actors exclusively to `req.user.userId`; reject a mismatched body `user_id`; stop requiring the client to send `user_id`.

 * **Private community-challenge join/write ignores `is_public` (2026-09-11, re-verified 2026-09-15).** Class-level `JwtAuthGuard` is not enough. Default list applies `AND COALESCE(c.is_public, true) = true` only when `creator_id` is omitted (`community-group-challenges.controller.ts` 232–238). `GET :id` (496–546) returns `c.*`, creator name/avatar, and the participant roster with no public/membership check. `POST :id/join` (574–616) selects only `id, is_active` and inserts the caller as a participant. `POST :id/entries` (667–685) accepts any participant. Concrete trigger: authenticated user A calls `GET /api/community-challenges?creator_id=<B>` (or guesses a UUID), then `POST /api/community-challenges/<id>/join`, then `POST /<id>/entries` with a value. B’s private challenge (no feed post, 138–141) now has a stranger participant and attacker-written entries. Contrast: `PUT :id` / `DELETE :id` correctly require `creator_id === CurrentUser()` (908–1072). - File: `apps/api/src/controllers/community-group-challenges.controller.ts` (183–238, 496–546, 560–631, 651–677) -> Action: Keep the public filter even when `creator_id` is set unless the caller is that creator or an admin; require membership or `is_public` on `GET :id`; reject `join` when `is_public = false` unless invited/creator.

 * **Unauthenticated identifier-only account takeover via `POST /api/users/resolve-id`.** No `JwtAuthGuard`. Supplying a known `email`, `google_id`, or `firebase_uid` looks up `user_profiles`, optionally **links** a caller-supplied `firebase_uid`/`google_id` onto that row, then **mints a full JWT pair** for that user. If Admin SDK is initialized and no local row matches, `tryAutoCreateUserFromFirebase` calls `admin.auth().getUser(firebase_uid)` **without an ID token** and provisions a KC user + tokens. Concrete trigger: `POST /api/users/resolve-id` with `{ "email": "<victim>" }` returns tokens with the victim’s `roles`. - File: `apps/api/src/controllers/users.controller.ts` (183–188) → `apps/api/src/services/user-auth.service.ts` (`resolveUserId` 270–342, `linkResolveIdentifiers` 580–627, `buildResolveSuccessResponse` 645–672) -> Action: Remove token minting from resolve-id; require a verified ID token; never link identifiers from an unauthenticated body.

 * **Primary mobile login accepts email-only (password verification skipped, including empty string).** `POST /api/users/login` verifies argon2 **only when both** `loginData.password` and `user.password_hash` are truthy (223–231). Omitting `password`, sending `password: ""`, or targeting a null hash falls through to `success: true` and returns email, phone, roles, and `parent_manager_id`. `/auth/login` correctly rejects missing hash and invalid passwords. Combined with resolve-id, the documented mobile sequence is an email-only takeover. Contrasts SRS §2.1.2. - File: `apps/api/src/controllers/users.controller.ts` (116–118); `apps/api/src/services/user-auth.service.ts` (190–263, especially 223–231) -> Action: Always require a non-empty password; fail closed if hash is missing; never return `success: true` without `argon2.verify`.

 * **Unauthenticated root-admin bootstrap via committed fallback email (identity-source split).** `KC_ROOT_ADMIN_EMAIL_FALLBACK` is committed in `kc-root-admin.defaults.ts`. Unauthenticated `POST /api/users/register` with that email sets `initialRoles = ["user", "admin"]` (101–102). Unauthenticated `POST /api/users/login` with the same email runs `array_append(roles, 'admin')` **before** the optional password check (212–220), then succeeds without a password. `getRootAdminEmail()` reads only `ROOT_ADMIN_EMAIL` (empty if unset) and is used solely to skip `roles` writes. The PUT role/hierarchy **block** (281–297) compares a **hardcoded Gmail literal**, not the env var and not the shared constant. Setting `ROOT_ADMIN_EMAIL` to a different mailbox does not stop bootstrap of the fallback address. - File: `apps/api/src/config/kc-root-admin.defaults.ts`; `apps/api/src/services/user-auth.service.ts` (101–102, 212–231); `apps/api/src/services/user-profile.service.ts` (52–56, 281–297, 349–361) -> Action: Single source of truth for root-admin identity; require verified secret/env match plus password; never mutate roles before `argon2.verify`.

 * **Unauthenticated register binds attacker-chosen Firebase UID.** `POST /api/users/register` has no guard. INSERT writes `userData.firebase_uid || userData.id || null` into `user_profiles.firebase_uid` (139). Password is optional (97–99). The victim’s later Firebase ID-token path attaches the attacker’s KC row. - File: `apps/api/src/services/user-auth.service.ts` (97–99, 139) -> Action: Ignore client `firebase_uid`/`id` on public register; require a verified Firebase ID token before binding.

 * **JWT-gated profile mass-assignment + password IDOR (`PUT /api/users/:id`).** `UpdateUserBody` accepts `password`, `roles`, and `firebase_uid`. Controller uses `JwtAuthGuard` only — **no ownership check and no `req.user` binding**. Lookup matches UUID **or** email / `firebase_uid` / `google_id` (267). Root-admin block covers roles/hierarchy only; `password` and `firebase_uid` are still written (303–347). Any JWT (including one minted by resolve-id) can reset any other user’s password or steal their Firebase identity. - File: `apps/api/src/controllers/users.controller.ts` (126–133); `apps/api/src/services/user-profile.service.ts` (18–32, 267, 281–361) -> Action: Bind `:id` to `req.user.userId` unless admin; strip `password`/`roles`/`firebase_uid` from the public DTO; extend the root-admin carve-out to password and identity fields.

 * **Unauthenticated user directory and profile PII.** `GET /api/users`, `GET /api/users/:id`, `GET /api/users/search`, and `GET /api/users/stats/summary` have no guards. `getUserById` / `searchUsers` return email, phone, and roles. ## 🐞 Bugs & Logic Issues

 * **Unauthenticated posts feed treats query `user_id` as the viewer.** `GET /api/posts` has no guard. `feed_scope=friends` plus `user_id` filters to that user’s own posts and the people they follow (776–782) and the same id drives `is_liked`. Recommendation: Require JWT; bind viewer exclusively to `req.user.userId`; delete or auth-gate the likes/check and `viewer_id` query.

 * **Ride booking approval oversell.** `PUT /api/rides/bookings/:bookingId/status` (505–555) sets `approved` then only flips the ride to `full` after the fact — it does not reject when `approved + requested > available_seats`. Concurrent books can oversell. Recommendation: `SELECT … FOR UPDATE` and reject when remaining seats are insufficient.

 * **Task hours-report catch returns success.** `GET /api/tasks/hours-report/:managerId` catch returns `success: true` with empty zeros, hiding failures. Recommendation: Return `success: false` and a generic error.

 * **Items-delivery / dedicated-items / collections static-route shadows.** `GET /api/items-delivery/:id` is declared before `GET requests`, so `GET /api/items-delivery/requests` hits `getItemById("requests")`. Dedicated-items `GET :id` shadows `GET search`. Collections `GET :collection` precedes `GET popular-collections` / `GET cache-stats` (those return 400 Invalid collection). Recommendation: Declare static routes before parameterized `:id` / `:collection`.

 * **`loginUser` / JWT guard never consult `user_profiles.is_active`.** Deactivated rows can still obtain a session via email-only login or an existing refresh token. Recommendation: Fail closed on `is_active = false` in login, resolve-id, refresh, and `JwtAuthGuard`.

 * **Anonymity filtering is specified but not implemented.** SRS §2.5.7 / NFR §3.2 require server-side redaction for `anonymity_level < 4`. The column is still absent from posts DDL (SRS §10). Public feed returns author `id` / `name` / `avatar_url` for every post. Recommendation: Add the column + feed/by-id projection per SRS; do not treat this as a new product feature in a security hotfix PR.

 * **Chat mark-read falls back to body `user_id`.** `POST /api/chat/conversations/:id/read-all` uses `req.user?.userId || body?.user_id`. With `OptionalAuthGuard` always-true, an unauthenticated caller who knows a participant id can mark that victim’s receipts read. Recommendation: Require JWT; bind the reader exclusively to `req.user.userId`.

 * **Personal-challenge reset-log `challengeId` is not ownership-checked.** `POST /api/challenges/reset-logs` overwrites `createDto.userId` from the JWT (507) then INSERTs any `challengeId` with no `challenges.user_id` match. A caller can attach reset-log rows to another user’s timer (own `user_id` on the log). Recommendation: INSERT only when `challenge_id` belongs to `CurrentUser()`.

 * **ClosedRoute task-type / duplicate handling.** `apps/mobile/bottomBarScreens/profile/ClosedRoute.tsx` still uses an inline `require` of `databaseService`, `console.error`, and a loose `user?: any` prop. Duplicate-task skip only compares `taskData.id` after mapping posts as `type === 'task'`. Recommendation: Use the shared logger; unify closed-content type tags; drop the inline `require`.

 * **Hand-rolled JWT signature compare is not constant-time.** `verifyTokenSignature` (`jwt.service.ts` 308) uses `!==` on the HMAC digest. Combined with the committed `JWT_SECRET` in `railway.toml.dev`, this is secondary to secret rotation. Recommendation: Use `crypto.timingSafeEqual` after length-checking; still rotate the committed secret.

## 🏗️ Architecture & Clean Code

 * **No Domain / Application / Infrastructure folders** under `apps/` or `packages/` (count 0). Target in `docs/SSOT/CODE_QUALITY/layers-and-boundaries.md` is Infrastructure → Application → Domain. The monorepo remains NestJS feature folders + RN screens; `packages/` still only `config-eslint`. Closest pure islands remain `apps/api/src/tasks/task-completion-participants.ts`, `tasks-validation.ts`, `tasks-query-params.ts`, `tasks.types.ts` (no Nest/pg imports).

 * **Fat HTTP layer owns SQL + policy.** Worst API files: `posts.controller.ts` (2741), `stats.controller.ts` (1709), `user-hierarchy.service.ts` (1675), `database.init.ts` (1374), `community-group-challenges.controller.ts` (1097), `chat.controller.ts` (813), `rides.controller.ts` (779). `items-delivery.service.ts` is misplaced under `controllers/`.

 * **Privilege checks are inconsistent inside the same controller (authorization-in-one-file smell).** Chat JWT conversation list binds `:userId` to self while the guest branch dumps any inbox (2026-09-15); JWT send/read checks `ANY(participants)` while the guest branch skips it and `createConversation` returns `SELECT *` of an existing DM. Community-group-challenges binds JWT on create/join/entry and correctly gates PUT/DELETE to the creator, but list/`GET :id`/join ignore `is_public`. Posts hide on the public feed only; likes/comments writes are JWT-gated but bind `body.user_id`. Users JWT-gates follow/hierarchy writes but leaves `:id/activities` and `:id/stats` public. Stats admin-gates `analytics/users` but JWT-only-gates `details/:statType`. Rides has no guards at all. `SessionController` is registered in every environment despite DEMO/TEST file comments.

 * **Positive in-folder contrasts (do not regress):** community-group-challenges binds creator from JWT on create/join/entry and uses `CurrentUser()` on `GET user/:userId/stats`, `GET :id/entries`, `PUT :id`, and `DELETE :id`; ChallengesController scopes personal timers to `CurrentUser()`; NotificationsController.`validateOwnership`; knowledge contribution-request binds `req.user.userId`; SyncController user/all/status use `AdminAuthGuard`; post DELETE binds session user without body fallback; authenticated chat send/read checks `ANY(participants)`; authenticated `GET conversations/user/:userId` already denies cross-user reads (do not delete that branch — apply it to guests too).

 * **Operator matching workspace is specified, not implemented.** `OperatorAuthGuard` exists (`jwt-auth.guard.ts`) but there is no `/api/operator/*` module. Anonymity + matching-case audit tables remain SRS §10 gaps.

 * **196 source `.ts`/`.tsx` files exceed the ~200 LOC guideline.** Largest tracked source: `apps/mobile/utils/bubbles_Data.tsx` (4852). Mobile debt hubs: `databaseService.ts` (1225), `apiService.ts` (1055), `enhancedDatabaseService.ts`, duplicate `google_auth/SecureApiService.ts` (1165).
