## 🚨 Critical Vulnerabilities

 * **Unauthenticated identifier-only account takeover via `POST /api/users/resolve-id`.** No `JwtAuthGuard`. Supplying a known `email`, `google_id`, or `firebase_uid` looks up `user_profiles`, optionally **links** a caller-supplied `firebase_uid`/`google_id` onto that row, then **mints a full JWT pair** (`accessToken` + `refreshToken`) for that user. If Admin SDK is initialized and no local row matches, `tryAutoCreateUserFromFirebase` calls `admin.auth().getUser(firebase_uid)` **without an ID token** and provisions a KC user + tokens from that UID. Concrete trigger: `POST /api/users/resolve-id` with `{ "email": "<victim>" }` returns tokens with the victim’s `roles`. SRS §2.1.6 currently documents this minting behavior — the spec itself should be tightened to require proof of possession. - File: `apps/api/src/controllers/users.controller.ts` (183–188) → `apps/api/src/services/user-auth.service.ts` (`resolveUserId` 270–342, `linkResolveIdentifiers` 580–627, `buildResolveSuccessResponse` 645–672) -> Action: Remove token minting from resolve-id; require a verified ID token; never link identifiers from an unauthenticated body.

 * **Primary mobile login accepts email-only (password verification skipped, including empty string).** `POST /api/users/login` verifies argon2 **only when both** `loginData.password` and `user.password_hash` are truthy (223–231). Omitting `password`, sending `password: ""`, or targeting a null hash falls through to `success: true` and returns email, phone, roles, and `parent_manager_id`. `/auth/login` correctly rejects missing hash and invalid passwords. Combined with resolve-id, the documented mobile sequence is an email-only takeover. Contrasts SRS §2.1.2. - File: `apps/api/src/controllers/users.controller.ts` (116–118); `apps/api/src/services/user-auth.service.ts` (190–263, especially 223–231) -> Action: Always require a non-empty password; fail closed if hash is missing; never return `success: true` without `argon2.verify`.

 * **Unauthenticated root-admin bootstrap via committed fallback email (identity-source split).** `KC_ROOT_ADMIN_EMAIL_FALLBACK` is committed in `kc-root-admin.defaults.ts`. Unauthenticated `POST /api/users/register` with that email sets `initialRoles = ["user", "admin"]` (101–102). Unauthenticated `POST /api/users/login` with the same email runs `array_append(roles, 'admin')` **before** the optional password check (212–220), then succeeds without a password. `getRootAdminEmail()` reads only `ROOT_ADMIN_EMAIL` (empty if unset) and is used solely to skip `roles` writes. The PUT role/hierarchy **block** (281–297) compares a **hardcoded Gmail literal**, not the env var and not the shared constant. Setting `ROOT_ADMIN_EMAIL` to a different mailbox does not stop bootstrap of the fallback address. - File: `apps/api/src/config/kc-root-admin.defaults.ts`; `apps/api/src/services/user-auth.service.ts` (101–102, 212–231); `apps/api/src/services/user-profile.service.ts` (52–56, 281–297, 349–361) -> Action: Single source of truth for root-admin identity; require verified secret/env match plus password; never mutate roles before `argon2.verify`.

 * **Unauthenticated register binds attacker-chosen Firebase UID.** `POST /api/users/register` has no guard. INSERT writes `userData.firebase_uid || userData.id || null` into `user_profiles.firebase_uid` (139). Password is optional (97–99). The victim’s later Firebase ID-token path attaches the attacker’s KC row. - File: `apps/api/src/services/user-auth.service.ts` (97–99, 139) -> Action: Ignore client `firebase_uid`/`id` on public register; require a verified Firebase ID token before binding.

 * **JWT-gated profile mass-assignment + password IDOR (`PUT /api/users/:id`).** `UpdateUserBody` accepts `password`, `roles`, and `firebase_uid`. Controller uses `JwtAuthGuard` only — **no ownership check and no `req.user` binding**. Lookup matches UUID **or** email / `firebase_uid` / `google_id` (267). Root-admin block covers roles/hierarchy only; `password` and `firebase_uid` are still written (303–347). Any JWT (including one minted by resolve-id) can reset any other user’s password or steal their Firebase identity. - File: `apps/api/src/controllers/users.controller.ts` (126–133); `apps/api/src/services/user-profile.service.ts` (18–32, 267, 281–361) -> Action: Bind `:id` to `req.user.userId` unless admin; strip `password`/`roles`/`firebase_uid` from the public DTO; extend the root-admin carve-out to password and identity fields.

 * **Unauthenticated user directory and profile PII.** `GET /api/users`, `GET /api/users/:id`, `GET /api/users/search`, and `GET /api/users/stats/summary` have no guards. `getUserById` / `searchUsers` return email, phone, and roles. `GET /api/users/stats/summary` also returns `SUM(total_donations_amount) as total_platform_donations` plus weekly/monthly active counts (`user-stats.service.ts` 150–175). Activity/stats-by-id reads remain first-classed (2026-09-08). - File: `apps/api/src/controllers/users.controller.ts` (40–43, 101–123, 135–149) -> Action: Require auth (and minimize fields) on list/search/profile/summary reads.

 * **Unauthenticated activity stream is a hidden-post / social-graph / financial discovery oracle (2026-09-08).** `GET /api/users/:id/activities` (152–158) has no `UseGuards` and returns `SELECT activity_type, activity_data, created_at FROM user_activities` (`user-stats.service.ts` 35–44) with only a `LIMIT` (default 50). Writers persist sensitive JSONB: hide/unhide `{post_id}` (`posts.controller.ts` 2482–2488, 2568–2574); follow `{followed_user_id}` (`user-follow.service.ts` 58–67); chat `{conversation_id}` (`chat.controller.ts` 218–230); ride `{ride_id, from, to, seats}` (`rides.controller.ts` 178–192); donation `{donation_id, type, amount}` (`donations.controller.ts` 545–557). Complementary `GET /api/users/:id/stats` (160–163) returns `total_money_donated`, `rides_created`, and `rides_booked` (`user-stats.service.ts` 50–148). Concrete trigger: owner calls `POST /api/posts/<id>/hide`; `GET /api/users/<authorId>/activities` (no auth) returns `post_hidden` + the id; `GET /api/posts/<id>` / `.../comments` / `.../likes` then return the hidden content and liker roster (09-06 / 09-07). The same stream enumerates who the victim followed and which conversations they created — those conversation IDs now feed the 09-09 inject. The 09-10 factory/oracle no longer needs this stream to obtain a pairwise DM. - File: `apps/api/src/controllers/users.controller.ts` (152–163); `apps/api/src/services/user-stats.service.ts` (24–148) -> Action: Require JWT; bind `:id` to `req.user.userId` unless admin; never return `activity_data` for `post_hidden` / follows / conversations / money amounts on a public read.

 * **Unauthenticated chat message inject skips participant membership (2026-09-09).** `ChatController` is class-guarded with `OptionalAuthGuard`, whose `canActivate` always returns `true` (`jwt-auth.guard.ts` 338). `POST /api/chat/messages` (`chat.controller.ts` 441–668): when no JWT is present, body `sender_id` is required and used as-is (456–464); after resolving the conversation, the **unauthenticated** branch runs `SELECT id FROM chat_conversations WHERE id = $1` (564–569) and does **not** require the spoofed sender (or any caller) to be in `participants`. The **authenticated** branch correctly requires `$2::uuid = ANY(participants::uuid[])` (555–563). Guest `GET conversations/user/:userId` (267–268) and `GET conversations/:id/messages` (378–387) remain open. Concrete trigger (09-09): `GET /api/users/<victim>/activities` (or `GET /api/chat/conversations/user/<victim>`) discloses a `conversation_id`; `POST /api/chat/messages` with `{ "conversation_id": "<id>", "sender_id": "<any-uuid>", "content": "…" }` inserts into that thread. SRS §2.7.1 documents `OptionalAuthGuard` for **guest read** — it does not authorize unauthenticated writes into arbitrary threads. - File: `apps/api/src/controllers/chat.controller.ts` (45–46, 246–268, 341–387, 441–569); `apps/api/src/auth/guards/jwt-auth.guard.ts` (338) -> Action: Require JWT on all chat writes; always enforce participant membership (authenticated and unauthenticated paths); bind `sender_id` / conversation list subject to `req.user.userId`; keep guest reads off or scoped to public metadata only.

 * **NEW 2026-09-10 — Unauthenticated pairwise-DM factory and existence oracle.** The 09-09 inject still required a known `conversation_id`. `POST /api/chat/conversations` (`chat.controller.ts` 107–244) does not: `OptionalAuthGuard` always returns `true`; when no JWT is present, body `created_by` is required and used as-is (134–141); `created_by` is **not** required to be in `participants` (146–175). The handler first `SELECT * FROM chat_conversations` for the exact participant set (183–196) and, on a hit, returns the existing row (`id`, `participants`, `created_by`, `metadata`, `last_message_id`). On a miss it INSERTs a new conversation (199–214) and writes `user_activities.conversation_created` with `{conversation_id}` (218–231). Complementary `POST /api/chat/messages` without a valid `conversation_id` but with `participants` (481–541) finds or INSERTs that same pairwise (or group) thread using body `sender_id` as `created_by`; the sender is **not** required to be in `participants`. Guest `GET conversations/:id/messages` then dumps `cm.*` plus `sender_name` / `sender_avatar` with only `WHERE id = $1` (378–387). Concrete trigger: `GET /api/users` (unauthenticated directory) yields user IDs A and B; `POST /api/chat/conversations` `{ "participants": ["<A>", "<B>"], "created_by": "<A>" }` returns the existing A–B DM or creates it; `GET /api/chat/conversations/<id>/messages` reads the history; `POST /api/chat/messages` `{ "conversation_id": "<id>", "sender_id": "<A>", "content": "…" }` injects as A (09-09). One-shot variant: `POST /api/chat/messages` `{ "participants": ["<A>", "<B>"], "sender_id": "<A>", "content": "…" }` creates-or-finds and injects without a prior `conversation_id`. The 09-09 chat bullet named `created_by` acceptance as a side note; this pass first-classes the factory/oracle and the sendMessage auto-create path. - File: `apps/api/src/controllers/chat.controller.ts` (107–244, 341–387, 481–541, 564–569); `apps/api/src/auth/guards/jwt-auth.guard.ts` (338) -> Action: Require JWT on conversation create and message send; require `created_by` / `sender_id` ∈ `participants` and equal to `req.user.userId`; never return an existing conversation to a non-participant; delete the guest participants auto-create branch.

 * **Client-supplied hierarchy actors (privilege escalation).** JWT-gated promote/demote/set-manager/manage-hierarchy trust body `requestingAdminId` / `requestingUserId` / `managerId`, not `req.user`. `setManagerEnsureRequesterAdminIfProvided` **skips the admin check** when the id is omitted or not found. `manageHierarchy` applies add/remove with no JWT binding. Unauthenticated `GET eligible-for-promotion/:adminId`, `GET hierarchy/tree`, and `GET :id/hierarchy` leak the org tree (emails included). - File: `apps/api/src/controllers/users.controller.ts` (45–108); `apps/api/src/services/user-hierarchy.service.ts` -> Action: Bind actor to `req.user`; require `AdminAuthGuard`; authenticate tree/eligible reads.

 * **JWT refresh copies stale roles (SRS §2.1.4 violation).** `refreshAccessToken` copies `payload.roles` from the refresh token and never reloads `user_profiles.roles`. Demoted admins keep elevated roles until the 30-day refresh token expires or is revoked. Redis existence **is** checked in `verifyToken`. HMAC compare uses `!==` not `timingSafeEqual` (308). Missing `exp` is treated as not-expired (`payload.exp < now` is false when `exp` is undefined). - File: `apps/api/src/auth/services/jwt.service.ts` (146–177, 308) -> Action: Reload roles from DB on refresh; reject tokens without `exp`; use `timingSafeEqual`.

 * **Three additional unauthenticated login paths besides resolve-id.** (1) Firebase JWKS fallback accepts any Google-signed Firebase ID token unless `FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID` is set (`firebase-admin.service.ts` 11–14, 177–181); fabricated `exp=now+3600` if claim missing (216–219). (2) `POST /auth/google` falls back to `GET oauth2/v3/userinfo` with a raw Bearer access token, hardcodes `emailVerified: true`, and skips `aud` binding (613–698). (3) JwtAuthGuard Firebase fallback (117–134) then looks up `user_profiles` by `firebase_uid`. Combined with register/profile `firebase_uid` mass-assignment this is account takeover. - File: `apps/api/src/auth/services/firebase-admin.service.ts`; `apps/api/src/auth/controllers/auth.controller.ts` (613–698); `apps/api/src/auth/guards/jwt-auth.guard.ts` (117–134, 170–213) -> Action: Require `FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID` and reject tokens for other projects; accept Google **ID tokens** only with `aud` bound to this app; never mint a session from an access token.

 * **JwtAuthGuard shared HS256-header rate-limit bucket + unauthenticated plant-block.** `checkRateLimit(token.substring(0, 16), "api_access")` (`jwt-auth.guard.ts` 96–114). Issued header is always `{alg:HS256,typ:JWT}` so the first 16 chars are constant. 100 req/60s then 5-min block is **global** for every JWT user and is thrown as `UnauthorizedException` (401); mobile `authFetchInterceptor` clears the session on 401. Unauthenticated `DELETE /rate-limit/clear` deletes the shared window and block keys. Unauthenticated `POST /rate-limit/custom` passes client `rule` + `customKey` into `applyCustomRateLimit` and can plant `blocked:api_access:<shared-prefix>` with attacker `blockDurationMs` — two calls log every JWT user out. `POST /rate-limit/stress-test` accepts unbounded `delayMs` (HTTP timeout 30s). `ThrottlerModule` is registered without a global `APP_GUARD` (zero matches under `apps/api/src`); only Auth/Notifications opt in. Primary mobile `POST /api/users/login` and `POST /api/users/register` are unthrottled. - File: `apps/api/src/auth/guards/jwt-auth.guard.ts` (96–114); `apps/api/src/controllers/rate-limit.controller.ts`; `apps/api/src/app.module.ts` (72–77) -> Action: Key rate limits by `userId` (or IP for anonymous); require admin on `/rate-limit/*`; register `ThrottlerGuard` as `APP_GUARD`; throttle `/api/users/login` and `/register`.

 * **JWT-gated actor spoof on posts, donations, and tasks.** Like (`toggleLike` 1345–1406), comment create (1573–1584), comment like (2152–2217), comment PUT (1975–2026), and comment DELETE (2054–2087) bind owner from body/query `user_id`, not `req.user`. `POST /api/donations` uses body `donor_id` and for `type==="money"` increments that user’s `total_donations_amount` (478–534). JWT-gated `PUT`/`DELETE /api/donations/:id` have no owner/admin check (698–746). `POST /api/tasks/:id/log-hours` UPSERTs as body `user_id` (384–445). JWT-gated `GET /api/tasks` is an unscoped list (74–146). `GET :id` / `:id/subtasks` / `:id/tree` (191–249) embed `creator_details` / `assignees_details` emails (`tasks-read.service.ts` 48–59) with no owner/assignee/admin check. `GET /api/tasks/hours-report/:managerId` (568–587) has no owner/admin check and returns org-tree names/user IDs/hours/task titles. Follow `POST`/`DELETE /api/users/:id/follow` writes body `follower_id` (`user-follow.service.ts` 19–34). - File: `apps/api/src/controllers/posts.controller.ts`; `apps/api/src/controllers/donations.controller.ts`; `apps/api/src/tasks/tasks.controller.ts`; `apps/api/src/tasks/tasks-read.service.ts`; `apps/api/src/services/user-follow.service.ts` -> Action: Bind every actor id to `req.user.userId`; scope task reads to owner/assignee/admin; require admin for hours-report.

 * **JWT-gated community-challenge IDOR and private-list leak.** `GET /api/community-challenges` skips `is_public` when query `creator_id` is set (232–238). `GET :id` (496–546) and `POST :id/join` (574–590) also omit `is_public`. `GET /api/community-challenges/daily-tracker` uses query `user_id` instead of `CurrentUser()` (288–336) and returns victim streaks/entries. Contrast: `GET user/:userId/stats` and `GET :id/entries` correctly use `CurrentUser()`. - File: `apps/api/src/controllers/community-group-challenges.controller.ts` -> Action: Always apply `is_public` (or membership) on list/get/join; bind daily-tracker to `CurrentUser()`.

 * **JWT-gated stats/details PII dump vs admin analytics + unauthenticated summary trio.** `GET /api/stats/details/:statType` (834–981) dumps emails (`totalUsers` 862–876 LIMIT 500) and donor names/amounts to any JWT. Contrast: `GET /api/stats/analytics/users` is `AdminAuthGuard` (498–499). Unauthenticated `GET /api/stats/analytics/categories` sums donation money. Unauthenticated `GET /api/stats/real-time` returns `users_online` + last-hour activity and uses `FULL OUTER JOIN rides ON 1=1` (803–809) — cartesian D×R, inflated counts + unauthenticated DoS. Unauthenticated `POST /api/stats/track-visit` (373–401) increments site_visits. Unauthenticated `GET /api/donations/stats/summary` (806–831) returns 30-day `total_money` / `unique_donors`; unauthenticated `GET /api/rides/stats/summary` (656–692) returns 30-day unique drivers, `avg_price`, and approved booking seats. - File: `apps/api/src/controllers/stats.controller.ts`; `apps/api/src/controllers/donations.controller.ts` (806–831); `apps/api/src/controllers/rides.controller.ts` (656–692) -> Action: Admin-gate details; auth-gate analytics/real-time/summaries; replace `ON 1=1` with independent counts.

 * **Unauthenticated rides driver PII + write path + booking oversell.** No `UseGuards` in file. `GET /api/rides` selects `up.phone as driver_phone` (249). `GET :id` also selects `up.email as driver_email` (350). `GET user/:userId?type=passenger` returns `driver_phone` (640). `POST /api/rides` (47–225) trusts body `driver_id`; non-UUID values INSERT `user_profiles` at `${driver_id}@legacy.com` (80–118). `PUT :id` (695–736) updates title/seats/price/`status` of any ride. `DELETE :id` (738–755) cancels any ride. Book spoofs `passenger_id`; approve does not reject when capacity is exceeded (505–555). - File: `apps/api/src/controllers/rides.controller.ts` -> Action: Require JWT on all ride writes; bind driver/passenger to `req.user`; never INSERT `user_profiles` from an unauthenticated body; `SELECT … FOR UPDATE` and reject oversell; strip phone/email from public GET.

 * **Unauthenticated community-members `contact_info` dump.** No `UseGuards`. `GET /api/community-members` (186–245) and `GET :id` (247–273) `SELECT` `contact_info` (email/phone). `POST` / `PATCH` / `DELETE` remain unauthenticated writes (294–458). - File: `apps/api/src/controllers/community-members.controller.ts` -> Action: Require `AdminAuthGuard`; never return `contact_info` on public GET.

 * **Unauthenticated collections `userId=all` JSONB dump.** No `UseGuards` on `ItemsController`. `GET /api/collections/:collection` calls `listAll` when `query.userId === "all"` **or** when `userId` is omitted and `collection === "links"` (57–62). `listAll` (`items.service.ts` 227–277) runs `SELECT data FROM %I` with **no `user_id` predicate**. `ALLOWED_COLLECTIONS` includes `users`, `chats`, `messages`, `notifications`, `settings`. Unauthenticated POST/PUT/DELETE remain open. `GET :collection` is registered before static `GET popular-collections` / `GET cache-stats`, so those helpers return 400 Invalid collection. - File: `apps/api/src/items/items.controller.ts` (43–87); `apps/api/src/items/items.service.ts` (15–47, 227–277) -> Action: Require JWT; bind CRUD to `req.user.userId`; delete or admin-gate `userId=all` and the unauthenticated `links` dump; reorder static routes before `:collection`.

 * **Unauthenticated CRM `SELECT *` contact dump.** No `UseGuards`. `GET /api/crm` (106–147) runs `SELECT * FROM crm_contacts`. `POST` / `PATCH` / `DELETE` remain unauthenticated (149–267). - File: `apps/api/src/controllers/crm.controller.ts` -> Action: Require `AdminAuthGuard`; bind `created_by` to JWT on writes.

 * **Unauthenticated hidden-post bypass on user-posts, by-id, and comments (2026-09-06).** The public feed applies `(p.status IS NULL OR p.status != 'hidden')` (`posts.controller.ts` 754). Owner hide (`POST /api/posts/:postId/hide`, JWT + owner, 2434–2480) sets `status = 'hidden'`. `GET /api/posts/user/:userId` uses `WHERE p.author_id = $1` only (1159–1161) and still embeds `ride_data` / task / metadata. `GET /api/posts/:postId` uses `WHERE p.id = $1` only (1944–1945). `GET :postId/comments` (1726–1772) ignores `posts.status`. Concrete trigger: hide a post then `GET /api/posts/user/<authorId>` still returns it. - File: `apps/api/src/controllers/posts.controller.ts` (754 vs 1023–1167, 1726–1772, 1813–1955, 2434–2480) -> Action: Apply the hidden-status predicate on user-posts, by-id, likes, comments, and the activity stream unless the caller is the author or an admin.

 * **Hidden-post liker roster remains public (2026-09-07).** `GET /api/posts/:postId/likes` (1463–1520) has no `UseGuards` and no join on `posts.status`. It returns liker `id` / `name` / `avatar_url` plus a total count for **any** `postId`, including rows the owner just hid. `GET :postId/likes/check/:userId` (1527–1546) is the same like-state oracle on a hidden post. Concrete trigger: owner calls `POST /api/posts/<id>/hide`; `GET /api/posts` omits the row; `GET /api/posts/<id>/likes` still lists everyone who liked it. The 09-08 activity stream discloses the hidden `post_id` so an attacker does not need to guess it. - File: `apps/api/src/controllers/posts.controller.ts` (1463–1546 vs 754, 2434–2480) -> Action: 404 (or empty) likes/check/comments when `posts.status = 'hidden'` unless the caller is the author or an admin; bind `likes/check` to JWT.

 * **Unauthenticated donations list / by-user / detail PII.** `GET /api/donations` `SELECT d.*` (577–661) bulk-dumps amount, `donor_id`, metadata, location; query `status` overrides the active-only default. `GET /api/donations/user/:userId` (782–804) returns `d.*` history. `GET /api/donations/:id` returns `donor_phone` + `donor_email` (667–696). - File: `apps/api/src/controllers/donations.controller.ts` -> Action: Auth-gate list/by-user/detail; strip donor phone/email from public reads; do not honor a public `status` override that expands the dump.

 * **Fully unguarded write surfaces (items-delivery, dedicated-items, session logout-all, places proxy).** No `UseGuards` on those controllers. Items-delivery: `POST` trusts body `owner_id` (32–71); `PUT`/`DELETE :id` are unscoped (185–196); `POST :id/reserve` and `POST requests` create requests as any client `userId`; `POST :id/deliver` (241–258) sets `status='delivered'` with no owner check and may complete a request as body `userId`. `GET :id` (180) precedes `GET requests` (216) so the request list is unreachable. Dedicated-items: unauthenticated CRUD; `GET :id` (69) shadows `GET search` (166) and `GET category/:category` (147). Session `GET user/:userId`, `DELETE logout/:sessionId`, `DELETE logout-all/:userId` are unauthenticated. Places `/autocomplete`, `/place-details`, `/search-stats` proxy `GOOGLE_API_KEY`; `/place-details` interpolates `place_id` without `encodeURIComponent` (75); `/search-stats` runs Redis `KEYS` over search activity. Redis-test (get/set/delete/keys) is registered only when `NODE_ENV !== production` (`app.module.ts` 122) — Railway `railway.toml.dev` uses `NODE_ENV=development`, so it is live on that service. Knowledge-link `POST /api/donations/knowledge/links` remains public; DELETE checks admin roles in-handler. - File: `apps/api/src/controllers/items-delivery.controller.ts`; `apps/api/src/items/dedicated-items.controller.ts`; `apps/api/src/auth/controllers/session.controller.ts`; `apps/api/src/controllers/places.controller.ts` (9–103) -> Action: Add `JwtAuthGuard` (admin where appropriate); bind owners to JWT; encode `place_id`; disable redis-test and session demo in deployed environments.

 * **Admin-files list ACL too weak.** `GET /api/admin-files` and `GET folders` are `JwtAuthGuard` only; POST/DELETE correctly use `AdminAuthGuard`. Any authenticated user can list Finance/HR file URLs. - File: `apps/api/src/controllers/admin-files.controller.ts` (80–140 vs 142–203) -> Action: Put list/folders behind `AdminAuthGuard`.

 * **Request-path `DROP TABLE ... CASCADE`.** `ensurePostsTable` (invoked from GET/POST post routes) can `DROP TABLE IF EXISTS posts CASCADE` when legacy columns are detected (78), plus likes/comments drops (309, 373–374). `tasks-schema.service.ts` (41) can drop `posts` via task side-effects. `DatabaseInit` drops donations/rides on startup (568, 670) when it decides the schema is legacy. Concrete trigger: any traffic that hits `ensurePostsTable` while the live table is missing `id` or `author_id`. - File: `apps/api/src/controllers/posts.controller.ts` (78, 309, 373–374); `apps/api/src/tasks/tasks-schema.service.ts` (41); `apps/api/src/database/database.init.ts` (568, 670) -> Action: Never DROP on a request path; gate destructive DDL behind an explicit offline migration.

 * **Committed credentials, backups, and env fingerprints.** `apps/api/railway.toml.dev` line 34 commits a `JWT_SECRET`. `docs/SSOT/runbooks/api/environment-separation.md` documents a production JWT secret (L102 is a placeholder; L126 is a real-looking value). `main.ts` 149–218 fingerprints env using committed DB/Redis password/host **substrings** (do not copy values). 49 tracked JSON backups under `apps/api/data-backups/20251224-162421/` include `user_profiles` keys (email/phone/`password_hash`). - File: `apps/api/railway.toml.dev` (34); `apps/api/src/main.ts` (149–218); `apps/api/data-backups/` -> Action: Rotate all fingerprinted credentials; replace substring detection with an explicit `ENVIRONMENT` flag; purge backups from git history; move JWT secrets to the secret store.

## 🐞 Bugs & Logic Issues

 * **Unauthenticated posts feed treats query `user_id` as the viewer.** `GET /api/posts` has no guard. `feed_scope=friends` plus `user_id` filters to that user’s own posts and the people they follow (`posts.controller.ts` 776–782) and the same id drives `is_liked` (793–823). Concrete trigger: `GET /api/posts?feed_scope=friends&user_id=<victim>` enumerates the victim’s follow graph among recent authors and whether they liked each returned post. `GET /api/posts/:postId?viewer_id=` is the same like-state oracle. Recommendation: Require JWT; bind viewer exclusively to `req.user.userId`; delete or auth-gate the likes/check and `viewer_id` query.

 * **Ride booking approval oversell.** `PUT /api/rides/bookings/:bookingId/status` (505–555) sets `approved` then only flips the ride to `full` after the fact — it does not reject when `approved + requested > available_seats`. Concurrent books can oversell. Recommendation: `SELECT … FOR UPDATE` and reject when remaining seats are insufficient.

 * **Task hours-report catch returns success.** `GET /api/tasks/hours-report/:managerId` catch returns `success: true` with empty zeros, hiding failures. Recommendation: Return `success: false` and a generic error.

 * **Items-delivery / dedicated-items static-route shadows.** `GET /api/items-delivery/:id` is declared before `GET requests`, so `GET /api/items-delivery/requests` hits `getItemById("requests")`. Dedicated-items `GET :id` shadows `GET search` and `GET category/:category`. Recommendation: Declare static routes before parameterized `:id`.

 * **Collections static-route shadow.** `GET /api/collections/:collection` precedes `GET popular-collections` and `GET cache-stats` (those return 400 Invalid collection). `GET user-activity/:userId` is 2-segment and still reachable. Recommendation: Move static helpers above `:collection`.

 * **ClosedRoute task-type / duplicate handling.** `apps/mobile/bottomBarScreens/profile/ClosedRoute.tsx` still uses `require('../../utils/databaseService')` inside the component (36), `console.error` (316), and a loose `user?: any` prop. Duplicate-task skip (338) only compares `taskData.id` after mapping posts as `type === 'task'` — remaining type inconsistency can still double-count closed tasks vs task posts. Recommendation: Use the shared logger; unify closed-content type tags; drop the inline `require`.

 * **Client-facing `error.message` leaks.** Posts catch blocks (~1168–1182, ~1704–1716), tasks, dedicated-items, items.controller, and JwtAuthGuard Firebase verify (211–213) return raw `error.message` to clients. Recommendation: Map to generic errors; log details server-side only.

 * **Knowledge-link POST remains public.** `POST /api/donations/knowledge/links` accepts unauthenticated URLs (max 2048) and optional spoofed `createdByUserId`. DELETE correctly checks admin roles in-handler. Recommendation: JWT-gate create; ignore client `createdByUserId`.

 * **Places `place_id` is unencoded.** `GET /place-details` interpolates `place_id` into the Google URL without `encodeURIComponent` (75), enabling query-parameter injection against the Places API key. Recommendation: Encode the parameter; auth-gate the proxy.

 * **Chat mark-read falls back to body `user_id`.** `POST /api/chat/conversations/:id/read-all` uses `req.user?.userId || body?.user_id` (679). With `OptionalAuthGuard` always-true, an unauthenticated caller who knows a participant id can mark that victim’s receipts read (participant check at 697 still applies). Recommendation: Require JWT; bind the reader exclusively to `req.user.userId`.

## 🏗️ Architecture & Clean Code

 * **Clean Architecture target is unmet.** `docs/SSOT/CODE_QUALITY/layers-and-boundaries.md` requires Infrastructure → Application → Domain (inward). Scan of `apps/` and `packages/` found **zero** `/domain`, `/application`, or `/infrastructure` folders. Nest feature folders and RN screens/utils own SQL, HTTP, and policy in the same files. Closest pure islands remain `apps/api/src/tasks/task-completion-participants.ts`, `tasks-validation.ts`, `tasks-query-params.ts`, `tasks.types.ts` (no Nest/pg imports). `packages/` still only `config-eslint`.

 * **Privilege checks are inconsistent inside the same controller (authorization-in-one-file smell).** `ChatController.createConversation` returns an existing pairwise DM to any guest who supplies the two user IDs (183–196) and `sendMessage` auto-creates a thread from body `participants` without requiring the sender to be a member (481–541) — same file as the JWT branch that correctly checks `ANY(participants)` (555–563). `ChatController.sendMessage` also skips membership on the guest inject path (564–569). `PostsController` hides on the public feed only (754) and skips hide on user-posts / by-id / comments / likes; hide also writes a public `user_activities` row that the unauthenticated users controller then serves. `UsersController` JWT-gates follow/hierarchy writes but leaves `:id/activities` and `:id/stats` public. `StatsController` admin-gates `analytics/users` but JWT-only-gates `details/:statType`. `CommunityGroupChallengesController` binds `CurrentUser()` on stats/entries but query `user_id` on daily-tracker. `DonationsController` JWT-gates writes but binds `donor_id` from the body. `RidesController` has no guards at all.

 * **Fat HTTP/SQL files (LOC, apps+packages excluding node_modules/dist/spec/test).** `posts.controller.ts` (2741), `stats.controller.ts` (1709), `user-hierarchy.service.ts` (1675), `database.init.ts` (1374), `community-group-challenges.controller.ts` (1097), `auth.controller.ts` (1029), `chat.controller.ts` (813), `rides.controller.ts` (779). Mobile hubs: `bubbles_Data.tsx` (4852), `databaseService.ts` (1225), `SettingsScreen.tsx` (1220), `SecureApiService.ts` (1165) vs `apiService.ts` (1055). **196** source files exceed the ~200 LOC aim. `ItemsDeliveryService` is misplaced under `controllers/`.

 * **Positive contrasts (do not regress).** `ChallengesController` scopes CRUD to `CurrentUser()`. `NotificationsController.validateOwnership` binds URL `userId` to `req.user` (admins may read others). Knowledge contribution-request binds `req.user.userId`. Sync user/all/status use `AdminAuthGuard`. Post DELETE binds `getSessionUserId(req)` without a body fallback. Community-challenge join/entry creator binding and `GET user/:userId/stats` / `GET :id/entries` use `CurrentUser()`. Authenticated chat send/read **does** check `ANY(participants)` — keep that branch and apply it to conversation create, the participants auto-create path, and the guest inject path.

 * **SRS gaps still open** (`docs/SSOT/SRS/10-gaps-and-assumptions.md`): no `anonymity_level` column / filtering; no `/api/operator/*` module; `OperatorAuthGuard` exists but is unused; events/organizations schema without controllers; custom JWT instead of a battle-tested library. §2.7.1’s “guest read access” wording conflicts with NFR §3.2 data minimization and should be tightened so it cannot be read as authorizing unauthenticated conversation create, DM existence oracles, or writes into arbitrary threads.

## 🚨 Critical Vulnerabilities

 * **Unauthenticated identifier-only account takeover via `POST /api/users/resolve-id`.** No `JwtAuthGuard`. Supplying a known `email`, `google_id`, or `firebase_uid` looks up `user_profiles`, optionally **links** a caller-supplied `firebase_uid`/`google_id` onto that row, then **mints a full JWT pair** (`accessToken` + `refreshToken`) for that user. If Admin SDK is initialized and no local row matches, `tryAutoCreateUserFromFirebase` calls `admin.auth().getUser(firebase_uid)` **without an ID token** and provisions a KC user + tokens from that UID. Concrete trigger: `POST /api/users/resolve-id` with `{ "email": "<victim>" }` returns tokens with the victim’s `roles`. SRS §2.1.6 currently documents this minting behavior — the spec itself should be tightened to require proof of possession. - File: `apps/api/src/controllers/users.controller.ts` (183–188) → `apps/api/src/services/user-auth.service.ts` (`resolveUserId` 270–342, `linkResolveIdentifiers` 580–627, `buildResolveSuccessResponse` 645–672) -> Action: Remove token minting from resolve-id; require a verified ID token; never link identifiers from an unauthenticated body.

 * **Primary mobile login accepts email-only (password verification skipped, including empty string).** `POST /api/users/login` verifies argon2 **only when both** `loginData.password` and `user.password_hash` are truthy (223–231). Omitting `password`, sending `password: ""`, or targeting a null hash falls through to `success: true` and returns email, phone, roles, and `parent_manager_id`. `/auth/login` correctly rejects missing hash and invalid passwords. Combined with resolve-id, the documented mobile sequence is an email-only takeover. Contrasts SRS §2.1.2. - File: `apps/api/src/controllers/users.controller.ts` (116–118); `apps/api/src/services/user-auth.service.ts` (190–263, especially 223–231) -> Action: Always require a non-empty password; fail closed if hash is missing; never return `success: true` without `argon2.verify`.

 * **Unauthenticated root-admin bootstrap via committed fallback email (identity-source split).** `KC_ROOT_ADMIN_EMAIL_FALLBACK` is committed in `kc-root-admin.defaults.ts`. Unauthenticated `POST /api/users/register` with that email sets `initialRoles = ["user", "admin"]` (101–102). Unauthenticated `POST /api/users/login` with the same email runs `array_append(roles, 'admin')` **before** the optional password check (212–220), then succeeds without a password. `getRootAdminEmail()` reads only `ROOT_ADMIN_EMAIL` (empty if unset) and is used solely to skip `roles` writes. The PUT role/hierarchy **block** (281–297) compares a **hardcoded Gmail literal**, not the env var and not the shared constant. Setting `ROOT_ADMIN_EMAIL` to a different mailbox does not stop bootstrap of the fallback address. - File: `apps/api/src/config/kc-root-admin.defaults.ts`; `apps/api/src/services/user-auth.service.ts` (101–102, 212–231); `apps/api/src/services/user-profile.service.ts` (52–56, 281–297, 349–361) -> Action: Single source of truth for root-admin identity; require verified secret/env match plus password; never mutate roles before `argon2.verify`.

 * **Unauthenticated register binds attacker-chosen Firebase UID.** `POST /api/users/register` has no guard. INSERT writes `userData.firebase_uid || userData.id || null` into `user_profiles.firebase_uid` (139). Password is optional (97–99). The victim’s later Firebase ID-token path attaches the attacker’s KC row. - File: `apps/api/src/services/user-auth.service.ts` (97–99, 139) -> Action: Ignore client `firebase_uid`/`id` on public register; require a verified Firebase ID token before binding.

 * **JWT-gated profile mass-assignment + password IDOR (`PUT /api/users/:id`).** `UpdateUserBody` accepts `password`, `roles`, and `firebase_uid`. Controller uses `JwtAuthGuard` only — **no ownership check and no `req.user` binding**. Lookup matches UUID **or** email / `firebase_uid` / `google_id` (267). Root-admin block covers roles/hierarchy only; `password` and `firebase_uid` are still written (303–347). Any JWT (including one minted by resolve-id) can reset any other user’s password or steal their Firebase identity. - File: `apps/api/src/controllers/users.controller.ts` (126–133); `apps/api/src/services/user-profile.service.ts` (18–32, 267, 281–361) -> Action: Bind `:id` to `req.user.userId` unless admin; strip `password`/`roles`/`firebase_uid` from the public DTO; extend the root-admin carve-out to password and identity fields.

 * **Unauthenticated user directory and profile PII.** `GET /api/users`, `GET /api/users/:id`, `GET /api/users/search`, and `GET /api/users/stats/summary` have no guards. `getUserById` / `searchUsers` return email, phone, and roles. `GET /api/users/stats/summary` also returns `SUM(total_donations_amount) as total_platform_donations` plus weekly/monthly active counts (`user-stats.service.ts` 150–175). Activity/stats-by-id reads remain first-classed (2026-09-08). - File: `apps/api/src/controllers/users.controller.ts` (40–43, 101–123, 135–149) -> Action: Require auth (and minimize fields) on list/search/profile/summary reads.

 * **Unauthenticated activity stream is a hidden-post / social-graph / financial discovery oracle (2026-09-08).** `GET /api/users/:id/activities` (152–158) has no `UseGuards` and returns `SELECT activity_type, activity_data, created_at FROM user_activities` (`user-stats.service.ts` 35–44) with only a `LIMIT` (default 50). Writers persist sensitive JSONB: hide/unhide `{post_id}` (`posts.controller.ts` 2482–2488, 2568–2574); follow `{followed_user_id}` (`user-follow.service.ts` 58–67); chat `{conversation_id}` (`chat.controller.ts` 218–230); ride `{ride_id, from, to, seats}` (`rides.controller.ts` 178–192); donation `{donation_id, type, amount}` (`donations.controller.ts` 545–557). Complementary `GET /api/users/:id/stats` (160–163) returns `total_money_donated`, `rides_created`, and `rides_booked` (`user-stats.service.ts` 50–148). Concrete trigger: owner calls `POST /api/posts/<id>/hide`; `GET /api/users/<authorId>/activities` (no auth) returns `post_hidden` + the id; `GET /api/posts/<id>` / `.../comments` / `.../likes` then return the hidden content and liker roster (09-06 / 09-07). The same stream enumerates who the victim followed and which conversations they created — those conversation IDs now feed the 09-09 inject. - File: `apps/api/src/controllers/users.controller.ts` (152–163); `apps/api/src/services/user-stats.service.ts` (24–148) -> Action: Require JWT; bind `:id` to `req.user.userId` unless admin; never return `activity_data` for `post_hidden` / follows / conversations / money amounts on a public read.

 * **NEW 2026-09-09 — Unauthenticated chat message inject skips participant membership.** `ChatController` is class-guarded with `OptionalAuthGuard`, whose `canActivate` always returns `true` (`jwt-auth.guard.ts` 338). `POST /api/chat/messages` (`chat.controller.ts` 441–668): when no JWT is present, body `sender_id` is required and used as-is (456–464); after resolving the conversation, the **unauthenticated** branch runs `SELECT id FROM chat_conversations WHERE id = $1` (564–569) and does **not** require the spoofed sender (or any caller) to be in `participants`. The **authenticated** branch correctly requires `$2::uuid = ANY(participants::uuid[])` (555–563). `POST /api/chat/conversations` still accepts body `created_by` when no JWT is present (134–141) and does not require `created_by` to be in `participants`. Guest `GET conversations/user/:userId` (267–268) and `GET conversations/:id/messages` (378–387) remain open. Concrete trigger: `GET /api/users/<victim>/activities` (or `GET /api/chat/conversations/user/<victim>`) discloses a `conversation_id`; `POST /api/chat/messages` with `{ "conversation_id": "<id>", "sender_id": "<any-uuid>", "content": "…" }` inserts into that thread. The 09-08 chat bullet named sender impersonation and guest reads; this pass first-classes the missing membership check on the write path (564–569 vs 555–563). SRS §2.7.1 documents `OptionalAuthGuard` for **guest read** — it does not authorize unauthenticated writes into arbitrary threads. - File: `apps/api/src/controllers/chat.controller.ts` (45–46, 107–141, 246–268, 341–387, 441–569); `apps/api/src/auth/guards/jwt-auth.guard.ts` (338) -> Action: Require JWT on all chat writes; always enforce participant membership (authenticated and unauthenticated paths); bind `sender_id` / `created_by` / conversation list subject to `req.user.userId`; keep guest reads off or scoped to public metadata only.

 * **Client-supplied hierarchy actors (privilege escalation).** JWT-gated promote/demote/set-manager/manage-hierarchy trust body `requestingAdminId` / `requestingUserId` / `managerId`, not `req.user`. `setManagerEnsureRequesterAdminIfProvided` **skips the admin check** when the id is omitted or not found. `manageHierarchy` applies add/remove with no JWT binding.  * **JWT refresh copies stale roles (SRS §2.1.4 violation).** `refreshAccessToken` copies `payload.roles` from the refresh token and never reloads `user_profiles.roles`. Demoted admins keep elevated roles until the 30-day refresh token expires or is revoked. Redis existence **is** checked in `verifyToken`. HMAC compare uses `!==` not `timingSafeEqual` (308). Missing `exp` is treated as not-expired (`payload.exp < now` is false when `exp` is undefined). - File: `apps/api/src/auth/services/jwt.service.ts` (146–177, 308) -> Action: Reload roles from DB on refresh; reject tokens without `exp`; use `timingSafeEqual`.

(2) `POST /auth/google` falls back to `GET oauth2/v3/userinfo` with a raw Bearer access token, hardcodes `emailVerified: true`, and skips `aud` binding (613–698). (3) JwtAuthGuard Firebase fallback (117–134) then looks up `user_profiles` by `firebase_uid`. Combined with register/profile `firebase_uid` mass-assignment this is account takeover. - File: `apps/api/src/auth/services/firebase-admin.service.ts`; `apps/api/src/auth/controllers/auth.controller.ts` (613–698); `apps/api/src/auth/guards/jwt-auth.guard.ts` (117–134, 170–213) -> Action: Require `FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID` and reject tokens for other projects; accept Google **ID tokens** only with `aud` bound to this app; never mint a session from an access token.

 * **JwtAuthGuard shared HS256-header rate-limit bucket + unauthenticated plant-block.** `checkRateLimit(token.substring(0, 16), "api_access")` (`jwt-auth.guard.ts` 96–114). Issued header is always `{alg:HS256,typ:JWT}` so the first 16 chars are constant. 100 req/60s then 5-min block is **global** for every JWT user and is thrown as `UnauthorizedException` (401); mobile `authFetchInterceptor` clears the session on 401. Unauthenticated `DELETE /rate-limit/clear` deletes the shared window and block keys. Unauthenticated `POST /rate-limit/custom` passes client `rule` + `customKey` into `applyCustomRateLimit` and can plant `blocked:api_access:<shared-prefix>` with attacker `blockDurationMs` — two calls log every JWT user out. `POST /rate-limit/stress-test` accepts unbounded `delayMs` (HTTP timeout 30s). `ThrottlerModule` is registered without a global `APP_GUARD` (zero matches under `apps/api/src`); only Auth/Notifications opt in. Redis-test (get/set/delete/keys) is registered only when `NODE_ENV !== production` (`app.module.ts` 122) — Railway `railway.toml.dev` uses `NODE_ENV=development`, so it is live on that service. CASCADE`.** `ensurePostsTable` (invoked from GET/POST post routes) can `DROP TABLE IF EXISTS posts CASCADE` when legacy columns are detected (78), plus likes/comments drops (309, 373–374). `tasks-schema.service.ts` (41) can drop `posts` via task side-effects. `DatabaseInit` drops donations/rides on startup (568, 670) when it decides the schema is legacy. ## 🐞 Bugs & Logic Issues

 * **Unauthenticated posts feed treats query `user_id` as the viewer.** `GET /api/posts` has no guard. `feed_scope=friends` plus `user_id` filters to that user’s own posts and the people they follow (`posts.controller.ts` 776–782) and the same id drives `is_liked` (793–823). Concrete trigger: `GET /api/posts?feed_scope=friends&user_id=<victim>` enumerates the victim’s follow graph among recent authors and whether they liked each returned post. `GET /api/posts/:postId?viewer_id=` is the same like-state oracle. Recommendation: Require JWT; bind viewer exclusively to `req.user.userId`; delete or auth-gate the likes/check and `viewer_id` query.

 * **Ride booking approval oversell.** `PUT /api/rides/bookings/:bookingId/status` (505–555) sets `approved` then only flips the ride to `full` after the fact — it does not reject when `approved + requested > available_seats`. Concurrent books can oversell. Recommendation: `SELECT … FOR UPDATE` and reject when remaining seats are insufficient.

 * **Task hours-report catch returns success.** `GET /api/tasks/hours-report/:managerId` catch returns `success: true` with empty zeros, hiding failures. Recommendation: Return `success: false` and a generic error.

 * **Items-delivery / dedicated-items static-route shadows.** `GET /api/items-delivery/:id` is declared before `GET requests`, so `GET /api/items-delivery/requests` hits `getItemById("requests")`. Dedicated-items `GET :id` shadows `GET search` and `GET category/:category`. Recommendation: Declare static routes before parameterized `:id`.

 * **Collections static-route shadow.** `GET /api/collections/:collection` precedes `GET popular-collections` and `GET cache-stats` (those return 400 Invalid collection). `GET user-activity/:userId` is 2-segment and still reachable. Recommendation: Move static helpers above `:collection`.

 * **ClosedRoute task-type / duplicate handling.** `apps/mobile/bottomBarScreens/profile/ClosedRoute.tsx` still uses `require('../../utils/databaseService')` inside the component (36), `console.error` (316), and a loose `user?: any` prop. Duplicate-task skip (338) only compares `taskData.id` after mapping posts as `type === 'task'` — remaining type inconsistency can still double-count closed tasks vs task posts. Recommendation: Use the shared logger; unify closed-content type tags; drop the inline `require`.

 * **Client-facing `error.message` leaks.** Posts catch blocks (~1168–1182, ~1704–1716), tasks, dedicated-items, items.controller, and JwtAuthGuard Firebase verify (211–213) return raw `error.message` to clients. Recommendation: Map to generic errors; log details server-side only.

 * **Knowledge-link POST remains public.** `POST /api/donations/knowledge/links` accepts unauthenticated URLs (max 2048) and optional spoofed `createdByUserId`. DELETE correctly checks admin roles in-handler. Recommendation: JWT-gate create; ignore client `createdByUserId`.

 * **Places `place_id` is unencoded.** `GET /place-details` interpolates `place_id` into the Google URL without `encodeURIComponent` (75), enabling query-parameter injection against the Places API key. Recommendation: Encode the parameter; auth-gate the proxy.

 * **Chat mark-read falls back to body `user_id`.** `POST /api/chat/conversations/:id/read-all` uses `req.user?.userId || body?.user_id` (679). With `OptionalAuthGuard` always-true, an unauthenticated caller who knows a participant id can mark that victim’s receipts read (participant check at 697 still applies). Recommendation: Require JWT; bind the reader exclusively to `req.user.userId`.

## 🏗️ Architecture & Clean Code

 * **Clean Architecture target is unmet.** `docs/SSOT/CODE_QUALITY/layers-and-boundaries.md` requires Infrastructure → Application → Domain (inward). Scan of `apps/` and `packages/` found **zero** `/domain`, `/application`, or `/infrastructure` folders. Nest feature folders and RN screens/utils own SQL, HTTP, and policy in the same files. Closest pure islands remain `apps/api/src/tasks/task-completion-participants.ts`, `tasks-validation.ts`, `tasks-query-params.ts`, `tasks.types.ts` (no Nest/pg imports). `packages/` still only `config-eslint`.

 * **Privilege checks are inconsistent inside the same controller (authorization-in-one-file smell).** `ChatController.sendMessage` enforces participant membership only when a JWT is present (555–563) and skips it on the guest branch (564–569) — same file, opposite policy. `PostsController` hides on the public feed only (754) and skips hide on user-posts / by-id / comments / likes; hide also writes a public `user_activities` row that the unauthenticated users controller then serves. `UsersController` JWT-gates follow/hierarchy writes but leaves `:id/activities` and `:id/stats` public. `StatsController` admin-gates `analytics/users` but JWT-only-gates `details/:statType`. `CommunityGroupChallengesController` binds `CurrentUser()` on stats/entries but query `user_id` on daily-tracker. `DonationsController` JWT-gates writes but binds `donor_id` from the body. `RidesController` has no guards at all.

 * **Fat HTTP/SQL files (LOC, apps+packages excluding node_modules/dist/spec/test).** `posts.controller.ts` (2741), `stats.controller.ts` (1709), `user-hierarchy.service.ts` (1675), `database.init.ts` (1374), `community-group-challenges.controller.ts` (1097), `auth.controller.ts` (1029), `chat.controller.ts` (813), `rides.controller.ts` (779). Mobile hubs: `bubbles_Data.tsx` (4852), `databaseService.ts` (1225), `SettingsScreen.tsx` (1220), `SecureApiService.ts` (1165) vs `apiService.ts` (1055). **196** source files exceed the ~200 LOC aim. `ItemsDeliveryService` is misplaced under `controllers/`.

 * **Positive contrasts (do not regress).** `ChallengesController` scopes CRUD to `CurrentUser()`. `NotificationsController.validateOwnership` binds URL `userId` to `req.user` (admins may read others). Knowledge contribution-request binds `req.user.userId`. Sync user/all/status use `AdminAuthGuard`. Post DELETE binds `getSessionUserId(req)` without a body fallback. Community-challenge join/entry creator binding and `GET user/:userId/stats` / `GET :id/entries` use `CurrentUser()`. Authenticated chat send/read **does** check `ANY(participants)` — keep that branch and apply it to the guest path.

 * **SRS gaps still open** (`docs/SSOT/SRS/10-gaps-and-assumptions.md`): no `anonymity_level` column / filtering; no `/api/operator/*` module; `OperatorAuthGuard` exists but is unused; events/organizations schema without controllers; custom JWT instead of a battle-tested library. §2.7.1’s “guest read access” wording conflicts with NFR §3.2 data minimization and should be tightened so it cannot be read as authorizing unauthenticated writes.

## 🚨 Critical Vulnerabilities

 * **Unauthenticated identifier-only account takeover via `POST /api/users/resolve-id`.** No `JwtAuthGuard`. Supplying a known `email`, `google_id`, or `firebase_uid` looks up `user_profiles`, optionally **links** a caller-supplied `firebase_uid`/`google_id` onto that row, then **mints a full JWT pair** (`accessToken` + `refreshToken`) for that user. If Admin SDK is initialized and no local row matches, `tryAutoCreateUserFromFirebase` calls `admin.auth().getUser(firebase_uid)` **without an ID token** and provisions a KC user + tokens from that UID. Concrete trigger: `POST /api/users/resolve-id` with `{ "email": "<victim>" }` returns tokens with the victim’s `roles`. SRS §2.1.6 currently documents this minting behavior — the spec itself should be tightened to require proof of possession. - File: `apps/api/src/controllers/users.controller.ts` (183–188) → `apps/api/src/services/user-auth.service.ts` (`resolveUserId` 270–342, `linkResolveIdentifiers` 580–627, `buildResolveSuccessResponse` 645–672) -> Action: Remove token minting from resolve-id; require a verified ID token; never link identifiers from an unauthenticated body.

 * **Primary mobile login accepts email-only (password verification skipped, including empty string).** `POST /api/users/login` verifies argon2 **only when both** `loginData.password` and `user.password_hash` are truthy (223–231). Omitting `password`, sending `password: ""`, or targeting a null hash falls through to `success: true` and returns email, phone, roles, and `parent_manager_id`. `/auth/login` correctly rejects missing hash and invalid passwords. Combined with resolve-id, the documented mobile sequence is an email-only takeover. Contrasts SRS §2.1.2. - File: `apps/api/src/controllers/users.controller.ts` (116–118); `apps/api/src/services/user-auth.service.ts` (190–263, especially 223–231) -> Action: Always require a non-empty password; fail closed if hash is missing; never return `success: true` without `argon2.verify`.

 * **Unauthenticated root-admin bootstrap via committed fallback email (identity-source split).** `KC_ROOT_ADMIN_EMAIL_FALLBACK` is committed in `kc-root-admin.defaults.ts`. Unauthenticated `POST /api/users/register` with that email sets `initialRoles = ["user", "admin"]` (101–102). Unauthenticated `POST /api/users/login` with the same email runs `array_append(roles, 'admin')` **before** the optional password check (212–220), then succeeds without a password. `getRootAdminEmail()` reads only `ROOT_ADMIN_EMAIL` (empty if unset) and is used solely to skip `roles` writes. The PUT role/hierarchy **block** (281–297) compares a **hardcoded Gmail literal**, not the env var and not the shared constant. Setting `ROOT_ADMIN_EMAIL` to a different mailbox does not stop bootstrap of the fallback address. - File: `apps/api/src/config/kc-root-admin.defaults.ts`; `apps/api/src/services/user-auth.service.ts` (101–102, 212–231); `apps/api/src/services/user-profile.service.ts` (52–56, 281–297, 349–361) -> Action: Single source of truth for root-admin identity; require verified secret/env match plus password; never mutate roles before `argon2.verify`.

 * **Unauthenticated register binds attacker-chosen Firebase UID.** `POST /api/users/register` has no guard. INSERT writes `userData.firebase_uid || userData.id || null` into `user_profiles.firebase_uid` (139). Password is optional (97–99). The victim’s later Firebase ID-token path attaches the attacker’s KC row. - File: `apps/api/src/services/user-auth.service.ts` (97–99, 139) -> Action: Ignore client `firebase_uid`/`id` on public register; require a verified Firebase ID token before binding.

 * **JWT-gated profile mass-assignment + password IDOR (`PUT /api/users/:id`).** `UpdateUserBody` accepts `password`, `roles`, and `firebase_uid`. Controller uses `JwtAuthGuard` only — **no ownership check and no `req.user` binding**. Lookup matches UUID **or** email / `firebase_uid` / `google_id` (267). Root-admin block covers roles/hierarchy only; `password` and `firebase_uid` are still written (303–347). Any JWT (including one minted by resolve-id) can reset any other user’s password or steal their Firebase identity. - File: `apps/api/src/controllers/users.controller.ts` (126–133); `apps/api/src/services/user-profile.service.ts` (18–32, 267, 281–361) -> Action: Bind `:id` to `req.user.userId` unless admin; strip `password`/`roles`/`firebase_uid` from the public DTO; extend the root-admin carve-out to password and identity fields.

 * **Unauthenticated user directory and profile PII.** `GET /api/users`, `GET /api/users/:id`, `GET /api/users/search`, and `GET /api/users/stats/summary` have no guards. `getUserById` / `searchUsers` return email, phone, and roles. Activity/stats reads are first-classed below (2026-09-08). - File: `apps/api/src/controllers/users.controller.ts` (40–43, 101–123, 135–149) -> Action: Require auth (and minimize fields) on list/search/profile reads.

 * **NEW 2026-09-08 — Unauthenticated activity stream is a hidden-post / social-graph / financial discovery oracle.** `GET /api/users/:id/activities` (152–158) has no `UseGuards` and returns `SELECT activity_type, activity_data, created_at FROM user_activities` (`user-stats.service.ts` 35–44) with only a `LIMIT` (default 50). Writers persist sensitive JSONB: hide/unhide `{post_id}` (`posts.controller.ts` 2482–2488, 2568–2574); follow `{followed_user_id}` (`user-follow.service.ts` 58–67); chat `{conversation_id}` (`chat.controller.ts` 218–230); ride `{ride_id, from, to, seats}` (`rides.controller.ts` 178–192); donation `{donation_id, type, amount}` (`donations.controller.ts` 545–557). Complementary `GET /api/users/:id/stats` (160–163) returns `total_money_donated`, `rides_created`, and `rides_booked` (`user-stats.service.ts` 50–148). Concrete trigger: owner calls `POST /api/posts/<id>/hide`; `GET /api/users/<authorId>/activities` (no auth) returns `post_hidden` + the id; `GET /api/posts/<id>` / `.../comments` / `.../likes` then return the hidden content and liker roster (09-06 / 09-07). The same stream enumerates who the victim followed and which conversations they created (guest chat then reads those IDs). The 09-07 directory-PII bullet listed these routes but only described email/phone/roles. - File: `apps/api/src/controllers/users.controller.ts` (152–163); `apps/api/src/services/user-stats.service.ts` (24–148) -> Action: Require JWT; bind `:id` to `req.user.userId` unless admin; never return `activity_data` for `post_hidden` / follows / conversations / money amounts on a public read.

 * **Client-supplied hierarchy actors (privilege escalation).** JWT-gated promote/demote/set-manager/manage-hierarchy trust body `requestingAdminId` / `requestingUserId` / `managerId`, not `req.user`. `setManagerEnsureRequesterAdminIfProvided` **skips the admin check** when the id is omitted or not found. `manageHierarchy` applies add/remove with no JWT binding. Unauthenticated `GET eligible-for-promotion/:adminId`, `GET hierarchy/tree`, and `GET :id/hierarchy` leak the org tree. - File: `apps/api/src/controllers/users.controller.ts` (45–108); `apps/api/src/services/user-hierarchy.service.ts` -> Action: Bind actor to `req.user`; require `AdminAuthGuard`; authenticate tree/eligible reads.

 * **JWT refresh copies stale roles (SRS §2.1.4 violation).** `refreshAccessToken` copies `payload.roles` from the refresh token and never reloads `user_profiles.roles`. Demoted admins keep elevated roles until the 30-day refresh token expires or is revoked. Redis existence **is** checked in `verifyToken`. HMAC compare uses `!==` not `timingSafeEqual` (308). Missing `exp` is treated as not-expired (`payload.exp < now` is false when `exp` is undefined). - File: `apps/api/src/auth/services/jwt.service.ts` (146–177, 308) -> Action: Reload roles from DB on refresh; reject tokens without `exp`; use `timingSafeEqual`.

 * **Three additional unauthenticated login paths besides resolve-id.** (1) Firebase JWKS fallback accepts any Google-signed Firebase ID token unless `FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID` is set (`firebase-admin.service.ts` 11–14, 177–181); fabricated `exp=now+3600` if claim missing (216–219). (2) `POST /auth/google` falls back to `GET oauth2/v3/userinfo` with a raw Bearer access token, hardcodes `emailVerified: true`, and skips `aud` binding (613–698). (3) JwtAuthGuard Firebase fallback (117–134) then looks up `user_profiles` by `firebase_uid`. Combined with register/profile `firebase_uid` mass-assignment this is account takeover. - File: `apps/api/src/auth/services/firebase-admin.service.ts`; `apps/api/src/auth/controllers/auth.controller.ts` (613–698); `apps/api/src/auth/guards/jwt-auth.guard.ts` (117–134, 170–213) -> Action: Require `FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID` and reject tokens for other projects; accept Google **ID tokens** only with `aud` bound to this app; never mint a session from an access token.

 * **JwtAuthGuard shared HS256-header rate-limit bucket + unauthenticated plant-block.** `checkRateLimit(token.substring(0, 16), "api_access")` (`jwt-auth.guard.ts` 96–114). Issued header is always `{alg:HS256,typ:JWT}` so the first 16 chars are constant. 100 req/60s then 5-min block is **global** for every JWT user and is thrown as `UnauthorizedException` (401); mobile `authFetchInterceptor` clears the session on 401. Unauthenticated `DELETE /rate-limit/clear` deletes the shared window and block keys. Unauthenticated `POST /rate-limit/custom` passes client `rule` + `customKey` into `applyCustomRateLimit` and can plant `blocked:api_access:<shared-prefix>` with attacker `blockDurationMs` — two calls log every JWT user out. `POST /rate-limit/stress-test` accepts unbounded `delayMs` (HTTP timeout 30s). `ThrottlerModule` is registered without a global `APP_GUARD`; only Auth/Notifications opt in. Primary mobile `POST /api/users/login` and `POST /api/users/register` are unthrottled. - File: `apps/api/src/auth/guards/jwt-auth.guard.ts` (96–114); `apps/api/src/controllers/rate-limit.controller.ts`; `apps/api/src/app.module.ts` (72–77) -> Action: Key rate limits by `userId` (or IP for anonymous); require admin on `/rate-limit/*`; register `ThrottlerGuard` as `APP_GUARD`; throttle `/api/users/login` and `/register`.

 * **OptionalAuthGuard always allows; unauthenticated chat write + read.** `OptionalAuthGuard.canActivate` returns `true` (`jwt-auth.guard.ts` 338). `ChatController` is class-guarded with it. Unauthenticated `POST /messages` uses body `sender_id` (441–465). Unauthenticated `GET conversations/user/:userId` takes the guest branch (267–268) and dumps that user’s conversations. Unauthenticated `GET conversations/:id/messages` skips the participant check (378–387). `POST conversations` accepts body `created_by` when no JWT is present (134–141). Authenticated sender mismatch is rejected (450–455). - File: `apps/api/src/controllers/chat.controller.ts` (46, 107–141, 246–268, 341–387, 441–465); `apps/api/src/auth/guards/jwt-auth.guard.ts` (338) -> Action: Require JWT on all chat reads/writes; bind `sender_id` / `created_by` / conversation list subject to `req.user.userId`.

 * **JWT-gated actor spoof on posts, donations, and tasks.** Like (`toggleLike` 1345–1406), comment create (1573–1584), comment like (2152–2217), comment PUT (1975–2026), and comment DELETE (2054–2087) bind owner from body/query `user_id`, not `req.user`. `POST /api/donations` uses body `donor_id` and for `type==="money"` increments that user’s `total_donations_amount` (478–534). JWT-gated `PUT`/`DELETE /api/donations/:id` have no owner/admin check (698–746). `POST /api/tasks/:id/log-hours` UPSERTs as body `user_id` (384–445). JWT-gated `GET /api/tasks` is an unscoped list (74–146). `GET :id` / `:id/subtasks` / `:id/tree` (191–249) embed `creator_details` / `assignees_details` emails (`tasks-read.service.ts` 48–59) with no owner/assignee/admin check. `GET /api/tasks/hours-report/:managerId` (568–587) has no owner/admin check and returns org-tree names/user IDs/hours/task titles. - File: `apps/api/src/controllers/posts.controller.ts`; `apps/api/src/controllers/donations.controller.ts`; `apps/api/src/tasks/tasks.controller.ts`; `apps/api/src/tasks/tasks-read.service.ts` -> Action: Bind every actor id to `req.user.userId`; scope task reads to owner/assignee/admin; require admin for hours-report.

 * **JWT-gated community-challenge IDOR and private-list leak.** `GET /api/community-challenges` skips `is_public` when query `creator_id` is set (232–238). `GET :id` (496–546) and `POST :id/join` (574–590) also omit `is_public`. `GET /api/community-challenges/daily-tracker` uses query `user_id` instead of `CurrentUser()` (288–336) and returns victim streaks/entries. Contrast: `GET user/:userId/stats` and `GET :id/entries` correctly use `CurrentUser()`. - File: `apps/api/src/controllers/community-group-challenges.controller.ts` -> Action: Always apply `is_public` (or membership) on list/get/join; bind daily-tracker to `CurrentUser()`.

 * **JWT-gated stats/details PII dump vs admin analytics.** `GET /api/stats/details/:statType` (834–981) dumps emails (`totalUsers` 862–876 LIMIT 500) and donor names/amounts to any JWT. Contrast: `GET /api/stats/analytics/users` is `AdminAuthGuard` (498–499). Unauthenticated `GET /api/stats/analytics/categories` sums donation money. Unauthenticated `GET /api/stats/real-time` returns `users_online` + last-hour activity and uses `FULL OUTER JOIN rides ON 1=1` (803–809) — cartesian D×R, inflated counts + unauthenticated DoS. Unauthenticated `POST /api/stats/track-visit` (373–401) increments site_visits. - File: `apps/api/src/controllers/stats.controller.ts` -> Action: Admin-gate details; auth-gate analytics/real-time; replace `ON 1=1` with independent counts.

 * **Unauthenticated rides driver PII + write path + booking oversell.** No `UseGuards` in file. `GET /api/rides` selects `up.phone as driver_phone` (249). `GET :id` also selects `up.email as driver_email` (350). `GET user/:userId?type=passenger` returns `driver_phone` (640). `POST /api/rides` (47–225) trusts body `driver_id`; non-UUID values INSERT `user_profiles` at `${driver_id}@legacy.com` (80–118). `PUT :id` (695–736) updates title/seats/price/`status` of any ride. `DELETE :id` (738–755) cancels any ride. Book spoofs `passenger_id`; approve does not reject when capacity is exceeded (505–555). - File: `apps/api/src/controllers/rides.controller.ts` -> Action: Require JWT on all ride writes; bind driver/passenger to `req.user`; never INSERT `user_profiles` from an unauthenticated body; `SELECT … FOR UPDATE` and reject oversell; strip phone/email from public GET.

 * **Unauthenticated community-members `contact_info` dump.** No `UseGuards`. `GET /api/community-members` (186–245) and `GET :id` (247–273) `SELECT` `contact_info` (email/phone). `POST` / `PATCH` / `DELETE` remain unauthenticated writes. - File: `apps/api/src/controllers/community-members.controller.ts` -> Action: Require `AdminAuthGuard`; never return `contact_info` on public GET.

 * **Unauthenticated collections `userId=all` JSONB dump.** No `UseGuards` on `ItemsController`. `GET /api/collections/:collection` calls `listAll` when `query.userId === "all"` **or** when `userId` is omitted and `collection === "links"` (57–62). `listAll` (`items.service.ts` 227–277) runs `SELECT data FROM %I` with **no `user_id` predicate**. `ALLOWED_COLLECTIONS` includes `users`, `chats`, `messages`, `notifications`, `settings`. Unauthenticated POST/PUT/DELETE remain open. `GET :collection` is registered before static `GET popular-collections` / `GET cache-stats`, so those helpers return 400 Invalid collection. - File: `apps/api/src/items/items.controller.ts` (43–87); `apps/api/src/items/items.service.ts` (15–47, 227–277) -> Action: Require JWT; bind CRUD to `req.user.userId`; delete or admin-gate `userId=all` and the unauthenticated `links` dump; reorder static routes before `:collection`.

 * **Unauthenticated CRM `SELECT *` contact dump.** No `UseGuards`. `GET /api/crm` (106–147) runs `SELECT * FROM crm_contacts`. `POST` / `PATCH` / `DELETE` remain unauthenticated (149–267). - File: `apps/api/src/controllers/crm.controller.ts` -> Action: Require `AdminAuthGuard`; bind `created_by` to JWT on writes.

 * **Unauthenticated hidden-post bypass on user-posts, by-id, and comments (2026-09-06).** The public feed applies `(p.status IS NULL OR p.status != 'hidden')` (`posts.controller.ts` 754). Owner hide (`POST /api/posts/:postId/hide`, JWT + owner, 2434–2480) sets `status = 'hidden'`. `GET /api/posts/user/:userId` uses `WHERE p.author_id = $1` only (1159–1161) and still embeds `ride_data` / task / metadata. `GET /api/posts/:postId` uses `WHERE p.id = $1` only (1944–1945). `GET :postId/comments` (1726–1772) ignores `posts.status`. Concrete trigger: hide a post then `GET /api/posts/user/<authorId>` still returns it. - File: `apps/api/src/controllers/posts.controller.ts` (754 vs 1023–1167, 1726–1772, 1813–1955, 2434–2480) -> Action: Apply the hidden-status predicate on user-posts, by-id, likes, comments, and the activity stream unless the caller is the author or an admin.

 * **Hidden-post liker roster remains public (2026-09-07).** `GET /api/posts/:postId/likes` (1463–1520) has no `UseGuards` and no join on `posts.status`. It returns liker `id` / `name` / `avatar_url` plus a total count for **any** `postId`, including rows the owner just hid. `GET :postId/likes/check/:userId` (1527–1546) is the same like-state oracle on a hidden post. Concrete trigger: owner calls `POST /api/posts/<id>/hide`; `GET /api/posts` omits the row; `GET /api/posts/<id>/likes` still lists everyone who liked it. The 09-08 activity stream now also discloses the hidden `post_id` so an attacker does not need to guess it. - File: `apps/api/src/controllers/posts.controller.ts` (1463–1546 vs 754, 2434–2480) -> Action: 404 (or empty) likes/check/comments when `posts.status = 'hidden'` unless the caller is the author or an admin; bind `likes/check` to JWT.

 * **Unauthenticated donations list / by-user / detail PII.** `GET /api/donations` `SELECT d.*` (577–661) bulk-dumps amount, `donor_id`, metadata, location; query `status` overrides the active-only default. `GET /api/donations/user/:userId` (782–804) returns `d.*` history. `GET /api/donations/:id` returns `donor_phone` + `donor_email` (667–696). - File: `apps/api/src/controllers/donations.controller.ts` -> Action: Auth-gate list/by-user/detail; strip donor phone/email from public reads; do not honor a public `status` override that expands the dump.

 * **Fully unguarded write surfaces (items-delivery, dedicated-items, session logout-all, places proxy).** No `UseGuards` on those controllers. Items-delivery: `POST` trusts body `owner_id` (32–71); `PUT`/`DELETE :id` are unscoped (185–196); `POST :id/reserve` and `POST requests` create requests as any client `userId`; `POST :id/deliver` (241–258) sets `status='delivered'` with no owner check and may complete a request as body `userId`. `GET :id` (180) precedes `GET requests` (216) so the request list is unreachable. Dedicated-items: unauthenticated CRUD; `GET :id` (69) shadows `GET search` (166) and `GET category/:category` (147). Session `GET user/:userId`, `DELETE logout/:sessionId`, `DELETE logout-all/:userId` are unauthenticated. Places `/autocomplete`, `/place-details`, `/search-stats` proxy `GOOGLE_API_KEY`; `/place-details` interpolates `place_id` without `encodeURIComponent` (75). Redis-test (get/set/delete/keys) is registered only when `NODE_ENV !== production` (`app.module.ts` 122) — Railway `railway.toml.dev` uses `NODE_ENV=development`, so it is live on that service. Knowledge-link `POST /api/donations/knowledge/links` remains public; DELETE checks admin roles in-handler. - File: `apps/api/src/controllers/items-delivery.controller.ts`; `apps/api/src/items/dedicated-items.controller.ts`; `apps/api/src/auth/controllers/session.controller.ts`; `apps/api/src/controllers/places.controller.ts` (9–103) -> Action: Add `JwtAuthGuard` (admin where appropriate); bind owners to JWT; encode `place_id`; disable redis-test and session demo in deployed environments.

 * **Admin-files list ACL too weak.** `GET /api/admin-files` and `GET folders` are `JwtAuthGuard` only; POST/DELETE correctly use `AdminAuthGuard`. Any authenticated user can list Finance/HR file URLs. - File: `apps/api/src/controllers/admin-files.controller.ts` (80–140 vs 142–203) -> Action: Put list/folders behind `AdminAuthGuard`.

 * **Request-path `DROP TABLE ... CASCADE`.** `ensurePostsTable` (invoked from GET/POST post routes) can `DROP TABLE IF EXISTS posts CASCADE` when legacy columns are detected (78), plus likes/comments drops (309, 373–374). `tasks-schema.service.ts` (41) can drop `posts` via task side-effects. `DatabaseInit` drops donations/rides on startup (568, 670) when it decides the schema is legacy. Concrete trigger: any traffic that hits `ensurePostsTable` while the live table is missing `id` or `author_id`. - File: `apps/api/src/controllers/posts.controller.ts` (78, 309, 373–374); `apps/api/src/tasks/tasks-schema.service.ts` (41); `apps/api/src/database/database.init.ts` (568, 670) -> Action: Never DROP on a request path; gate destructive DDL behind an explicit offline migration.

 * **Committed credentials, backups, and env fingerprints.** `apps/api/railway.toml.dev` line 34 commits a `JWT_SECRET`. `docs/SSOT/runbooks/api/environment-separation.md` documents a production JWT secret (L102 is a placeholder; L126 is a real-looking value). `main.ts` 149–218 fingerprints env using committed DB/Redis password/host **substrings** (do not copy values). 49 tracked JSON backups under `apps/api/data-backups/20251224-162421/` include `user_profiles` keys (email/phone/`password_hash`). - File: `apps/api/railway.toml.dev` (34); `apps/api/src/main.ts` (149–218); `apps/api/data-backups/` -> Action: Rotate all fingerprinted credentials; replace substring detection with an explicit `ENVIRONMENT` flag; purge backups from git history; move JWT secrets to the secret store.

## 🐞 Bugs & Logic Issues

 * **Unauthenticated posts feed treats query `user_id` as the viewer.** `GET /api/posts` has no guard. `feed_scope=friends` plus `user_id` filters to that user’s own posts and the people they follow (`posts.controller.ts` 776–782) and the same id drives `is_liked` (793–823). Concrete trigger: `GET /api/posts?feed_scope=friends&user_id=<victim>` enumerates the victim’s follow graph among recent authors and whether they liked each returned post. `GET /api/posts/:postId?viewer_id=` is the same like-state oracle. Recommendation: Require JWT; bind viewer exclusively to `req.user.userId`; delete or auth-gate the likes/check and `viewer_id` query.

 * **Ride booking approval oversell.** `PUT /api/rides/bookings/:bookingId/status` (505–555) sets `approved` then only flips the ride to `full` after the fact — it does not reject when `approved + requested > available_seats`. Concurrent books can oversell. Recommendation: `SELECT … FOR UPDATE` and reject when remaining seats are insufficient.

 * **Task hours-report catch returns success.** `GET /api/tasks/hours-report/:managerId` catch returns `success: true` with empty zeros, hiding failures. Recommendation: Return `success: false` and a generic error.

 * **Items-delivery / dedicated-items static-route shadows.** `GET /api/items-delivery/:id` is declared before `GET requests`, so `GET /api/items-delivery/requests` hits `getItemById("requests")`. Dedicated-items `GET :id` shadows `GET search` and `GET category/:category`. Recommendation: Declare static routes before parameterized `:id`.

 * **Collections static-route shadow.** `GET /api/collections/:collection` precedes `GET popular-collections` and `GET cache-stats` (those return 400 Invalid collection). `GET user-activity/:userId` is 2-segment and still reachable. Recommendation: Move static helpers above `:collection`.

 * **ClosedRoute task-type / duplicate handling.** `apps/mobile/bottomBarScreens/profile/ClosedRoute.tsx` still uses `require('../../utils/databaseService')` inside the component (36), `console.error` (316), and a loose `user?: any` prop. Duplicate-task skip (338) only compares `taskData.id` after mapping posts as `type === 'task'` — remaining type inconsistency can still double-count closed tasks vs task posts. Recommendation: Use the shared logger; unify closed-content type tags; drop the inline `require`.

 * **Client-facing `error.message` leaks.** Posts catch blocks (~1168–1182, ~1704–1716), tasks, dedicated-items, items.controller, and JwtAuthGuard Firebase verify (211–213) return raw `error.message` to clients. Recommendation: Map to generic errors; log details server-side only.

 * **Knowledge-link POST remains public.** `POST /api/donations/knowledge/links` accepts unauthenticated URLs (max 2048) and optional spoofed `createdByUserId`. DELETE correctly checks admin roles in-handler. Recommendation: JWT-gate create; ignore client `createdByUserId`.

 * **Places `place_id` is unencoded.** `GET /place-details` interpolates `place_id` into the Google URL without `encodeURIComponent` (75), enabling query-parameter injection against the Places API key. Recommendation: Encode the parameter; auth-gate the proxy.

## 🏗️ Architecture & Clean Code

 * **Clean Architecture target is unmet.** `docs/SSOT/CODE_QUALITY/layers-and-boundaries.md` requires Infrastructure → Application → Domain (inward). Scan of `apps/` and `packages/` found **zero** `/domain`, `/application`, or `/infrastructure` folders. Nest feature folders and RN screens/utils own SQL, HTTP, and policy in the same files. Closest pure islands remain `apps/api/src/tasks/task-completion-participants.ts`, `tasks-validation.ts`, `tasks-query-params.ts`, `tasks.types.ts` (no Nest/pg imports). `packages/` still only `config-eslint`.

 * **Privilege checks are inconsistent inside the same controller (authorization-in-one-file smell).** `PostsController` hides on the public feed only (754) and skips hide on user-posts / by-id / comments / likes; hide also writes a public `user_activities` row that the unauthenticated users controller then serves. `UsersController` JWT-gates follow/hierarchy writes but leaves `:id/activities` and `:id/stats` public. `StatsController` admin-gates `analytics/users` but JWT-only-gates `details/:statType`. `CommunityGroupChallengesController` binds `CurrentUser()` on stats/entries but query `user_id` on daily-tracker. `DonationsController` JWT-gates writes but binds `donor_id` from the body. `RidesController` has no guards at all.

 * **Fat HTTP/SQL files (LOC, apps+packages excluding node_modules/dist/spec/test).** `posts.controller.ts` (2741), `stats.controller.ts` (1709), `user-hierarchy.service.ts` (1675), `database.init.ts` (1374), `community-group-challenges.controller.ts` (1097), `auth.controller.ts` (1029), `chat.controller.ts` (813), `rides.controller.ts` (779). Mobile hubs: `bubbles_Data.tsx` (4852), `databaseService.ts` (1225), `SettingsScreen.tsx` (1220), `SecureApiService.ts` (1165) vs `apiService.ts` (1055). **196** source files exceed the ~200 LOC aim. `ItemsDeliveryService` is misplaced under `controllers/`.

 * **Positive contrasts (do not regress).** `ChallengesController` scopes CRUD to `CurrentUser()`. `NotificationsController.validateOwnership` binds URL `userId` to `req.user` (admins may read others). Knowledge contribution-request binds `req.user.userId`. Sync user/all/status use `AdminAuthGuard`. Post DELETE binds `getSessionUserId(req)` without a body fallback. Community-challenge join/entry creator binding and `GET user/:userId/stats` / `GET :id/entries` use `CurrentUser()`.

 * **SRS gaps still open** (`docs/SSOT/SRS/10-gaps-and-assumptions.md`): no `anonymity_level` column / filtering; no `/api/operator/*` module; `OperatorAuthGuard` exists but is unused; events/organizations schema without controllers; custom JWT instead of a battle-tested library.
